messages.zh: 那匹白色母马是你的吗？
messages.en: Is that white mare yours?

messages.speaker: Mark (马主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u l-felu ħdejha tagħha wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u l-felu ħdejha tagħha wkoll.
messages.zh: 是的，旁边的小马驹也是它的孩子。
messages.en: Yes, and the foal beside her is hers too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“母马带着小马驹”记住 debba 的主教学义；昆虫义另配图片，指人的贬义另标侮辱语，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something weaker or less strong.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物力量减弱、变得衰弱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa aktar dgħajfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使衰弱；削弱力量。

formal.mt: Il-mard debbel il-ġisem tal-pazjent, li kellu bżonn perjodu twil ta' mistrieħ.
formal.en: The illness weakened the patient's body, and the patient needed a long period of rest.
formal.zh: 疾病使患者身体衰弱，患者需要长时间休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tistrieħ daqshekk illum? Mark: Il-mard debbel il-ġisem tiegħi, u għadni bla saħħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you resting so much today? Mark: The illness weakened my body, and I still have no energy.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天怎么一直在休息？马克：这场病把我的身体拖弱了，我还是没力气。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么一直在休息？
messages.en: Why are you resting so much today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mard debbel il-ġisem tiegħi, u għadni bla saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mard debbel il-ġisem tiegħi, u għadni bla saħħa.
messages.zh: 这场病把我的身体拖弱了，我还是没力气。
messages.en: The illness weakened my body, and I still have no energy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 debbel 配上逐渐下降的体力条：疾病使体力减少，重点记住“使某人或某物变弱”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To negotiate with others in order to reach an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与他人商谈条件，以达成协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tinnegozja ma' oħrajn biex tilħaq ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判；协商条件。
做生意；从事商业交易。
招募工人；招用劳动力。

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant debber mal-fornitur dwar il-prezz u l-kundizzjonijiet tal-ħlas.
formal.en: The representative negotiated with the supplier about the price and payment terms.
formal.zh: 代表与供应商就价格和付款条件进行了谈判。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min debber il-ħaddiema għall-proġett? Mark: Pawlu; sab tliet persuni li jistgħu jibdew għada.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who recruited the workers for the project? Mark: Pawlu did; he found three people who can start tomorrow.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁为这个项目招了工人？马克：保罗；他找到了三个明天就能开工的人。

messages.speaker: Maja (项目同事)
messages.zh: 谁为这个项目招了工人？
messages.en: Who recruited the workers for the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu; sab tliet persuni li jistgħu jibdew għada.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu; sab tliet persuni li jistgħu jibdew għada.
messages.zh: 保罗；他找到了三个明天就能开工的人。
messages.en: Pawlu did; he found three people who can start tomorrow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三张商务场景卡记 debber：桌边谈条件、柜台做买卖、工地招工人；这是词义联想，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 虚弱的；脆弱的；缺乏说服力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Weak in physical strength, ability to resist, or power to persuade.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体力弱、抵抗能力不足，或缺乏说服力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajjef fis-saħħa, fil-ħila li jirreżisti jew fil-ħila li jikkonvinċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 弱的；虚弱的。
虚弱的；无力的。
脆弱的；易受伤害或攻击的。
说服力弱的；不足以令人信服的。

formal.mt: L-argument huwa debboli għax ma jinkludix evidenza biżżejjed biex isostni l-konklużjoni.
formal.en: The argument is weak because it does not include enough evidence to support the conclusion.
formal.zh: 这一论证缺乏说服力，因为其中没有足够的证据支持结论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadek debboli wara l-mard? Mark: Iva, imma llum għandi ftit aktar saħħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you still weak after being ill? Mark: Yes, but I have a little more strength today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你病后还是很虚弱吗？马克：是的，不过今天稍微有力气些了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你病后还是很虚弱吗？
messages.en: Are you still weak after being ill?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma llum għandi ftit aktar saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma llum għandi ftit aktar saħħa.
messages.zh: 是的，不过今天稍微有力气些了。
messages.en: Yes, but I have a little more strength today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 debboli 配三种“力量不足”：身体没力气、防御挡不住、论证说不服；由具体体力联想到抽象说服力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A club or mace used as a weapon, including a metal mace.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作武器的棍棒或钉头锤，也可指金属制的钉头锤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun jew mazza li tintuża bħala arma, u li tista' tkun tal-metall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钉头锤；用于击打的锤头式武器。
棍棒；用作武器的粗棒。
金属制的钉头锤或锤头式武器。
力量；威力；势力。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi debbus tal-ħadid bħala eżempju ta' arma li tintuża għad-daqqiet.
formal.en: The museum displays an iron mace as an example of a weapon used for striking.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一柄铁制钉头锤，作为击打类武器的例子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak wara l-ħġieġ? Pawlu: Debbus tal-ħadid; ħares kemm għandu ras kbira.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that behind the glass? Pawlu: An iron mace; look how big its head is.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：玻璃后面那个是什么？保罗：一柄铁制钉头锤；你看它的锤头多大。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 玻璃后面那个是什么？
messages.en: What is that behind the glass?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Debbus tal-ħadid; ħares kemm għandu ras kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Debbus tal-ħadid; ħares kemm għandu ras kbira.
messages.zh: 一柄铁制钉头锤；你看它的锤头多大。
messages.en: An iron mace; look how big its head is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象展柜中一柄沉重的 debbus，用它的重量记住棍棒、钉头锤，再把“力量”单独联想为抽象义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To discuss terms with another person or party in order to reach an agreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一人或另一方商谈条件，以求达成协议。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiddiskuti l-kundizzjonijiet ma' persuna jew ma' parti oħra biex tilħaq ftehim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 谈判；就条件进行协商。

formal.mt: Ix-xerrej deber mal-bejjiegħ dwar il-prezz qabel ma ffirma l-ftehim.
formal.en: The buyer negotiated with the seller over the price before signing the agreement.
formal.zh: 买方在签署协议前与卖方就价格进行了协商。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark aċċetta l-ewwel prezz? Lara: Le, deber mal-bejjiegħ u qablu fuq prezz aktar baxx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark accept the first price? Lara: No, he negotiated with the seller and they agreed on a lower price.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克接受了最初的报价吗？拉拉：没有，他和卖方商量后，双方谈定了一个更低的价格。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克接受了最初的报价吗？
messages.en: Did Mark accept the first price?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, deber mal-bejjiegħ u qablu fuq prezz aktar baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, deber mal-bejjiegħ u qablu fuq prezz aktar baxx.
messages.zh: 没有，他和卖方商量后，双方谈定了一个更低的价格。
messages.en: No, he negotiated with the seller and they agreed on a lower price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deber 放在买卖双方讨论价格的画面里，按“提出条件、来回协商、争取协议”记忆，并留意它与 debber 的拼写区别。

gloss_zh: 首次亮相；首次公开演出

teaching_sense.en_definition: A first public appearance, especially a performer's first performance before an audience.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 首次公开亮相，尤指表演者第一次面向观众演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-ewwel dehra fil-pubbliku, speċjalment l-ewwel darba li artist jagħti wirja quddiem udjenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 首次亮相；初次登场。

sense_translations.en_definition: debut (a performer's first-time performance to the public)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表演者的首次公开演出。

formal.mt: Il-kantant għamel id-debutt tiegħu fuq il-palk waqt il-kunċert annwali tal-iskola.
formal.en: The singer made his stage debut during the school's annual concert.
formal.zh: 这位歌手在学校的年度音乐会上首次登台演出。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għada se nagħmel id-debutt tiegħi fuq il-palk! Mark: Kemm hu sabiħ! Se niġi narak.
colloquial.en: Lara: Tomorrow I'm making my stage debut! Mark: That's wonderful! I'll come and watch you.
colloquial.zh: Lara：明天我要首次登台演出了！Mark：太好了！我会去看你演出。

messages.speaker: Lara (歌手)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada se nagħmel id-debutt tiegħi fuq il-palk!
messages.mt_standard: Għada se nagħmel id-debutt tiegħi fuq il-palk!
messages.zh: 明天我要首次登台演出了！
messages.en: Tomorrow I'm making my stage debut!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Se niġi narak.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Se niġi narak.
messages.zh: 太好了！我会去看你演出。
messages.en: That's wonderful! I'll come and watch you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象舞台幕布第一次拉开，主角首次面对观众；把 debutt 与“第一次公开登场”整幅画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 献祭宰杀；祭牲；圣体祭献

teaching_sense.en_definition: The slaughter of an animal as a religious offering; also a sacrifice or, in a Eucharistic context, the sacrifice celebrated in the Eucharist.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为宗教献祭而宰杀动物的行为；也可指祭牲、献祭事件，或圣体圣事中的祭献。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-qtil ta' annimal bħala offerta reliġjuża; ukoll sagrifiċċju jew, fil-kuntest tal-Ewkaristija, is-sagrifiċċju ċċelebrat fiha.

sense_translations.en_definition: the slaughter of an animal as a sacrificial offering
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为献祭而宰杀动物的行为。

sense_translations.en_definition: an animal or human sacrifice; an instance of sacrificial slaughter
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用作献祭的动物或人；一次献祭宰杀。
用于圣体圣事语境的“祭献”。

collocations.en: the sacrificial slaughter of an animal

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi d-debħa ta' annimal bħala offerta reliġjuża.
formal.en: The text describes the slaughter of an animal as a religious offering.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了把动物宰杀作为宗教祭品的行为。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser 'debħa' f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Hawn tfisser il-qtil ta' annimal bħala sagrifiċċju.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does 'debħa' mean in this text? Pawlu: Here it means killing an animal as a sacrifice.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章里的 debħa 是什么意思？Pawlu：这里指把动物宰杀用于献祭。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 debħa 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does 'debħa' mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hawn tfisser il-qtil ta' annimal bħala sagrifiċċju.
messages.mt_standard: Hawn tfisser il-qtil ta' annimal bħala sagrifiċċju.
messages.zh: 这里指把动物宰杀用于献祭。
messages.en: Here it means killing an animal as a sacrifice.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 debħa 放进“献祭仪式”的画面记忆：既可指宰杀献祭，也可指祭牲；遇到圣体语境则理解为祭献。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Committed effort and attention given to a person, task, or purpose; also words dedicating a work to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人、任务或目标持续付出的心力与奉献；也指将作品献给某人的献词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-impenn u l-attenzjoni li wieħed jagħti lil persuna, xogħol jew għan; ukoll kliem li bih xogħol jiġi ddedikat lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 投入；尽心奉献；也可指作品中的献词。

formal.mt: L-għalliema wriet dedikazzjoni kbira lejn l-istudenti tagħha matul is-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The teacher showed great dedication to her students throughout the school year.
formal.zh: 这位老师在整个学年中都对学生尽心尽力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min hi d-dedikazzjoni fil-bidu tal-ktieb tiegħek? Lara: Lill-familja tiegħi, għax dejjem għenitni.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is the dedication at the beginning of your book for? Lara: My family, because they've always helped me.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你书开头的献词是写给谁的？Lara：写给我的家人，因为他们一直帮助我。

messages.speaker: Mark (读者)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min hi d-dedikazzjoni fil-bidu tal-ktieb tiegħek?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min hi d-dedikazzjoni fil-bidu tal-ktieb tiegħek?
messages.zh: 你书开头的献词是写给谁的？
messages.en: Who is the dedication at the beginning of your book for?

messages.speaker: Lara (作者)
messages.zh: 写给我的家人，因为他们一直帮助我。
messages.en: My family, because they've always helped me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把心力献给工作，把文字献给家人”记 dedikazzjoni：前者是投入奉献，后者是书中的献词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To push or thrust something through an opening or into a space, often packing it tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西从开口处推入或塞进某个空间，常带有挤紧、塞满的意思。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idaħħal xi ħaġa minn fetħa jew fi spazju billi jimbottaha, spiss jagħfas ħafna affarijiet flimkien.

sense_translations.en_definition: to push sth. through an opening
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物从开口处推入或塞过去。
把东西挤塞进去；紧紧装入。
推；猛推；用力塞入。
硬塞；挤入；塞满。

collocations.en: he pushed the paper through the opening
collocations.zh: 他把纸从开口处塞了进去

collocations.en: he crammed the clothes into the suitcase
collocations.zh: 他把衣服硬塞进了行李箱

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem deffes il-kejbil mill-fetħa dejqa fil-ħajt.
formal.en: The worker pushed the cable through the narrow opening in the wall.
formal.zh: 工人把电缆从墙上的狭窄开口处塞了过去。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn poġġejt il-ġakketta? Mark: Deffistha fil-bagalja, imma issa ma tagħlaqx.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where did you put the jacket? Mark: I crammed it into the suitcase, but now it won't close.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你把外套放哪儿了？Mark：我把它塞进行李箱了，可现在箱子关不上。

messages.speaker: Lara (旅伴)
messages.zh: 你把外套放哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did you put the jacket?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行者)
messages.mt_spoken: Deffistha fil-bagalja, imma issa ma tagħlaqx.
messages.mt_standard: Deffistha fil-bagalja, imma issa ma tagħlaqx.
messages.zh: 我把它塞进行李箱了，可现在箱子关不上。
messages.en: I crammed it into the suitcase, but now it won't close.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象行李箱快满了，还把外套用力塞进去；用这个动作记 deffes 的“推入、硬塞、挤装”几种意思。

gloss_zh: 狭窄花瓶；狭小室内空间

teaching_sense.en_definition: A narrow vase; also a small interior space, such as a cramped house or room.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 瓶身狭窄的花瓶；也可指狭小的室内空间，例如拥挤的小房屋或房间。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vażun dejjaq; ukoll spazju żgħir fuq ġewwa, bħal dar jew kamra dejqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄的花瓶。

sense_translations.en_definition: a small interior (such as a house or room)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭小的内部空间，例如小房屋或小房间。
瓶身狭窄的花瓶。

formal.mt: Fuq l-ixkaffa tqiegħed deffus taċ-ċeramika b'żewġ fjuri bojod.
formal.en: A narrow ceramic vase holding two white flowers was placed on the shelf.
formal.zh: 架子上摆着一个狭窄的陶瓷花瓶，里面插着两朵白花。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema vażun se tpoġġi dawn il-fjuri? Lara: Fid-deffus ħdejn it-tieqa; għandu biżżejjed spazju għalihom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which vase will you put these flowers in? Lara: In the narrow vase by the window; it has enough room for them.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你要把这些花插在哪个花瓶里？Lara：窗边那个窄花瓶里，放这些花空间够了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: F'liema vażun se tpoġġi dawn il-fjuri?
messages.mt_standard: F'liema vażun se tpoġġi dawn il-fjuri?
messages.zh: 你要把这些花插在哪个花瓶里？
messages.en: Which vase will you put these flowers in?

messages.speaker: Lara (屋主)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-deffus ħdejn it-tieqa; għandu biżżejjed spazju għalihom.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-deffus ħdejn it-tieqa; għandu biżżejjed spazju għalihom.
messages.zh: 窗边那个窄花瓶里，放这些花空间够了。
messages.en: In the narrow vase by the window; it has enough room for them.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deffus 配上两张学习图片：一个窄花瓶、一间小房间；用“内部空间狭小”帮助联想，不把联想当成词源。

gloss_zh: 拨探工具；漏斗的狭窄部分

teaching_sense.en_definition: An implement used to poke through a pile of things; also the narrow part of a funnel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在一堆物品中拨探的工具；也指漏斗下部的狭窄部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda biex wieħed iqalleb jew ifittex f'munzell ta' affarijiet; ukoll il-parti dejqa ta' lembut.

sense_translations.en_definition: implement used to poke through a pile of things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来在一堆物品中戳探、拨动的工具。

sense_translations.en_definition: the narrow part of a funnel
sense_translations.zh_definition: 漏斗的狭窄部分。
漏斗下部的狭窄部分。

collocations.en: a metal implement for poking through a pile
collocations.zh: 用于拨探物品堆的金属工具

collocations.en: the narrow part of the funnel

formal.mt: Qabel l-użu, iċċekkja li d-deffusa tal-lembut mhix imblukkata.
formal.en: Before use, check that the narrow part of the funnel is not blocked.
formal.zh: 使用前，请检查漏斗的狭窄部分是否堵塞。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex l-ilma mhux jgħaddi mil-lembut? Lara: Id-deffusa hi mblukkata. Ħa naħsilha.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why isn't the water flowing through the funnel? Lara: The narrow part is blocked. Let me wash it.
colloquial.zh: Mark：水怎么流不过漏斗？Lara：狭窄的那部分堵住了。我来洗一下。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 水怎么流不过漏斗？
messages.en: Why isn't the water flowing through the funnel?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 狭窄的那部分堵住了。我来洗一下。
messages.en: The narrow part is blocked. Let me wash it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 deffusa 画两幅提示图：伸进物品堆拨探的工具，以及漏斗下方的细管；分别记牢工具义和部件义。

gloss_zh: 明确的；确定的；已界定的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clear and specific, or given a precise meaning or boundary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 清楚而具体的，或其含义、范围已经得到明确界定的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċar u speċifiku, jew li għandu tifsira jew limiti stabbiliti b'mod preċiż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明确的；确定的。
已作出定义的；已明确界定含义或范围的。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu għan definit: li jnaqqas il-konsum tal-ilma fl-iskola.
formal.en: The project has a definite goal: to reduce water consumption at the school.
formal.zh: 这个项目有一个明确目标：减少学校的用水量。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek pjan definit għal għada? Pawlu: Iva, immorru l-librerija fid-disgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a definite plan for tomorrow? Pawlu: Yes, we're going to the library at nine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你明天有确定的计划吗？保罗：有，我们九点去图书馆。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天有确定的计划吗？
messages.en: Do you have a definite plan for tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我们九点去图书馆。
messages.en: Yes, we're going to the library at nine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 definit 和“目标写清楚、范围画清楚”一起记：既能说事情明确，也能说含义已经界定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A statement that explains the meaning of a word or concept precisely.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 准确说明一个词语或概念含义的表述。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spjegazzjoni preċiża tat-tifsira ta' kelma jew kunċett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 定义；对词语或概念含义的准确说明。

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tar-rapport, l-awtur jagħti definizzjoni ċara tal-kunċett.
formal.en: At the beginning of the report, the author gives a clear definition of the concept.
formal.zh: 在报告开头，作者为这个概念给出了清楚的定义。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'inhi d-definizzjoni ta' din il-kelma? Mark: Ejja nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju.
colloquial.en: Sara: What is the definition of this word? Mark: Let's look it up in the dictionary.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这个词的定义是什么？马克：我们查一下词典吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个词的定义是什么？
messages.en: What is the definition of this word?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 我们查一下词典吧。
messages.en: Let's look it up in the dictionary.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象词典中词条下面那句解释：那就是 definizzjoni。用“这个词的定义”整组记住它。

gloss_zh: 心思被占据；沉浸于；忙于

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have one's attention occupied by something, often becoming engrossed in an activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 注意力被某件事占据，常指沉浸于某项活动而顾不上其他事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu moħħu f'xi ħaġa jew ikun medhi b'attività, tant li ma jagħtix kas ta' affarijiet oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 心思被某事占据；一心想着某事。
沉浸于、专注于或忙于某事。

formal.mt: L-istudent deha bil-qari u nesa jikteb in-noti mitluba.
formal.en: The student became engrossed in reading and forgot to write the required notes.
formal.zh: 这名学生读书读得入迷，忘了做要求完成的笔记。

colloquial.mt: Omm: Għaliex ma weġibtx meta sejjaħtlek? Luca: Skużani, dehejt bil-logħob u ma smajtekx.
colloquial.en: Mum: Why didn't you answer when I called you? Luca: Sorry, I got absorbed in playing and didn't hear you.
colloquial.zh: 妈妈：我叫你的时候，你怎么没回答？卢卡：对不起，我玩入迷了，没听见你叫我。

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.zh: 我叫你的时候，你怎么没回答？
messages.en: Why didn't you answer when I called you?

messages.speaker: Luca (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Skużani, dehejt bil-logħob u ma smajtekx.
messages.mt_standard: Skużani, dehejt bil-logħob u ma smajtekx.
messages.zh: 对不起，我玩入迷了，没听见你叫我。
messages.en: Sorry, I got absorbed in playing and didn't hear you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看书或玩耍入迷，别人叫你也没听见；用这个“心思全被占住”的画面记 deha。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the colour of gold, or made of gold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有黄金颜色的，或由黄金制成的；具体指颜色还是材质，要看上下文。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-kulur tad-deheb, jew li huwa magħmul mid-deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 呈金黄色的；具有黄金颜色的。

sense_translations.en_definition: gold; golden (made of gold and/or of its colour)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 金质的或金色的；可指由黄金制成，也可指具有金色，或兼有两者。

formal.mt: Il-qoxra tal-ktieb għandha sfond dehbi u t-titlu miktub bl-iswed.
formal.en: The book cover has a golden background and the title written in black.
formal.zh: 这本书的封面以金色为底，书名用黑色书写。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Jogħġbok dan il-qafas dehbi? Sara: Iva, il-kulur tiegħu jaqbel mar-ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you like this golden frame? Sara: Yes, its colour goes well with the photograph.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你喜欢这个金色相框吗？萨拉：喜欢，它的颜色和照片很搭。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个金色相框吗？
messages.en: Do you like this golden frame?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 喜欢，它的颜色和照片很搭。
messages.en: Yes, its colour goes well with the photograph.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehbi 放在物品旁边记成“金色的／金质的”。看到金色相框时，先想到颜色，再由语境判断材质。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A valuable yellow metal used to make jewellery and other objects.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种贵重的黄色金属，常用于制作首饰及其他物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metall isfar u prezzjuż li jintuża biex isiru ġojjelli u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 黄金；金这种贵重金属。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesibixxi ġojjelli magħmula mid-deheb.
formal.en: The museum exhibits jewellery made of gold.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出由黄金制成的首饰。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan iċ-ċurkett huwa tad-deheb? Rita: Iva, huwa magħmul mid-deheb.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is this ring gold? Rita: Yes, it is made of gold.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这枚戒指是金的吗？丽塔：是的，它是用黄金做的。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 这枚戒指是金的吗？
messages.en: Is this ring gold?

messages.speaker: Rita (珠宝店店员)
messages.zh: 是的，它是用黄金做的。
messages.en: Yes, it is made of gold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一块黄金记名词 deheb，用“金色的物品”记形容词 dehbi；再把 tad-deheb 整组记成“金制的”。

gloss_zh: 动词：膏立、选定；名词：理性、明察、智慧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To anoint someone, or to designate someone as the chosen person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人施行傅油礼或膏立某人，也可指选定某人为被选中者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidlek lil xi ħadd biż-żejt f'rit, jew jagħżlu bħala l-persuna magħżula.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择某人，或给某人施行傅油礼、膏立某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. the chosen one
sense_translations.zh_definition: 选定某人；使某人成为被选中者。
理性；进行理智思考和判断的能力。
留心；对自身行为或所处情况保持觉察。
健全的判断力；明智而可靠的判断。
智慧、明理、理性或审慎；处理事情时明智稳妥的心智品质。
以油涂抹以施行傅油礼；膏立。

formal.mt: Waqt iċ-ċerimonja, il-qassis dehen lir-re biż-żejt.
formal.en: During the ceremony, the priest anointed the king with oil.
formal.zh: 在仪式中，神父用油膏立了国王。

colloquial.mt: Luca: X'għamel il-qassis f'dik ix-xena? Maja: Dehen lir-re biż-żejt.
colloquial.en: Luca: What did the priest do in that scene? Maja: He anointed the king with oil.
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：那个场景里，神父做了什么？玛雅：他用油膏立了国王。

messages.speaker: Luca (同学)
messages.zh: 那个场景里，神父做了什么？
messages.en: What did the priest do in that scene?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 他用油膏立了国王。
messages.en: He anointed the king with oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dehen 做两张词性卡：动词卡画“用油膏立、选定某人”，名词卡写“理性与智慧”；同形词分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become visible or show up, or to seem a certain way to an observer.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入视野、出现或到场，也可表示在观察者看来呈现某种样子或印象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir viżibbli jew jasal f'post, jew jagħti ċerta impressjoni lil min jarah.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现；显现。
被看见；进入他人的视野。
看起来像某物或某人；与之相似。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a spectacle of oneself
sense_translations.zh_definition: 当众出洋相；因自己的举动而惹人注目。

sense_translations.en_definition: to give the impression of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给人某种印象；显出某种样子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to appear; to become visible; to show up
sense_translations.zh_definition: 出现；变得可见；到场、露面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to appear; to give an impression; to seem
sense_translations.zh_definition: 显得；看似；给人某种印象。

formal.mt: Meta waqaf ix-xita, deher qawsalla fis-sema.
formal.en: When the rain stopped, a rainbow appeared in the sky.
formal.zh: 雨停后，天空中出现了一道彩虹。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif deher Mark illum? Pawlu: Deher għajjien, imma qal li kien tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: How did Mark look today? Pawlu: He looked tired, but he said he was fine.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：马克今天看起来怎么样？保罗：他显得很疲倦，不过他说自己挺好的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克今天看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark look today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Deher għajjien, imma qal li kien tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Deher għajjien, imma qal li kien tajjeb.
messages.zh: 他显得很疲倦，不过他说自己挺好的。
messages.en: He looked tired, but he said he was fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个镜头记 deher：先拍“人出现在门口”，再拍“他看起来很累”；分别对应出现和显得。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel fear, become startled, or feel a chill of alarm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到害怕、突然受惊，或因恐惧而感到胆寒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibża', jieħu qatgħa jew iħoss bard ta' biża'.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使害怕；吓唬。
使胆寒；使因恐惧而感到寒意。
使突然受惊；吓一跳。

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi dehex lit-tifel, li waqaf ħesrem u ħares lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The loud noise startled the boy, who stopped abruptly and looked towards the door.
formal.zh: 巨响把男孩吓了一跳，他突然停下，朝门口望去。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ġara? Għaliex qbiżt? Luca: Dak il-ħoss dehexxni; ma kontx qed nistennieh.
colloquial.en: Maja: What happened? Why did you jump? Luca: That noise startled me; I wasn't expecting it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：怎么了？你怎么吓得一跳？卢卡：那个声音吓到我了，我完全没料到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 怎么了？你怎么吓得一跳？
messages.en: What happened? Why did you jump?

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-ħoss dehexxni; ma kontx qed nistennieh.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-ħoss dehexxni; ma kontx qed nistennieh.
messages.zh: 那个声音吓到我了，我完全没料到。
messages.en: That noise startled me; I wasn't expecting it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象突然一声巨响让人一跳，再想象可怕的故事让人背后发凉；用这两个受惊画面记 dehex。

gloss_zh: 明智的；理性的；判断稳健的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Wise and rational, showing good judgement when making decisions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 明智而理性的，能够在作决定时表现出良好判断力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqli u razzjonali, li juża ġudizzju tajjeb meta jieħu deċiżjonijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明智的；有智慧的。
理性的；能够依据道理思考的。
判断稳健的；有良好判断力的。
明智、理性、审慎而聪明的。

collocations.zh: 一个有良好判断力的人

formal.mt: Mexxej dehni jisma' l-opinjonijiet kollha qabel jieħu deċiżjoni importanti.
formal.en: A wise leader listens to all opinions before making an important decision.
formal.zh: 明智的领导者在作出重要决定前，会听取所有意见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tlabt il-parir ta' Pawlu? Mark: Għax hu dehni u jaħseb sew qabel jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you ask Pawlu for advice? Mark: Because he has good judgement and thinks carefully before speaking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么向保罗请教？马克：因为他判断稳健，而且说话前会认真思考。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么向保罗请教？
messages.en: Why did you ask Pawlu for advice?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu dehni u jaħseb sew qabel jitkellem.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu dehni u jaħseb sew qabel jitkellem.
messages.zh: 因为他判断稳健，而且说话前会认真思考。
messages.en: Because he has good judgement and thinks carefully before speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehni 联想到先听意见、再作决定的人，用“明智而理性”串起各个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way someone or something looks; also a supernatural vision or an instance of becoming visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物呈现出的外观；也可指超自然异象，或某物显现出来的一次现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-mod kif persuna jew ħaġa tidher; ukoll viżjoni sopranaturali jew okkażjoni meta xi ħaġa ssir viżibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外观；外貌；呈现出的样子。
异象；超自然意义上的所见景象。
幽灵般的显现；某人或某物变得可见的一次显现。

formal.mt: Id-dehra tal-bini nbidlet wara r-restawr, iżda l-istruttura oriġinali nżammet.
formal.en: The building's appearance changed after restoration, but its original structure was retained.
formal.zh: 这座建筑修复后的外观发生了变化，但保留了原有结构。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif tidher il-kamra issa? Mark: Għandha dehra ġdida wara li żbajnieha.
colloquial.en: Maja: How does the room look now? Mark: It has a new look after we painted it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：房间现在看起来怎么样？马克：我们刷过漆后，它焕然一新了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 房间现在看起来怎么样？
messages.en: How does the room look now?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandha dehra ġdida wara li żbajnieha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandha dehra ġdida wara li żbajnieha.
messages.zh: 我们刷过漆后，它焕然一新了。
messages.en: It has a new look after we painted it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dehra 记成“眼前呈现的样子”：日常是外观，超自然语境中则是异象或显现。

gloss_zh: 可见的；显而易见的；表面呈现的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Visible or apparent: able to be seen, or evident from what can be observed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可见或显而易见的，即能够看见，或能够从观察中察觉出来的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jista' jidher jew li huwa evidenti minn dak li wieħed josserva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可见的；能够被看见的。
显现出来的；能够从表面或观察中察觉的。
明显的；表面呈现出来的，具体含义取决于语境。

formal.mt: L-effett tat-tiswija kien dehrien fil-wiċċ lixx tal-ħajt.
formal.en: The effect of the repair was apparent in the wall's smooth surface.
formal.zh: 从墙壁平整的表面可以看出修补的效果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad hemm sinjal fuq il-ħajt? Mark: Iva, għadu dehrien ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is there still a mark on the wall? Mark: Yes, it is still visible beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：墙上还留着痕迹吗？马克：有，在窗户旁边仍然看得见。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)
messages.zh: 墙上还留着痕迹吗？
messages.en: Is there still a mark on the wall?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修人员)
messages.zh: 有，在窗户旁边仍然看得见。
messages.en: Yes, it is still visible beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“墙上的痕迹看得见”记住 dehrien；它描述可见或明显的性质，词性是形容词。

gloss_zh: 使变窄；使烦恼；使厌烦；狭窄的；紧的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something narrower, or to cause someone annoyance, boredom, trouble, or low spirits.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物变窄；也可指使某人烦恼、厌烦、遇到麻烦或情绪低落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa idjaq, jew ġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss dwejjaq, irritazzjoni jew skumdità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物变窄。
使某人烦恼；惹某人不快。
使某人觉得无聊或厌烦。
给某人添麻烦；使某人困扰。
狭窄的；宽度小的。
紧的；空间不足或贴得过紧的。
心胸狭窄的；思想不开放的。
使变窄；使某物变得狭窄。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bore; to displease; to annoy; to depress
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使厌烦；使不悦；使烦恼；使情绪低落。

formal.mt: Il-ħajt il-ġdid dejjaq il-passaġġ u naqqas l-ispazju għan-nies li jgħaddu.
formal.en: The new wall narrowed the passage and reduced the space for people passing through.
formal.zh: 新墙使通道变窄，减少了行人通行的空间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ġirien ilmentaw? Mark: L-istorbju tal-bieraħ dejjaq lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did the neighbours complain? Mark: Yesterday's noise annoyed everyone.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：邻居们为什么投诉？马克：昨天的噪声让大家都很烦。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 邻居们为什么投诉？
messages.en: Why did the neighbours complain?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 昨天的噪声让大家都很烦。
messages.en: Yesterday's noise annoyed everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记忆 dejjaq：通道被挤窄，人被噪声惹烦；再单独记住形容词义“窄、紧、心胸狭窄”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Always, either on every occasion or continuously without an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 总是，表示每次都如此；也可表示一直持续或永远。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: F'kull okkażjoni, il-ħin kollu, jew għal żmien bla tmiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 总是；每次都；一直。
永远；永久地。
使长久延续；使永久存在。

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu dejjem jiċċekkja d-dettalji qabel jibgħat id-dokumenti.
formal.en: Staff should always check the details before sending the documents.
formal.zh: 工作人员在发送文件前，应当每次都核对细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark diġà wasal? Pawlu: Iva, hu dejjem jasal qabel kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Mark arrived already? Pawlu: Yes, he always arrives before everyone else.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克已经到了吗？保罗：到了，他总是比其他人先到。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克已经到了吗？
messages.en: Has Mark arrived already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu dejjem jasal qabel kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu dejjem jasal qabel kulħadd.
messages.zh: 到了，他总是比其他人先到。
messages.en: Yes, he always arrives before everyone else.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dejjem 放在时间线上：每次都发生是“总是”，持续到没有终点是“永远”；动词义另记为“使延续”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organized military force maintained permanently and kept ready for service.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长期维持组织和人员、随时准备执行任务的军事力量，即常备军。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forza militari organizzata li tinżamm b'mod permanenti u tkun lesta għas-servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 常备军；长期维持并随时准备服役的军队。

collocations.en: the cost of the standing army

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina l-ispiża biex tinżamm dejma u t-taħriġ meħtieġ għas-suldati tagħha.
formal.en: The report examines the cost of maintaining a standing army and the training required for its soldiers.
formal.zh: 报告考察了维持常备军的费用，以及其士兵所需的训练。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser dejma f'dan it-test? Pawlu: Tfisser armata li tinżamm lesta b'mod permanenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does dejma mean in this text? Pawlu: It means an army kept permanently ready for service.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这篇文章里的 dejma 是什么意思？保罗：指长期保持战备的军队，也就是常备军。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这篇文章里的 dejma 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does dejma mean in this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Tfisser armata li tinżamm lesta b'mod permanenti.
messages.mt_standard: Tfisser armata li tinżamm lesta b'mod permanenti.
messages.zh: 指长期保持战备的军队，也就是常备军。
messages.en: It means an army kept permanently ready for service.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆 dejma 时想象一支平时也持续训练、随时准备出动的军队，用画面锁定“常备军”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money that is owed, or an obligation to repay someone's kindness with good treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 应当偿还的钱款或负债状态；也可指因受人恩惠而应善待或回报对方的人情债。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus li wieħed għandu jagħti lura, jew obbligu morali li jpatti għall-ġid li rċieva mingħand xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务；欠款。

sense_translations.en_definition: debt (money owed; the state of owing money)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 债务，指所欠的钱款或欠钱的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: moral debt (good treatment that one owes someone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 人情债；道义上应给予他人的善待或回报。
赊销；出售商品并允许买方以后付款。

collocations.zh: 一笔人情债；道义上的亏欠

formal.mt: Il-ftehim jistabbilixxi li d-dejn għandu jitħallas kollu sal-aħħar tas-sena.
formal.en: The agreement stipulates that the debt must be repaid in full by the end of the year.
formal.zh: 协议规定，债务必须在年底前全部偿清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għad għandek dejn mal-bank? Mark: Le, ħallastu kollu x-xahar li għadda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you still owe money to the bank? Mark: No, I paid it all off last month.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还欠银行的钱吗？马克：不欠了，我上个月已经全部还清。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还欠银行的钱吗？
messages.en: Do you still owe money to the bank?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħallastu kollu x-xahar li għadda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħallastu kollu x-xahar li għadda.
messages.zh: 不欠了，我上个月已经全部还清。
messages.en: No, I paid it all off last month.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dejn 记成“还欠着”：欠钱是债务，欠恩情是人情债；动词义“赊销”要从卖方角度记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something used to make a place or object more attractive, or the act of decorating it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使场所或物品更加美观的装饰品，也指进行装饰的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tintuża biex issebbaħ post jew oġġett, jew l-att li żżejnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 装饰；装饰品；装饰的行为。

formal.mt: Id-dekorazzjoni tas-sala tinkludi fjuri friski u dwal żgħar fuq l-imwejjed.
formal.en: The hall's decoration includes fresh flowers and small lights on the tables.
formal.zh: 大厅的装饰包括鲜花和桌上的小灯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex poġġejt dawn il-fjuri hawn? Mark: Għad-dekorazzjoni tal-mejda; jogħġbuk?
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you put these flowers here? Mark: For the table decoration; do you like them?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么把这些花放在这里？马克：用来装饰餐桌；你喜欢吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把这些花放在这里？
messages.en: Why did you put these flowers here?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 用来装饰餐桌；你喜欢吗？
messages.en: For the table decoration; do you like them?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dekorazzjoni 与餐桌上的鲜花、小灯连在一起：这些东西使环境更美观，就是“装饰”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person chosen to represent a group at a meeting or event.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由某个团体选出或委派、在会议或活动中代表该团体的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna magħżula biex tirrappreżenta grupp f'laqgħa jew f'attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表；受委派代表某个团体出席会议或活动的人。

formal.mt: Id-delegat tal-ħaddiema ppreżenta l-proposti tagħhom waqt il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The workers' delegate presented their proposals during the meeting.
formal.zh: 工人代表在会议上提出了工人们的建议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jirrappreżenta lill-grupp tagħna? Mark: Jien se mmur bħala delegat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will represent our group? Mark: I'll go as a delegate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来代表我们小组？马克：我会作为代表去。

messages.speaker: Maja (小组成员)
messages.zh: 谁来代表我们小组？
messages.en: Who will represent our group?

messages.speaker: Mark (小组代表)
messages.zh: 我会作为代表去。
messages.en: I'll go as a delegate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 delegat 和“一个人替整个小组发言”的画面绑定，记住它指代表本人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A group sent to represent others, or the act of assigning a task or authority to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被派去代表他人的团体；也指把任务或权限交给他人的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp mibgħut biex jirrappreżenta lil oħrajn, jew l-għoti ta' xogħol jew ta' awtorità lil persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表团；受派遣代表某个组织或群体的一组人。
委派或授权的行为；把某项任务、职责或权限交给他人。

formal.mt: Id-delegazzjoni uffiċjali żaret l-iskola u ltaqgħet mal-għalliema.
formal.en: The official delegation visited the school and met the teachers.
formal.zh: 官方代表团参观了学校，并与教师们会面。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-mistednin kollha huma mid-delegazzjoni? Pawlu: Iva, ġew biex jirrappreżentaw l-għaqda tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are all the guests part of the delegation? Pawlu: Yes, they came to represent their association.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这些来宾都是代表团成员吗？保罗：是的，他们是来代表自己协会的。

messages.speaker: Sara (活动志愿者)
messages.zh: 这些来宾都是代表团成员吗？
messages.en: Are all the guests part of the delegation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġew biex jirrappreżentaw l-għaqda tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġew biex jirrappreżentaw l-għaqda tagħhom.
messages.zh: 是的，他们是来代表自己协会的。
messages.en: Yes, they came to represent their association.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 delegazzjoni：一队人出访是“代表团”，把任务交出去是“委派”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act that breaks criminal law and may be punished by the authorities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 违反刑事法律、可能受到有关机关处罚的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Att li jikser il-liġi kriminali u li jista' jwassal għal piena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罪行；犯罪行为。
罪行；违法犯罪行为，可按具体法律语境指重罪或轻罪。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-provi marbuta mad-delitt.
formal.en: The report describes the evidence connected with the crime.
formal.zh: 报告描述了与该罪行有关的证据。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fuq xiex inhu dan il-ktieb? Ġanni: Fuq delitt f'raħal żgħir u l-investigazzjoni li ssegwi.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this book about? Ġanni: A crime in a small village and the investigation that follows.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这本书讲什么？詹尼：讲一个小村庄里发生的罪案，以及随后的调查。

messages.speaker: Lara (读者)
messages.zh: 这本书讲什么？
messages.en: What is this book about?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fuq delitt f'raħal żgħir u l-investigazzjoni li ssegwi.
messages.mt_standard: Fuq delitt f'raħal żgħir u l-investigazzjoni li ssegwi.
messages.zh: 讲一个小村庄里发生的罪案，以及随后的调查。
messages.en: A crime in a small village and the investigation that follows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 delitt 放进侦探小说的“罪案—证据—调查”场景中记忆，重点记作“罪行”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An activity a person enjoys doing in their free time, often with strong interest.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人在空闲时间喜欢从事、往往投入较多兴趣的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Attività li persuna tieħu gost tagħmel fil-ħin liberu tagħha u li jista' jkollha interess kbir fiha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱好；在闲暇时经常从事并感到愉快的活动。
消遣；用来愉快地度过空闲时间的活动。

sense_translations.en_definition: an activity one is passionate about
sense_translations.zh_definition: 自己非常热衷、乐于投入精力的活动。
业余爱好；闲暇消遣。

formal.mt: Il-fotografija hija delizzju li jgħin lill-istudenti jesprimu l-kreattività tagħhom.
formal.en: Photography is a hobby that helps students express their creativity.
formal.zh: 摄影是一种有助于学生发挥创造力的爱好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandek xi delizzju ġdid? Mark: Iva, bdejt inkabbar il-ħxejjex fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you have a new hobby? Mark: Yes, I've started growing vegetables in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你有什么新爱好吗？马克：有，我开始在花园里种蔬菜了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有什么新爱好吗？
messages.en: Do you have a new hobby?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我开始在花园里种蔬菜了。
messages.en: Yes, I've started growing vegetables in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到下班后主动拿起相机或走进花园的自己，把 delizzju 记成“乐于投入的爱好”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a very pleasant taste.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 味道非常好、吃起来令人愉快的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu togħma tajba ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美味的；味道非常好的。

formal.mt: Il-kok ħejja ikel delizzjuż għall-mistednin.
formal.en: The chef prepared delicious food for the guests.
formal.zh: 厨师为来宾准备了美味的食物。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif sibt il-kejk? Pawlu: Delizzjuż! Nista' nieħu biċċa oħra?
colloquial.en: Sara: How did you like the cake? Pawlu: Delicious! Can I have another slice?
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你觉得蛋糕怎么样？保罗：太好吃了！我可以再吃一块吗？

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: 你觉得蛋糕怎么样？
messages.en: How did you like the cake?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (客人)
messages.zh: 太好吃了！我可以再吃一块吗？
messages.en: Delicious! Can I have another slice?

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 delizzjuż 就想象吃完蛋糕还想再来一块，用“真美味”的味觉画面记住它。

gloss_zh: 遮阴；投下阴影；影子；阴凉处

teaching_sense.en_definition: To provide shade or cast a shadow over something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为某物遮挡光线，使其处于阴影中，或在其上投下影子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitfa' dell fuq xi ħaġa jew jagħtiha kenn mix-xemx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 遮阴；为某物挡住阳光或其他光线。
投下影子；使某处出现阴影。
影子；物体挡住光线后形成的暗影。
阴凉；阳光被遮挡的地方或状态。
阴凉处；阴影；影子。

collocations.en: the shade or shadow of a tree

formal.mt: Il-ħajt għoli dell parti mill-bitħa matul waranofsinhar.
formal.en: The high wall shaded part of the courtyard during the afternoon.
formal.zh: 高墙在下午为庭院的一部分遮了阴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se noqogħdu? Toni: Fid-dell ta' dik is-siġra; hawn wisq xemx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we sit? Toni: In the shade of that tree; it's too sunny here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们坐在哪里？托尼：坐到那棵树的树荫下吧，这里太阳太晒了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall we sit?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-dell ta' dik is-siġra; hawn wisq xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-dell ta' dik is-siġra; hawn wisq xemx.
messages.zh: 坐到那棵树的树荫下吧，这里太阳太晒了。
messages.en: In the shade of that tree; it's too sunny here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一棵树串起词性：树“遮阴”是动词，地上的“树影”和可乘凉的“树荫”是名词。

gloss_zh: 涂抹；给……抹上；洗得不干净

teaching_sense.en_definition: To smear or spread a substance over a surface; also, to wash something poorly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂抹在表面上；也可指草草清洗，洗得不干净。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifrex sustanza fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa; jista' jfisser ukoll li taħsel xi ħaġa ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹；把某种物质抹在表面上。
给某物涂上某种东西，例如给面包抹上黄油。
洗得不好或不干净；草草清洗。

collocations.en: spread the cream on the skin

formal.mt: Dellek il-ħobż bil-butir qabel iżżid il-ġobon.
formal.en: Spread butter on the bread before adding the cheese.
formal.zh: 先给面包抹上黄油，再放上奶酪。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm butir inpoġġi? Mark: Dellek il-ħobż bi ftit butir biss.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much butter should I put on? Mark: Spread just a little butter on the bread.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我要放多少黄油？马克：给面包抹上一点黄油就好。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要放多少黄油？
messages.en: How much butter should I put on?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dellek il-ħobż bi ftit butir biss.
messages.mt_standard: Dellek il-ħobż bi ftit butir biss.
messages.zh: 给面包抹上一点黄油就好。
messages.en: Spread just a little butter on the bread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用刀把黄油抹开来记 dellek 的“涂抹”；另设一幅脏盘子画面，提醒自己还有“洗不干净”义。

gloss_zh: 粪便；粪肥；肥料；卑劣之人（骂语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: Animal dung, especially when used as fertiliser; also an insulting word for a mean person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物的粪便，尤其指用于施肥的粪肥；也可用作辱骂卑劣之人的词。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħmieġ tal-annimali, speċjalment meta jintuża biex jgħin il-pjanti jikbru; jintuża wkoll bħala tgħajjira għal persuna kattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物粪便。
粪肥；用作肥料的动物粪便。
肥料；用于补充土壤养分、促进植物生长的物质。

sense_translations.en_definition: term of abuse for a mean person
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于辱骂卑劣、刻薄之人的词，相当于骂人“人渣”。
动物粪便；作肥料用的粪肥。

collocations.en: to spread manure in the field

formal.mt: Il-bidwi juża d-demel biex itejjeb il-ħamrija qabel iż-żrigħ.
formal.en: The farmer uses manure to improve the soil before sowing.
formal.zh: 农民在播种前使用粪肥改良土壤。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ġibt din il-borża demel? Ġanni: Biex inħalltu mal-ħamrija fil-ġnien.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you bring this bag of manure? Ġanni: To mix it with the soil in the garden.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么带来这袋粪肥？詹尼：用来拌进花园的土里。

messages.speaker: Lara (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 你为什么带来这袋粪肥？
messages.en: Why did you bring this bag of manure?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.zh: 用来拌进花园的土里。
messages.en: To mix it with the soil in the garden.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demel 记成从牛棚运到菜地的一袋“粪肥”；若用它指人，则是在骂对方卑劣。

gloss_zh: 血；血缘；遗传的特征；天性

teaching_sense.en_definition: The red liquid that circulates in the body; also used figuratively for family ties, inherited traits, or natural disposition.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在身体内循环的红色液体；也可比喻血缘关系、遗传的特征或天性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-likwidu aħmar li jiċċirkola fil-ġisem; jintuża wkoll figurattivament għar-rabtiet tal-familja, għall-karatteristiċi li jintirtu jew għall-karattru naturali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 血；血液。

sense_translations.en_definition: inherited characteristic (colloquial, used of tendencies one ascribes to inheritance)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 遗传的特征；口语中指被认为由家族遗传而来的倾向。
血缘关系；亲属之间因共同祖先而形成的关系。
天性；与生俱来的性情或倾向。

collocations.en: he has music in his blood

formal.mt: Il-laboratorju rċieva kampjun tad-demm għall-analiżi.
formal.en: The laboratory received a blood sample for analysis.
formal.zh: 实验室收到了用于分析的血液样本。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tgħid li Pawlu għandu l-mużika f'demmu? Rita: Għax ilu jkanta minn meta kien żgħir, bħall-ġenituri tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you say Pawlu has music in his blood? Rita: Because he has been singing since he was little, just like his parents.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么说Pawlu天生有音乐细胞？Rita：因为他从小就唱歌，和他父母一样。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tgħid li Pawlu għandu l-mużika f'demmu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tgħid li Pawlu għandu l-mużika f'demmu?
messages.zh: 你为什么说Pawlu天生有音乐细胞？
messages.en: Why do you say Pawlu has music in his blood?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ilu jkanta minn meta kien żgħir, bħall-ġenituri tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ilu jkanta minn meta kien żgħir, bħall-ġenituri tiegħu.
messages.zh: 因为他从小就唱歌，和他父母一样。
messages.en: Because he has been singing since he was little, just like his parents.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记身体里的“血”，再联想到“血缘”和“骨子里的天性”；这些是帮助区分词义的语义联想。

gloss_zh: 施粪肥；用厩肥给土地施肥

teaching_sense.en_definition: To apply manure to land to make the soil more fertile.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把粪肥施入土地，以提高土壤肥力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti d-demel lill-art biex il-ħamrija ssir aktar għammiela.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用粪肥给土地施肥，提高土壤肥力。
施粪肥；给土地施用厩肥。

collocations.en: he fertilised the soil with manure

formal.mt: Il-bidwi demmel l-għalqa qabel iż-żrigħ biex itejjeb il-fertilità tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: The farmer manured the field before sowing to improve the fertility of the soil.
formal.zh: 农民在播种前给田地施了粪肥，以提高土壤肥力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu demmel l-għalqa diġà? Mark: Iva, demmilha lbieraħ, qabel ix-xita.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu manured the field already? Mark: Yes, he manured it yesterday, before the rain.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu已经给田地施过粪肥了吗？Mark：是的，他昨天下雨前就施好了。

messages.speaker: Maja (农户)
messages.zh: Pawlu已经给田地施过粪肥了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu manured the field already?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 是的，他昨天下雨前就施好了。
messages.en: Yes, he manured it yesterday, before the rain.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把demmel配上“农民往田里施粪肥”的动作画面，重点记住它表示施肥这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something bloody or stain it with blood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物沾上血液或染上血迹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iċappas xi ħaġa bid-demm jew iħalli tbajja' tad-demm fuqha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物沾满血或变得血淋淋。
使某物带上血迹。
用血沾污；使染上血迹。

collocations.en: he stained the towel with blood
he stained the shirt with blood

formal.mt: Il-ferit demmem ix-xugaman meta użah biex jagħfas fuq il-ferita.
formal.en: The injured man stained the towel with blood when he used it to apply pressure to the wound.
formal.zh: 伤者用毛巾按压伤口时，使毛巾沾上了血。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min demmem dan ix-xugaman? Mark: Jien, meta qtajt subgħajja. Issa se naħslu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who got blood on this towel? Mark: I did, when I cut my finger. I'll wash it now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把这条毛巾弄上血了？Mark：是我，我割伤手指时弄的。我现在就洗。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把这条毛巾弄上血了？
messages.en: Who got blood on this towel?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, meta qtajt subgħajja. Issa se naħslu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, meta qtajt subgħajja. Issa se naħslu.
messages.zh: 是我，我割伤手指时弄的。我现在就洗。
messages.en: I did, when I cut my finger. I'll wash it now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用demm“血”作提示，再想象白毛巾被血染红；demmem记作“使某物沾血”的动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to blood, marked by blood, or involving bloodshed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与血液有关的、带血的，或涉及流血杀戮的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mad-demm, li hu mċappas bid-demm jew li jinvolvi tixrid ta' demm.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 与血液有关的；血液方面的。
带血的；血淋淋的；血腥的。
造成大量流血的；涉及血腥杀戮的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kunflitt demmi li ħalla ħafna vittmi.
formal.en: The report describes a bloody conflict that left many casualties.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一场造成大量伤亡的血腥冲突。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif kien il-film? Mark: Kien fih episodju demmi, u għalaqt għajnejja għal ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: What was the film like? Mark: It had a bloody episode, and I closed my eyes for a moment.
colloquial.zh: Maja：电影怎么样？Mark：里面有一段血腥情节，我把眼睛闭了一会儿。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影怎么样？
messages.en: What was the film like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien fih episodju demmi, u għalaqt għajnejja għal ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Kien fih episodju demmi, u għalaqt għajnejja għal ftit.
messages.zh: 里面有一段血腥情节，我把眼睛闭了一会儿。
messages.en: It had a bloody episode, and I closed my eyes for a moment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把demmi贴在名词旁当描述标签：描述血液关系时是“血液的”，描述冲突时可理解为“血腥的”。

gloss_zh: 施粪肥的人；施用厩肥者

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who applies manure to land to fertilise it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把粪肥施到土地上以增加肥力的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħti d-demel lill-art biex tagħmilha aktar għammiela.

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who fertilises land with manure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用粪肥给土地施肥的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: one who dungs, who uses manure
sense_translations.zh_definition: 施粪肥者；使用厩肥给土地施肥的人。

formal.mt: Id-demmiel qassam id-demel b'mod indaqs fuq l-għalqa.
formal.en: The manure worker spread the manure evenly over the field.
formal.zh: 施肥者把粪肥均匀地撒在田里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu r-raġel ħdejn it-trattur? Pawlu: Dak id-demmiel. Ġie biex jagħti d-demel lill-għalqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is the man by the tractor? Pawlu: That's the manure worker. He has come to manure the field.
colloquial.zh: Maja：拖拉机旁边那个男人是谁？Pawlu：那是施粪肥的人。他是来给田地施肥的。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 拖拉机旁边那个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the man by the tractor?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农户)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak id-demmiel. Ġie biex jagħti d-demel lill-għalqa.
messages.mt_standard: Dak id-demmiel. Ġie biex jagħti d-demel lill-għalqa.
messages.zh: 那是施粪肥的人。他是来给田地施肥的。
messages.en: That's the manure worker. He has come to manure the field.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给demmiel配一个拿着工具施粪肥的人物形象；与动作词demmel一起记，明确这里指的是人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A heap of dung, refuse, or organic material collected for composting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 堆积起来的粪便、垃圾，或用于制作堆肥的有机材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Munzell ta' demel, skart jew materjal organiku miġbur biex isir kompost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 粪堆；堆积的牲畜粪便。
垃圾堆；废弃物堆。
堆肥堆；为制成肥料而堆积的有机材料。

collocations.en: a large dung or compost heap

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar iqiegħed il-weraq niexef fid-demmiela biex isir kompost għall-ġnien.
formal.en: The gardener puts the dry leaves in the compost heap to make compost for the garden.
formal.zh: 园丁把干树叶放进堆肥堆，制作供花园使用的堆肥。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn inpoġġi dan il-weraq niexef? Rita: Fid-demmiela, wara l-ġnien. Hemm jinbidel f'kompost.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where should I put these dry leaves? Rita: In the compost heap behind the garden. They'll turn into compost there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这些干树叶放在哪里？Rita：放到花园后面的堆肥堆里。它们会在那里变成堆肥。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 这些干树叶放在哪里？
messages.en: Where should I put these dry leaves?

messages.speaker: Rita (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Fid-demmiela, wara l-ġnien. Hemm jinbidel f'kompost.
messages.mt_standard: Fid-demmiela, wara l-ġnien. Hemm jinbidel f'kompost.
messages.zh: 放到花园后面的堆肥堆里。它们会在那里变成堆肥。
messages.en: In the compost heap behind the garden. They'll turn into compost there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象花园角落里堆成小山的材料：是粪便就记“粪堆”，是废物就记“垃圾堆”，用于腐熟就记“堆肥堆”。

gloss_zh: 能增加土壤肥力的；具有肥效的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Able to fertilise soil or increase its fertility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能够给土壤提供肥力或提高土壤肥力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jżid il-fertilità tal-ħamrija.

sense_translations.en_definition: having the ability to fertilise soil
sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有给土壤施肥、提高土壤肥力的能力的。
具有施肥作用的；能增加肥力的。

collocations.zh: 能增加土壤肥力的材料

formal.mt: Il-kompost għandu effett demmieli u jgħin biex tiżdied il-fertilità tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: Compost has a fertilising effect and helps increase the fertility of the soil.
formal.zh: 堆肥具有增肥作用，有助于提高土壤肥力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iżżid il-kompost mal-ħamrija? Rita: Għax għandu effett demmieli u jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you adding compost to the soil? Rita: Because it has a fertilising effect and helps the plants grow.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么往土里加堆肥？Rita：因为它有肥效，能帮助植物生长。

messages.speaker: Maja (园艺学员)
messages.zh: 你为什么往土里加堆肥？
messages.en: Why are you adding compost to the soil?

messages.speaker: Rita (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax għandu effett demmieli u jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru.
messages.mt_standard: Għax għandu effett demmieli u jgħin lill-pjanti jikbru.
messages.zh: 因为它有肥效，能帮助植物生长。
messages.en: Because it has a fertilising effect and helps the plants grow.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把demmieli写在一袋堆肥旁，标注“有肥效”；它描述材料或作用具有增加土壤肥力的能力。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the size, structure, distribution, or changes of a human population.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与人口数量、结构、分布或变化有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-għadd, l-istruttura, it-tqassim jew il-bidliet tal-popolazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人口的；与人口数量、结构、分布及变化等统计特征有关的。

formal.mt: L-istudju demografiku janalizza l-età tar-residenti u l-bidliet fl-għadd tal-popolazzjoni.
formal.en: The demographic study analyses residents' ages and changes in population size.
formal.zh: 这项人口统计研究分析居民年龄以及人口数量的变化。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed turi din it-tabella? Mark: Il-profil demografiku tal-lokalità: kemm hemm tfal, adulti u anzjani.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this table show? Mark: The locality's demographic profile: how many children, adults, and older people there are.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这张表显示什么？Mark：本地区的人口特征概况，也就是有多少儿童、成年人和老年人。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 这张表显示什么？
messages.en: What does this table show?

messages.speaker: Mark (社区工作人员)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-profil demografiku tal-lokalità: kemm hemm tfal, adulti u anzjani.
messages.mt_standard: Il-profil demografiku tal-lokalità: kemm hemm tfal, adulti u anzjani.
messages.zh: 本地区的人口特征概况，也就是有多少儿童、成年人和老年人。
messages.en: The locality's demographic profile: how many children, adults, and older people there are.

cognitive_memory_aid: 可借英语demographic的相似拼写记忆demografiku，再联想一张按年龄分组的人口统计表。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Based on democracy, with people participating in decisions or choosing their representatives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以民主为基础的，让人们参与决策或选出代表的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ibbażat fuq id-demokrazija, fejn in-nies jipparteċipaw fid-deċiżjonijiet jew jagħżlu r-rappreżentanti tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民主的；遵循民主原则的。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għażel il-president tiegħu permezz ta' vot demokratiku.
formal.en: The committee chose its chair through a democratic vote.
formal.zh: 委员会通过民主投票选出了主席。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Taħseb li dan kien vot demokratiku? Mark: Iva, kulħadd seta' jivvota.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you think this was a democratic vote? Mark: Yes, everyone was able to vote.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你觉得这次投票是民主的吗？马克：是的，每个人都能投票。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li dan kien vot demokratiku?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li dan kien vot demokratiku?
messages.zh: 你觉得这次投票是民主的吗？
messages.en: Do you think this was a democratic vote?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，每个人都能投票。
messages.en: Yes, everyone was able to vote.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demokratiku 和 vot（投票）一起记：想象每个人都有一票，用这个画面记住“民主的”这一形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of government in which people participate in political decisions, directly or through elected representatives.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人民直接或通过选出的代表参与政治决策的一种治理制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' tmexxija li fiha n-nies jipparteċipaw fid-deċiżjonijiet politiċi direttament jew permezz ta' rappreżentanti eletti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 民主；由人民直接或通过民选代表参与治理的制度。

formal.mt: Id-demokrazija teħtieġ parteċipazzjoni attiva taċ-ċittadini.
formal.en: Democracy requires active participation by citizens.
formal.zh: 民主需要公民积极参与。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi d-demokrazija? Pawlu: Hija sistema fejn in-nies jistgħu jagħżlu r-rappreżentanti tagħhom.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is democracy? Pawlu: It is a system in which people can choose their representatives.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：什么是民主？保罗：就是人们能够选出自己代表的一种制度。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是民主？
messages.en: What is democracy?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Hija sistema fejn in-nies jistgħu jagħżlu r-rappreżentanti tagħhom.
messages.mt_standard: Hija sistema fejn in-nies jistgħu jagħżlu r-rappreżentanti tagħhom.
messages.zh: 就是人们能够选出自己代表的一种制度。
messages.en: It is a system in which people can choose their representatives.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用词性对照记忆：demokrazija 是“民主”这个制度的名称，demokratiku 则用来描述“民主的”政府或程序。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An evil supernatural being, especially one described in stories or religious beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邪恶的超自然存在，尤其指故事或宗教信仰中的恶魔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejqa sopranaturali ħażina, speċjalment fl-istejjer jew fit-twemmin reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶魔；邪恶的超自然存在。
魔鬼；恶魔。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, id-demonju jipprova jqarraq bil-protagonist.
formal.en: In the story, the demon tries to deceive the protagonist.
formal.zh: 在故事中，恶魔试图欺骗主人公。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Hemm demonju f'din l-istorja? Adam: Iva, imma fl-aħħar l-eroj jirbaħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there a demon in this story? Adam: Yes, but the hero wins in the end.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这个故事里有恶魔吗？亚当：有，不过最后英雄赢了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个故事里有恶魔吗？
messages.en: Is there a demon in this story?

messages.speaker: Adam (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，不过最后英雄赢了。
messages.en: Yes, but the hero wins in the end.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 demonju 放进童话画面：恶魔设下骗局，英雄最终获胜。借故事角色记住“恶魔、魔鬼”的意思。

gloss_zh: 尾巴；末尾附加部分；词尾

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part extending from the rear of an animal's body; also something added at the end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 动物身体后部伸出的尾巴；也指附加在末尾的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti li toħroġ minn wara ta' ġisem annimal; ukoll xi ħaġa miżjuda fl-aħħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尾巴；动物身体后部伸出的部分。

sense_translations.en_definition: something added at the end, e.g. a grammatical ending, suffix
sense_translations.zh_definition: 加在末尾的部分，例如语法词尾或后缀。

formal.mt: Il-volpi fl-istampa għandha denb twil u oħxon.
formal.en: The fox in the picture has a long, thick tail.
formal.zh: 图中的狐狸有一条又长又粗的尾巴。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex il-kelb qed ixejjer denbu? Ben: Forsi qed jifraħ għax wasalt int.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the dog wagging its tail? Ben: Perhaps it is happy because you have arrived.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：狗为什么在摇尾巴？本：也许是因为你来了，它很高兴。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 狗为什么在摇尾巴？
messages.en: Why is the dog wagging its tail?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi qed jifraħ għax wasalt int.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi qed jifraħ għax wasalt int.
messages.zh: 也许是因为你来了，它很高兴。
messages.en: Perhaps it is happy because you have arrived.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记动物后面的“尾巴”，再把词尾想象成单词后面的小尾巴；这是帮助区分 denb 两个义项的学习比喻。

gloss_zh: 悬挂；吊死；递交（口语，常指钱）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something in a position where it hangs from a hook, support, or other attachment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把物品挂在钩子、支架或其他固定处，使其悬垂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qiegħed xi ħaġa mdendla ma' ganċ jew ma' xi ħaġa oħra li żżommha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悬挂某物；把某物挂起来。
以绞刑处死某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hand over sth. to sb. (colloquial, often used for the exchange of money)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把某物交给某人；口语中常用于钱款的交付。
悬挂；挂起。

sense_translations.en_definition: to kill by hanging; to hang
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吊死；以吊挂的方式杀死。

collocations.en: hang the picture on the wall
hang the coat on the hook

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem dendel il-kwadru mal-ħajt b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The worker carefully hung the picture on the wall.
formal.zh: 工人小心地把画挂在墙上。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Dendel il-kowt mal-ganċ, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Tajjeb, u fejn inpoġġi l-basket?
colloquial.en: Rita: Hang the coat on the hook, please. Mark: All right, and where should I put the bag?
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：请把外套挂在钩子上。马克：好，那包放在哪里？

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 请把外套挂在钩子上。
messages.en: Hang the coat on the hook, please.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，那包放在哪里？
messages.en: All right, and where should I put the bag?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把外套挂上钩子”的动作记 dend el 的整体词形 dendel；遇到人物或钱款作宾语时，再根据语境辨认吊死或递交义。

gloss_zh: 垂饰；耳饰；护身符；邋遢的人；无足轻重的东西；爱说闲话的女人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorative piece that hangs from an earring or a chandelier.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 悬垂在耳环或枝形吊灯上的装饰物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa dekorattiva li tkun imdendla ma' misluta jew ma' linef.

sense_translations.en_definition: pendant or dangle on an earring or chandelier
sense_translations.zh_definition: 耳环或枝形吊灯上的吊坠、垂饰。
衣着破旧或外表邋遢的人，带贬义。
耳环；护身符。
无足轻重的东西；不值一提的小物件。
爱说闲话、搬弄是非的女人，带贬义。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem naddaf kull dendul tal-linef b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: The worker carefully cleaned each pendant on the chandelier.
formal.zh: 工人仔细清洁了枝形吊灯上的每一个垂饰。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan id-dendul tal-ħġieġ. Luqa: Iva, jaqbel ħafna mal-linef.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how beautiful this glass pendant is. Luqa: Yes, it goes very well with the chandelier.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，这个玻璃垂饰多漂亮。卢卡：是啊，和这盏枝形吊灯很相配。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan id-dendul tal-ħġieġ.
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan id-dendul tal-ħġieġ.
messages.zh: 看，这个玻璃垂饰多漂亮。
messages.en: Look how beautiful this glass pendant is.

messages.speaker: Luqa (店员)
messages.zh: 是啊，和这盏枝形吊灯很相配。
messages.en: Yes, it goes very well with the chandelier.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用吊灯上垂下的一颗玻璃饰物记住 dendul 的主要义；其他义项分别配上人物或物件语境，避免把贬义称呼当作普通饰物名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An aquatic mammal that breathes air and has a streamlined body and a beaklike snout.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种在水中生活、用空气呼吸、身体呈流线形且吻部像喙的哺乳动物，即海豚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu li jgħix fl-ilma, jieħu n-nifs fl-arja u għandu ġisem adattat għall-għawm u geddum twil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海豚。
扶壁；用于支撑或加固墙体的突出结构。

formal.mt: Id-denfil huwa mammiferu li jgħix fl-ilma u jieħu n-nifs fl-arja.
formal.en: The dolphin is a mammal that lives in water and breathes air.
formal.zh: 海豚是一种生活在水中、用空气呼吸的哺乳动物。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Rajt dak id-denfil ħdejn id-dgħajsa? Ben: Iva, qabeż barra mill-ilma!
colloquial.en: Anna: Did you see that dolphin beside the boat? Ben: Yes, it jumped out of the water!
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你看到船旁边那只海豚了吗？本：看到了，它跃出水面了！

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 你看到船旁边那只海豚了吗？
messages.en: Did you see that dolphin beside the boat?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了，它跃出水面了！
messages.en: Yes, it jumped out of the water!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 denfil 配两张独立的记忆卡：海面跃起的海豚，以及墙外支撑墙体的扶壁；根据海洋或建筑语境选择词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A condition in which body temperature is higher than normal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 体温高于正常水平的状态，即发烧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kundizzjoni li fiha t-temperatura tal-ġisem tkun ogħla min-normal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 发烧；体温异常升高的状态。
对某人造成的伤害或损害。
伤害；祸害；邪恶。

formal.mt: L-istudent kellu d-deni u għalhekk baqa' d-dar.
formal.en: The student had a fever and therefore stayed at home.
formal.zh: 这名学生发烧了，因此留在家中。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Ma nistax niġi llum; għandi d-deni. Sara: Mela strieħ, u nċempillek aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Mark: I cannot come today; I have a fever. Sara: Then get some rest, and I will call you later.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我今天来不了了，我发烧了。萨拉：那你休息一下，我晚点给你打电话。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nistax niġi llum; għandi d-deni.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nistax niġi llum; għandi d-deni.
messages.zh: 我今天来不了了，我发烧了。
messages.en: I cannot come today; I have a fever.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela strieħ, u nċempillek aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Mela strieħ, u nċempillek aktar tard.
messages.zh: 那你休息一下，我晚点给你打电话。
messages.en: Then get some rest, and I will call you later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记短语：għandi d-deni 表示“我发烧了”，jagħmel id-deni 表示“造成伤害”；用完整搭配区分同一词形的不同意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who places money in an account or leaves property for safekeeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将钱存入账户，或将财物交付保管的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tqiegħed flus f'kont jew tħalli oġġetti f'idejn ħaddieħor biex jinżammu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存款人；将钱款或财物交付存放、保管的人。

formal.mt: Id-depożitant għandu jikteb ismu u jiffirma l-formola.
formal.en: The depositor must write their name and sign the form.
formal.zh: 存款人须填写姓名并在表格上签名。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min hu d-depożitant fuq din il-formola? Rita: Int, għax il-flus se jidħlu fil-kont tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who is the depositor on this form? Rita: You are, because the money is going into your account.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这张表上的存款人是谁？Rita：是你，因为这笔钱要存入你的账户。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu d-depożitant fuq din il-formola?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu d-depożitant fuq din il-formola?
messages.zh: 这张表上的存款人是谁？
messages.en: Who is the depositor on this form?

messages.speaker: Rita (银行职员)
messages.mt_spoken: Int, għax il-flus se jidħlu fil-kont tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Int, għax il-flus se jidħlu fil-kont tiegħek.
messages.zh: 是你，因为这笔钱要存入你的账户。
messages.en: You are, because the money is going into your account.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把银行表格上的姓名栏与签名栏连起来记：depożitant 指办理存款的那个人。

gloss_zh: 存款；预付款；托存；仓库；沉积

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money or property placed somewhere for safekeeping, or money paid in advance towards a purchase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为保管而存放的钱款或财物，也可指购买时预先支付的一部分款项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Flus jew oġġetti mqiegħda f'post biex jinżammu, jew somma mħallsa minn qabel bħala parti mill-prezz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 存款；存入银行或其他保管处的钱款。
预付款；购买商品或服务时先支付的部分价款。
托存；交由他人保管的钱款或财物。
仓库；用于存放物品的库房或储存站。
沉积；物质逐渐沉降、积聚或形成沉积层的过程。

formal.mt: Biex tikkonferma l-ordni, trid tħallas depożitu ta' mitt ewro.
formal.en: To confirm the order, you must pay a down payment of one hundred euros.
formal.zh: 要确认订单，须支付一百欧元的预付款。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Irrid inħallas il-prezz kollu llum? Toni: Le, illum tħallas biss depożitu ta' ħamsin ewro.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do I have to pay the full price today? Toni: No, today you only pay a down payment of fifty euros.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我今天必须付清全款吗？Toni：不用，今天只需先付五十欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 我今天必须付清全款吗？
messages.en: Do I have to pay the full price today?

messages.speaker: Toni (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum tħallas biss depożitu ta' ħamsin ewro.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum tħallas biss depożitu ta' ħamsin ewro.
messages.zh: 不用，今天只需先付五十欧元。
messages.en: No, today you only pay a down payment of fifty euros.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用五张情境卡记忆：钱存银行、先付部分款、财物托管、货放仓库、物质沉积；逐一对应 depożitu 的不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A representative, especially an elected member of parliament.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 代表他人履行职责的人，尤其指经选举产生的议会议员。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tirrappreżenta lil oħrajn, speċjalment membru elett tal-parlament.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 代表；受委托代行职务的人，亦指议会议员。

formal.mt: Id-deputat ippreżenta proposta fil-parlament dwar it-trasport pubbliku.
formal.en: The deputy presented a proposal in parliament concerning public transport.
formal.zh: 这位议员在议会提出了一项有关公共交通的提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jitkellem fil-laqgħa? Pawlu: Id-deputat tad-distrett tagħna; tista' tistaqsih dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is going to speak at the meeting? Pawlu: Our district's member of parliament; you can ask him about the buses.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁会在会上发言？Pawlu：我们选区的议员；你可以问他公交车的事。

messages.speaker: Maja (居民)
messages.zh: 谁会在会上发言？
messages.en: Who is going to speak at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-deputat tad-distrett tagħna; tista' tistaqsih dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.mt_standard: Id-deputat tad-distrett tagħna; tista' tistaqsih dwar il-karozzi tal-linja.
messages.zh: 我们选区的议员；你可以问他公交车的事。
messages.en: Our district's member of parliament; you can ask him about the buses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位替选区居民在议会发言的人，用“代表居民说话”的画面记住 deputat。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An authorized exemption from a requirement or an exception to the usual application of a rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经许可免于遵守某项要求，或对通常适用的规则作出的例外安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Eżenzjoni awtorizzata minn rekwiżit jew eċċezzjoni għall-applikazzjoni normali ta' regola.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 豁免；免除某项要求，或放弃某项权利、请求的安排。
例外适用；在特定条件下偏离通常规则或免除其适用。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat approva deroga temporanja mir-regola dwar il-ħinijiet tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The committee approved a temporary derogation from the rule on delivery times.
formal.zh: 委员会批准对交货时间规定实行临时例外安排。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Nista' nwassal l-oġġetti wara s-sitta? Mark: Biss jekk tingħata deroga; normalment il-bieb jagħlaq fis-sitta.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can I deliver the items after six? Mark: Only if you are granted an exemption; the gate normally closes at six.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我可以六点以后送货吗？Mark：只有获准例外才可以；大门通常六点关闭。

messages.speaker: Sara (送货员)
messages.zh: 我可以六点以后送货吗？
messages.en: Can I deliver the items after six?

messages.speaker: Mark (管理员)
messages.mt_spoken: Biss jekk tingħata deroga; normalment il-bieb jagħlaq fis-sitta.
messages.mt_standard: Biss jekk tingħata deroga; normalment il-bieb jagħlaq fis-sitta.
messages.zh: 只有获准例外才可以；大门通常六点关闭。
messages.en: Only if you are granted an exemption; the gate normally closes at six.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象规则旁盖着“本次获准例外”的印章：deroga 就是有条件的豁免或例外安排。

gloss_zh: 贬损的；带有侮辱意味的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Expressing disrespect or a low opinion of someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达轻视、贬低或不尊重某人某物的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jesprimi disprezz jew nuqqas ta' rispett lejn persuna jew ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贬损的；含有轻视、贬低或侮辱意味的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkritika l-użu ta' kliem derogatorju fil-konfront tal-ħaddiema.
formal.en: The report criticizes the use of derogatory language towards the workers.
formal.zh: 报告批评了针对员工使用贬损性言辞的行为。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Dan il-kumment jidher derogatorju? Adam: Iva, ibdel il-kliem biex tesprimi l-kritika b'rispett.
colloquial.en: Nina: Does this comment seem derogatory? Adam: Yes, change the wording so that you express the criticism respectfully.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这条评论听起来有贬损意味吗？Adam：有，换个说法，尊重地表达批评。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 这条评论听起来有贬损意味吗？
messages.en: Does this comment seem derogatory?

messages.speaker: Adam (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ibdel il-kliem biex tesprimi l-kritika b'rispett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ibdel il-kliem biex tesprimi l-kritika b'rispett.
messages.zh: 有，换个说法，尊重地表达批评。
messages.en: Yes, change the wording so that you express the criticism respectfully.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derogatorju 与“话里把人看低”联想起来，重点记住言辞中的轻视和贬损意味。

gloss_zh: 扬谷；使谷糠分离；散播；借活动排忧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate grain from chaff, especially by tossing it so that moving air carries the chaff away.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使谷粒与糠秕分离，尤其指扬起谷物，利用流动的空气带走轻糠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred il-qamħ mill-karfa, speċjalment billi jitfgħu fl-arja biex ir-riħ iġorr il-karfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扬谷；通过扬起谷物等方式除去轻糠。

sense_translations.en_definition: to indulge in activities that keep worries at bay
sense_translations.zh_definition: 投入能暂时排遣烦恼、使自己不受忧虑困扰的活动。
将麦粒与糠秕分开。
撒开；使事物分散到各处。

sense_translations.en_definition: to thresh or winnow (separate the grain from the chaff, regardless of manner)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 打谷或扬谷；不限定具体方式，使谷粒与糠秕分离。

collocations.en: he winnowed the wheat in the wind
he scattered the seeds on the ground

formal.mt: Il-bidwi derra l-qamħ biex jifred il-ħbub mill-karfa.
formal.en: The farmer winnowed the wheat to separate the grains from the chaff.
formal.zh: 农夫扬麦，使麦粒与糠秕分离。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'għamel in-nannu bil-qamħ? Pawlu: Derra l-qamħ; ir-riħ ġarr il-karfa u l-ħbub baqgħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Grandpa do with the wheat? Pawlu: He winnowed it; the wind carried away the chaff and the grains remained.
colloquial.zh: Maja：爷爷对那些麦子做了什么？Pawlu：他扬了麦；风吹走糠秕，麦粒留了下来。

messages.speaker: Maja (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷对那些麦子做了什么？
messages.en: What did Grandpa do with the wheat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Derra l-qamħ; ir-riħ ġarr il-karfa u l-ħbub baqgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Derra l-qamħ; ir-riħ ġarr il-karfa u l-ħbub baqgħu.
messages.zh: 他扬了麦；风吹走糠秕，麦粒留了下来。
messages.en: He winnowed it; the wind carried away the chaff and the grains remained.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记“扬起麦子，轻糠随风走”的动作画面；散播和借活动排忧另作情境卡记忆，不把这些义项当作词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A machine or implement used to separate grain from harvested stalks or ears.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于使谷粒从收割后的谷秆或谷穗上脱离的机器或农具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Magna jew għodda użata biex tifred il-ħbub miz-zkuk jew mis-sbul wara l-ħsad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 脱粒机；使谷粒从谷穗或谷秆上脱离的农业机械。
脱粒农具；用于打谷、使谷粒脱离植株的工具。

formal.mt: Il-mużew juri derriesa qadima li kienet tintuża wara l-ħsad tal-qamħ.
formal.en: The museum displays an old threshing machine that was used after the wheat harvest.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一台过去在小麦收割后使用的旧式脱粒机。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Għal xiex tintuża din il-magna? Ġużeppi: Din derriesa; tifred il-ħbub miz-zkuk wara l-ħsad.
colloquial.en: Lina: What is this machine used for? Ġużeppi: This is a threshing machine; it separates the grains from the stalks after the harvest.
colloquial.zh: Lina：这台机器是做什么用的？Ġużeppi：这是脱粒机，收割后用来把谷粒从谷秆上分离出来。

messages.speaker: Lina (参观者)
messages.zh: 这台机器是做什么用的？
messages.en: What is this machine used for?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Din derriesa; tifred il-ħbub miz-zkuk wara l-ħsad.
messages.mt_standard: Din derriesa; tifred il-ħbub miz-zkuk wara l-ħsad.
messages.zh: 这是脱粒机，收割后用来把谷粒从谷秆上分离出来。
messages.en: This is a threshing machine; it separates the grains from the stalks after the harvest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象收割后的麦穗进入机器、谷粒脱落的画面；derriesa 指完成脱粒工作的机器或农具。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The lentisk or mastic shrub, Pistacia lentiscus; the word can also refer to its resin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 乳香黄连木，即 Pistacia lentiscus；该词也可指这种植物的树脂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arbuxxell magħruf bħala Pistacia lentiscus; il-kelma tista' tirreferi wkoll għar-raża tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: Lentisk (Pistacia lentiscus)endemik and protected in Malta.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 乳香黄连木（Pistacia lentiscus）；此义项标注其为马耳他特有且受保护的植物。
乳香黄连木，亦称乳香灌木（Pistacia lentiscus）。
乳香黄连木树脂；这种植物分泌的树脂。

collocations.en: the resin of the mastic shrub

formal.mt: It-tikketta tidentifika l-arbuxxell bħala deru, bl-isem xjentifiku Pistacia lentiscus.
formal.en: The label identifies the shrub as lentisk, with the scientific name Pistacia lentiscus.
formal.zh: 标签将这株灌木标为乳香黄连木，学名为 Pistacia lentiscus。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jismu dan l-arbuxxell? Toni: Dan deru; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ir-raża tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this shrub called? Toni: This is lentisk; the word can also mean its resin.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这种灌木叫什么？Toni：这是乳香黄连木；这个词也可以指它的树脂。

messages.speaker: Maja (游客)
messages.zh: 这种灌木叫什么？
messages.en: What is this shrub called?

messages.speaker: Toni (自然导览员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan deru; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ir-raża tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Dan deru; il-kelma tista' tfisser ukoll ir-raża tiegħu.
messages.zh: 这是乳香黄连木；这个词也可以指它的树脂。
messages.en: This is lentisk; the word can also mean its resin.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一株灌木，再在旁边画一滴树脂，两处都标 deru，帮助区分植物本身与树脂两个指称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To drive someone into a state of extreme agitation or make a situation chaotic.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人极度烦躁、近乎发狂，或使场面陷入混乱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jiġġennen jew joħloq taħwid kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人极度烦躁或愤怒，近乎发狂。
制造严重混乱，使场面失去秩序。
使人发狂；把人弄得心烦意乱。

collocations.zh: 把所有人都弄得快发狂了

collocations.en: sent the whole class into chaos
collocations.zh: 把整个班级搅得一团乱

formal.mt: L-istorbju kontinwu derwex lill-ħaddiema u fixkel ix-xogħol tagħhom.
formal.en: The constant noise drove the workers crazy and disrupted their work.
formal.zh: 持续不断的噪声让工人们烦躁不堪，也干扰了他们的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak l-istorbju derwex lil kulħadd! Mark: Veru! Ejja mmorru f'post iktar kwiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: That noise drove everyone crazy! Mark: It really did! Let's go somewhere quieter.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那噪声把大家都弄得快发狂了！Mark：可不是嘛！我们去个安静一点的地方吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 那噪声把大家都弄得快发狂了！
messages.en: That noise drove everyone crazy!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ejja mmorru f'post iktar kwiet.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ejja mmorru f'post iktar kwiet.
messages.zh: 可不是嘛！我们去个安静一点的地方吧。
messages.en: It really did! Let's go somewhere quieter.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把它联想到噪声把全班搅得心烦意乱的画面：既能记住“使人发狂”，也能记住“制造混乱”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A member of a Muslim Sufi religious order, often associated with an ascetic way of life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 伊斯兰教苏菲派修行团体的成员，常与苦修生活相联系，通常译为托钵修士或德尔维希。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru ta' ordni reliġjuż Sufi fl-Iżlam, spiss marbut ma' ħajja axxetika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 德尔维希，指伊斯兰教苏菲派的修行者，通常译为托钵修士。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-ħajja ta' derwix u l-prattiki reliġjużi tiegħu.
formal.en: The text describes the life of a dervish and his religious practices.
formal.zh: 这篇文章描述了一位托钵修士的生活及其宗教修行。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min hu dan ir-raġel fl-istorja? Pawlu: Huwa derwix, membru ta' ordni Sufi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who is this man in the story? Pawlu: He is a dervish, a member of a Sufi order.
colloquial.zh: Sara：故事里的这个男人是谁？Pawlu：他是一位托钵修士，属于一个苏菲派修行团体。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 故事里的这个男人是谁？
messages.en: Who is this man in the story?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa derwix, membru ta' ordni Sufi.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa derwix, membru ta' ordni Sufi.
messages.zh: 他是一位托钵修士，属于一个苏菲派修行团体。
messages.en: He is a dervish, a member of a Sufi order.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 derwix 放进人物介绍卡，旁边写“苏菲派修行者”；用人物身份记名词，避免与表示搅乱的 derwex 混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoken or written account explaining what someone or something is like.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用口头或书面语言说明某人或某物的样子、特点或情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħrif bil-kliem jew bil-kitba li juri kif inhi persuna jew ħaġa.
