sense_translations.zh_definition: 描述；对人物、事物或情况所作的口头或书面说明。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jinkludi deskrizzjoni dettaljata tal-bini u tal-kundizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The report includes a detailed description of the building and its condition.
formal.zh: 报告包含对这座建筑及其状况的详细描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek deskrizzjoni tal-borża li tlift? Mark: Iva, hija sewda u għandha żewġ bwiet fuq quddiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you have a description of the bag you lost? Mark: Yes, it is black and has two pockets on the front.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你能描述一下丢的包吗？Mark：可以，它是黑色的，前面有两个口袋。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能描述一下丢的包吗？
messages.en: Do you have a description of the bag you lost?

messages.speaker: Mark (失主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hija sewda u għandha żewġ bwiet fuq quddiem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hija sewda u għandha żewġ bwiet fuq quddiem.
messages.zh: 可以，它是黑色的，前面有两个口袋。
messages.en: Yes, it is black and has two pockets on the front.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象失物招领表上的“物品描述”一栏，把颜色、形状、口袋数量写进去，这段文字就是 deskrizzjoni。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The course of events in a person's life, especially when understood as shaped by forces beyond their control.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人生命中经历的际遇和最终走向，尤其指被认为受个人无法控制的力量支配的命运。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġrajjiet u t-triq tal-ħajja ta' persuna, speċjalment meta jitqiesu bħala mmexxija minn forzi barra mill-kontroll tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 命运；被认为注定的人生道路或未来归宿。
命运；个人难以控制的际遇或结局。
命运、宿命；被认为决定人生际遇和结局的力量或安排。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist jistaqsi jekk jistax ibiddel id-destin tiegħu.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist wonders whether he can change his destiny.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公思考自己能否改变命运。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Taħseb li kien id-destin li ltqajna? Daniel: Forsi, imma kien tajjeb li ġejt illum!
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you think it was fate that we met? Daniel: Maybe, but I'm glad you came today!
colloquial.zh: Lara：你觉得我们的相遇是命运的安排吗？Daniel：也许吧，不过我很高兴你今天来了！

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li kien id-destin li ltqajna?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li kien id-destin li ltqajna?
messages.zh: 你觉得我们的相遇是命运的安排吗？
messages.en: Do you think it was fate that we met?

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, imma kien tajjeb li ġejt illum!
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, imma kien tajjeb li ġejt illum!
messages.zh: 也许吧，不过我很高兴你今天来了！
messages.en: Maybe, but I'm glad you came today!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 destin 想成人生故事最后的走向：谈“命运如何安排”时用它；再配读 id-destin tiegħi，记住“我的命运”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The place that a person or thing is travelling to or is intended to reach.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或物正在前往、计划到达或被送往的地点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-post li persuna jew ħaġa tkun sejra lejh jew li tkun maħsuba biex tasal fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 目的地；旅程或运送所要到达的地点。

formal.mt: Il-passiġġieri għandhom jikkonfermaw id-destinazzjoni finali qabel jixtru l-biljett.
formal.en: Passengers should confirm their final destination before buying the ticket.
formal.zh: 乘客应在购票前确认最终目的地。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi d-destinazzjoni tagħna llum? Sara: Ir-Rabat. Nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Mark: What's our destination today? Sara: Rabat. We'll take the bus from here.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们今天的目的地是哪里？Sara：拉巴特。我们从这里坐公交车。

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.zh: 我们今天的目的地是哪里？
messages.en: What's our destination today?

messages.speaker: Sara (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-Rabat. Nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-Rabat. Nieħdu l-karozza tal-linja minn hawn.
messages.zh: 拉巴特。我们从这里坐公交车。
messages.en: Rabat. We'll take the bus from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象导航界面上的终点旗帜，把 destinazzjoni 贴在旗帜旁；它回答的是“这趟旅程要到哪里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A firm intention to achieve a goal and continue trying despite difficulties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为实现目标而坚定努力、即使遇到困难也继续坚持的决心。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ir-rieda soda li tilħaq għan u tibqa' tipprova minkejja d-diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决心；为实现目标而坚持努力的坚定意志。
决心、毅力；面对困难仍不轻易放弃的意志。

formal.mt: L-istudenta wriet determinazzjoni kbira u kompliet tistudja minkejja d-diffikultajiet.
formal.en: The student showed great determination and continued studying despite the difficulties.
formal.zh: 这名女学生表现出极大的决心，尽管遇到困难，仍继续学习。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-eżami diffiċli, imma se nibqa' nipprova. Pawlu: Għandek ħafna determinazzjoni. Ejja nistudjaw flimkien!
colloquial.en: Maja: This exam is difficult, but I'll keep trying. Pawlu: You have a lot of determination. Let's study together!
colloquial.zh: Maja：这场考试很难，不过我会继续努力。Pawlu：你很有决心。我们一起学习吧！

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-eżami diffiċli, imma se nibqa' nipprova.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-eżami diffiċli, imma se nibqa' nipprova.
messages.zh: 这场考试很难，不过我会继续努力。
messages.en: This exam is difficult, but I'll keep trying.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek ħafna determinazzjoni. Ejja nistudjaw flimkien!
messages.mt_standard: Għandek ħafna determinazzjoni. Ejja nistudjaw flimkien!
messages.zh: 你很有决心。我们一起学习吧！
messages.en: You have a lot of determination. Let's study together!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象遇到难题后仍继续练习的自己，把“我还要再试一次”与 determinazzjoni 连起来，记住坚持目标的决心。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small, specific part or fact within a larger description, situation, or whole.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 整体、情境或描述中一个具体而细小的部分或事实。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti żgħira u speċifika jew fatt partikolari fi ħdan deskrizzjoni, sitwazzjoni jew ħaġa sħiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 细节；整体中的一个具体部分，或说明中的一项具体信息。

formal.mt: Qabel il-pubblikazzjoni, l-editur ivverifika kull dettall fir-rapport.
formal.en: Before publication, the editor checked every detail in the report.
formal.zh: 出版前，编辑核查了报告中的每一个细节。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Insejna dettall importanti: il-ħin tal-laqgħa! Mark: Sewwa! Se nikteb li tibda fl-erbgħa.
colloquial.en: Sara: We forgot an important detail: the meeting time! Mark: Right! I'll write that it starts at four.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们忘了一个重要细节：开会时间！Mark：对！我会写上四点开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 我们忘了一个重要细节：开会时间！
messages.en: We forgot an important detail: the meeting time!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa! Se nikteb li tibda fl-erbgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa! Se nikteb li tibda fl-erbgħa.
messages.zh: 对！我会写上四点开始。
messages.en: Right! I'll write that it starts at four.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用放大镜查看通知上的开会时间：整张通知里这个具体小信息就是一个 dettall，细小却可能很重要。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A departure from an expected course or direction, including a change of direction or an alternative route around an obstruction.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 偏离原定或预期的路线、方向或标准，也可指改变方向或为避开障碍而绕行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbegħid minn rotta, direzzjoni jew norma mistennija, inkluż tibdil fid-direzzjoni jew rotta oħra biex jiġi evitat ostaklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 偏离；与预期路线、正常状态或既定标准之间的差异。
方向的改变；从原来的行进方向转向另一方向。
绕行；为避开封路或其他障碍而改走另一条路线。

formal.mt: Minħabba x-xogħlijiet fit-triq, ġiet introdotta devjazzjoni tat-traffiku għal ġimgħa.
formal.en: Because of the roadworks, a traffic diversion was introduced for one week.
formal.zh: 由于道路施工，实施了为期一周的交通改道。

colloquial.mt: Daniel: Għaliex qed immorru minn hawn? Lara: Hemm devjazzjoni għax it-triq prinċipali magħluqa.
colloquial.en: Daniel: Why are we going this way? Lara: There's a detour because the main road is closed.
colloquial.zh: Daniel：我们为什么走这边？Lara：主路封了，需要绕行。

messages.speaker: Daniel (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们为什么走这边？
messages.en: Why are we going this way?

messages.speaker: Lara (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm devjazzjoni għax it-triq prinċipali magħluqa.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm devjazzjoni għax it-triq prinċipali magħluqa.
messages.zh: 主路封了，需要绕行。
messages.en: There's a detour because the main road is closed.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条原定直线路线，再画一个转弯绕过路障的箭头；用这幅图串起 devjazzjoni 的“偏离、转向、绕行”三个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To sound or echo so that a noise is heard again or carries through a space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指声音鸣响，或在某个空间中传播、产生回声。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel ħoss li jinstema' jidwi jew jinfirex f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回响；产生回声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sound, to ring, to echo
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发出声响；鸣响；回荡。

collocations.en: The sound echoed through the hall.
His voice echoed through the valley.
collocations.zh: 他的声音在山谷中回响。

formal.mt: Meta ntemm id-diskors, iċ-ċapċip dewa fis-sala kollha.
formal.en: When the speech ended, applause resounded throughout the hall.
formal.zh: 演讲结束时，掌声响彻整个大厅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Pawlu: Iva, dewa mat-taraġ kollu!
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear that noise? Paul: Yes, it echoed all through the stairwell!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听到刚才那个声音了吗？保罗：听到了，整个楼梯间都在回响！

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听到刚才那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that noise?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 听到了，整个楼梯间都在回响！
messages.en: Yes, it echoed all through the stairwell!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dewa 放进山谷回声的画面里：喊一声，声音又传回来；用“声音回响”这一场景记住它。

gloss_zh: 一段时间；持续时长；拖延

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of time or the length of time something lasts; also procrastination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一段时间或某事持续的时长；也可指迟迟不行动的拖延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda ta' żmien jew kemm iddum xi ħaġa; ukoll it-tkaxkir biex wieħed jagħmel xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一段时间；某个时间跨度。
持续时间；时长。
拖延；将应做的事情一再推后。

formal.mt: Id-dewm tal-proċess jiddependi min-numru ta' applikazzjonijiet li jaslu.
formal.en: The duration of the process depends on the number of applications received.
formal.zh: 该过程的持续时间取决于收到的申请数量。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Biżżejjed dewm! Se nibdew? Toni: Iva, lest. Nibdew issa.
colloquial.en: Maria: Enough putting it off! Shall we start? Tony: Yes, I'm ready. Let's start now.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：别再拖了！我们开始吧？托尼：好，我准备好了。现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Marija (同学)
messages.zh: 别再拖了！我们开始吧？
messages.en: Enough putting it off! Shall we start?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 好，我准备好了。现在就开始。
messages.en: Yes, I'm ready. Let's start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dewm 配一只计时器：正常计时表示“一段时间、时长”，迟迟不按开始键则表示“拖延”。

gloss_zh: 延误；迟到；持续时间；拖延

teaching_sense.en_definition: A delay or lateness in something happening, sometimes referring to its duration or to putting it off.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事情发生得比预期晚所造成的延误或迟到；也可表示持续时间或拖延。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Meta xi ħaġa ssir aktar tard milli mistenni; jista' jfisser ukoll kemm iddum jew it-tkaxkir biex issir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 延误；耽搁。
迟到；不准时。
持续时间；某事所占的时长。
拖延；迟迟不开始或不完成应做之事。

formal.mt: Minħabba xogħlijiet fit-triq, huwa mistenni dewmien ta' għoxrin minuta fis-servizz tal-karozzi tal-linja.
formal.en: Because of roadworks, a twenty-minute delay is expected in the bus service.
formal.zh: 由于道路施工，公交服务预计会延误二十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadna hawn? Mark: Hemm dewmien minħabba t-traffiku. Sara: Tajjeb, navża lil ommi.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are we still here? Mark: There's a delay because of the traffic. Sara: Okay, I'll let my mum know.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们怎么还在这里？马克：因为堵车，耽搁了。萨拉：好吧，我告诉妈妈一声。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们怎么还在这里？
messages.en: Why are we still here?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 因为堵车，耽搁了。
messages.en: There's a delay because of the traffic.

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 好吧，我告诉妈妈一声。
messages.en: Okay, I'll let my mum know.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公交站牌上显示“晚点二十分钟”，用 dewmien 记这段耽搁；再把它与一般的“持续时长”联系起来。

gloss_zh: 医治；处理伤口；弥补伤害

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat or heal an illness or wound, or to make amends for harm caused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 医治疾病、治疗或处理伤口；也可指弥补已经造成的冒犯或伤害。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jikkura marda jew ferita, jew jagħmel tajjeb għal offiża jew ħsara li jkun għamel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治愈；使伤病得到恢复。
处理、敷治或包扎伤口。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make amends for an offence or injury
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为冒犯或伤害作出补偿；弥补过错。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cure, treat, help (someone wounded or their wounds, someone ill or their issues)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 医治、照料或帮助伤者及其伤口，或帮助病人处理疾病及相关问题。

formal.mt: Wara li eżamina lill-pazjent, it-tabib dewwa l-ferita u spjega kif kellha tinżamm nadifa.
formal.en: After examining the patient, the doctor treated the wound and explained how it should be kept clean.
formal.zh: 检查病人后，医生处理了伤口，并说明了应如何保持伤口清洁。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min dewwa l-ferita? Ġanni: L-infermier. Issa nħossni aħjar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who treated the wound? Gianni: The nurse. I feel better now.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：谁给你处理了伤口？詹尼：护士。现在我感觉好些了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给你处理了伤口？
messages.en: Who treated the wound?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (伤者)
messages.zh: 护士。现在我感觉好些了。
messages.en: The nurse. I feel better now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面对比 dewa 与 dewwa：前者听见回声，后者看见护士处理伤口；把双写 w 当作提醒治疗场景的记号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make or let someone taste something, or cause someone to experience something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让某人尝一尝某物；也可表示使某人亲身经历某种感受或处境。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel jew iħalli lil xi ħadd iduq xi ħaġa, jew jgħaddi minn esperjenza.

sense_translations.en_definition: to give a taste of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给某人尝一点某物；让人初步领略某事物。

sense_translations.en_definition: to allow sb. to experience sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 让某人体验或经历某事。
使某人品尝某物。
使某人经历某种事情、处境或感受。

collocations.en: gave the children a taste of the cheese

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara, il-kok dewwaq lill-istudenti diversi platti u spjega l-ingredjenti tagħhom.
formal.en: During the visit, the chef let the students taste several dishes and explained their ingredients.
formal.zh: 参观期间，厨师让学生们品尝了几道菜，并介绍了各道菜的食材。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dewwaqni ftit mis-soppa, jekk jogħġbok. Luqa: Żgur, ħu kuċċarina. Maja: Tajba ħafna!
colloquial.en: Maya: Let me taste a little of the soup, please. Luke: Sure, take a spoonful. Maya: It's really good!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请让我尝一点汤。卢卡：当然，舀一勺吧。玛雅：真好喝！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 请让我尝一点汤。
messages.en: Let me taste a little of the soup, please.

messages.speaker: Luqa (做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，舀一勺吧。
messages.en: Sure, take a spoonful.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 真好喝！
messages.en: It's really good!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dewwaq 记成“把试吃勺递给别人”的动作：重点是让另一个人尝到，也能延伸为让人体验某种滋味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something melt or dissolve; figuratively, to squander money or resources.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物熔化或溶解；用于比喻时，指挥霍金钱或资源。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel xi ħaġa tinħall jew issir likwida; b'mod figurattiv, iberbaq flus jew riżorsi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物溶解。
使熔化；使溶解。
挥霍；浪费金钱或资源。

formal.mt: Biex tipprepara t-taħlita, dewweb iz-zokkor fl-ilma sħun u ħawwad sakemm jinħall kollu.
formal.en: To prepare the mixture, dissolve the sugar in the warm water and stir until it has all dissolved.
formal.zh: 配制混合液时，把糖溶解在温水中，并搅拌至完全溶解。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'nagħmel bil-butir? Ben: Dewweb il-butir l-ewwel, imbagħad żid id-dqiq. Anna: Tajjeb, nagħmel hekk.
colloquial.en: Anna: What do I do with the butter? Ben: Melt the butter first, then add the flour. Anna: Okay, I'll do that.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：黄油要怎么处理？本：先把黄油融化，再加面粉。安娜：好，我照着做。

messages.speaker: Anna (学做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 黄油要怎么处理？
messages.en: What do I do with the butter?

messages.speaker: Ben (教做饭的朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dewweb il-butir l-ewwel, imbagħad żid id-dqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Dewweb il-butir l-ewwel, imbagħad żid id-dqiq.
messages.zh: 先把黄油融化，再加面粉。
messages.en: Melt the butter first, then add the flour.

messages.speaker: Anna (学做饭的朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我照着做。
messages.en: Okay, I'll do that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象糖在水里消失、黄油在锅里融化，再想象钱被挥霍得消失；用这三个画面串联 dewweb 的不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become infested with bugs, worms or lice.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生虫；受到虫害侵染，或变得满是蠕虫、虱子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimtela bid-dud, bil-qamel jew b'insetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生虫；受到虫害侵染。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be full in worms or lice
sense_translations.zh_definition: 满是蠕虫或虱子；长满虫子。

collocations.en: The wheat became infested with bugs.
The apples became infested with worms.

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni nstab li l-qamħ maħżun dewwed, u għalhekk ma tqassamx.
formal.en: During the inspection, the stored wheat was found to have become infested with bugs, so it was not distributed.
formal.zh: 检查发现储存的小麦已经生虫，因此没有分发。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex warrabt dak it-tuffieħ? Samwel: Għax dewwed. Ara d-dud ġewwa. Rita: Mela nieħdu tuffieħ ieħor.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you set those apples aside? Samuel: Because they've got worms. Look at the worms inside. Rita: Then let's get some other apples.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么把那些苹果放到一边？萨姆韦尔：因为生虫了。看，里面有虫子。丽塔：那我们拿别的苹果吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 你为什么把那些苹果放到一边？
messages.en: Why did you set those apples aside?

messages.speaker: Samwel (家人)
messages.zh: 因为生虫了。看，里面有虫子。
messages.en: Because they've got worms. Look at the worms inside.

messages.speaker: Rita (家人)
messages.zh: 那我们拿别的苹果吧。
messages.en: Then let's get some other apples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dewwed 和切开苹果后发现虫子的画面绑定：这里记的是“东西生虫了”，主语就是受虫害影响的东西。

gloss_zh: 使耽搁；拖延；留住；让人等候

teaching_sense.en_definition: To delay someone or something, hold someone up, or keep someone waiting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某事耽搁，把人留住，或让某人等候。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa tasal jew issir aktar tard, iżomm lil xi ħadd, jew iħallih jistenna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人耽搁；使某事延后。
延迟；拖延；耽搁。
留住某人；使某人暂时不能离开。
让某人一直等候；使某人久等。

formal.mt: Il-kontroll addizzjonali dewwem lill-passiġġieri għal nofs siegħa qabel ma setgħu jitilgħu fuq il-vapur.
formal.en: The additional check held up the passengers for half an hour before they could board the ship.
formal.zh: 额外检查耽搁了乘客半小时，之后他们才得以上船。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex wasalt tard? David: Skużani, it-traffiku dewwimni. Marta: Tajjeb, ejja nitilqu issa.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you arrive late? David: Sorry, the traffic held me up. Marta: Okay, let's leave now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你怎么来晚了？戴维：抱歉，堵车把我耽搁了。玛尔塔：好吧，我们现在走。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么来晚了？
messages.en: Why did you arrive late?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 抱歉，堵车把我耽搁了。
messages.en: Sorry, the traffic held me up.

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 好吧，我们现在走。
messages.en: Okay, let's leave now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dewwem 记为“让别人的时钟往后走”：堵车耽搁乘客、事情推迟会议，都突出某个原因使人或事延后。

gloss_zh: 迟到者；拖延者；始终如一或忠诚的人；迟缓的；持久的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who arrives late or causes delays; in other senses, a person who is constant or faithful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指迟到或使事情延误的人；另一些义项指始终如一或忠诚的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tasal tard jew iddewwem l-affarijiet; f'tifsiriet oħra, persuna li tibqa' kostanti jew leali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 迟到的人；到得晚的人。
使事情延误的人；拖延者。
始终如一的人；恒定不变的人。
忠诚的人；忠实可靠的人。
迟到的；迟缓的；行动慢的。
造成延误的；使事情拖延的。
持久的；持续不变的；恒常的。

collocations.en: a person who is late or causes delays at work
collocations.zh: 工作中迟到或拖延的人

formal.mt: Id-dewwiem għandu jasal qabel tibda l-laqgħa sabiex ma jtellifx lill-parteċipanti l-oħra.
formal.en: The latecomer should arrive before the meeting begins so as not to disturb the other participants.
formal.zh: 这位常迟到的人应在会议开始前到场，以免打扰其他与会者。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed nistennew lil Mark? Pawlu: Għax hu dewwiem; dejjem jasal għaxar minuti tard.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are we waiting for Mark? Pawlu: Because he's a latecomer; he always arrives ten minutes late.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们为什么还在等马克？保罗：因为他是个常迟到的人，总要晚到十分钟。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们为什么还在等马克？
messages.en: Why are we waiting for Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu dewwiem; dejjem jasal għaxar minuti tard.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hu dewwiem; dejjem jasal għaxar minuti tard.
messages.zh: 因为他是个常迟到的人，总要晚到十分钟。
messages.en: Because he's a latecomer; he always arrives ten minutes late.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“大家都到了，他还没来”的画面记名词“迟到者”；再另记“持久、忠诚”这一组义项，阅读时结合词性和语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A device that turns with the wind to show the direction from which it is blowing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随风转动、用来显示风从哪个方向吹来的装置。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat li jdur mar-riħ u juri minn liema direzzjoni jkun ġej ir-riħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风向标；随风转动以指示来风方向的装置。

collocations.en: a weather vane on the roof

formal.mt: Id-dewwiema fuq il-bejt turi minn liema direzzjoni jkun ġej ir-riħ.
formal.en: The weather vane on the roof shows the direction from which the wind is blowing.
formal.zh: 屋顶上的风向标显示风从哪个方向吹来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik il-ħaġa li ddur fuq il-bejt? Nannu: Dik dewwiema; turina minn fejn ġej ir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: What's that thing turning on the roof? Grandpa: That's a weather vane; it shows us where the wind is coming from.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：屋顶上那个转动的东西是什么？爷爷：那是风向标，告诉我们风从哪边吹来。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi dik il-ħaġa li ddur fuq il-bejt?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi dik il-ħaġa li ddur fuq il-bejt?
messages.zh: 屋顶上那个转动的东西是什么？
messages.en: What's that thing turning on the roof?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik dewwiema; turina minn fejn ġej ir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Dik dewwiema; turina minn fejn ġej ir-riħ.
messages.zh: 那是风向标，告诉我们风从哪边吹来。
messages.en: That's a weather vane; it shows us where the wind is coming from.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象屋顶上有一支随风转动的小箭头，把整个词与“转动着指示风向”的画面相连；这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 迟缓的；爱逗留的；惯于拖延的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Slow to act or move on, with a tendency to linger or postpone things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行动迟缓、容易逗留，或习惯把事情往后拖的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jdum biex jaġixxi jew jitlaq, jew li għandu tendenza jħalli l-affarijiet għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缓慢的；行动迟缓的。
容易逗留的；往往迟迟不离开的。

sense_translations.en_definition: having a tendency to delay things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有拖延事情倾向的；常使事情延后的。
惯于拖延的；常把该做的事留到以后的。

formal.mt: L-atteġġjament dewwiemi tal-organizzatur wassal biex it-tħejjijiet bdew aktar tard milli kien ippjanat.
formal.en: The organizer's procrastinatory attitude caused the preparations to begin later than planned.
formal.zh: 组织者拖延的态度导致筹备工作比原计划更晚开始。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għadek ma bdejtx ir-rapport? Mark: Le, għandi karattru dewwiemi, imma se nibda issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: You still haven't started the report? Mark: No, I tend to procrastinate, but I'll start now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你还没开始写报告？马克：没有，我这个人爱拖延，不过现在就开始。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你还没开始写报告？
messages.en: You still haven't started the report?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għandi karattru dewwiemi, imma se nibda issa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għandi karattru dewwiemi, imma se nibda issa.
messages.zh: 没有，我这个人爱拖延，不过现在就开始。
messages.en: No, I tend to procrastinate, but I'll start now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个形容词贴在“明天再做”的便条旁，记住它描述迟缓、逗留或拖延的倾向；用“拖延的态度”这一搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 已决定的；坚定的；坚决的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Already settled by a decision, or firm and determined about a choice or intention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经决定或确定的；也形容人在选择或意图上坚定、坚决。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li diġà ġie stabbilit permezz ta' deċiżjoni, jew li hu sod u determinat fl-għażla jew fl-intenzjoni tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已决定的；已确定的。
坚定的；坚决的。
有决心的；坚定的；果断坚决的；已拿定主意的。

formal.mt: Id-direttur tkellem b'ton deċiż u kkonferma li l-proġett kien se jkompli.
formal.en: The director spoke in a firm tone and confirmed that the project would continue.
formal.zh: 主管以坚定的语气讲话，并确认项目将继续进行。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għadek trid tagħmel il-kors? Mark: Iva, jien deċiż li nkompli, anki jekk ikun diffiċli.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you still want to take the course? Mark: Yes, I'm determined to continue, even if it's difficult.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你还想上这门课吗？Mark：想，我决心继续，即使会很难。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你还想上这门课吗？
messages.en: Do you still want to take the course?

messages.speaker: Mark (学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jien deċiż li nkompli, anki jekk ikun diffiċli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jien deċiż li nkompli, anki jekk ikun diffiċli.
messages.zh: 想，我决心继续，即使会很难。
messages.en: Yes, I'm determined to continue, even if it's difficult.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“主意已经定下，语气十分坚定”串联 deċiż 的含义；记住它是形容词，描述确定或坚决的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A choice or conclusion reached after considering what to do.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 考虑该怎么做之后作出的选择或结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għażla jew konklużjoni li wieħed jasal għaliha wara li jqis x'għandu jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决定；决策；作出的选择。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat ħa deċiżjoni importanti wara li eżamina l-proposti kollha.
formal.en: The committee made an important decision after examining all the proposals.
formal.zh: 委员会审查所有提案后，作出了一项重要决定。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħadt deċiżjoni dwar il-vjaġġ? Lara: Iva, se mmur f'Diċembru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you made a decision about the trip? Lara: Yes, I'm going in December.
colloquial.zh: Maja：关于旅行，你作出决定了吗？Lara：作出了，我打算十二月去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 关于旅行，你作出决定了吗？
messages.en: Have you made a decision about the trip?

messages.speaker: Lara (旅行者)
messages.zh: 作出了，我打算十二月去。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going in December.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 deċiżjoni 想成选择题上最终画下的圈，表示“一个决定”；整块记忆 tieħu deċiżjoni，即“作出决定”。

gloss_zh: 沙漠；荒野；无人居住的地方

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very dry region with little vegetation, or more broadly a wild or uninhabited place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植被稀少、非常干旱的地区；也可泛指荒野或无人居住的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda art niexfa ħafna bi ftit veġetazzjoni; jista' jfisser ukoll post selvaġġ jew bla abitanti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 沙漠；降水稀少、植被稀疏的干旱地区。
荒野；人类活动稀少、保持自然状态的地方。
无人居住的地方；荒无人烟之地。

formal.mt: Il-grupp qasam id-deżert ma' gwida u ġarr miegħu biżżejjed ilma għall-vjaġġ.
formal.en: The group crossed the desert with a guide and carried enough water for the journey.
formal.zh: 这支队伍在向导带领下穿越沙漠，并携带了旅途中所需的足够饮水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn ħadtu dan ir-ritratt? Toni: Fid-deżert, waqt il-vjaġġ tagħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you take this photo? Toni: In the desert, during our trip.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这张照片是你们在哪里拍的？托尼：在沙漠里，我们旅行的时候拍的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张照片是你们在哪里拍的？
messages.en: Where did you take this photo?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 在沙漠里，我们旅行的时候拍的。
messages.en: In the desert, during our trip.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先联想大片干旱、植被稀少的土地来记“沙漠”，再把画面扩展到荒野和无人居住之地，帮助区分三个相关义项。

gloss_zh: 使变弱；使衰弱；虚弱的；无力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone or something weaker or less able to function effectively.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人或某物力量减小、身体衰弱或效能降低。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inaqqas is-saħħa ta' persuna jew ta' ħaġa, jew jagħmilha inqas kapaċi taħdem sew.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使变弱；削弱某人或某物的力量。
使衰弱；使失去体力或活力。
弱的；虚弱的；力量不足的。
衰弱的；无力的；强度很低的。

formal.mt: Il-mard dgħajjef lill-pazjent, li kellu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
formal.en: The illness weakened the patient, who needed assistance to walk.
formal.zh: 疾病使病人身体虚弱，走路需要他人协助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tistrieħ daqshekk? Mark: Il-mard dgħajjef ġismi; għadni nħossni għajjien.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why are you resting so much? Mark: The illness weakened my body; I still feel tired.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么休息这么久？马克：这场病让我身体变弱了，我现在还觉得累。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你怎么休息这么久？
messages.en: Why are you resting so much?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-mard dgħajjef ġismi; għadni nħossni għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Il-mard dgħajjef ġismi; għadni nħossni għajjien.
messages.zh: 这场病让我身体变弱了，我现在还觉得累。
messages.en: The illness weakened my body; I still feel tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张句子卡区分词性：“疾病使他变弱”记动词，“微弱的声音”记形容词；同一拼写在句中承担的作用不同。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A vessel used to travel on water, especially a small one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于在水上航行的船只，尤其指小船。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mezz tat-trasport li jżomm fuq l-ilma u jintuża biex wieħed jivvjaġġa fuqu, ġeneralment ta' daqs żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 船；用于水上航行的小船或船只。

collocations.zh: 乘船游览；坐船的一段行程

formal.mt: Id-dgħajsa tas-sajd telqet mill-port kmieni filgħodu u reġgħet lura wara nofsinhar.
formal.en: The fishing boat left the harbour early in the morning and returned in the afternoon.
formal.zh: 渔船清晨驶离港口，下午返回。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Trid tmur għal rikba bid-dgħajsa? Toni: Iva, ejja nieħdu d-dgħajsa minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you want to go for a boat ride? Toni: Yes, let's take the boat from here.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：你想坐船兜一圈吗？托尼：想，我们就在这里坐船吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想坐船兜一圈吗？
messages.en: Do you want to go for a boat ride?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja nieħdu d-dgħajsa minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja nieħdu d-dgħajsa minn hawn.
messages.zh: 想，我们就在这里坐船吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's take the boat from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一条停在港口的小船，在旁边写上整词；再分别加上渔网和船帆，用“渔船、帆船”两个搭配反复提取词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grow dark or become less clearly visible as light fades.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 随着光线减弱而变暗，或变得难以看清。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir mudlam jew anqas ċar għax jonqos id-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；逐渐昏暗下来。
变得昏暗；变得模糊、难以看清。

formal.mt: Hekk kif niżlet ix-xemx, il-wied dgħam u l-mogħdija saret diffiċli biex tidher.
formal.en: As the sun set, the valley grew dark and the path became difficult to see.
formal.zh: 随着太阳落下，山谷暗了下来，小路也变得难以看清。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex xgħelt id-dawl? Pawlu: Għax is-sema dgħam u hawn ġew mudlam.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you turn on the light? Pawlu: Because the sky has grown dark and it's dark in here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么开灯了？保罗：因为天暗下来了，屋里很黑。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么开灯了？
messages.en: Why did you turn on the light?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax is-sema dgħam u hawn ġew mudlam.
messages.mt_standard: Għax is-sema dgħam u hawn ġew mudlam.
messages.zh: 因为天暗下来了，屋里很黑。
messages.en: Because the sky has grown dark and it's dark in here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象夕阳落下后山谷逐渐看不清，把这个词记成“光线减弱，景物变暗”的变化过程，而不只是一幅静态的黑暗画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become weaker or lose physical strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 自身变得虚弱，或体力逐渐减退。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir inqas b'saħħtu jew jitlef mis-saħħa ta' ġismu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得衰弱；身体逐渐失去力量。
变得虚弱；力量减退。

collocations.en: became weak because of a lack of food
collocations.zh: 因食物不足而变得虚弱

formal.mt: Il-pazjent dgħief wara ġimgħat ta' mard u kellu bżonn l-għajnuna biex iqum mis-sodda.
formal.en: The patient became weak after weeks of illness and needed help to get out of bed.
formal.zh: 病人数周患病后变得虚弱，下床需要他人帮助。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif inhu n-nannu llum? Mark: Dgħief wara l-marda, imma llum kiel ftit aktar.
colloquial.en: Lara: How is Grandpa today? Mark: He became weak after the illness, but today he ate a little more.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：爷爷今天怎么样？马克：他病后变虚弱了，不过今天多吃了一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 爷爷今天怎么样？
messages.en: How is Grandpa today?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Dgħief wara l-marda, imma llum kiel ftit aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Dgħief wara l-marda, imma llum kiel ftit aktar.
messages.zh: 他病后变虚弱了，不过今天多吃了一点。
messages.en: He became weak after the illness, but today he ate a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“他病后变虚弱了”记住自身状态的变化；与动词 dgħajjef 的“使别人变弱”并排练习，重点辨认谁发生变化、谁造成变化。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Thin in build, or containing little fat when describing meat.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人身材瘦，或形容肉所含脂肪很少。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ġisem irqiq, jew li fih ftit xaħam meta jingħad għal-laħam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瘦的；身上脂肪少的。

sense_translations.en_definition: without fat (used of a cut of meat)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 不带肥肉的；用于形容一块肉。
瘦肉；肉中不带肥肉的部分。
瘦的；指肉中脂肪含量少。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, agħżel laħam dgħif u neħħi x-xaħam li jidher.
formal.en: For this recipe, choose lean meat and remove any visible fat.
formal.zh: 制作这道菜时，选用瘦肉，并去掉看得见的脂肪。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandek laħam dgħif għal din ir-riċetta? Pawlu: Iva, din il-biċċa fiha ftit xaħam.
colloquial.en: Mark: Do you have lean meat for this recipe? Pawlu: Yes, this piece has little fat.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你有适合做这道菜的瘦肉吗？Pawlu：有，这块肉脂肪很少。

messages.speaker: Mark（顾客）
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek laħam dgħif għal din ir-riċetta?
messages.mt_standard: Għandek laħam dgħif għal din ir-riċetta?
messages.zh: 你有适合做这道菜的瘦肉吗？
messages.en: Do you have lean meat for this recipe?

messages.speaker: Pawlu（肉贩）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, din il-biċċa fiha ftit xaħam.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, din il-biċċa fiha ftit xaħam.
messages.zh: 有，这块肉脂肪很少。
messages.en: Yes, this piece has little fat.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把身材瘦的人和少肥肉的肉块并排想象：共同点是脂肪少。再用词性区分，形容词表示瘦的，名词表示瘦肉。

gloss_zh: 虚弱；衰弱；意志薄弱；缺乏决心

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of physical strength or firmness of mind and determination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体力量不足，或精神、意志和决心不够坚定的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' saħħa fil-ġisem jew ta' fermezza fil-ħsieb u fid-determinazzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 虚弱；力量或能力不足的状态。
衰弱；身体软弱无力。
意志薄弱；思想不坚定、容易受他人影响。
缺乏决心；不能坚定地作出决定或坚持行动。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddistingwi bejn dgħufija fiżika u nuqqas ta' determinazzjoni.
formal.en: The report distinguishes between physical weakness and a lack of determination.
formal.zh: 报告区分了身体虚弱与缺乏决心这两种情况。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadni nħoss dgħufija f'saqajja wara l-mixja. Lara: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: I still feel weakness in my legs after the walk. Lara: Let's sit down and rest a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：走完路后，我的双腿还是觉得无力。Lara：我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nħoss dgħufija f'saqajja wara l-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nħoss dgħufija f'saqajja wara l-mixja.
messages.zh: 走完路后，我的双腿还是觉得无力。
messages.en: I still feel weakness in my legs after the walk.

messages.speaker: Lara（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down and rest a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记忆：双腿没力气对应身体虚弱，作决定时总动摇对应意志薄弱；两者都可归入这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A state or atmosphere of darkness, sadness, or solemn gloom.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光线暗淡，或气氛忧郁、沉重的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stat jew atmosfera ta' dlam, dwejjaq jew serjetà tqila.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴暗；令人感到忧郁或压抑的气氛。
阴沉；肃穆而沉重的状态或气氛。
昏暗、阴郁或忧郁的状态。

formal.mt: Il-poeta juża xbihat ta' sħab u toroq vojta biex joħloq sens ta' dgħum.
formal.en: The poet uses images of clouds and empty streets to create a sense of gloom.
formal.zh: 诗人用云层与空荡街道的意象营造阴郁感。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm hawn dgħum f'din il-kamra! Lara: Niftaħ il-purtieri biex jidħol ftit dawl?
colloquial.en: Maja: It's so gloomy in this room! Lara: Shall I open the curtains to let in some light?
colloquial.zh: Maja：这间屋子真昏暗啊！Lara：我把窗帘拉开，让一点光进来好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja（室友）
messages.zh: 这间屋子真昏暗啊！
messages.en: It's so gloomy in this room!

messages.speaker: Lara（室友）
messages.mt_spoken: Niftaħ il-purtieri biex jidħol ftit dawl?
messages.mt_standard: Niftaħ il-purtieri biex jidħol ftit dawl?
messages.zh: 我把窗帘拉开，让一点光进来好吗？
messages.en: Shall I open the curtains to let in some light?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗帘紧闭、光线昏暗的房间，再把这种暗转成心情的阴郁；把 dgħum 记作这种状态的名词。

gloss_zh: 阴郁的；闷闷不乐的；情绪低落的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dark or gloomy in atmosphere, or sullen and low in mood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容环境或气氛阴郁，也可形容人闷闷不乐、情绪低落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu dehra mudlama jew atmosfera ta' dwejjaq, jew li jidher imqarras u mdejjaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴暗的；阴郁的；令人感到压抑的。
闷闷不乐的、阴郁的、情绪低落的。

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist jidher dgħumi wara li jirċievi l-aħbar ħażina.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist appears gloomy after receiving the bad news.
formal.zh: 小说中的主人公在收到坏消息后显得情绪低落。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex tidher daqshekk dgħumi llum, Mark? Mark: Ma mortx tajjeb fl-eżami u għadni mdejjaq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you look so gloomy today, Mark? Mark: I didn't do well in the exam, and I'm still upset.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark，你今天怎么看起来这么闷闷不乐？Mark：我考试没考好，现在还很难过。

messages.speaker: Maja（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex tidher daqshekk dgħumi llum, Mark?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex tidher daqshekk dgħumi llum, Mark?
messages.zh: Mark，你今天怎么看起来这么闷闷不乐？
messages.en: Why do you look so gloomy today, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Ma mortx tajjeb fl-eżami u għadni mdejjaq.
messages.mt_standard: Ma mortx tajjeb fl-eżami u għadni mdejjaq.
messages.zh: 我考试没考好，现在还很难过。
messages.en: I didn't do well in the exam, and I'm still upset.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dgħumi 放在一张愁眉不展的脸旁边记忆：它回答的是人或气氛怎么样，因此要记成形容词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A discussion in which people present and examine different views on a question.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕一个问题提出、比较和论证不同观点的讨论，常有明确的发言安排。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Diskussjoni li fiha n-nies jippreżentaw u jeżaminaw fehmiet differenti dwar kwistjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 辩论；围绕某一问题展开的不同观点之间的讨论。

collocations.en: to take part in a debate

formal.mt: L-iskola organizzat dibattitu dwar l-użu tat-telefowns fil-klassi, u kull tim ippreżenta l-argumenti tiegħu.
formal.en: The school organized a debate about using phones in class, and each team presented its arguments.
formal.zh: 学校组织了一场关于课堂上使用手机的辩论，各队分别陈述了自己的论点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tieħu sehem fid-dibattitu ta' għada? Mark: Iva, u llejla se nipprepara l-argumenti tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you taking part in tomorrow's debate? Mark: Yes, and tonight I'll prepare my arguments.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你会参加明天的辩论吗？Mark：会，我今晚要准备自己的论点。

messages.speaker: Lara（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Se tieħu sehem fid-dibattitu ta' għada?
messages.mt_standard: Se tieħu sehem fid-dibattitu ta' għada?
messages.zh: 你会参加明天的辩论吗？
messages.en: Are you taking part in tomorrow's debate?

messages.speaker: Mark（同学）
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u llejla se nipprepara l-argumenti tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u llejla se nipprepara l-argumenti tiegħi.
messages.zh: 会，我今晚要准备自己的论点。
messages.en: Yes, and tonight I'll prepare my arguments.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象课堂上两队轮流提出论点，再把 dibattitu 与英语 debate 配对朗读；记忆重点是围绕同一问题交流不同观点。

gloss_zh: 变暖；变温；暖和的天气；冬日温和天气

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become warm or tepid rather than remain cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由冷变得温暖或微温，表示温度发生变化。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir sħun jew fietel wara li jkun kiesaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暖；变得微温或温热。
暖和的天气。
温和的天气，尤指冬季不冷的天气。

formal.mt: Wara ftit ħin fix-xemx, l-ilma fil-flixkun diefa.
formal.en: After a short time in the sun, the water in the bottle became warm.
formal.zh: 在太阳下放了一会儿后，瓶子里的水变暖了。

colloquial.mt: Mark: L-ilma għadu kiesaħ? Lara: Le, diefa wara li ħallejnieh fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is the water still cold? Lara: No, it became warm after we left it in the sun.
colloquial.zh: Mark：水还是冷的吗？Lara：不是，我们把它放在太阳下后，它就变暖了。

messages.speaker: Mark（朋友）
messages.zh: 水还是冷的吗？
messages.en: Is the water still cold?

messages.speaker: Lara（朋友）
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diefa wara li ħallejnieh fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diefa wara li ħallejnieh fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 不是，我们把它放在太阳下后，它就变暖了。
messages.en: No, it became warm after we left it in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象冷水晒过太阳后变温，再想象冬日忽然暖和的天气：前者帮助记动词变暖，后者帮助记名词暖和天气。

gloss_zh: 温暖的；温和的；暖而不烫的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Warm at a comfortable temperature, without being too hot; also used of mild weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度舒适、暖和而不过热的；也可形容天气温和。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu sħana ħafifa u pjaċevoli, mingħajr ma jkun jaħraq; jintuża wkoll għat-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温暖的；暖和的
（指天气）温和的；不冷的

sense_translations.en_definition: pleasantly warm, but not too hot
sense_translations.zh_definition: 暖和舒适而不过热的

formal.mt: Għall-ħasil tal-idejn, uża ilma diefi u sapun.
formal.en: For washing your hands, use warm water and soap.
formal.zh: 洗手时，请使用温水和肥皂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-ħalib għadu jaħraq? Lara: Le, issa diefi. Tista' tixorbu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is the milk still hot? Lara: No, it is warm now. You can drink it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：牛奶还烫吗？拉拉：不，现在温温的，可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 牛奶还烫吗？
messages.en: Is the milk still hot?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 不，现在温温的，可以喝了。
messages.en: No, it is warm now. You can drink it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一杯捧在手里很舒服的温牛奶，用 diefi 记住“暖和但不烫”，再联想到温和的天气。

gloss_zh: 镀金；给……包覆金层；使变成金

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover something with a layer of gold or turn it into gold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面覆上一层金，或使其变成金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiksi xi ħaġa b'saff ta' deheb jew jibdilha f'deheb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给……镀金；在……表面贴覆金层

sense_translations.en_definition: to gild; to coat with or turn into gold
sense_translations.zh_definition: 镀金；给……包覆金层，或使……变成金

formal.mt: L-artiġjan dieheb il-qafas tal-mera b'saff irqiq ta' deheb.
formal.en: The artisan gilded the mirror frame with a thin layer of gold.
formal.zh: 工匠给镜框覆上了一层薄金。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Min dieheb dan il-qafas? Pawlu: In-nannu tiegħi. Għamel dan ix-xogħol bl-idejn.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who gilded this frame? Pawlu: My grandfather. He did this work by hand.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这个框是谁镀的金？保罗：我爷爷，是他手工做的。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个框是谁镀的金？
messages.en: Who gilded this frame?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu tiegħi. Għamel dan ix-xogħol bl-idejn.
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu tiegħi. Għamel dan ix-xogħol bl-idejn.
messages.zh: 我爷爷，是他手工做的。
messages.en: My grandfather. He did this work by hand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dieheb 配上一幅“工匠给旧镜框覆金”的画面，重点记住动作是给表面加上金层。

gloss_zh: 使出现；公开的；透明的；明显可见的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause something to appear or become visible.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物出现，或使原本看不见的东西显现出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa tidher jew issir viżibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物出现；使某物显现
公开的；不加掩饰的
透明的
使某物出现；让某物显现出来
明显的；显而易见的
显现的；可见的

formal.mt: Waqt il-wirja, il-maġiku dieher munita fuq mejda vojta.
formal.en: During the performance, the magician made a coin appear on an empty table.
formal.zh: 表演时，魔术师让一枚硬币出现在空桌上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt kif il-maġiku dieher fjura? Mark: Iva! Il-kaxxa kienet vojta qabel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you see how the magician made a flower appear? Mark: Yes! The box was empty before.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你看到魔术师怎么变出一朵花了吗？马克：看到了！那个盒子之前还是空的。

messages.speaker: Maja (观众)
messages.zh: 你看到魔术师怎么变出一朵花了吗？
messages.en: Did you see how the magician made a flower appear?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 看到了！那个盒子之前还是空的。
messages.en: Yes! The box was empty before.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“魔术师让花显现”记动词义；另外单独列出形容词卡片，分别记公开、透明、明显和可见，注意词性边界。

gloss_zh: 使害怕；使震惊；使突然受惊

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel frightened, shocked, or suddenly startled.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到害怕、震惊，或因突然发生的事情而受惊。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jibża', jinħasad jew jieħu qatgħa għal għarrieda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使害怕；吓唬
使震惊；使受到强烈冲击
使突然受惊；吓一跳

formal.mt: Il-ħoss qawwi tal-isplużjoni diehex lir-residenti tal-inħawi.
formal.en: The loud sound of the explosion frightened the local residents.
formal.zh: 爆炸的巨响吓到了附近居民。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex it-tifel beda jibki? Mark: Il-ħoss tal-bieb diehex lit-tifel, imma issa kkalma.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the boy start crying? Mark: The sound of the door startled him, but he has calmed down now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：那个男孩怎么哭起来了？马克：门响把他吓了一跳，不过他现在已经平静下来了。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 那个男孩怎么哭起来了？
messages.en: Why did the boy start crying?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħoss tal-bieb diehex lit-tifel, imma issa kkalma.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħoss tal-bieb diehex lit-tifel, imma issa kkalma.
messages.zh: 门响把他吓了一跳，不过他现在已经平静下来了。
messages.en: The sound of the door startled him, but he has calmed down now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门突然砰地一响、孩子吓一跳，用这个画面记 diehex；再把“震惊”作为情绪冲击更强的义项单独练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A climbing grape plant that produces grapes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种攀援生长、结出葡萄的植物，即葡萄藤或葡萄树。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li titla' ma' appoġġ u tagħmel l-għeneb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 葡萄藤；葡萄树

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ħawwel dielja ħdejn il-ħajt u taha appoġġ biex titla'.
formal.en: The gardener planted a grapevine beside the wall and gave it support to climb.
formal.zh: 园丁在墙边种了一株葡萄藤，并给它搭了攀援支架。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Din dielja? Pawlu: Iva, u fis-sajf tagħmel għeneb ħelu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this a grapevine? Pawlu: Yes, and it produces sweet grapes in summer.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是葡萄藤吗？保罗：是啊，夏天还会结出甜葡萄。

messages.speaker: Maja (访客)
messages.zh: 这是葡萄藤吗？
messages.en: Is this a grapevine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u fis-sajf tagħmel għeneb ħelu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u fis-sajf tagħmel għeneb ħelu.
messages.zh: 是啊，夏天还会结出甜葡萄。
messages.en: Yes, and it produces sweet grapes in summer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dielja 写在一幅葡萄架图旁边：藤蔓沿支架攀爬，下面挂着葡萄，记住它指整株葡萄植物。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get out of bed early in the morning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在早晨较早的时候起床。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqum mis-sodda kmieni filgħodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早起；很早起床

collocations.en: got up early to go to work
got up early to catch the bus
collocations.zh: 为了赶公共汽车而早起

formal.mt: L-istudent dierek biex jirrevedi n-noti qabel l-eżami.
formal.en: The student got up early to review his notes before the exam.
formal.zh: 那名学生早早起床，在考试前复习笔记。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex Pawlu dierek illum? Mark: Ried jaqbad l-ewwel karozza tal-linja.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Pawlu get up early today? Mark: He wanted to catch the first bus.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗今天为什么这么早起床？马克：他想赶第一班公共汽车。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗今天为什么这么早起床？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu get up early today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他想赶第一班公共汽车。
messages.en: He wanted to catch the first bus.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“天刚亮就起床赶首班车”的连续画面记 dierek，重点放在早起这个动作，而不只是醒来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put someone or something under the ground, especially for burial, or to hide someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将人或物放到地下，尤指埋葬；也可指把人或物隐藏起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqiegħed lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa taħt l-art, speċjalment għad-difna, jew jaħbi lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 埋葬；将……埋入地下
把某物或某人藏起来
隐藏；藏起

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, il-baħri difen it-teżor taħt siġra biex ħadd ma jsibu.
formal.en: In the story, the sailor buried the treasure under a tree so that nobody would find it.
formal.zh: 故事中，水手把宝藏埋在树下，以免有人找到。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn marret l-għadma? Pawlu: Il-kelb difen l-għadma fil-ġnien. Ara fejn ħaffer!
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did the bone go? Pawlu: The dog buried the bone in the garden. Look where he dug!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：骨头去哪儿了？保罗：狗把骨头埋在花园里了。看它挖过的地方！

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 骨头去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did the bone go?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kelb difen l-għadma fil-ġnien. Ara fejn ħaffer!
messages.mt_standard: Il-kelb difen l-għadma fil-ġnien. Ara fejn ħaffer!
messages.zh: 狗把骨头埋在花园里了。看它挖过的地方！
messages.en: The dog buried the bone in the garden. Look where he dug!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“狗挖坑埋骨头”记 difen 的埋藏义，再分别配上葬礼和藏物画面，区分埋葬与一般隐藏。

gloss_zh: 指甲；趾甲；猛禽的利爪；动物的爪

teaching_sense.en_definition: The hard covering at the end of a finger or toe, or a claw or talon of an animal or bird.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手指或脚趾末端的硬甲，也可指动物的爪或猛禽的利爪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti iebsa fit-tarf ta' saba' tal-id jew tas-sieq, jew id-difer ta' annimal jew għasfur.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 指甲；趾甲
猛禽的利爪
动物的爪；爪甲

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, jidher difer twil u mgħawweġ fuq sieq l-ajkla.
formal.en: In the picture, a long, curved talon is visible on the eagle's foot.
formal.zh: 图片中可以看到鹰脚上一根又长又弯的利爪。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandi difer miksur. Għandek imqass żgħir? Maja: Iva, hawn wieħed. Oqgħod attenta meta taqtgħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: I have a broken nail. Do you have a small pair of scissors? Maja: Yes, here is a pair. Be careful when you cut it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我有个指甲裂了。你有小剪刀吗？玛雅：有，这里有一把。剪的时候小心。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi difer miksur. Għandek imqass żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi difer miksur. Għandek imqass żgħir?
messages.zh: 我有个指甲裂了。你有小剪刀吗？
messages.en: I have a broken nail. Do you have a small pair of scissors?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn wieħed. Oqgħod attenta meta taqtgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn wieħed. Oqgħod attenta meta taqtgħu.
messages.zh: 有，这里有一把。剪的时候小心。
messages.en: Yes, here is a pair. Be careful when you cut it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把人的指甲、猫的爪甲和鹰的利爪并排画出来，用 difer 串起三幅图；这里的 nail 要记作指甲。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Not the same as another person or thing in one or more ways.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人或事物在一个或多个方面不一样的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex l-istess bħal persuna jew ħaġa oħra f'aspett wieħed jew aktar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 不同的；不一样的。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ rapporti joffru spjegazzjonijiet differenti għall-istess problema.
formal.en: The two reports offer different explanations for the same problem.
formal.zh: 这两份报告对同一个问题给出了不同的解释。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żewġ basktijiet huma l-istess? Lara: Le, għandhom kuluri differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these two bags the same? Lara: No, they have different colours.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这两个包一样吗？拉拉：不一样，它们的颜色不同。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这两个包一样吗？
messages.en: Are these two bags the same?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 不一样，它们的颜色不同。
messages.en: No, they have different colours.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个颜色不同的包，用 differenti 描述“不一样”；再把 differenti minn 连起来记成“与……不同”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A way in which two people, things, or situations are not the same.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个人、事物或情况之间不相同的地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Aspett li fih żewġ persuni, affarijiet jew sitwazzjonijiet mhumiex l-istess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 差别；区别；不相同之处。

formal.mt: It-tabella turi d-differenza bejn il-prezz oriġinali u l-prezz il-ġdid.
formal.en: The table shows the difference between the original price and the new price.
formal.zh: 表格显示了原价与新价格之间的差别。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hemm differenza bejn dawn iż-żewġ biljetti? Nina: Iva, dan jinkludi l-ikla u l-ieħor le.
colloquial.en: Mark: Is there a difference between these two tickets? Nina: Yes, this one includes the meal and the other does not.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这两种票有什么区别吗？妮娜：有，这种包含餐食，另一种不包含。

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm differenza bejn dawn iż-żewġ biljetti?
messages.mt_standard: Hemm differenza bejn dawn iż-żewġ biljetti?
messages.zh: 这两种票有什么区别吗？
messages.en: Is there a difference between these two tickets?

messages.speaker: Nina (售票员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dan jinkludi l-ikla u l-ieħor le.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dan jinkludi l-ikla u l-ieħor le.
messages.zh: 有，这种包含餐食，另一种不包含。
messages.en: Yes, this one includes the meal and the other does not.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把两张票并排比较，圈出那一处“差别”，圈出的内容就是 differenza；用 bejn 连接比较的两方。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A problem or obstacle that makes something hard to do, or the effort involved in doing it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某事难以完成的问题或障碍，也指做某事时感受到的困难。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Problema jew ostaklu li jagħmel xi ħaġa iebsa biex issir, jew it-tbatija biex tagħmilha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困难；做某事时遇到的难处。
阻碍进展的障碍；意外出现的麻烦。
需要解决的问题；造成不便或阻碍的麻烦。

formal.mt: Minħabba diffikultà teknika, il-laqgħa bdiet nofs siegħa tard.
formal.en: Because of a technical difficulty, the meeting started half an hour late.
formal.zh: 由于一个技术问题，会议晚了半小时开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandek xi diffikultà bil-formola? Mark: Iva, ma nafx fejn nikteb l-indirizz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you having any difficulty with the form? Mark: Yes, I don't know where to write the address.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：填这张表有什么困难吗？马克：有，我不知道地址该填在哪里。

messages.speaker: Lara (办事员)
messages.zh: 填这张表有什么困难吗？
messages.en: Are you having any difficulty with the form?

messages.speaker: Mark (办事者)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ma nafx fejn nikteb l-indirizz.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ma nafx fejn nikteb l-indirizz.
messages.zh: 有，我不知道地址该填在哪里。
messages.en: Yes, I don't know where to write the address.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆：diffiċli 描述“很难”，diffikultà 指遇到的“困难”。想象填表卡住的一栏，就是一个具体的 diffikultà。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Requiring considerable effort, skill, or thought to do, understand, or deal with.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做起来、理解起来或处理起来需要较多努力、技巧或思考的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jeħtieġ ħafna sforz, ħila jew ħsieb biex isir, jinftiehem jew jiġi ttrattat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 困难的；不容易完成或理解的。
困难的；费力的；难以应付的。

formal.mt: It-test huwa diffiċli biex tifhem mingħajr l-għajnuna ta' dizzjunarju.
formal.en: The text is difficult to understand without the help of a dictionary.
formal.zh: 没有词典的帮助，这篇文章很难理解。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kien l-eżami? Pawlu: Kien diffiċli, imma weġibt il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was the exam? Pawlu: It was difficult, but I answered all the questions.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：考试怎么样？保罗：很难，不过我回答了所有题目。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 考试怎么样？
messages.en: How was the exam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien diffiċli, imma weġibt il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
messages.mt_standard: Kien diffiċli, imma weġibt il-mistoqsijiet kollha.
messages.zh: 很难，不过我回答了所有题目。
messages.en: It was difficult, but I answered all the questions.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diffiċli 写在一道需要反复思考的题旁边，联想“这题很难”；这里的 hard 表示困难，不表示物体坚硬。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Protection against attack, a team's action to stop opponents from scoring, or arguments used to answer criticism or an accusation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 抵御攻击的防御、比赛中阻止对方得分的防守，或回应批评和指控的辩护。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Protezzjoni kontra attakk, il-ħidma ta' tim biex iwaqqaf lill-avversarji milli jiskorjaw, jew argumenti bi tweġiba għal kritika jew akkuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 防御；防守；针对批评或指控所作的辩护。

formal.mt: L-awtur ippreżenta argumenti fid-difiża tal-proposta tiegħu.
formal.en: The author presented arguments in defence of his proposal.
formal.zh: 作者提出了论据，为自己的提议辩护。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif lagħab it-tim illum? Sara: Kellu difiża soda u ma qala' l-ebda gowl.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How did the team play today? Sara: It had a solid defence and did not concede any goals.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：球队今天踢得怎么样？萨拉：防守很稳，一个球也没丢。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (球迷)
messages.zh: 球队今天踢得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the team play today?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu difiża soda u ma qala' l-ebda gowl.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu difiża soda u ma qala' l-ebda gowl.
messages.zh: 防守很稳，一个球也没丢。
messages.en: It had a solid defence and did not concede any goals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 difiża 配两幅学习画面：球员挡住射门是“防守”，作者用论据支持提议是“辩护”；共同联想都是抵挡攻击。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An official order issued by a person or institution with authority.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由有权者或权力机构发布的正式命令或法令。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ordni uffiċjali maħruġa minn persuna jew istituzzjoni li għandha l-awtorità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法令；政令；由有权者或权力机构颁布的正式命令。

collocations.zh: 颁布法令；发布正式命令

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jaqraw id-digriet u jiġbru fil-qosor il-punti ewlenin tiegħu.
formal.en: The students should read the decree and summarise its main points.
formal.zh: 学生应阅读这项法令，并概括其要点。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qrajt id-digriet li tana l-għalliem? Mark: Iva, imma ma fhimtx l-aħħar parti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you read the decree the teacher gave us? Mark: Yes, but I didn't understand the last part.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你读了老师给我们的那项法令吗？马克：读了，但我没看懂最后一部分。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你读了老师给我们的那项法令吗？
messages.en: Did you read the decree the teacher gave us?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ma fhimtx l-aħħar parti.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ma fhimtx l-aħħar parti.
messages.zh: 读了，但我没看懂最后一部分。
messages.en: Yes, but I didn't understand the last part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份由权力机构正式发布的命令，在文件上标注 digriet“法令”；再把 joħroġ digriet 整组记为“颁布法令”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Light or brightness given off by a source, or a soft shine visible on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 光源发出的光亮，或物体表面呈现的柔和光泽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dawl jew tleqqija li toħroġ minn sors ta' dawl jew tidher fuq wiċċ ta' oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 柔和而持续的光；微光。
光亮；闪耀的光辉。
物体表面柔和的光泽。
光辉；表面的亮泽或润泽。

formal.mt: Id-dija tax-xemgħa kienet biżżejjed biex tidher il-kitba fuq il-karta.
formal.en: The candle's glow was enough to make the writing on the paper visible.
formal.zh: 烛光足以照见纸上的字迹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara d-dija tal-qamar fuq il-baħar! Toni: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the moon's glow on the sea! Toni: It's beautiful! Let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看海面上的月光！托尼：真美！我们拍张照吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看海面上的月光！
messages.en: Look at the moon's glow on the sea!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hi sabiħa! Ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.zh: 真美！我们拍张照吧。
messages.en: It's beautiful! Let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dija 配上烛光、月光和丝绸光泽三幅画面，记住它强调可见的光亮与柔和亮泽。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The identification of an illness or condition by examining symptoms and other evidence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 根据症状、检查结果等证据判断疾病或身体状况的过程或结论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-identifikazzjoni ta' marda jew kundizzjoni permezz tal-eżami tas-sintomi u ta' evidenza oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 诊断；依据症状和检查结果作出的病情判断。

formal.mt: It-tabib talab aktar testijiet biex jasal għal dijanjosi preċiża.
formal.en: The doctor requested further tests to reach an accurate diagnosis.
formal.zh: 医生要求进一步检查，以作出准确诊断。

colloquial.mt: Lara: It-tabib tak dijanjosi? Mark: Għadu le. Qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Has the doctor given you a diagnosis? Mark: Not yet. He's waiting for the test results.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：医生给你诊断结果了吗？马克：还没有。他在等检查结果。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 医生给你诊断结果了吗？
messages.en: Has the doctor given you a diagnosis?

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu le. Qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu le. Qed jistenna r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
messages.zh: 还没有。他在等检查结果。
messages.en: Not yet. He's waiting for the test results.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dijanjosi 放进“症状—检查—诊断”的学习流程，并与英语 diagnosis 对照记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spoken or written statement that formally makes information, a position, or an intention known.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以口头或书面形式正式说明事实、立场或意图的声明，也可指正式申报。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stqarrija bil-fomm jew bil-miktub li tgħarraf b'mod formali b'fatti, pożizzjoni jew intenzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 声明；正式宣布或申报。
声明；对事实、立场或意图作出的正式陈述。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija ħarġet dikjarazzjoni uffiċjali dwar il-bidla fis-servizz.
formal.en: The company issued an official statement about the change to the service.
formal.zh: 公司就服务变更发布了正式声明。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid dikjarazzjoni bil-miktub? Pawlu: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Ibgħathieli bl-email.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you need a written declaration? Pawlu: Yes, please. Send it to me by email.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你需要书面声明吗？保罗：是的，麻烦你。用电子邮件发给我吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你需要书面声明吗？
messages.en: Do you need a written declaration?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，麻烦你。用电子邮件发给我吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Send it to me by email.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一份标题写着“正式声明”的文件，把 dikjarazzjoni 与声明、陈述和申报的场景联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bench made of stone or wood, often found in a church.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用石头或木头制成、可供人坐的长凳，常见于教堂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bank magħmul mill-ġebel jew mill-injam, li spiss jinsab fi knisja.

sense_translations.en_definition: bench made of stone or wood (often found in churches)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 石制或木制长凳，常见于教堂。

sense_translations.en_definition: bench made of stone or wood
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用石头或木头制成的长凳。

formal.mt: Fil-knisja hemm dikkiena tal-injam ħdejn il-bieb prinċipali.
formal.en: There is a wooden bench in the church near the main entrance.
formal.zh: 教堂内靠近正门的地方有一张木长凳。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Nistgħu noqogħdu fuq dik id-dikkiena? Ġużeppi: Iva, hemm post għalina t-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Can we sit on that bench? Ġużeppi: Yes, there's room for both of us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们可以坐那张长凳吗？朱塞佩：可以，够我们两个人坐。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 我们可以坐那张长凳吗？
messages.en: Can we sit on that bench?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 可以，够我们两个人坐。
messages.en: Yes, there's room for both of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dikkiena 画一张教堂里的长凳，再分别标注石头和木头，用材质与场景一起记住词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rub or spread a substance over a surface, such as ointment on skin or butter on bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂抹在表面上，例如给皮肤涂药膏或给面包抹黄油；也可指施行傅油。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Togħrok jew tifrex sustanza fuq wiċċ, bħal ingwent fuq il-ġilda jew butir fuq il-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹；把某种物质抹在表面上。
涂药膏；给身体部位抹上药膏。
给某物涂上某种物质，例如给面包抹黄油。
涂油；尤指在宗教仪式中给人傅油。

collocations.en: to apply ointment to the skin

formal.mt: Il-kok dilek il-ħobż bil-butir qabel poġġieh fil-forn.
formal.en: The cook spread butter on the bread before putting it in the oven.
formal.zh: 厨师先给面包抹上黄油，再把它放进烤箱。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dlikt il-ħobż bil-butir? Leo: Iva, u poġġejt ftit ġamm fuqu wkoll.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you spread butter on the bread? Leo: Yes, and I put a little jam on it too.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你给面包抹黄油了吗？利奥：抹了，还加了一点果酱。

messages.speaker: Marta (母亲)
messages.zh: 你给面包抹黄油了吗？
messages.en: Did you spread butter on the bread?

messages.speaker: Leo (儿子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u poġġejt ftit ġamm fuqu wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u poġġejt ftit ġamm fuqu wkoll.
messages.zh: 抹了，还加了一点果酱。
messages.en: Yes, and I put a little jam on it too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dilek 时做一个把东西抹开的动作：面包抹黄油、皮肤涂药膏、仪式中涂油，都围绕“涂抹”。

gloss_zh: 业余爱好者；业余的；不专业的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pursues an activity out of interest or enjoyment rather than as a profession.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 出于兴趣或乐趣从事某项活动、而不以此为职业的人；某些语境中也可指涉猎较浅的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tagħmel attività għall-interess jew għall-pjaċir, aktar milli bħala professjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 业余参与者；不以某项活动为职业的人。
涉猎者；对某个领域有兴趣但钻研不深的人，可带贬义。
业余爱好者；把某项活动作为兴趣爱好的人。
显得生疏的；缺乏熟练技巧或专业水准的。
不专业的；未达到应有专业水准的。
业余的；出于兴趣从事、而非作为职业的。

collocations.zh: 缺乏专业水准的作品或工作

formal.mt: Bħala dilettant, Pawlu jieħu sehem f'wirjiet tal-fotografija fil-ħin liberu tiegħu.
formal.en: As an amateur, Pawlu takes part in photography exhibitions in his spare time.
formal.zh: 保罗是一名业余爱好者，会利用空闲时间参加摄影展。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Int fotografu professjonali? Pawlu: Le, jien dilettant. Nieħu r-ritratti għall-gost.
colloquial.en: Nina: Are you a professional photographer? Pawlu: No, I'm an amateur. I take photos for fun.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你是职业摄影师吗？保罗：不是，我是业余爱好者。我拍照是为了好玩。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是职业摄影师吗？
messages.en: Are you a professional photographer?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (摄影爱好者)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jien dilettant. Nieħu r-ritratti għall-gost.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jien dilettant. Nieħu r-ritratti għall-gost.
messages.zh: 不是，我是业余爱好者。我拍照是为了好玩。
messages.en: No, I'm an amateur. I take photos for fun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dilettant 放在“兴趣爱好”的抽屉里；指人可中性，评价作品时要留意是否带有“不够专业”的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A measurable extent such as length, width, or height, or a particular aspect of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 长度、宽度或高度等可测量的维度或尺寸，也可指事物的某个方面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kejl bħat-tul, il-wisa' jew l-għoli, jew aspett partikolari ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 维度；长、宽、高等度量方向，也可指某个方面。
尺寸；大小；物体在某一方向上的量度。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jeżamina d-dimensjoni soċjali tal-proġett u l-effett tiegħu fuq il-komunità.
formal.en: The report examines the social dimension of the project and its effect on the community.
formal.zh: 报告考察了该项目的社会层面及其对社区的影响。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema dimensjoni għad irridu nkejlu? Toni: L-għoli. It-tul u l-wisa' diġà ktibthom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which dimension do we still need to measure? Toni: The height. I've already written down the length and width.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们还需要量哪个尺寸？托尼：高度。长度和宽度我已经记下了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同住朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还需要量哪个尺寸？
messages.en: Which dimension do we still need to measure?

messages.speaker: Toni (同住朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-għoli. It-tul u l-wisa' diġà ktibthom.
messages.mt_standard: L-għoli. It-tul u l-wisa' diġà ktibthom.
messages.zh: 高度。长度和宽度我已经记下了。
messages.en: The height. I've already written down the length and width.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个盒子并标出长宽高，记住 dimensjoni 的具体尺寸义，再联想到分析问题时的不同方面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A religion or system of faith, including its beliefs and teachings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宗教或信仰体系，包括其信念、教义和信条。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reliġjon jew sistema ta' twemmin, bil-prinċipji u t-tagħlim tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信仰；信条；宗教及其信念体系。
宗教；以共同信念和教义为基础的信仰体系。

formal.mt: Ir-rispett lejn id-din ta' ħaddieħor jgħin biex tissaħħaħ il-paċi fil-komunità.
formal.en: Respect for other people's religion helps strengthen peace within the community.
formal.zh: 尊重他人的宗教信仰有助于增进社区和睦。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Xi tfisser il-kelma 'din' f'din is-sentenza? Mark: Hawn tfisser reliġjon jew twemmin.
colloquial.en: Lina: What does the word 'din' mean in this sentence? Mark: Here it means religion or faith.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个句子里的 din 是什么意思？马克：这里指宗教或信仰。

messages.speaker: Lina (学生)
messages.zh: 这个句子里的 din 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word 'din' mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Mark (教师)
messages.zh: 这里指宗教或信仰。
messages.en: Here it means religion or faith.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把本词条的名词 din 写在“宗教—信仰—信条”的学习卡中央，再用“宗教自由”这一搭配巩固记忆。

gloss_zh: 犯罪；犯戒；违反道德准则

teaching_sense.en_definition: To commit a sin or act against a religious or moral rule.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 犯下罪过，或做出违反宗教戒律、道德准则的行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel dnub jew jikser regola reliġjuża jew morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪；犯下宗教或道德意义上的罪过。
违犯戒律、道德准则或应当遵守的界限。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sin, to commit a sin
sense_translations.zh_definition: 犯罪；犯下一项罪过。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fall into temptation of a meal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抵不住一顿饭的诱惑而失守。

collocations.zh: 得罪了上帝；犯下违背上帝旨意的罪

formal.mt: Fit-test, il-karattru jammetti li dineb u jitlob maħfra.
formal.en: In the text, the character admits that he sinned and asks for forgiveness.
formal.zh: 在这篇文本中，人物承认自己犯了罪，并请求宽恕。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex qed jitlob maħfra l-karattru? Pawlu: Għax jgħid li dineb meta gideb lil ħabibu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why is the character asking for forgiveness? Pawlu: Because he says he sinned when he lied to his friend.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这个人物为什么请求宽恕？保罗：因为他说，自己对朋友撒谎时犯了罪。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这个人物为什么请求宽恕？
messages.en: Why is the character asking for forgiveness?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jgħid li dineb meta gideb lil ħabibu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jgħid li dineb meta gideb lil ħabibu.
messages.zh: 因为他说，自己对朋友撒谎时犯了罪。
messages.en: Because he says he sinned when he lied to his friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dineb 放进“犯错后请求宽恕”的故事画面中记忆，重点联结宗教或道德上的罪过。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The earth where we live, or the world of people, places, and life around us.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 我们居住的地球，也指由人、地方和生活构成的世界。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-art fejn ngħixu, jew id-dinja tan-nies, tal-postijiet u tal-ħajja ta' madwarna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 地球；人类居住的大地。
世界；全球各地及其中的人与事物。

formal.mt: L-istudju jiġbor informazzjoni dwar l-użu tal-ilma f'pajjiżi differenti madwar id-dinja.
formal.en: The study gathers information about water use in different countries around the world.
formal.zh: 这项研究收集了世界各地不同国家的用水信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn tixtieq tivvjaġġa? Mark: Nixtieq nivvjaġġa madwar id-dinja u nara postijiet ġodda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where would you like to travel? Mark: I'd like to travel around the world and see new places.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想去哪里旅行？马克：我想环游世界，看看新的地方。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想去哪里旅行？
messages.en: Where would you like to travel?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq nivvjaġġa madwar id-dinja u nara postijiet ġodda.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq nivvjaġġa madwar id-dinja u nara postijiet ġodda.
messages.zh: 我想环游世界，看看新的地方。
messages.en: I'd like to travel around the world and see new places.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 dinja 就想象一个地球仪：指脚下的星球时是“地球”，指各地的人与事时是“世界”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person's inherent worth and right to respect, or a calm and self-respecting manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人应受尊重的内在价值，也指保持自尊、沉着庄重的举止。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-valur ta' kull persuna u d-dritt tagħha għar-rispett, jew imġiba kalma li turi rispett lejha nnifisha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尊严；应受尊重的价值；自尊而庄重的仪态。

collocations.zh: 以尊重其尊严的方式对待某人

formal.mt: Il-persunal għandu jirrispetta d-dinjità ta' kull persuna li tuża s-servizz.
formal.en: Staff should respect the dignity of every person who uses the service.
formal.zh: 工作人员应尊重每一位服务使用者的尊严。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif nista' ngħinu mingħajr ma nġiegħlu jistħi? Rita: Staqsih x'għandu bżonn u rrispetta d-dinjità tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Sara: How can I help him without making him feel embarrassed? Rita: Ask him what he needs and respect his dignity.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我怎样才能帮助他，又不让他难堪？丽塔：问问他需要什么，并尊重他的尊严。

messages.speaker: Sara (志愿者)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif nista' ngħinu mingħajr ma nġiegħlu jistħi?
messages.mt_standard: Kif nista' ngħinu mingħajr ma nġiegħlu jistħi?
messages.zh: 我怎样才能帮助他，又不让他难堪？
messages.en: How can I help him without making him feel embarrassed?

messages.speaker: Rita (志愿者同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Staqsih x'għandu bżonn u rrispetta d-dinjità tiegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Staqsih x'għandu bżonn u rrispetta d-dinjità tiegħu.
messages.zh: 问问他需要什么，并尊重他的尊严。
messages.en: Ask him what he needs and respect his dignity.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“帮助别人时，也让对方保有体面”的场景记 dinjità，把尊重与尊严一起联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A division of an organization responsible for a particular subject, service, or type of work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 机构中负责某一领域、服务或工作类别的部门，也可指大学的系。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taqsima ta' organizzazzjoni responsabbli għal qasam, servizz jew tip ta' xogħol partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 部门；机构中的业务单位；大学中的系。

formal.mt: Id-dipartiment tal-finanzi għandu jivverifika l-ispejjeż qabel ma jiġi approvat il-baġit.
formal.en: The finance department should check the expenses before the budget is approved.
formal.zh: 财务部门应在预算获批之前核查各项支出。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Lil min għandi nagħti din il-fattura? Lara: Ħudha fid-dipartiment tal-finanzi, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Mark: Who should I give this invoice to? Lara: Take it to the finance department, please.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这张发票我该交给谁？拉拉：请把它送到财务部门。

messages.speaker: Mark (新员工)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min għandi nagħti din il-fattura?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min għandi nagħti din il-fattura?
messages.zh: 这张发票我该交给谁？
messages.en: Who should I give this invoice to?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 请把它送到财务部门。
messages.en: Take it to the finance department, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dipartiment 写在办公室分区图上，再给每个区域标注职责，用“机构中的一个部门”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to relations between countries, or showing tact when dealing with people or disagreement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与国家间外交关系有关的；也指处理人际关系或分歧时措辞得体、讲究分寸的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mar-relazzjonijiet bejn il-pajjiżi, jew li juri tattika u għaqal fit-trattament tan-nies u tan-nuqqas ta' qbil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外交的；与国家间交往有关的；处事圆融、措辞得体的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juża lingwaġġ diplomatiku biex jiddeskrivi n-nuqqas ta' qbil bejn iż-żewġ pajjiżi.
formal.en: The report uses diplomatic language to describe the disagreement between the two countries.
formal.zh: 这份报告使用外交措辞来描述两国之间的分歧。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Kif ngħidlu li ma naqbilx miegħu? Maja: Kun diplomatiku u spjega l-opinjoni tiegħek bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: How do I tell him that I disagree with him? Maja: Be diplomatic and explain your opinion calmly.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我该怎么告诉他，我不同意他的看法？玛雅：说得圆融一些，平静地解释你的观点。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kif ngħidlu li ma naqbilx miegħu?
messages.mt_standard: Kif ngħidlu li ma naqbilx miegħu?
messages.zh: 我该怎么告诉他，我不同意他的看法？
messages.en: How do I tell him that I disagree with him?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kun diplomatiku u spjega l-opinjoni tiegħek bil-kalma.
messages.mt_standard: Kun diplomatiku u spjega l-opinjoni tiegħek bil-kalma.
messages.zh: 说得圆融一些，平静地解释你的观点。
messages.en: Be diplomatic and explain your opinion calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象外交会谈中谨慎而得体的说话方式，把 diplomatiku 的“外交的”和“圆融的”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To thresh grain by beating it to separate the grains from the stalks, or to beat or strike.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过敲打使谷粒与茎秆分离，即打谷、脱粒；也可指击打或鞭打。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred il-ħbub miz-zkuk billi jsawwat il-wiċċ tar-raba', jew isawwat u jagħti daqqiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打谷；通过敲打等方式使谷粒脱离茎秆。
打；反复击打。
打谷；用连枷等工具拍打谷物使其脱粒。
鞭打；抽打；击打。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi dires il-qamħ biex jifred il-ħbub mit-tiben.
formal.en: The farmer threshed the wheat to separate the grains from the straw.
formal.zh: 农民给小麦脱粒，使麦粒与麦秆分离。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'għamel il-bidwi bil-qamħ? Ġanni: Dires il-qamħ biex jifred il-ħbub mit-tiben.
colloquial.en: Nina: What did the farmer do with the wheat? Ġanni: He threshed the wheat to separate the grains from the straw.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：农民对小麦做了什么？詹尼：他给小麦脱粒，把麦粒与麦秆分开。

messages.speaker: Nina (学生)
messages.zh: 农民对小麦做了什么？
messages.en: What did the farmer do with the wheat?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dires il-qamħ biex jifred il-ħbub mit-tiben.
messages.mt_standard: Dires il-qamħ biex jifred il-ħbub mit-tiben.
messages.zh: 他给小麦脱粒，把麦粒与麦秆分开。
messages.en: He threshed the wheat to separate the grains from the straw.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象拍打麦穗后谷粒落下的画面来记 dires；再用“击打”的动作联想其他义项，不必编造词源。

gloss_zh: 直接的；直达的；直截了当的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Going straight to a destination without an intermediate stop, or expressed clearly without indirect wording.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不经中途停靠而直达的；也指表达清楚、直截了当、不绕弯子的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jasal fid-destinazzjoni mingħajr waqfa intermedja, jew li jesprimi ħsieb b'mod ċar u bla tidwir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接的；直达的；表达直截了当的。

formal.mt: Il-klijenti jistgħu jagħmlu kuntatt dirett mal-maniġer permezz tal-email.
formal.en: Customers can make direct contact with the manager by email.
formal.zh: 客户可以通过电子邮件直接与经理联系。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm titjira diretta lejn Ruma? Mark: Iva, hemm waħda filgħodu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there a direct flight to Rome? Mark: Yes, there's one in the morning.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：有直达罗马的航班吗？马克：有，早上有一班。

messages.speaker: Sara (旅客)
messages.zh: 有直达罗马的航班吗？
messages.en: Is there a direct flight to Rome?

messages.speaker: Mark (旅行社职员)
messages.zh: 有，早上有一班。
messages.en: Yes, there's one in the morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dirett 想成两点之间的一条直线：路线可以直达，联系可以直接，说话也可以直截了当。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Straight to a person or place, or without an intermediary or intervening step.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 径直到某人或某处，或不经过中间人、中间环节而直接进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dritt għand persuna jew lejn post, jew mingħajr intermedjarju jew pass ieħor bejniethom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直接地；径直地；不经过中间人或中间环节地。

collocations.en: to speak directly to the manager

formal.mt: L-applikanti għandhom jibagħtu d-dokumenti direttament lid-dipartiment responsabbli.
formal.en: Applicants should send the documents directly to the responsible department.
formal.zh: 申请人应将文件直接发送给负责的部门。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Wara x-xogħol se tieqaf il-ħanut? Pawlu: Le, illum se mmur direttament id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to stop at the shop after work? Pawlu: No, today I'm going directly home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：下班后你会去商店一趟吗？保罗：不会，今天我要直接回家。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 下班后你会去商店一趟吗？
messages.en: Are you going to stop at the shop after work?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum se mmur direttament id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum se mmur direttament id-dar.
messages.zh: 不会，今天我要直接回家。
messages.en: No, today I'm going directly home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“下班后直接回家”的动作记 direttament；它说明动作怎样进行，对应中文的“直接地、径直地”。

gloss_zh: 方向；指示；领导；导演工作

teaching_sense.en_definition: The way in which someone or something moves, faces, or develops.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或事物移动、朝向或发展的方向。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-naħa li lejha persuna jew ħaġa timxi, tħares jew tiżviluppa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 方向；行进、朝向或发展的方位。
指示；说明应当如何行动或完成任务的要求。
领导；指导和管理集体或机构的工作。
戏剧或电影的导演工作；对表演和作品呈现的整体指导。

formal.mt: Il-vleġġa tindika d-direzzjoni tal-ħruġ.
formal.en: The arrow indicates the direction of the exit.
formal.zh: 箭头指示出口的方向。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Qegħdin nimxu fid-direzzjoni t-tajba? Pawlu: Iva, il-baħar qiegħed quddiemna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we walking in the right direction? Pawlu: Yes, the sea is ahead of us.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们走的方向对吗？保罗：对，海就在我们前面。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走的方向对吗？
messages.en: Are we walking in the right direction?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 对，海就在我们前面。
messages.en: Yes, the sea is ahead of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个指路箭头，先记住“方向”；再把指挥团队和指导电影看成“给出方向”，串联各个义项。

gloss_zh: 九（置于名词前的短形式）；第九

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short form of disgħa used before a noun to express a quantity of nine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量九、放在名词前使用的 disgħa 的短形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma qasira ta' disgħa li tintuża quddiem nom biex tindika kwantità ta' disgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第九；表示顺序中排在第九位。
disgħa（九）放在名词前作数量修饰语时使用的短形式。

formal.mt: Il-grupp jinkludi disa' studenti minn skejjel differenti.
formal.en: The group includes nine students from different schools.
formal.zh: 该小组包括来自不同学校的九名学生。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kemm għandna kotba fil-kaxxa? Ġanni: Għandna disa' kotba.
colloquial.en: Marta: How many books do we have in the box? Ġanni: We have nine books.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：箱子里有多少本书？詹尼：有九本书。

messages.speaker: Marta (同学)
messages.zh: 箱子里有多少本书？
messages.en: How many books do we have in the box?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同学)
messages.zh: 有九本书。
messages.en: We have nine books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 disa' kotba 整体记成“九本书”：看到后面紧跟所数的名词，就联想到这个短形式，并记住末尾的撇号。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number nine, used on its own when counting or stating a total.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数目九；用于独立数数、回答数量或说明总数。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru disgħa, użat waħdu meta ngħoddu jew ngħidu total.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九；表示数量的基数词。
九的独立形式；单独说出数目九时使用。

collocations.en: from eight o'clock to nine o'clock

formal.mt: Wara l-għadd finali, it-total tal-parteċipanti huwa disgħa.
formal.en: After the final count, the total number of participants is nine.
formal.zh: 最终清点后，参与者总人数为九人。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm se jiġu għall-ikla? Mark: Disgħa. Il-mejda hija kbira biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Sara: How many people are coming for the meal? Mark: Nine. The table is big enough.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：有多少人来吃饭？马克：九个。桌子够大。

messages.speaker: Sara (主人)
messages.zh: 有多少人来吃饭？
messages.en: How many people are coming for the meal?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 九个。桌子够大。
messages.en: Nine. The table is big enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 练习一问一答：“多少个？”“Disgħa.” 把它记作能够独立站出来回答的“九”，再与名词前的 disa' 对照。
