teaching_sense.en_definition: The number ninety, equal to nine groups of ten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数目九十，相当于九个十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru disgħin, li huwa daqs disa' gruppi ta' għaxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 九十；表示数量的基数词。
九十，数值为90。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom disgħin minuta biex ilestu l-eżami.
formal.en: Participants have ninety minutes to complete the examination.
formal.zh: 参与者有九十分钟完成考试。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kemm jiswa dan il-kors? David: Disgħin ewro, u l-materjal huwa inkluż.
colloquial.en: Nina: How much does this course cost? David: Ninety euros, and the materials are included.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这门课多少钱？戴维：九十欧元，包含教材。

messages.speaker: Nina (学员)
messages.zh: 这门课多少钱？
messages.en: How much does this course cost?

messages.speaker: David (课程接待员)
messages.mt_spoken: Disgħin ewro, u l-materjal huwa inkluż.
messages.mt_standard: Disgħin ewro, u l-materjal huwa inkluż.
messages.zh: 九十欧元，包含教材。
messages.en: Ninety euros, and the materials are included.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在记忆卡上把 disgħin 配上“90”和九组十个圆点，再用“九十分钟”造句，避免把九十读成九。

gloss_zh: 设计；图示；绘图；蓝图；计划；意图

teaching_sense.en_definition: A drawing or plan that shows the appearance, structure, or arrangement of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 展示某物外观、结构或布局的设计、图样或方案。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tpinġija jew pjan li juri d-dehra, l-istruttura jew l-arranġament ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计；对外观、结构或布局的构思及其成果。
图示；用线条、符号等说明结构或关系的图。
绘图；画出的图画或图样。
蓝图；用于说明建造或制作细节的设计图。
设计或绘图；表达构思的图样。
设计或计划；为实现某项目标拟定的方案。
意图；心中打算实现的目的。

formal.mt: Id-disinn tal-bini jinkludi twieqi kbar biex jidħol aktar dawl naturali.
formal.en: The building design includes large windows to let in more natural light.
formal.zh: 建筑设计包含大窗户，以引入更多自然光。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Jogħġbok dan id-disinn għall-kċina? Toni: Iva, imma nippreferi mejda iżgħar.
colloquial.en: Elena: Do you like this design for the kitchen? Toni: Yes, but I would prefer a smaller table.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你喜欢这个厨房设计吗？托尼：喜欢，不过我更想要一张小一点的桌子。

messages.speaker: Elena (家人)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这个厨房设计吗？
messages.en: Do you like this design for the kitchen?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过我更想要一张小一点的桌子。
messages.en: Yes, but I would prefer a smaller table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先在纸上画出厨房，再照着图布置：纸上的图样是 disinn，脑中的设计和计划也可放进同一记忆画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An exchange of ideas or opinions about a particular subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 围绕某个主题交换想法或意见的讨论。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Skambju ta' ideat jew opinjonijiet dwar suġġett partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 讨论；就某个问题交流看法和意见。

collocations.en: to take part in a discussion

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa saret diskussjoni dwar il-proposta l-ġdida.
formal.en: During the meeting, there was a discussion about the new proposal.
formal.zh: 会议期间，大家讨论了新提案。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Se tieħu sehem fid-diskussjoni għada? Luqa: Iva, għandi xi ideat dwar il-proġett.
colloquial.en: Marija: Will you take part in the discussion tomorrow? Luqa: Yes, I have some ideas about the project.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：你明天会参加讨论吗？卢卡：会，我对这个项目有些想法。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 你明天会参加讨论吗？
messages.en: Will you take part in the discussion tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Luqa (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandi xi ideat dwar il-proġett.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandi xi ideat dwar il-proġett.
messages.zh: 会，我对这个项目有些想法。
messages.en: Yes, I have some ideas about the project.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diskussjoni 与英语 discussion 并排做词卡，再画两个人轮流发表意见，记住它表示围绕主题交换看法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A strong feeling that there is no hope or no way out of a difficult situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 觉得毫无希望或无法摆脱困境时产生的强烈绝望感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sensazzjoni qawwija li m'hemmx tama jew mod kif toħroġ minn sitwazzjoni diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绝望；认为希望已经破灭的情绪。
绝望或走投无路的焦急；觉得无计可施而迫切想找到出路的状态。

formal.mt: Wara xhur mingħajr xogħol, beda jħoss sens ta' disperazzjoni.
formal.en: After months without work, he began to feel a sense of despair.
formal.zh: 失业数月后，他开始感到绝望。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ma nafx x'se nagħmel; qed inħoss disperazzjoni kbira. Rita: Ejja nitkellmu u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: I don't know what I'm going to do; I feel so desperate. Rita: Let's talk and see what we can do together.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我不知道该怎么办了，感到特别绝望。丽塔：我们聊聊，看看能一起做些什么。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx x'se nagħmel; qed inħoss disperazzjoni kbira.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx x'se nagħmel; qed inħoss disperazzjoni kbira.
messages.zh: 我不知道该怎么办了，感到特别绝望。
messages.en: I don't know what I'm going to do; I feel so desperate.

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nitkellmu u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nitkellmu u naraw x'nistgħu nagħmlu flimkien.
messages.zh: 我们聊聊，看看能一起做些什么。
messages.en: Let's talk and see what we can do together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象困境中的人说“看不到希望，也不知道怎么办”，把这份强烈情绪标成 disperazzjoni，区别于普通的失望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling that someone or something is unworthy of respect.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某人或某事不值得尊重而产生的轻蔑或鄙视。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment li persuna jew ħaġa ma jistħoqqilhiex rispett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻蔑；鄙视；认为对方低劣或不值得尊重的态度。

formal.mt: Il-kodiċi ta' mġiba jitlob rispett u ma jaċċettax kliem li jesprimi disprezz lejn il-kollegi.
formal.en: The code of conduct requires respect and does not accept language that expresses contempt for colleagues.
formal.zh: 行为准则要求相互尊重，不接受表达对同事轻蔑的言语。

colloquial.mt: Klara: Għaliex ħares lejja b'disprezz? Ben: Ma nafx. Tista' tistaqsih x'ried ifisser.
colloquial.en: Klara: Why did he look at me with contempt? Ben: I don't know. You can ask him what he meant.
colloquial.zh: 克拉拉：他为什么轻蔑地看着我？本：我不知道。你可以问问他是什么意思。

messages.speaker: Klara (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么轻蔑地看着我？
messages.en: Why did he look at me with contempt?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx. Tista' tistaqsih x'ried ifisser.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx. Tista' tistaqsih x'ried ifisser.
messages.zh: 我不知道。你可以问问他是什么意思。
messages.en: I don't know. You can ask him what he meant.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个居高临下、看不起人的眼神，用 b'disprezz 给这个画面配字幕，记住它表达轻蔑和缺乏尊重。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of a town or country, often with defined boundaries or a particular administrative purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 城镇或国家内的一个区域，常有明确边界或特定行政用途，也可指街区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żona ta' belt jew pajjiż, spiss b'konfini definiti jew b'funzjoni amministrattiva partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 区；地区，尤指划定的行政或管理区域
街区；邻里区域；地区

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jippreżenta n-numru ta' residenti f'kull distrett.
formal.en: The report presents the number of residents in each district.
formal.zh: 报告列出了各区的居民人数。

colloquial.mt: Maja: F'liema distrett toqgħod? Mark: Noqgħod f'distrett qrib iċ-ċentru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which district do you live in? Mark: I live in a district near the centre.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你住在哪个区？马克：我住在靠近市中心的一个区。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你住在哪个区？
messages.en: Which district do you live in?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我住在靠近市中心的一个区。
messages.en: I live in a district near the centre.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图被边界分成若干区，每一块都可以用 distrett 来标记；搭配 elettorali 时就想到选区。

gloss_zh: 多样的；不同的；各式各样的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Containing people or things that differ from one another, or showing a range of different characteristics.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包含彼此不同的人或事物的，或呈现多种不同特征的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li fih nies jew affarijiet differenti minn xulxin, jew li juri firxa ta' karatteristiċi differenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多样的；由不同类型构成的
不同的；有区别的
各种各样的；多种的
多样的；呈现很大差异或丰富变化的

formal.mt: Il-mużew joffri attivitajiet għal pubbliku divers, inklużi tfal u adulti.
formal.en: The museum offers activities for a diverse audience, including children and adults.
formal.zh: 博物馆为包括儿童和成人在内的多样化受众提供活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif inhu l-grupp il-ġdid? Mark: Huwa divers ħafna; hemm nies b'interessi differenti.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is the new group like? Mark: It is very diverse; there are people with different interests.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：新小组怎么样？马克：成员很多样，大家有不同的兴趣。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 新小组怎么样？
messages.en: What is the new group like?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa divers ħafna; hemm nies b'interessi differenti.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa divers ħafna; hemm nies b'interessi differenti.
messages.zh: 成员很多样，大家有不同的兴趣。
messages.en: It is very diverse; there are people with different interests.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 divers 配上一张成员背景各不相同的集体照，记住它强调多样或差异；联系英语 diverse 也可帮助记形。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used before a plural noun to indicate several people or things, typically three or more, without giving an exact number.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用在复数名词前，表示好几个或若干人、事物，通常为三个或更多，但不说明确切数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża qabel nom fil-plural biex tindika għadd ta' nies jew affarijiet, normalment tlieta jew aktar, mingħajr numru eżatt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 好几个；若干

sense_translations.en_definition: several (three or more, a fairly large number of)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 好几个；若干个，指三个或更多、数量颇为可观但未明确计数的人或事物

formal.mt: Diversi studenti pparteċipaw fid-diskussjoni u ppreżentaw l-ideat tagħhom.
formal.en: Several students participated in the discussion and presented their ideas.
formal.zh: 好几名学生参与了讨论，并提出了自己的想法。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kont hemm xi darba? Mark: Iva, mort diversi drabi mal-ħbieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you ever been there? Mark: Yes, I have been several times with friends.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你去过那里吗？马克：去过，我和朋友一起去过好几次。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你去过那里吗？
messages.en: Have you ever been there?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去过，我和朋友一起去过好几次。
messages.en: Yes, I have been several times with friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 diversi 后面想象好几个可数的人或物：diversi studenti 是好几名学生，diversi drabi 是好几次。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The presence of different kinds of people, things, or characteristics within a group or place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个群体或地方中存在不同类型的人、事物或特征的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-preżenza ta' tipi differenti ta' nies, affarijiet jew karatteristiċi fi grupp jew f'post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 多样性；不同类型并存的状态
丰富种类；多种多样

formal.mt: Il-programm edukattiv iħeġġeġ ir-rispett għad-diversità kulturali.
formal.en: The educational programme encourages respect for cultural diversity.
formal.zh: 这项教育计划鼓励人们尊重文化多样性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex jogħġbok dan is-suq? Mark: Għax hawn diversità kbira ta' ikel; dejjem insib xi ħaġa ġdida.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you like this market? Mark: Because there is a great variety of food here; I always find something new.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么喜欢这个市场？马克：因为这里食物种类丰富，我总能找到新鲜的东西。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么喜欢这个市场？
messages.en: Why do you like this market?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax hawn diversità kbira ta' ikel; dejjem insib xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: Għax hawn diversità kbira ta' ikel; dejjem insib xi ħaġa ġdida.
messages.zh: 因为这里食物种类丰富，我总能找到新鲜的东西。
messages.en: Because there is a great variety of food here; I always find something new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diversità 想成一幅同时容纳多种颜色的画，整幅画体现的就是多样性；配合文化或意见来记更具体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Enjoyment or activities that provide pleasure, relaxation, or entertainment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带来愉快、放松或娱乐的体验与活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjaċir jew attivitajiet li jagħtu gost, serħan jew okkażjoni biex wieħed jieħu pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消遣；娱乐带来的愉快
乐趣；开心的体验
休闲；用于放松身心的活动
乐趣；消遣；娱乐

formal.mt: Iċ-ċentru joffri attivitajiet ta' divertiment għat-tfal matul il-vaganzi.
formal.en: The centre offers recreational activities for children during the holidays.
formal.zh: 该中心在假期期间为儿童提供休闲娱乐活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tilgħab magħna? Mark: Iva! Ftit divertiment wara x-xogħol jagħmilli tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to play with us? Mark: Yes! A little fun after work will do me good.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想和我们一起玩吗？马克：想！下班后娱乐一下对我有好处。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我们一起玩吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play with us?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Ftit divertiment wara x-xogħol jagħmilli tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Ftit divertiment wara x-xogħol jagħmilli tajjeb.
messages.zh: 想！下班后娱乐一下对我有好处。
messages.en: Yes! A little fun after work will do me good.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到下班后玩游戏、听音乐的轻松时段，就联想到 divertiment；它既能指享受到的乐趣，也能指娱乐活动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sound heard again after it is reflected from a surface; also harmony between sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 声音遇到表面反射后再次被听到的回声；也可指声音之间的和谐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħoss li jerġa' jinstema' wara li jiġi rifless minn wiċċ; ukoll armonija bejn il-ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 回声；反射后再次传来的声音
和声；不同声音之间的和谐

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw li d-diwi kien jinstema' ċar meta tkellmu ġewwa l-grotta.
formal.en: The students observed that the echo could be heard clearly when they spoke inside the cave.
formal.zh: 学生们观察到，在洞穴里说话时可以清楚地听到回声。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Smajt dak il-ħoss? Mark: Iva, kien id-diwi ta' leħnek!
colloquial.en: Maja: Did you hear that sound? Mark: Yes, it was the echo of your voice!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你听到那个声音了吗？马克：听到了，那是你的回声！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你听到那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Did you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 听到了，那是你的回声！
messages.en: Yes, it was the echo of your voice!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在山洞里喊一声，声音又传回来，这个听觉画面帮助记住 diwi 的回声义；另把和声义配上合唱画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container used for serving or cooking food, or a particular food prepared as part of a meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于盛放或烹调食物的盘碟，也可指一餐中的某一道菜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent biex fih jitqiegħed jew jissajjar l-ikel, jew ikel partikolari mħejji bħala parti minn ikla.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盘；碟；一道菜，具体含义依上下文而定

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tispjega kif jitħejja dixx tal-ħut bil-ħaxix.
formal.en: The recipe explains how to prepare a fish dish with vegetables.
formal.zh: 这份食谱说明了如何制作一道配蔬菜的鱼菜。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fiex se npoġġi l-insalata? Mark: Uża d-dixx il-kbir; hemm biżżejjed spazju fih.
colloquial.en: Maja: What should I put the salad in? Mark: Use the large dish; it has enough room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我该用什么盛沙拉？马克：用那个大盘子，里面放得下。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 我该用什么盛沙拉？
messages.en: What should I put the salad in?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Uża d-dixx il-kbir; hemm biżżejjed spazju fih.
messages.mt_standard: Uża d-dixx il-kbir; hemm biżżejjed spazju fih.
messages.zh: 用那个大盘子，里面放得下。
messages.en: Use the large dish; it has enough room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一盘鱼菜同时记两层意思：盛菜的盘子是 dixx，盘中做好的那道菜也可以叫 dixx，靠上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A reference work that lists words and gives their meanings, translations, or other information about their use.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 收录词语并提供释义、翻译或用法等信息的工具书。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ktieb jew riżorsa diġitali li jiġbor il-kliem u jagħti t-tifsiriet, it-traduzzjonijiet jew tagħrif dwar l-użu tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 词典；供查找词语释义、翻译或用法的工具书。

collocations.en: to look up a word in the dictionary

formal.mt: L-istudenti għandhom jużaw dizzjunarju bilingwi biex jiċċekkjaw it-tifsira tal-kliem ġdid.
formal.en: Students should use a bilingual dictionary to check the meaning of new words.
formal.zh: 学生应使用双语词典核查生词的含义。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xi tfisser din il-kelma? Toni: Ejja nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju; forsi hemm ukoll eżempju.
colloquial.en: Nina: What does this word mean? Toni: Let's look it up in the dictionary; there may also be an example.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这个词是什么意思？Toni：我们查一下词典吧，里面也许还有例句。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 这个词是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this word mean?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju; forsi hemm ukoll eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nfittxuha fid-dizzjunarju; forsi hemm ukoll eżempju.
messages.zh: 我们查一下词典吧，里面也许还有例句。
messages.en: Let's look it up in the dictionary; there may also be an example.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到生词就想“打开 dizzjunarju 查意思”，把这个词与查词动作一起记，双语词典则搭配 bilingwi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: December, the twelfth month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 十二月，一年中的第十二个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tnax-il xahar tas-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十二月；作为月份名称使用。
十二月；一年中的第十二个月。

formal.mt: Il-kors jibda fil-bidu ta' Diċembru u jintemm qabel il-Milied.
formal.en: The course starts at the beginning of December and ends before Christmas.
formal.zh: 课程于十二月初开始，并在圣诞节前结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tiġi żżurna? Lara: F'Diċembru, ftit qabel il-Milied.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you coming to visit us? Lara: In December, shortly before Christmas.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你什么时候来看我们？Lara：十二月，圣诞节前不久。

messages.speaker: Maja（朋友）
messages.zh: 你什么时候来看我们？
messages.en: When are you coming to visit us?

messages.speaker: Lara（朋友）
messages.zh: 十二月，圣诞节前不久。
messages.en: In December, shortly before Christmas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日历第十二页写上 Diċembru，再配上圣诞节前后的行程；用 f'Diċembru 整块记住在十二月的说法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process by which the body breaks down food so that it can absorb and use nutrients.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体分解食物，以便吸收和利用营养物质的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih il-ġisem ikisser l-ikel biex ikun jista' jassorbi u juża n-nutrijenti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消化；身体分解食物以吸收营养的过程。

formal.mt: Dan il-kapitlu jispjega l-proċess tad-diġestjoni fil-ġisem tal-bniedem.
formal.en: This chapter explains the process of digestion in the human body.
formal.zh: 本章介绍人体内的消化过程。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'qed tistudja llum? Pawlu: Id-diġestjoni. Qed naqra dwar kif il-ġisem ikisser l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you studying today? Pawlu: Digestion. I'm reading about how the body breaks down food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天在学什么？保罗：消化。我正在读身体如何分解食物的内容。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你今天在学什么？
messages.en: What are you studying today?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Id-diġestjoni. Qed naqra dwar kif il-ġisem ikisser l-ikel.
messages.mt_standard: Id-diġestjoni. Qed naqra dwar kif il-ġisem ikisser l-ikel.
messages.zh: 消化。我正在读身体如何分解食物的内容。
messages.en: Digestion. I'm reading about how the body breaks down food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diġestjoni 写在食物逐步被分解的示意图旁，记成一个“消化过程”；再用 problemi tad-diġestjoni 联想“消化问题”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Before now or before a particular time, often earlier than expected.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事在现在或某个时间之前已经发生，有时带有比预期更早的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qabel issa jew qabel żmien partikolari, xi drabi aktar kmieni milli kien mistenni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 已经；表示事情此前便已发生或状态此前便已成立。

formal.mt: L-istudenti diġà rċevew l-istruzzjonijiet għall-eżami ta' għada.
formal.en: The students have already received the instructions for tomorrow's exam.
formal.zh: 学生们已经收到了明天考试的说明。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid tiekol xi ħaġa? Mark: Le, grazzi, diġà kilt.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like something to eat? Mark: No, thank you, I've already eaten.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你想吃点东西吗？马克：不用，谢谢，我已经吃过了。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想吃点东西吗？
messages.en: Would you like something to eat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 不用，谢谢，我已经吃过了。
messages.en: No, thank you, I've already eaten.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象别人端来饭，你指着空盘说 diġà kilt“我已经吃过了”；用完成在先的画面记住 diġà“已经”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An event causing serious damage or suffering, or an undertaking that goes very badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 造成严重破坏或痛苦的事件，也可指结果极其糟糕的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja li tikkawża ħsara jew tbatija kbira, jew xi ħaġa li tmur ħażin ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灾难；造成严重损失或痛苦的事件
大灾难；严重灾祸
灾难；惨败；彻底搞砸的事情

formal.mt: Wara d-diżastru naturali, il-voluntiera qassmu ikel u ilma lill-familji milquta.
formal.en: After the natural disaster, volunteers distributed food and water to the affected families.
formal.zh: 自然灾害发生后，志愿者向受灾家庭分发了食物和水。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif ġie l-kejk? Mark: Kien diżastru! Inħaraq u kellna nagħmlu ieħor.
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the cake turn out? Mark: It was a disaster! It burned, and we had to make another one.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：蛋糕做得怎么样？马克：彻底搞砸了！烤焦了，我们只好重新做一个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 蛋糕做得怎么样？
messages.en: How did the cake turn out?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien diżastru! Inħaraq u kellna nagħmlu ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Kien diżastru! Inħaraq u kellna nagħmlu ieħor.
messages.zh: 彻底搞砸了！烤焦了，我们只好重新做一个。
messages.en: It was a disaster! It burned, and we had to make another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个场景记住 diżastru：新闻中的严重灾害，以及朋友夸张形容烤焦蛋糕；两者都强调结果非常糟糕。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An unfortunate event, ranging from a mishap to a disaster or a serious accident.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不幸发生的事件，可指一般意外，也可指灾难、严重事故或悲剧。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġrajja ħażina jew sfortunata li tista' tkun inċident żgħir, aċċident serju jew traġedja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 造成深重痛苦或损失的悲剧。
造成严重损害或重大损失的灾难。
意外发生的不幸事件或小事故。
悲剧；造成严重后果的重大事故。

collocations.en: to avoid a disaster or accident

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema ngħataw taħriġ dwar is-sigurtà biex jevitaw diżgrazzja fuq il-post tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The workers received safety training to avoid an accident in the workplace.
formal.zh: 工人接受了安全培训，以避免发生工作场所事故。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tħallix is-sikkina fuq tarf il-mejda; tista' tiġri diżgrazzja. Pawlu: Għandek raġun, se nqegħedha fil-kexxun.
colloquial.en: Maja: Don't leave the knife on the edge of the table; an accident could happen. Pawlu: You're right, I'll put it in the drawer.
colloquial.zh: Maja：别把刀放在桌边，可能会出意外。Pawlu：你说得对，我把它放进抽屉。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tħallix is-sikkina fuq tarf il-mejda; tista' tiġri diżgrazzja.
messages.mt_standard: Tħallix is-sikkina fuq tarf il-mejda; tista' tiġri diżgrazzja.
messages.zh: 别把刀放在桌边，可能会出意外。
messages.en: Don't leave the knife on the edge of the table; an accident could happen.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 你说得对，我把它放进抽屉。
messages.en: You're right, I'll put it in the drawer.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象桌边的刀可能引发意外，把 diżgrazzja 连到“不幸事件”；再按后果轻重记住小事故、灾难与悲剧。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A loss of honour or respect, or the disgrace associated with shameful conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 荣誉或社会尊重的丧失，也指可耻行为带来的耻辱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Telf tal-unur jew tar-rispett, jew għajb li ġġib magħha mġiba ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荣誉或名誉的丧失；失去应有的尊重。
使人声名受损的耻辱或不光彩状态。
耻辱；因可耻行为而蒙受的羞辱。

collocations.en: to bring dishonour upon the family

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi l-falsifikazzjoni tad-dokumenti bħala diżunur għall-professjoni.
formal.en: The report describes the falsification of documents as a disgrace to the profession.
formal.zh: 报告将伪造文件的行为描述为有辱职业声誉之举。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex irrifjutajt li tqarraq fl-eżami? Lara: Għax il-qerq iġib diżunur; nippreferi nieħu marka aktar baxxa.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why did you refuse to cheat in the exam? Lara: Because cheating brings dishonour; I'd rather get a lower mark.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你为什么拒绝在考试中作弊？Lara：因为作弊会带来耻辱，我宁愿分数低一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么拒绝在考试中作弊？
messages.en: Why did you refuse to cheat in the exam?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-qerq iġib diżunur; nippreferi nieħu marka aktar baxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-qerq iġib diżunur; nippreferi nieħu marka aktar baxxa.
messages.zh: 因为作弊会带来耻辱，我宁愿分数低一点。
messages.en: Because cheating brings dishonour; I'd rather get a lower mark.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 diżunur 放进“作弊使人蒙羞”的场景，重点记名誉与尊重受损，不要只记成心里不好意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person holding the church office of deacon and carrying out religious and service duties.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 担任教会执事职分、履行宗教礼仪及服务职责的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li għandha l-ministeru ta' djaknu fil-Knisja u taqdi dmirijiet reliġjużi u ta' servizz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 执事；教会中担任特定宗教礼仪与服务职务的人。

formal.mt: Id-djaknu għen lill-qassis waqt il-quddiesa tal-Ħadd.
formal.en: The deacon assisted the priest during Sunday Mass.
formal.zh: 执事在主日弥撒中协助了神父。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min kien dak li għen lill-qassis illum? Ġużeppi: Dak hu d-djaknu tal-parroċċa tagħna.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who was the man who helped the priest today? Ġużeppi: That's the deacon of our parish.
colloquial.zh: Marta：今天协助神父的那个人是谁？Ġużeppi：那是我们堂区的执事。

messages.speaker: Marta (堂区信众)
messages.mt_spoken: Min kien dak li għen lill-qassis illum?
messages.mt_standard: Min kien dak li għen lill-qassis illum?
messages.zh: 今天协助神父的那个人是谁？
messages.en: Who was the man who helped the priest today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (堂区信众)
messages.zh: 那是我们堂区的执事。
messages.en: That's the deacon of our parish.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“弥撒中协助神父的执事”这一画面记 djaknu，并把它作为独立的教会职分名称来学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A variety of a language used by a particular regional or social community, with distinctive pronunciation, vocabulary, or grammar.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某个地域或社会群体使用的语言变体，在发音、词汇或语法上具有自身特点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Varjetà ta' lingwa użata f'reġjun jew minn grupp partikolari, b'karatteristiċi tagħha fil-pronunzja, fil-kliem jew fil-grammatika.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 方言；特定地域或群体使用、具有自身语言特点的语言变体。

formal.mt: L-istudju jqabbel il-pronunzja ta' dan id-djalett ma' dik tal-Malti standard.
formal.en: The study compares the pronunciation of this dialect with that of Standard Maltese.
formal.zh: 该研究将这种方言的发音与标准马耳他语的发音进行比较。

colloquial.mt: Sara: In-nanna tiegħek tuża kliem li ma nafx. Ben: Iva, titkellem bid-djalett tar-raħal tagħha; nista' nispjegalek xi kliem.
colloquial.en: Sara: Your grandmother uses words I don't know. Ben: Yes, she speaks the dialect of her village; I can explain some words to you.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你奶奶用的一些词我不认识。Ben：是啊，她说的是她村里的方言，我可以给你解释几个词。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nanna tiegħek tuża kliem li ma nafx.
messages.mt_standard: In-nanna tiegħek tuża kliem li ma nafx.
messages.zh: 你奶奶用的一些词我不认识。
messages.en: Your grandmother uses words I don't know.

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, titkellem bid-djalett tar-raħal tagħha; nista' nispjegalek xi kliem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, titkellem bid-djalett tar-raħal tagħha; nista' nispjegalek xi kliem.
messages.zh: 是啊，她说的是她村里的方言，我可以给你解释几个词。
messages.en: Yes, she speaks the dialect of her village; I can explain some words to you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 djalett 与“家乡说法”相连：既可能发音不同，也可能用词或语法不同，记忆时不要只想到口音。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A very hard crystalline form of carbon, often cut and polished for use as a gemstone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 碳的一种极硬晶体，常经切割和抛光后用作宝石，即金刚石或钻石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kristall iebes ħafna tal-karbonju, li spiss jinqata' u jiġi llustrat biex jintuża bħala ħaġra prezzjuża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钻石；金刚石，一种极硬的碳晶体，也用作宝石。

collocations.zh: 经过切割和抛光的钻石

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ċ-ċurkett bħala magħmul mid-deheb u mżejjen b'djamant wieħed.
formal.en: The catalogue describes the ring as made of gold and decorated with a single diamond.
formal.zh: 目录将这枚戒指描述为金制，并镶有一颗钻石。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-ġebla fiċ-ċurkett hija djamant? Mark: Iva, u għandi ċ-ċertifikat tagħha wkoll.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this stone in the ring a diamond? Mark: Yes, and I have its certificate too.
colloquial.zh: Lara：戒指上的这颗宝石是钻石吗？Mark：是的，我还有它的证书。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 戒指上的这颗宝石是钻石吗？
messages.en: Is this stone in the ring a diamond?

messages.speaker: Mark (珠宝店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u għandi ċ-ċertifikat tagħha wkoll.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u għandi ċ-ċertifikat tagħha wkoll.
messages.zh: 是的，我还有它的证书。
messages.en: Yes, and I have its certificate too.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象戒指中央的一颗钻石，用“ċurkett b'djamant”整组记忆，把戒指与钻石两个名词同时联结起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To narrow or become narrower in width or available space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 宽度或可用空间缩小，变得更窄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir idjaq fil-wisa' jew fl-ispazju disponibbli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 收窄；宽度或范围缩小。
变窄；由较宽的状态变为较窄的状态。

formal.mt: Minħabba x-xogħlijiet, il-passaġġ qed jidjieq u l-pedestrians għandhom jimxu b'attenzjoni.
formal.en: Because of the works, the passage is narrowing and pedestrians should walk carefully.
formal.zh: 由于施工，通道正在变窄，行人应小心通行。

colloquial.mt: Toni: Il-passaġġ qed jidjieq; nistgħu ngħaddu t-tnejn flimkien? Maja: Aħjar ngħaddu wieħed wieħed.
colloquial.en: Toni: The passage is getting narrower; can we both go through together? Maja: We'd better go through one at a time.
colloquial.zh: Toni：通道越来越窄了，我们能一起过去吗？Maja：最好一个一个过。

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-passaġġ qed jidjieq; nistgħu ngħaddu t-tnejn flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Il-passaġġ qed jidjieq; nistgħu ngħaddu t-tnejn flimkien?
messages.zh: 通道越来越窄了，我们能一起过去吗？
messages.en: The passage is getting narrower; can we both go through together?

messages.speaker: Maja (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 最好一个一个过。
messages.en: We'd better go through one at a time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象通道两侧逐渐靠拢，原本并排行走变成单人通过；用这个动态画面记 djieq 的“变窄”。

gloss_zh: 狭窄；心胸狭隘；清教徒式拘谨；过分拘守礼教

teaching_sense.en_definition: The state of being narrow, either physically or in outlook; also an excessively strict or prudish attitude toward conduct.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 空间上的狭窄或思想、心胸上的狭隘，也可指对行为道德过分严苛或拘谨的态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-fatt li xi ħaġa tkun dejqa, jew li persuna jkollha ħsieb magħluq jew attitudni riġida żżejjed dwar l-imġiba u d-deċenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狭窄；宽度不足或空间有限的状态。
心胸或思想狭隘；不愿接受不同意见或观点。
清教徒式的严苛道德态度；对享乐或行为规范过分严格。
对性、衣着或得体问题过分拘谨、拘守礼教的态度。

formal.mt: Id-djuqija tat-triq tagħmilha diffiċli biex żewġ vetturi jgħaddu minn ħdejn xulxin.
formal.en: The narrowness of the road makes it difficult for two vehicles to pass each other.
formal.zh: 道路狭窄，使两辆车难以交会通行。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Qed jikkritikawha biss għax tilbes dublett qasir. Sara: Din djuqija; il-ħwejjeġ ma jurux il-karattru ta' persuna.
colloquial.en: Nina: They're criticising her just because she wears a short skirt. Sara: That's prudishness; clothes don't show a person's character.
colloquial.zh: Nina：他们批评她，只是因为她穿短裙。Sara：这也太拘守礼教了，衣着并不能说明一个人的品格。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed jikkritikawha biss għax tilbes dublett qasir.
messages.mt_standard: Qed jikkritikawha biss għax tilbes dublett qasir.
messages.zh: 他们批评她，只是因为她穿短裙。
messages.en: They're criticising her just because she wears a short skirt.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Din djuqija; il-ħwejjeġ ma jurux il-karattru ta' persuna.
messages.mt_standard: Din djuqija; il-ħwejjeġ ma jurux il-karattru ta' persuna.
messages.zh: 这也太拘守礼教了，衣着并不能说明一个人的品格。
messages.en: That's prudishness; clothes don't show a person's character.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画面记 djuqija：窄路、容不下异见的脑袋、对衣着过分拘谨的目光；按语境区分空间、思想与道德态度。

gloss_zh: 天色变暗；黑暗；阴郁；蒙昧

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become dark, especially when daylight fades.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变暗，尤指日光渐退、天色暗下来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidħol id-dlam, speċjalment meta jonqos id-dawl tal-jum.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变暗；天色暗下来。
黑暗；缺少光亮的状态。
昏暗；阴郁、沉闷的气氛。
晦暗不明；蒙昧无知。

formal.mt: Dlam qabel ma wasal il-grupp, għalhekk il-gwida xegħlet torċa biex turi t-triq.
formal.en: It grew dark before the group arrived, so the guide switched on a torch to show the way.
formal.zh: 小组抵达之前天色就暗了，因此向导打开手电筒照路。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dlam diġà! Għandek torċa? | Pawlu: Iva, għandi waħda fil-basket.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's already grown dark! Do you have a torch? | Pawlu: Yes, I have one in my bag.
colloquial.zh: Maja：天已经黑了！你带手电筒了吗？ | Pawlu：带了，我包里有一支。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 天已经黑了！你带手电筒了吗？
messages.en: It's already grown dark! Do you have a torch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 带了，我包里有一支。
messages.en: Yes, I have one in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把日落后打开手电筒的画面与 dlam 相连：作动词记“天变暗”，放在 fid-dlam 中则记“在黑暗中”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Tenderness or gentleness expressed through words, feelings, or touch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过言语、情感或触碰表现出来的温柔、柔情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlewwa jew ġentilezza li tidher fil-kliem, fis-sentimenti jew fil-mess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温柔；柔情；亲切体贴。
柔软；柔和的性质。
长发。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-omm esprimiet ħafna dliel u tat kuraġġ lil bintha qabel l-eżami.
formal.en: In her letter, the mother expressed great tenderness and encouraged her daughter before the exam.
formal.zh: 母亲在信中流露出浓浓的柔情，并在考试前鼓励女儿。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hemm dliel fil-kliem tan-nanna! | Mark: Iva, dejjem taf kif tfarraġni.
colloquial.en: Lara: There's so much tenderness in Grandma's words! | Mark: Yes, she always knows how to comfort me.
colloquial.zh: Lara：奶奶的话真温柔！ | Mark：是啊，她总知道怎样安慰我。

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 奶奶的话真温柔！
messages.en: There's so much tenderness in Grandma's words!

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.zh: 是啊，她总知道怎样安慰我。
messages.en: Yes, she always knows how to comfort me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个独立画面记 dliel：温柔的话语、柔软的触感、垂下的长发；根据上下文选择词义，不把三义硬译成同一个词。

gloss_zh: 涂抹；软膏；黏性；dilek 的动名词

teaching_sense.en_definition: The action of spreading or rubbing a substance over a surface, such as applying cream to the skin.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某种物质涂开或揉擦在表面上的动作，例如在皮肤上涂乳霜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-azzjoni li tifrex jew togħrok sustanza fuq wiċċ, bħal meta tapplika krema fuq il-ġilda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涂抹；把物质抹开。
软膏；供涂抹使用的膏剂。
黏性；黏附的性质。
动词 dilek 的动名词，表示涂抹、揉擦这一动作。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw id-dlik tal-krema fuq il-ġilda waqt id-dimostrazzjoni.
formal.en: The students observed the application of cream to the skin during the demonstration.
formal.zh: 学生们在示范过程中观察了把乳霜涂在皮肤上的动作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Lestejt id-dlik tal-krema? | Lara: Għadni, qed nifrex ftit fuq idejja.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you finished applying the cream? | Lara: Not yet, I'm spreading a little on my hands.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你涂完乳霜了吗？ | Lara：还没，我正往手上抹一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你涂完乳霜了吗？
messages.en: Have you finished applying the cream?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni, qed nifrex ftit fuq idejja.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni, qed nifrex ftit fuq idejja.
messages.zh: 还没，我正往手上抹一点。
messages.en: Not yet, I'm spreading a little on my hands.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把软膏慢慢抹开的动作来记 dlik：先记名词“涂抹”，再分别联结“软膏”和“黏性”；动名词也是名词用法。

gloss_zh: 突然；立即；骤然；马上；经常

teaching_sense.en_definition: Immediately or without delay after something happens.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 立即、马上，表示某事发生后不作耽搁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minnufih jew bla dewmien wara li jiġri xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然地；出乎意料地。
立即；毫不耽搁地。
骤然地；突然且急促地。
马上；直接就；立即。
经常；频繁地。

formal.mt: Malli rċeviet it-talba, is-segretarja wieġbet dlonk u bagħtet id-dokumenti meħtieġa.
formal.en: As soon as she received the request, the secretary replied immediately and sent the required documents.
formal.zh: 秘书一收到请求就立即回复，并发送了所需文件。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Tista' tiġi tgħinni? | Pawlu: Iva, niġi dlonk.
colloquial.en: Mark: Can you come and help me? | Pawlu: Yes, I'll come right away.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你能过来帮我吗？ | Pawlu：能，我马上来。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你能过来帮我吗？
messages.en: Can you come and help me?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 能，我马上来。
messages.en: Yes, I'll come right away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dlonk 放进“你叫我，我马上来”的场景记住“立即”；遇到其他语境，再分辨它表示突然、骤然还是经常。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something a person is expected or required to do because of a role or responsibility.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因身份、角色或责任而应当履行的义务或职责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li persuna għandha tagħmel minħabba r-rwol jew ir-responsabbiltà tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 义务；职责；应尽的本分。

formal.mt: Kull membru għandu d-dmir li jżomm l-informazzjoni personali tal-klijenti kunfidenzjali.
formal.en: Every member has a duty to keep clients' personal information confidential.
formal.zh: 每位成员都有义务为客户的个人信息保密。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Grazzi talli għentni! | Mark: Ta' xejn, għamilt dmiri.
colloquial.en: Lara: Thanks for helping me! | Mark: You're welcome, I did my duty.
colloquial.zh: Lara：谢谢你帮我！ | Mark：不客气，我只是尽了自己的本分。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 谢谢你帮我！
messages.en: Thanks for helping me!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.zh: 不客气，我只是尽了自己的本分。
messages.en: You're welcome, I did my duty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dmir 写在每日职责清单旁，联想“这是我应尽的本分”；再用 dmiri“我的职责”和 dmiru“他的职责”巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Eager to shed blood or inflict violent harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嗜血的，渴望流血或以暴力伤害他人的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jixtieq ixerred id-demm jew jagħmel ħsara vjolenti lil ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 嗜血的；渴望杀戮或暴力伤害的。
血腥的；涉及流血或杀戮的。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri kif tirann dmumi juża l-biża' biex iżomm il-poter.
formal.en: The novel shows how a bloodthirsty tyrant uses fear to retain power.
formal.zh: 这部小说展现了一个嗜血暴君如何利用恐惧维持权力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-tirann f'dan il-film huwa tassew dmumi. | Pawlu: Iva, kulħadd jibża' minnu.
colloquial.en: Maja: The tyrant in this film is really bloodthirsty. | Pawlu: Yes, everyone is afraid of him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这部电影里的暴君真嗜血。 | Pawlu：是啊，所有人都怕他。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tirann f'dan il-film huwa tassew dmumi.
messages.mt_standard: It-tirann f'dan il-film huwa tassew dmumi.
messages.zh: 这部电影里的暴君真嗜血。
messages.en: The tyrant in this film is really bloodthirsty.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，所有人都怕他。
messages.en: Yes, everyone is afraid of him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用故事中的暴君记 dmumi“嗜血的”，用冲突场景记“血腥的”；它是描述性质的形容词，学习时连同所修饰的名词一起记。

gloss_zh: 暴力；强力；施加于人的强制力或制裁

teaching_sense.en_definition: Violence or force used against another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 针对他人使用的暴力或强制力量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Vjolenza jew forza użata kontra persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 暴力；以强力伤害或压制他人的行为。
强力；强制力量。

sense_translations.en_definition: force used against someone; violence; sanction
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人施加的强力；暴力；制裁。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jikkundanna l-użu tad-dnewwa kontra persuni li kienu qed jipprotestaw b'mod paċifiku.
formal.en: The report condemns the use of violence against people who were protesting peacefully.
formal.zh: 该报告谴责对和平抗议者使用暴力。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nistgħu nsolvu din il-problema mingħajr dnewwa. | Lara: Iva, ejja nitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Mark: We can solve this problem without violence. | Lara: Yes, let's talk calmly.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们可以不用暴力解决这个问题。 | Lara：对，我们心平气和地谈谈吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Nistgħu nsolvu din il-problema mingħajr dnewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Nistgħu nsolvu din il-problema mingħajr dnewwa.
messages.zh: 我们可以不用暴力解决这个问题。
messages.en: We can solve this problem without violence.

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 对，我们心平气和地谈谈吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's talk calmly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dnewwa 与“对人施加强力”的场景相连，再用 mingħajr dnewwa“没有暴力”整句记忆；遇到制裁义时结合具体语境理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act considered wrong according to religious or moral principles.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 按宗教或道德原则被视为错误的行为，即罪或罪过。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għemil li jitqies ħażin skont prinċipji reliġjużi jew morali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 罪；罪过，尤指违背宗教或道德准则的行为。
道德上的罪责；因过错而负有的责任。

formal.mt: Fil-lezzjoni tar-reliġjon, l-għalliema spjegat għaliex il-gideb jitqies dnub.
formal.en: In the religion lesson, the teacher explained why lying is considered a sin.
formal.zh: 在宗教课上，老师解释了为什么说谎被视为一种罪过。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex il-gideb jitqies dnub? | Anna: Għax jista' jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor u jkisser il-fiduċja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is lying considered a sin? | Anna: Because it can harm others and break trust.
colloquial.zh: Mark：为什么说谎被视为罪过？ | Anna：因为说谎可能伤害别人，破坏信任。

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.zh: 为什么说谎被视为罪过？
messages.en: Why is lying considered a sin?

messages.speaker: Anna (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax jista' jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor u jkisser il-fiduċja.
messages.mt_standard: Għax jista' jagħmel ħsara lil ħaddieħor u jkisser il-fiduċja.
messages.zh: 因为说谎可能伤害别人，破坏信任。
messages.en: Because it can harm others and break trust.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dnub 放进“说谎被视为罪过”的课堂句子中记忆：既可指所犯的罪过，也可指由此承担的道德罪责。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to the home or household, or describing an animal kept by people.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与家庭或家务有关的，也可形容由人饲养的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mad-dar jew mal-ħajja tal-familja, jew li jiddeskrivi annimal miżmum mill-bniedem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 家庭的；家务的；家养的。

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol domestiku għandu jinqasam b'mod ġust bejn il-membri tal-familja.
formal.en: Housework should be shared fairly among family members.
formal.zh: 家务劳动应由家庭成员公平分担。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif taqsmu x-xogħol domestiku? Mark: Jien insajjar u ħija jaħsel il-platti.
colloquial.en: Maja: How do you share the housework? Mark: I cook and my brother washes the dishes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你们怎么分担家务？马克：我做饭，我哥哥洗碗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们怎么分担家务？
messages.en: How do you share the housework?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien insajjar u ħija jaħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Jien insajjar u ħija jaħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 我做饭，我哥哥洗碗。
messages.en: I cook and my brother washes the dishes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 domestiku 和家门内的生活画面一起记：做家务是 xogħol domestiku，家养动物是 annimal domestiku。

gloss_zh: 狮子；狮子座（星座或黄道星座）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large wild cat called a lion, whose adult male usually has a mane.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 狮子，一种大型野生猫科动物，成年雄性通常长有鬃毛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, magħruf ukoll bħala ljun, li r-raġel adult tiegħu normalment ikollu kriniera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 狮子，一种大型猫科动物。
狮子座，天文学中的星座名称。
狮子座，黄道十二星座之一的名称。

formal.mt: L-istampa turi dorbies adult bi kriniera kbira.
formal.en: The picture shows an adult lion with a large mane.
formal.zh: 图片展示了一头鬃毛浓密的成年狮子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dak l-annimal fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dak dorbies. Ara l-kriniera kbira tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that animal in the picture? Pawlu: That's a lion. Look at its big mane!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：图片里的那是什么动物？保罗：那是狮子。看它浓密的鬃毛！

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的那是什么动物？
messages.en: What is that animal in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak dorbies. Ara l-kriniera kbira tiegħu!
messages.mt_standard: Dak dorbies. Ara l-kriniera kbira tiegħu!
messages.zh: 那是狮子。看它浓密的鬃毛！
messages.en: That's a lion. Look at its big mane!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dorbies 配一张雄狮鬃毛图，再画两张天空卡片，分别标明天文学星座和黄道星座，帮助区分三个义项。

gloss_zh: 博士的；博士学位相关的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to a doctorate or to study and research undertaken for that degree.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与博士学位或攻读该学位所进行的学习和研究有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut ma' dottorat jew mal-istudju u r-riċerka li jsiru biex jinkiseb dan il-grad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 博士的；用于描述博士阶段的学习、研究或课程。
与博士学位有关的。

formal.mt: Il-programm dottorali jinkludi riċerka indipendenti taħt is-superviżjoni ta' membru akkademiku.
formal.en: The doctoral programme includes independent research under the supervision of an academic staff member.
formal.zh: 该博士培养项目包括在学术人员指导下开展的独立研究。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tfittex programm dottorali? David: Iva, nixtieq nagħmel riċerka fil-lingwistika.
colloquial.en: Sara: Are you looking for a doctoral programme? David: Yes, I'd like to do research in linguistics.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你在找博士项目吗？戴维：是的，我想做语言学研究。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 你在找博士项目吗？
messages.en: Are you looking for a doctoral programme?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我想做语言学研究。
messages.en: Yes, I'd like to do research in linguistics.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dottorali 当作贴在学习项目上的“博士级”标签：programm dottorali 是博士项目，studji dottorali 是博士阶段学习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An advanced university degree awarded after completing doctoral study and research.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 完成博士阶段学习和研究后获得的高等学位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grad universitarju avvanzat li jingħata wara li jitlestew studji u riċerka fil-livell dottorali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 博士学位。

formal.mt: Hija kisbet dottorat fil-lingwistika wara li temmet ir-riċerka tagħha.
formal.en: She obtained a doctorate in linguistics after completing her research.
formal.zh: 她完成研究后获得了语言学博士学位。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'qed tistudja bħalissa? Anna: Qed nagħmel dottorat fl-istorja.
colloquial.en: Mark: What are you studying at the moment? Anna: I'm doing a doctorate in history.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你现在在读什么？安娜：我在攻读历史学博士学位。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你现在在读什么？
messages.en: What are you studying at the moment?

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我在攻读历史学博士学位。
messages.en: I'm doing a doctorate in history.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象毕业证书上写着 dottorat：它指博士学位本身；配合 nagħmel 记“攻读”，配合 nikseb 记“获得”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A powder made by grinding grain, used to make bread, cakes, and other foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 谷物磨成的粉，用来制作面包、蛋糕等食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trab magħmul mit-tħin taċ-ċereali, li jintuża biex isiru l-ħobż, il-kejkijiet u ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面粉；谷物磨成、用于烹饪或烘焙的粉。

formal.mt: Żid id-dqiq ftit ftit u ħawwad sakemm it-taħlita tkun lixxa.
formal.en: Add the flour gradually and stir until the mixture is smooth.
formal.zh: 逐渐加入面粉，搅拌至混合物顺滑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għandna biżżejjed dqiq għall-kejk? Omm: Le, jekk jogħġbok ixtri kilo dqiq.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do we have enough flour for the cake? Mum: No, please buy a kilo of flour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我们做蛋糕的面粉够吗？妈妈：不够，请买一公斤面粉。

messages.speaker: Nina (女儿)
messages.zh: 我们做蛋糕的面粉够吗？
messages.en: Do we have enough flour for the cake?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, jekk jogħġbok ixtri kilo dqiq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, jekk jogħġbok ixtri kilo dqiq.
messages.zh: 不够，请买一公斤面粉。
messages.en: No, please buy a kilo of flour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dqiq 写在面粉袋图上，边想象撒面粉边读词；再连读 kilo dqiq，把它和“一公斤面粉”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A unit of time equal to sixty seconds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 分钟，等于六十秒的时间单位。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Unità ta' ħin li fiha sittin sekonda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分钟，六十秒。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom dqiqa waħda biex jaqraw il-mistoqsija.
formal.en: Participants have one minute to read the question.
formal.zh: 参与者有一分钟时间阅读题目。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Lest biex nitilqu? Ben: Stenna dqiqa, qed infittex iċ-ċwievet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Ready to leave? Ben: Wait a minute, I'm looking for the keys.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：准备好出发了吗？本：稍等一下，我在找钥匙。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 准备好出发了吗？
messages.en: Ready to leave?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.zh: 稍等一下，我在找钥匙。
messages.en: Wait a minute, I'm looking for the keys.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 dqiqa 配一个六十秒倒计时；和 dqiq 面粉分卡记忆，一张画时钟，一张画面粉袋，避免相近拼写混淆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dramatic work in which actors present a story through speech and action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由演员通过台词和动作演绎故事的戏剧作品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol teatrali li fih l-atturi jirrakkontaw storja permezz tad-djalogu u tal-azzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧；通过人物对话和行动展开故事的作品或艺术形式。
剧本；供演员演出的戏剧作品。
戏剧；剧作。
鼓，一种敲击发声的打击乐器。

formal.mt: L-istudenti se jtellgħu dramm storiku fit-teatru tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students will stage a historical drama in the school theatre.
formal.zh: 学生们将在学校剧场上演一部历史剧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi tara dramm miegħi s-Sibt? Karl: Iva! F'liema teatru se jkun?
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like to come and see a play with me on Saturday? Karl: Yes! Which theatre will it be at?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：星期六想和我一起看场戏吗？卡尔：想！在哪家剧院演？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi tara dramm miegħi s-Sibt?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi tara dramm miegħi s-Sibt?
messages.zh: 星期六想和我一起看场戏吗？
messages.en: Would you like to come and see a play with me on Saturday?

messages.speaker: Karl (朋友)
messages.zh: 想！在哪家剧院演？
messages.en: Yes! Which theatre will it be at?

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 dramm 画舞台和剧本来记主要戏剧义，再单独画一面鼓记录另一义项；用不同图卡保留义项边界。

gloss_zh: 戏剧的；戏剧性的；引人注目的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to drama, or striking and emotionally powerful in a way that attracts attention.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与戏剧有关的；也形容富有戏剧性、情感强烈或引人注目的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Marbut mad-drama, jew li jiġbed l-attenzjoni minħabba l-qawwa jew l-effett emozzjonali tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戏剧的；戏剧性的；也可指变化显著或效果强烈、引人注目的。

formal.mt: Id-direttur uża d-dawl u l-mużika biex joħloq effett drammatiku fix-xena finali.
formal.en: The director used lighting and music to create a dramatic effect in the final scene.
formal.zh: 导演运用灯光和音乐，在最后一幕营造了戏剧性效果。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għoġbok il-film? Mark: Iva, speċjalment it-tmiem. Kien drammatiku ħafna!
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you like the film? Mark: Yes, especially the ending. It was very dramatic!
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你喜欢这部电影吗？马克：喜欢，尤其是结局。太有戏剧性了！

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这部电影吗？
messages.en: Did you like the film?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, speċjalment it-tmiem. Kien drammatiku ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, speċjalment it-tmiem. Kien drammatiku ħafna!
messages.zh: 喜欢，尤其是结局。太有戏剧性了！
messages.en: Yes, especially the ending. It was very dramatic!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象电影结尾灯光骤变、音乐响起，用 drammatiku 给这种强烈效果贴标签；连记 tmiem drammatiku“戏剧性结局”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sewer or a system for carrying away wastewater; the drainage of unwanted water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 输送污水的下水道或排水系统，也指排除多余水分的过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kanal jew sistema li twassal l-ilma mormi 'l barra; it-tneħħija tal-ilma żejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 输送污水的下水道。
排水；将污水或多余水分排走的过程或系统。

formal.mt: Il-kunsill se jtejjeb is-sistema tad-dranaġġ biex l-ilma tax-xita ma jinġabarx fit-triq.
formal.en: The council will improve the drainage system so that rainwater does not collect in the street.
formal.zh: 地方议会将改善排水系统，防止雨水在街道上积聚。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex hemm daqshekk ilma fit-triq? Rita: Hemm problema fid-dranaġġ; l-ilma mhux qed jinżel.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why is there so much water in the street? Rita: There is a problem with the drainage; the water is not draining away.
colloquial.zh: 马克：街上为什么有这么多水？丽塔：排水出了问题，水排不下去。

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 街上为什么有这么多水？
messages.en: Why is there so much water in the street?

messages.speaker: Rita (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm problema fid-dranaġġ; l-ilma mhux qed jinżel.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm problema fid-dranaġġ; l-ilma mhux qed jinżel.
messages.zh: 排水出了问题，水排不下去。
messages.en: There is a problem with the drainage; the water is not draining away.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把街面积水沿管道排走的画面与 dranaġġ 配对：既记住下水道，也记住排水这一功能。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cloth or textile material used to make clothing, curtains, or other items.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于制作衣服、窗帘等物品的布或纺织材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal minsuġ jew maħdum li jintuża biex isiru ħwejjeġ, purtieri jew oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 布；可用于缝制或擦拭等用途的布。
布料；用于制作衣物或其他物品的织物材料。
纺织品；纺织材料。

formal.mt: Il-ħajjata għażlet drapp tal-qoton biex tagħmel il-qomos għall-istudenti.
formal.en: The seamstress chose cotton fabric to make shirts for the students.
formal.zh: 女裁缝选择了棉布，为学生们制作衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-drapp tajjeb għall-purtieri? Lara: Iva, huwa oħxon u l-kulur jaqbel mal-kamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this fabric suitable for curtains? Lara: Yes, it is thick and the colour matches the room.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种布适合做窗帘吗？拉拉：适合，布很厚，颜色也和房间相配。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种布适合做窗帘吗？
messages.en: Is this fabric suitable for curtains?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa oħxon u l-kulur jaqbel mal-kamra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa oħxon u l-kulur jaqbel mal-kamra.
messages.zh: 适合，布很厚，颜色也和房间相配。
messages.en: Yes, it is thick and the colour matches the room.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象布店里摸到的一块棉布，把 drapp 与布料本身相连，再用 biċċa drapp 记住一块布。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A usual way of acting, either a personal habit or a custom or tradition shared by a community.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 经常采用的行为方式，可指个人习惯，也可指群体共同遵循的习俗或传统。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mod ta' kif wieħed jaġixxi regolarment, jew użanza jew tradizzjoni komuni f'komunità.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 习俗；某个群体通常遵循的做法。
传统；在家庭或群体中传承的惯常做法。
习惯；个人反复进行、逐渐形成常态的行为。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-raħal, l-ikla komuni wara l-festa hija drawwa li tgħaddi minn ġenerazzjoni għal oħra.
formal.en: In this village, the communal meal after the feast is a custom passed from one generation to the next.
formal.zh: 在这个村庄，节庆后的聚餐是一项代代相传的习俗。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex taqra kull filgħodu? Mark: Għandi d-drawwa li naqra ftit qabel immur għax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why do you read every morning? Mark: I have a habit of reading a little before going to work.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么每天早上都读书？马克：我习惯上班前读一会儿书。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么每天早上都读书？
messages.en: Why do you read every morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi d-drawwa li naqra ftit qabel immur għax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi d-drawwa li naqra ftit qabel immur għax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 我习惯上班前读一会儿书。
messages.en: I have a habit of reading a little before going to work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用重复行为记 drawwa：一个人天天做是习惯，一群人长期共同做可成为习俗或传统。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arm, the upper limb of the body; figuratively, power or strength.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体的上肢，即手臂；比喻意义上也可指力量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem mill-ispalla sal-id; b'mod figurattiv, qawwa jew saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 手臂；从肩部延伸至手的上肢。
力量；以手臂作比喻所表示的实力或威力。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem weġġa' driegħu waqt li kien qed iġorr kaxxa tqila.
formal.en: The worker injured his arm while carrying a heavy box.
formal.zh: 这名工人在搬运一个沉重的箱子时弄伤了手臂。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed iżżomm driegħek? Pawlu: Għandi uġigħ fid-driegħ wara t-taħriġ tal-bieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you holding your arm? Pawlu: My arm hurts after yesterday's training.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么捂着手臂？保罗：昨天训练后，我的手臂一直疼。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么捂着手臂？
messages.en: Why are you holding your arm?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi uġigħ fid-driegħ wara t-taħriġ tal-bieraħ.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi uġigħ fid-driegħ wara t-taħriġ tal-bieraħ.
messages.zh: 昨天训练后，我的手臂一直疼。
messages.en: My arm hurts after yesterday's training.

cognitive_memory_aid: 抬起手臂读 driegħ，再想象手臂举起重物：先记身体部位，再联想比喻义力量。

gloss_zh: 直的；直立的；真理；正当选择；权利

teaching_sense.en_definition: Straight rather than bent or curved, or upright in position.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 呈直线、没有弯曲的，或处于直立姿态的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li mhuwiex mgħawweġ jew milwi, jew li jinsab f'pożizzjoni wieqfa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 直的；没有弯曲的。
直立的；竖直的。
真相；真实的情况或真理。
道德上正确的选择。
权利；一个人正当享有的资格或权益。

sense_translations.en_definition: that which is true and just; the right thing
sense_translations.zh_definition: 真实而公正的事物；正确、正当的事。

formal.mt: It-tekniku ċċekkja li l-arblu kien dritt qabel ma waħħlu f'postu.
formal.en: The technician checked that the pole was upright before securing it in place.
formal.zh: 技术人员在固定杆子之前，检查了它是否竖直。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-kwadru dritt? Mark: Le, għolli ftit in-naħa tax-xellug.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this picture straight? Mark: No, raise the left side a little.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这幅画挂正了吗？马克：还没有，把左边稍微抬高一点。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 这幅画挂正了吗？
messages.en: Is this picture straight?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 还没有，把左边稍微抬高一点。
messages.en: No, raise the left side a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dritt 分成两张学习卡：形容词配挺直的背，名词配权利或正当之事，借语境区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cardinal number nineteen, one more than eighteen and one less than twenty, used on its own in the absolute form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 基数十九，比十八多一、比二十少一；此处为可以独立使用的形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara tmintax u qabel għoxrin, fil-forma li tintuża waħedha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十九，表示数量的基数。
十九，独立使用时的数词形式。

formal.mt: Wara l-għadd finali, it-total tal-parteċipanti kien dsatax.
formal.en: After the final count, the total number of participants was nineteen.
formal.zh: 最终清点后，参与者总数为十九人。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm ġew nies għal-laqgħa? Pawlu: Dsatax, u kollha waslu fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Maja: How many people came to the meeting? Pawlu: Nineteen, and they all arrived on time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：有多少人来参加会议？保罗：十九人，而且全都准时到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (会议组织者)
messages.zh: 有多少人来参加会议？
messages.en: How many people came to the meeting?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (签到负责人)
messages.zh: 十九人，而且全都准时到了。
messages.en: Nineteen, and they all arrived on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出十九个圆点，数完后单独回答 dsatax；把这个完整读音与数字19直接配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 苍蝇，通常指普通苍蝇或家蝇

teaching_sense.en_definition: Flies, especially common flies or house flies, referred to collectively or in the plural.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 苍蝇，尤其指普通苍蝇或家蝇；用于集合地或复数地指称这类昆虫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insetti li jtiru, speċjalment dawk komuni fid-djar, imsemmija bħala grupp jew fil-plural.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 苍蝇，通常指普通苍蝇或家蝇。
苍蝇，指这类昆虫的集合或复数。

formal.mt: L-ikel għandu jinżamm mgħotti biex id-dubbien ma joqgħodx fuqu.
formal.en: Food should be kept covered so that flies do not land on it.
formal.zh: 食物应当盖好，以免苍蝇落在上面。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex għattejt il-kejk? Mark: Hemm ħafna dubbien fil-kċina, u ma rridx li joqgħod fuqu.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you cover the cake? Mark: There are lots of flies in the kitchen, and I don't want them landing on it.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么把蛋糕盖起来？马克：厨房里有很多苍蝇，我不想让它们落在蛋糕上。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把蛋糕盖起来？
messages.en: Why did you cover the cake?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm ħafna dubbien fil-kċina, u ma rridx li joqgħod fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm ħafna dubbien fil-kċina, u ma rridx li joqgħod fuqu.
messages.zh: 厨房里有很多苍蝇，我不想让它们落在蛋糕上。
messages.en: There are lots of flies in the kitchen, and I don't want them landing on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象几只苍蝇围着蛋糕飞，边盖食物边记 dubbien；用一群苍蝇的画面牢记其集合或复数用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A skirt, a garment worn from the waist down that hangs around the legs without separate leg sections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 裙子，通常指从腰部向下穿、围住双腿而不分裤腿的半身裙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies li tintlibes mill-qadd 'l isfel u tinżel madwar ir-riġlejn mingħajr ma tkun maqsuma bħal qalziet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裙子；从腰部向下穿着的半身裙。

formal.mt: Għall-kunċert, il-kantanta għażlet dublett twil u qmis bajda.
formal.en: For the concert, the singer chose a long skirt and a white shirt.
formal.zh: 这位女歌手为音乐会选了一条长裙和一件白衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan id-dublett jaqbel ma' din il-qmis? Lara: Iva, il-kuluri jmorru tajjeb flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this skirt go with this shirt? Lara: Yes, the colours work well together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条裙子配这件衬衫吗？拉拉：配，这两个颜色搭在一起很好看。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan id-dublett jaqbel ma' din il-qmis?
messages.mt_standard: Dan id-dublett jaqbel ma' din il-qmis?
messages.zh: 这条裙子配这件衬衫吗？
messages.en: Does this skirt go with this shirt?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.zh: 配，这两个颜色搭在一起很好看。
messages.en: Yes, the colours work well together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣架上一条从腰部垂下的半身裙，把 dublett 与这幅图配对，再用长裙和短裙练习搭配。

gloss_zh: 虫子；蠕虫；虱子；螨虫；挂窗帘的金属线

teaching_sense.en_definition: Worms or other small crawling creatures, with the precise meaning depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蠕虫或其他细小的爬行虫类，具体所指需结合上下文判断。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħlejjaq żgħar li jitkaxkru, bħalma huma dawk li jgħixu fil-ħamrija jew fil-frott; it-tifsira preċiża tiddependi mill-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小虫；虫子。
蠕虫。
虱子。

sense_translations.en_definition: the wire used to hang curtains
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来悬挂窗帘的金属线。
蠕虫；作为一类生物的蠕虫。
螨虫。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw id-dud fil-ħamrija u kitbu dwar il-movimenti tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed the worms in the soil and wrote about their movements.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了土壤中的蠕虫，并记录了它们的活动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tħares lejn il-ħamrija? Pawlu: Hemm id-dud! Ara kif qed jitkaxkar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you looking at the soil? Pawlu: There are worms! Look how they're crawling.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么盯着土看？Pawlu：有虫子！看它们爬的样子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么盯着土看？
messages.en: Why are you looking at the soil?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Hemm id-dud! Ara kif qed jitkaxkar.
messages.mt_standard: Hemm id-dud! Ara kif qed jitkaxkar.
messages.zh: 有虫子！看它们爬的样子。
messages.en: There are worms! Look how they're crawling.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dud 写在泥土与虫子的图画旁，再把窗帘金属线另画一格；借助场景区分同形词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extremely heavy fall of rain, or a great flood of water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 极猛烈的降雨，或大量水涌来形成的洪水。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xita qawwija ħafna, jew għargħar kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 洪水；倾盆大雨。
强降雨；大雨。
洪水；暴雨；倾盆大雨。

formal.mt: Wara d-dulluvju ta' xita, diversi toroq baqgħu mgħarrqa għal sigħat sħaħ.
formal.en: After the deluge of rain, several roads remained flooded for hours.
formal.zh: 倾盆大雨过后，多条道路积水持续了数小时。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se noħorġu issa? Toni: Stenna ftit! Barra hemm dulluvju ta' xita.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are we going out now? Toni: Wait a little! It's pouring outside.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我们现在出去吗？Toni：等一会儿！外面正下着倾盆大雨。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们现在出去吗？
messages.en: Are we going out now?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Stenna ftit! Barra hemm dulluvju ta' xita.
messages.mt_standard: Stenna ftit! Barra hemm dulluvju ta' xita.
messages.zh: 等一会儿！外面正下着倾盆大雨。
messages.en: Wait a little! It's pouring outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dulluvju 联想成整桶水从天空倒下的画面，记住它描述雨势或水量极大的情景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deep sorrow or suffering, especially emotional pain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 深切的悲伤或痛苦，尤其指情感上的伤痛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tbatija jew niket profond, speċjalment tbatija emozzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 悲伤；悲痛。

sense_translations.en_definition: pain, (chiefly) profound pain, emotional pain, suffering, sorrow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼痛或痛苦，主要指深切的痛苦、情感上的伤痛、苦难或悲痛。

collocations.en: to ease the pain or sorrow

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tagħha, l-awtriċi tesprimi d-dulur li ħasset wara t-telfa ta' ħabib għażiż.
formal.en: In her letter, the author expresses the sorrow she felt after losing a dear friend.
formal.zh: 作者在信中表达了失去挚友后的悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għadni nħoss dulur kbir meta naħseb fih. Maja: Nifhmek. Jekk trid titkellem, jien hawn.
colloquial.en: Nina: I still feel great sorrow when I think of him. Maja: I understand. If you want to talk, I'm here.
colloquial.zh: Nina：想起他时，我仍然感到很悲痛。Maja：我理解。你想聊聊的话，我就在这里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni nħoss dulur kbir meta naħseb fih.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni nħoss dulur kbir meta naħseb fih.
messages.zh: 想起他时，我仍然感到很悲痛。
messages.en: I still feel great sorrow when I think of him.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhmek. Jekk trid titkellem, jien hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhmek. Jekk trid titkellem, jien hawn.
messages.zh: 我理解。你想聊聊的话，我就在这里。
messages.en: I understand. If you want to talk, I'm here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dulur 写在一颗流泪的心旁，优先记住深切悲痛，再联系安慰他人、减轻伤痛的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A turkey: a large bird with a bare head and neck, including the wild turkey.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 火鸡，一种头颈裸露的大型鸟类，也包括野火鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur kbir b'rasu u għonqu mingħajr rix, li jista' jitrabba f'razzett jew jgħix fis-selvaġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 火鸡。
火鸡；野火鸡，均指鸟类。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara fir-razzett, l-istudenti osservaw dundjan u ddeskrivew ir-rix tiegħu.
formal.en: During the farm visit, the students observed a turkey and described its feathers.
formal.zh: 参观农场时，学生们观察了一只火鸡，并描述了它的羽毛。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Dak għasfur kbir x'inhu? Rita: Dak dundjan. Ara kemm għandu rix sabiħ!
colloquial.en: Ben: What's that big bird? Rita: That's a turkey. Look at its beautiful feathers!
colloquial.zh: Ben：那只大鸟是什么？Rita：那是火鸡。看它的羽毛多漂亮！

messages.speaker: Ben (学生)
messages.zh: 那只大鸟是什么？
messages.en: What's that big bird?

messages.speaker: Rita (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak dundjan. Ara kemm għandu rix sabiħ!
messages.mt_standard: Dak dundjan. Ara kemm għandu rix sabiħ!
messages.zh: 那是火鸡。看它的羽毛多漂亮！
messages.en: That's a turkey. Look at its beautiful feathers!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dundjan 与一只展开尾羽的火鸡配对记忆，再加上“野生”和“饲养”两个场景巩固用法。

gloss_zh: 捕鸟人或猎人用的石砌观察小屋

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small hut used by hunters or birdcatchers as a lookout, often built from rubble stone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 猎人或捕鸟人用作观察点的小屋，常以碎石砌成。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għarix, spiss mibni minn ġebel tas-sejjieħ, li jintuża mill-kaċċaturi jew min-nassaba bħala post minn fejn josservaw.

sense_translations.en_definition: a bird trapper's hut built out of rubble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 捕鸟人用碎石砌成的小屋。

sense_translations.en_definition: a hut used by hunters and birdcatchers as a watching place
sense_translations.zh_definition: 猎人和捕鸟人用作观察点的小屋。

formal.mt: Il-kitba tiddeskrivi dura tal-ġebel li kienet tintuża min-nassaba bħala post ta' osservazzjoni.
formal.en: The text describes a stone hut that birdcatchers used as a lookout.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述了一座捕鸟人曾用作观察点的石砌小屋。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għal xiex kien jintuża dak l-għarix żgħir? Ġużi: Dik dura. In-nassaba kienu joqogħdu fiha biex josservaw l-għasafar.
colloquial.en: Anna: What was that little hut used for? Ġużi: That's a birdcatcher's lookout hut. Birdcatchers would stay inside to watch the birds.
colloquial.zh: Anna：那座小屋以前是做什么用的？Ġużi：那是捕鸟人的观察小屋。他们会待在里面观察鸟。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.mt_spoken: Għal xiex kien jintuża dak l-għarix żgħir?
messages.mt_standard: Għal xiex kien jintuża dak l-għarix żgħir?
messages.zh: 那座小屋以前是做什么用的？
messages.en: What was that little hut used for?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (导游)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik dura. In-nassaba kienu joqogħdu fiha biex josservaw l-għasafar.
messages.mt_standard: Dik dura. In-nassaba kienu joqogħdu fiha biex josservaw l-għasafar.
messages.zh: 那是捕鸟人的观察小屋。他们会待在里面观察鸟。
messages.en: That's a birdcatcher's lookout hut. Birdcatchers would stay inside to watch the birds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记 dura 时画一座碎石小屋，并在窗口画一双观察鸟的眼睛，把建筑材料与用途一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spindle: a slender rod that turns, used in spinning thread or as a rotating part of a mechanism.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 纺线时使用的细长旋转杆，或机械装置中的细长转轴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga rqiqa li ddur, u li tintuża biex jinħadem il-ħajt jew bħala parti li ddur f'mekkaniżmu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺锤；锭子；机械中的转轴。
纺锤；锭子；机械中的转轴。

formal.mt: Fid-dimostrazzjoni, l-għalliema wriet kif id-dussies idur waqt li jinħadem il-ħajt.
formal.en: In the demonstration, the teacher showed how the spindle turns while thread is being spun.
formal.zh: 演示时，教师展示了纺线过程中纺锤如何旋转。

colloquial.mt: Mira: X'inhi dik il-biċċa tal-injam? Rosa: Dak dussies. Jintuża biex jinħadem il-ħajt.
colloquial.en: Mira: What's that wooden object? Rosa: That's a spindle. It's used to spin thread.
colloquial.zh: Mira：那个木制物件是什么？Rosa：那是纺锤，用来纺线。

messages.speaker: Mira (学员)
messages.zh: 那个木制物件是什么？
messages.en: What's that wooden object?

messages.speaker: Rosa (手工教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak dussies. Jintuża biex jinħadem il-ħajt.
messages.mt_standard: Dak dussies. Jintuża biex jinħadem il-ħajt.
messages.zh: 那是纺锤，用来纺线。
messages.en: That's a spindle. It's used to spin thread.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dussies 配上一根旋转纺线的细杆；先抓住“细长且旋转”的形象，再联系纺锤与机械转轴。

gloss_zh: 医生；博士；神学权威；强加己见的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A doctor, especially a physician, or a person holding a doctorate, including in law or medicine.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 医生，或拥有博士学位的人，包括法律或医学领域的博士。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tabib, jew persuna li għandha dottorat, fosthom fil-liġi jew fil-mediċina.

sense_translations.en_definition: a doctor (usually of laws or medicine)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 博士，通常指法学或医学博士；也可指医生。
神学权威；在神学领域具有权威地位的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who imposes their views on others
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把自己的观点强加给他人的人。
医生；医师。
博士，即拥有哲学博士、医学博士等博士学位的人。

formal.mt: Id-duttur eżamina lill-pazjent u spjegalu r-riżultati tat-testijiet.
formal.en: The doctor examined the patient and explained the test results to him.
formal.zh: 医生检查了患者，并向他解释了检测结果。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għandi appuntament mad-duttur fl-għaxra. Sara: Mela nitilqu issa biex tasal fil-ħin.
colloquial.en: Mark: I have an appointment with the doctor at ten. Sara: Then let's leave now so you get there on time.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我约了十点看医生。Sara：那我们现在出发吧，好让你准时到。

messages.speaker: Mark (患者)
messages.zh: 我约了十点看医生。
messages.en: I have an appointment with the doctor at ten.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela nitilqu issa biex tasal fil-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Mela nitilqu issa biex tasal fil-ħin.
messages.zh: 那我们现在出发吧，好让你准时到。
messages.en: Then let's leave now so you get there on time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 duttur 画四张场景卡：诊室医生、博士学位、神学权威和强加己见者；阅读时用上下文选择词义。

gloss_zh: 药；疗法；伤口敷药或敷料

teaching_sense.en_definition: Medicine, treatment, or a remedy used to help someone who is ill or wounded.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于帮助病人或伤者的药物、治疗方法或补救办法，也可指伤口使用的敷药或敷料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mediċina, kura jew rimedju biex jgħin lil min hu marid jew midrub.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于治病或使病情好转的疗法。
药；用于治疗疾病或缓解症状的药物。
伤口敷药或敷料；用于覆盖、保护或处理伤口的材料。

sense_translations.en_definition: cure, remedy, help (to someone wounded or ill)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给予伤者或病人的医治、补救办法或救助。

collocations.en: a remedy or dressing for a wound

formal.mt: L-infermier spjega lill-pazjent kif għandu jieħu d-duwa.
formal.en: The nurse explained to the patient how to take the medicine.
formal.zh: 护士向病人说明了应该如何服药。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn qiegħda d-duwa tiegħi? Pawlu: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tazza tal-ilma.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where is my medicine? Pawlu: On the table, next to the glass of water.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：我的药在哪里？保罗：在桌子上，水杯旁边。

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 我的药在哪里？
messages.en: Where is my medicine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 在桌子上，水杯旁边。
messages.en: On the table, next to the glass of water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 duwa 放进“水杯旁边放着药”的画面，连记 tieħu d-duwa“服药”；遇到伤口语境时，再想到敷药或敷料。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The cloud of particles and gases produced when something burns.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 物体燃烧时产生并散入空气中的烟或烟雾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita ta' gassijiet u frak fin li toħroġ meta xi ħaġa tinħaraq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟；燃烧产生的烟雾。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi d-duħħan oħxon li ħareġ mill-bini waqt in-nar.
formal.en: The report describes the thick smoke that came out of the building during the fire.
formal.zh: 报告描述了火灾期间从建筑物中冒出的浓烟。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tara d-duħħan ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Iva, xi ħadd qed ipejjep barra.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you see the smoke near the door? Mark: Yes, someone is smoking outside.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你看到门边的烟了吗？Mark：看到了，有人在外面抽烟。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 你看到门边的烟了吗？
messages.en: Do you see the smoke near the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, xi ħadd qed ipejjep barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, xi ħadd qed ipejjep barra.
messages.zh: 看到了，有人在外面抽烟。
messages.en: Yes, someone is smoking outside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记忆时把 duħħan 配上烟囱冒烟的画面，再用“浓烟”和“香烟烟雾”两个搭配巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lit or bright, or to begin to give off light.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得明亮、受到照明，或开始发出光亮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir imdawwal jew jibda jarmi d-dawl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被照亮；由暗变亮。
变得发亮；开始发出光亮。

formal.mt: Il-kuritur dwal meta nfetaħ il-bieb u daħal id-dawl tax-xemx.
formal.en: The corridor became illuminated when the door opened and sunlight came in.
formal.zh: 门打开、阳光照进来时，走廊亮了起来。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Rajt? Il-kuritur dwal f'daqqa! Mark: Iva, għax xi ħadd fetaħ il-bieb ta' barra.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you see? The corridor suddenly lit up! Mark: Yes, because someone opened the outside door.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看见了吗？走廊突然亮起来了！马克：是啊，因为有人打开了外门。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看见了吗？走廊突然亮起来了！
messages.en: Did you see? The corridor suddenly lit up!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax xi ħadd fetaħ il-bieb ta' barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax xi ħadd fetaħ il-bieb ta' barra.
messages.zh: 是啊，因为有人打开了外门。
messages.en: Yes, because someone opened the outside door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwal 记成一个变化镜头：门一打开，原来昏暗的走廊亮了起来；本条把它当动词，重点记住“变亮”的过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The authority or service that checks goods entering or leaving a country.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 检查进出境货物和行李的海关机构或海关部门。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-awtorità jew is-servizz li jiċċekkja l-merkanzija li tidħol f'pajjiż jew toħroġ minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海关；负责检查进出境货物和行李的机构。

formal.mt: L-uffiċjal tad-dwana talab lill-vjaġġatur jiftaħ il-bagalja għall-kontroll.
formal.en: The customs officer asked the traveller to open the suitcase for inspection.
formal.zh: 海关官员要求旅客打开行李箱接受检查。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaddejt mid-dwana? David: Iva, u issa qed nistenniek ħdejn il-ħruġ.
colloquial.en: Nina: Have you been through customs? David: Yes, and now I am waiting for you near the exit.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你过海关了吗？戴维：过了，现在在出口附近等你。

messages.speaker: Nina (接机的朋友)
messages.zh: 你过海关了吗？
messages.en: Have you been through customs?

messages.speaker: David (旅客)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa qed nistenniek ħdejn il-ħruġ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa qed nistenniek ħdejn il-ħruġ.
messages.zh: 过了，现在在出口附近等你。
messages.en: Yes, and now I am waiting for you near the exit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwana 和机场行李检查口联系起来：带着箱子过海关，遇到 uffiċjal tad-dwana 就想到海关官员。

gloss_zh: 关于；涉及；在……周围；周围环境

teaching_sense.en_definition: About or concerning a subject; also around something in a spatial sense.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示话题或关联，意为“关于、涉及、就……而言”；也可表示空间上的“在……周围”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dwar suġġett jew b'rabta miegħu; jista' jindika wkoll pożizzjoni madwar xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 关于；用于引出谈论或思考的话题。
与……有关；涉及……。
就……；关于……；用于说明内容所涉及的事项。
就……而言；在……方面。
在……周围；环绕……。
周围环境；某处四周的地方或事物。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jipprovdi informazzjoni dwar il-kwalità tal-ilma fir-reġjun.
formal.en: The report provides information about water quality in the region.
formal.zh: 这份报告提供了有关该地区水质的信息。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dwar xiex se nitkellmu llum? Ben: Dwar il-vjaġġ tagħna u fejn se noqogħdu.
colloquial.en: Sara: What are we going to talk about today? Ben: About our trip and where we are going to stay.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们今天要聊什么？本：聊我们的旅行，还有要住在哪里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今天要聊什么？
messages.en: What are we going to talk about today?

messages.speaker: Ben (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dwar il-vjaġġ tagħna u fejn se noqogħdu.
messages.mt_standard: Dwar il-vjaġġ tagħna u fejn se noqogħdu.
messages.zh: 聊我们的旅行，还有要住在哪里。
messages.en: About our trip and where we are going to stay.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwar 想成话题前面的中文标签“关于”：关于课程、关于价格都能套用；另把名词义“周围环境”单独记一格。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An arranged fight between two people, often using weapons.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两个人事先约定进行的搏斗，通常使用武器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġlieda miftiehma bejn żewġ persuni, spiss bl-armi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 决斗；两个人约定进行的搏斗。

collocations.mt: jisfida lil xi ħadd għal dwell
collocations.en: to challenge someone to a duel

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, iż-żewġ rivali jiltaqgħu għal dwell bix-xwabel.
formal.en: In the novel, the two rivals meet for a duel with swords.
formal.zh: 在小说中，两名对手见面进行持剑决斗。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif spiċċa d-dwell fil-film? Leo: Ħadd ma weġġa'; waqfu qabel ma bdiet il-ġlieda.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did the duel in the film end? Leo: Nobody got hurt; they stopped before the fighting began.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：电影里的决斗最后怎么样了？莱奥：没人受伤；还没打起来，他们就停下来了。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 电影里的决斗最后怎么样了？
messages.en: How did the duel in the film end?

messages.speaker: Leo (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħadd ma weġġa'; waqfu qabel ma bdiet il-ġlieda.
messages.mt_standard: Ħadd ma weġġa'; waqfu qabel ma bdiet il-ġlieda.
messages.zh: 没人受伤；还没打起来，他们就停下来了。
messages.en: Nobody got hurt; they stopped before the fighting began.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwell 配上“两人持剑相对”的电影画面来记；它是马耳他语名词“决斗”，学习时不要套用同形英语词的意思。

gloss_zh: 二重唱；二重奏；二人合演曲

teaching_sense.en_definition: A musical piece or performance for two singers or instrumentalists.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由两名歌手或乐器演奏者共同表演的乐曲或演出。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa mużika jew eżekuzzjoni għal żewġ kantanti jew żewġ strumentisti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二重唱或二重奏；由两人共同演唱或演奏的乐曲。

collocations.en: a duet for violin and piano

collocations.zh: 最后一首二重唱或二重奏

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-kunċert jinkludi dwett għall-vjolin u l-pjanu.
formal.en: The concert programme includes a duet for violin and piano.
formal.zh: 音乐会节目中包括一首小提琴与钢琴二重奏。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid inkantaw dwett flimkien? Toni: Iva! Int tibda, u jien nidħol warajk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we sing a duet together? Toni: Yes! You start, and I will come in after you.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们一起唱首二重唱好吗？托尼：好啊！你先开始，我随后接进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (合唱团伙伴)
messages.zh: 我们一起唱首二重唱好吗？
messages.en: Shall we sing a duet together?

messages.speaker: Toni (合唱团伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva! Int tibda, u jien nidħol warajk.
messages.mt_standard: Iva! Int tibda, u jien nidħol warajk.
messages.zh: 好啊！你先开始，我随后接进来。
messages.en: Yes! You start, and I will come in after you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwett 配上“两个人同台唱歌”的画面，并与 dwell 的决斗画面对照：字尾不同，一个合演，一个交锋。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The length of time that something lasts; also time without an end.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事物持续的时间或时长；也可指没有终点的时间，即永恒。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tul taż-żmien li ddum xi ħaġa; ukoll żmien bla tmiem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 持续时间；某个过程、事件或状态延续的时长。
永恒；没有尽头的时间。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jindika li d-dwiem tal-proġett huwa ta' sitt xhur.
formal.en: The report indicates that the duration of the project is six months.
formal.zh: 报告指出，该项目的持续时间为六个月。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Xi tfisser il-kelma dwiem hawn? Sam: It-tul taż-żmien li ddum il-laqgħa; hawn qed jgħidu siegħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: What does the word dwiem mean here? Sam: The length of time the meeting lasts; here they say one hour.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：这里的 dwiem 是什么意思？萨姆：会议持续的时间；这里写的是一小时。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 这里的 dwiem 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does the word dwiem mean here?

messages.speaker: Sam (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: It-tul taż-żmien li ddum il-laqgħa; hawn qed jgħidu siegħa.
messages.mt_standard: It-tul taż-żmien li ddum il-laqgħa; hawn qed jgħidu siegħa.
messages.zh: 会议持续的时间；这里写的是一小时。
messages.en: The length of time the meeting lasts; here they say one hour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 dwiem 想成一条时间线：有起点和终点时记“持续时间”，把终点向外无限延长时记“永恒”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of entering or admission to a place; also money received or the beginning of a period.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进入某处的行为或入场资格；也表示所得收入，或某一时期的开始。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tidħol jew il-permess li tidħol f'post; ukoll il-flus li wieħed jirċievi jew il-bidu ta' perjodu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 进入；入场；进入某处的行为或机会。
进入；获准进入某处。
收入；个人或机构所得的钱款。
开始；某段时间或某个阶段的开端。

formal.mt: Id-dħul għall-wirja huwa b'xejn, iżda l-viżitaturi għandhom jirreġistraw minn qabel.
formal.en: Admission to the exhibition is free, but visitors must register in advance.
formal.zh: 展览免费入场，但参观者须提前登记。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Id-dħul għall-mużew illum b'xejn? Mark: Iva, iżda rridu nirreġistraw hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is admission to the museum free today? Mark: Yes, but we need to register here.
colloquial.zh: Maja：博物馆今天免费入场吗？Mark：是的，不过我们得在这里登记。

messages.speaker: Maja（游客）
messages.zh: 博物馆今天免费入场吗？
