sense_translations.zh_definition: 溢出；因过满而流出。
广泛扩散；向大范围蔓延。
产生蒸汽；冒蒸汽。
大鼠，一种啮齿动物。
弹弓的 Y 字形叉架。

collocations.en: the water overflowed from the pot

formal.mt: L-ilma far mit-tank u għarraq parti mill-art tal-maħżen.
formal.en: The water overflowed from the tank and flooded part of the storeroom floor.
formal.zh: 水从水箱中溢出，淹湿了储藏室的部分地面。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex hemm l-ilma fuq il-fuklar? Mark: L-ilma far mill-borma. Se nimsaħ kollox issa.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why is there water on the cooker? Mark: The water overflowed from the pot. I'll wipe everything up now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：炉灶上怎么有水？Mark：水从锅里溢出来了。我现在就擦干净。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 炉灶上怎么有水？
messages.en: Why is there water on the cooker?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-ilma far mill-borma. Se nimsaħ kollox issa.
messages.mt_standard: L-ilma far mill-borma. Se nimsaħ kollox issa.
messages.zh: 水从锅里溢出来了。我现在就擦干净。
messages.en: The water overflowed from the pot. I'll wipe everything up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 far 分设三张图卡：溢水或蒸汽表示动词，大鼠和弹弓叉架分别表示两个名词义；不要硬编它们的词源关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To help someone feel less sad or distressed by offering kindness, reassurance, or support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过关怀、宽慰或支持，使悲伤或苦恼的人好受一些。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħin lil xi ħadd iħossu inqas imdejjaq permezz ta' kliem ta' ġid, għajnuna jew appoġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；宽慰悲伤或苦恼的人。
慰藉；在悲伤中获得的精神安慰。
安慰；使人安心或减轻痛苦的慰抚。
救助；在困境中给予的援助和支持。

sense_translations.en_definition: relief, disburdenment; joy that dispels sorrow; comfort, solace
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宽慰、释重负；驱散悲伤的喜悦；安慰、慰藉。

formal.mt: L-għalliem faraġ lill-istudent wara li sema' għaliex kien imdejjaq.
formal.en: The teacher consoled the student after hearing why he was upset.
formal.zh: 老师听完学生难过的原因后，安慰了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum għadni mdejqa. Mark: Trid nitkellmu ftit? Forsi ssib ftit faraġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm still feeling sad today. Mark: Would you like to talk for a bit? Perhaps you'll find some comfort.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我今天还是很难过。马克：想聊一会儿吗？也许你能得到一些安慰。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天还是很难过。
messages.en: I'm still feeling sad today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid nitkellmu ftit? Forsi ssib ftit faraġ.
messages.mt_standard: Trid nitkellmu ftit? Forsi ssib ftit faraġ.
messages.zh: 想聊一会儿吗？也许你能得到一些安慰。
messages.en: Would you like to talk for a bit? Perhaps you'll find some comfort.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词记成伤心时有人递来的一句暖心话：动词是安慰，名词是得到的慰藉。

gloss_zh: 奇数的；不能被二整除的；单个的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Describing a whole number that cannot be divided by two without a remainder, or an item without its matching partner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容整数不能被二整除，即奇数的；也可形容单独一个、没有配对的物品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiddeskrivi numru sħiħ li ma jinqasamx bi tnejn mingħajr bqija, jew oġġett wieħed mingħajr sieħbu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奇数的；数量不能两两分尽的。
不能被二整除的。
单个的；单独一个或没有配对的。
奇数的，非偶数的。

formal.mt: In-numru ħamsa huwa fard għax ma jistax jinqasam bi tnejn mingħajr bqija.
formal.en: The number five is odd because it cannot be divided by two without a remainder.
formal.zh: 五是奇数，因为它不能被二整除。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna seba' platti. Mark: Dak għadd fard; żid platt ieħor biex ikunu tmienja.
colloquial.en: Maja: We have seven plates. Mark: That's an odd number; add another plate to make eight.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们有七个盘子。马克：这是奇数；再加一个盘子，凑成八个。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们有七个盘子。
messages.en: We have seven plates.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak għadd fard; żid platt ieħor biex ikunu tmienja.
messages.mt_standard: Dak għadd fard; żid platt ieħor biex ikunu tmienja.
messages.zh: 这是奇数；再加一个盘子，凑成八个。
messages.en: That's an odd number; add another plate to make eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象物品两两站队后剩下一个：总数是奇数，剩下的物品则是单个未配对。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A garment worn over the front of the body to protect clothes while cooking, cleaning, or working.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做饭、清洁或工作时穿在身体前面，用来保护衣服的围裙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes fuq quddiem tal-ġisem biex jipproteġi l-ħwejjeġ waqt it-tisjir, it-tindif jew ix-xogħol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 围裙；罩在衣服前面以防弄脏的衣物。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jilbes fardal nadif waqt il-lezzjoni tat-tisjir.
formal.en: Every student should wear a clean apron during the cooking lesson.
formal.zh: 每位学生在烹饪课上都应穿干净的围裙。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-fardal tiegħi? Se nagħmel il-kejk. Mark: Fuq is-siġġu ħdejn il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's my apron? I'm going to make the cake. Mark: On the chair next to the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的围裙在哪里？我要做蛋糕。马克：在桌子旁边的椅子上。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-fardal tiegħi? Se nagħmel il-kejk.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-fardal tiegħi? Se nagħmel il-kejk.
messages.zh: 我的围裙在哪里？我要做蛋糕。
messages.en: Where's my apron? I'm going to make the cake.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在桌子旁边的椅子上。
messages.en: On the chair next to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和下厨前系围裙的动作绑定，想象围裙挡住面粉、保护衣服的画面。

gloss_zh: 掸尘；拂去；拍动；击打；逃避职责

teaching_sense.en_definition: To remove dust or loose particles by brushing or shaking; also to flap, strike, or avoid a duty, depending on context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过掸、刷或抖动去除灰尘等附着物；依语境也可指拍动、击打或逃避职责。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tneħħi t-trab jew frak billi tfarfar jew tħawwad xi ħaġa; skont il-kuntest, jista' jfisser ukoll tħabbat il-ġwienaħ, tolqot jew tevita dmir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 掸去灰尘；为物品除尘。
刷掉；拂去附着在表面的东西。

sense_translations.en_definition: to brush off, to swipe away
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拂掉、扫去；用刷动或挥动的动作移除。

sense_translations.en_definition: to flap (wings, tail, etc.) (to move (something broad and loose) up and down)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拍动或摆动翅膀、尾巴等；使宽而松动的部位上下运动。
打；击打；拍击。

sense_translations.en_definition: to shirk, to avoid a duty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逃避职责；推脱应尽的责任。

collocations.en: brush the dust off the coat

formal.mt: Qabel ma tibda tnaddaf l-art, farfar l-għamara b'ċarruta niexfa.
formal.en: Before you start cleaning the floor, dust the furniture with a dry cloth.
formal.zh: 开始清洁地面之前，先用干布掸去家具上的灰尘。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi t-trab fuq il-kowt. Mark: Farfar il-kowt barra qabel tidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: I've got dust on my coat. Mark: Brush the coat off outside before you come in.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我的外套上有灰。马克：进来之前，先在外面把外套掸一掸。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我的外套上有灰。
messages.en: I've got dust on my coat.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 进来之前，先在外面把外套掸一掸。
messages.en: Brush the coat off outside before you come in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记掸外套的手势，再分别联想翅膀拍动、击打和推脱职责；这是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An insect with two pairs of broad wings, often brightly coloured, commonly seen flying around flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种有两对宽阔翅膀、常呈鲜艳颜色，常见于花间飞舞的昆虫，即蝴蝶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Insett b'żewġ pari ġwienaħ wesgħin, spiss ikkuluriti, li ta' spiss narawh itir madwar il-fjuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝴蝶；具有两对宽阔翅膀的昆虫。

formal.mt: L-istudenti osservaw farfett fuq fjura u ddeskrivew il-kuluri tal-ġwienaħ tiegħu.
formal.en: The students observed a butterfly on a flower and described the colours of its wings.
formal.zh: 学生们观察了一只停在花上的蝴蝶，并描述了它翅膀的颜色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dak il-farfett fuq il-fjura! Mark: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja narawh minn hawn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that butterfly on the flower! Mark: It's so beautiful! Let's watch it from here.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看花上那只蝴蝶！马克：真漂亮！我们就在这里看它吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看花上那只蝴蝶！
messages.en: Look at that butterfly on the flower!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu sabiħ! Ejja narawh minn hawn.
messages.zh: 真漂亮！我们就在这里看它吧。
messages.en: It's so beautiful! Let's watch it from here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读这个词时想象一只彩色蝴蝶轻轻拍翅、落在花上，把发音与完整画面一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bat, a mammal that flies and is active at night; in another sense, the expression can refer to a moth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指蝙蝠，即能够飞行、夜间活动的哺乳动物；另一个义项指蛾，须依语境区分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Mammiferu li jtir u jkun attiv billejl; f'tifsira oħra, l-espressjoni tista' tirreferi għal insett simili għal farfett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蝙蝠；能够飞行的哺乳动物。
蛾；一种与蝴蝶相似的昆虫，与蝙蝠这一义项不同。
蝙蝠，指哺乳动物。

formal.mt: F'dan ir-rapport, l-isem farfett il-lejl jirreferi għal mammiferu li jtir, mhux għal insett.
formal.en: In this report, the name farfett il-lejl refers to a flying mammal, not an insect.
formal.zh: 在这份报告中，farfett il-lejl 指的是能够飞行的哺乳动物，即蝙蝠，而非昆虫。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak il-farfett il-lejl ħdejn il-lampa huwa insett? Mark: Iva, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar insett, mhux mammiferu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that farfett il-lejl beside the lamp an insect? Mark: Yes, here we're talking about a moth, an insect, rather than a mammal.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：灯旁那个叫 farfett il-lejl 的是昆虫吗？马克：对，这里说的是蛾，是昆虫，不是哺乳动物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-farfett il-lejl ħdejn il-lampa huwa insett?
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-farfett il-lejl ħdejn il-lampa huwa insett?
messages.zh: 灯旁那个叫 farfett il-lejl 的是昆虫吗？
messages.en: Is that farfett il-lejl beside the lamp an insect?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar insett, mhux mammiferu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hawn qed nitkellmu dwar insett, mhux mammiferu.
messages.zh: 对，这里说的是蛾，是昆虫，不是哺乳动物。
messages.en: Yes, here we're talking about a moth, an insect, rather than a mammal.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张夜间飞行动物记忆卡：蝙蝠归哺乳动物，蛾归昆虫；遇到这个词先看语境再选卡。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ruler of ancient Egypt, known by the title pharaoh.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 古埃及统治者的称号，中文称为法老，也可指具有这一称号的统治者。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakkiem tal-Eġittu tal-qedem li kellu t-titlu ta' fargħun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法老；古埃及统治者的称号，亦指该统治者。

formal.mt: Il-ktieb jispjega r-rwol tal-fargħun fl-Eġittu tal-qedem.
formal.en: The book explains the role of the pharaoh in ancient Egypt.
formal.zh: 这本书介绍了法老在古埃及的角色。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dan fl-istampa? Mark: Huwa fargħun, ħakkiem tal-Eġittu tal-qedem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who is this in the picture? Mark: He's a pharaoh, a ruler of ancient Egypt.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：图片里的这个人是谁？马克：他是一位法老，也就是古埃及的统治者。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 图片里的这个人是谁？
messages.en: Who is this in the picture?

messages.speaker: Mark (老师)
messages.zh: 他是一位法老，也就是古埃及的统治者。
messages.en: He's a pharaoh, a ruler of ancient Egypt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词写在古埃及统治者的图片旁，固定联想为法老这个称号，不泛指所有国王。

gloss_zh: 分开；分组；拆散一对；奇数的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate things that are together, divide a collection, or split the two members of a pair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把原本放在一起的东西分开，将一批物品分组，或把成对的两个成员拆开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifred affarijiet li jkunu flimkien, taqsam ġabra fi gruppi, jew tifred iż-żewġ elementi ta' par.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分开；使原本在一起的人或物彼此分离。
把一批或一组东西分开、分组。

sense_translations.en_definition: to separate elements of a pair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把一对中的两个成员分开。
非偶数的；奇数的。
不能被二整除的。
拆散一对；使成对的两个成员分离。
数量或编号为奇数的。

formal.mt: L-għalliem farrad il-karti f'żewġ gruppi skont il-kulur.
formal.en: The teacher divided the cards into two groups according to colour.
formal.zh: 老师按照颜色把卡片分成了两组。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi nżomm dawn iż-żewġ kalzetti flimkien? Mark: Iva, tfarradx il-par.
colloquial.en: Maja: Should I keep these two socks together? Mark: Yes, don't split up the pair.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这两只袜子应该放在一起吗？马克：对，别把这一对拆开。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi nżomm dawn iż-żewġ kalzetti flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Għandi nżomm dawn iż-żewġ kalzetti flimkien?
messages.zh: 这两只袜子应该放在一起吗？
messages.en: Should I keep these two socks together?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 对，别把这一对拆开。
messages.en: Yes, don't split up the pair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两栏卡片记忆：动词栏画双手把一对物品分开，形容词栏写一三五，分别提示分离和奇数。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To break or crush something into pieces, often with force; also to leave someone extremely tired.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力把东西打碎或压碎；也可指使人筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikisser xi ħaġa f'biċċiet, spiss bil-forza; jista' jfisser ukoll li jgħejja ħafna lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 猛力打碎；砸碎。
弄破；弄断；打碎。
压碎；碾碎。
使某人筋疲力尽。
咒骂；诅咒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak in a manner that is difficult to understand (may be derogatory; often used for dialectal speech)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以让人难以听懂的方式说话，常用于描述方言言语，可能带贬义。
打破或弄坏东西的人；破坏者。
使粉碎；压碎。
毁坏；撞毁。

collocations.zh: 工作使工人们筋疲力尽

formal.mt: Ir-riħ qawwi waqqa' l-vażun minn fuq il-mejda u farrak il-ħġieġ.
formal.en: The strong wind knocked the vase off the table and shattered the glass.
formal.zh: 强风把花瓶从桌上吹落，摔碎了玻璃。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min farrak il-gallettini kollha? Ben: Jien! Se nużahom għall-kejk.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who crushed all the biscuits? Ben: I did! I'm going to use them for the cake.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁把饼干全弄碎了？本：我呀！我要用它们做蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把饼干全弄碎了？
messages.en: Who crushed all the biscuits?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 我呀！我要用它们做蛋糕。
messages.en: I did! I'm going to use them for the cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“整块饼干变成碎屑”记住 farrak 的打碎、压碎义；再联想到累得全身像散了架，记住使人疲惫义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comfort someone who is sad or distressed and offer support during a difficult time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安慰悲伤或苦恼的人，并在困难时期给予关怀和支持。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħti faraġ, kura u appoġġ lil xi ħadd li jkun imnikket jew għaddej minn żmien diffiċli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰；慰藉。

sense_translations.en_definition: to support in times of trouble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在遭遇困难时给予支持。
给予安慰的人；慰藉者。

sense_translations.en_definition: to care for someone in sorrow, illness, misery; to be there for; to comfort
sense_translations.zh_definition: 关怀处于悲痛、疾病或困苦中的人；陪伴支持；安慰。

formal.mt: Wara l-aħbar diqa, l-għalliem farraġ lill-istudent u semgħu bil-paċenzja.
formal.en: After the sad news, the teacher comforted the student and listened to him patiently.
formal.zh: 得知令人难过的消息后，老师安慰了那名学生，并耐心听他倾诉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min farraġ lil Sara wara li tilfet il-kelb tagħha? Mark: Oħtha. Qagħdet magħha u semgħetha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who comforted Sara after she lost her dog? Mark: Her sister. She stayed with her and listened to her.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：萨拉失去爱犬后，是谁安慰她的？马克：她姐姐。她陪着萨拉，听她倾诉。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min farraġ lil Sara wara li tilfet il-kelb tagħha?
messages.mt_standard: Min farraġ lil Sara wara li tilfet il-kelb tagħha?
messages.zh: 萨拉失去爱犬后，是谁安慰她的？
messages.en: Who comforted Sara after she lost her dog?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 她姐姐。她陪着萨拉，听她倾诉。
messages.en: Her sister. She stayed with her and listened to her.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 farraġ 和“朋友难过时坐在身旁倾听”的画面连起来，记住它强调给予安慰和支持。

gloss_zh: 放出液体；排空；使流血；使苦恼或愤怒

teaching_sense.en_definition: To draw off or release liquid from something, such as a tree or a tank.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使树木、储液罐等内部的液体流出；放出或排出液体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ jew iħalli joħroġ likwidu minn xi ħaġa, bħal siġra jew tank.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给树木开口，使树液流出。
激怒某人；使某人大怒。
排空储液罐或水箱。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make bleed, e.g. by bloodletting
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使流血，例如通过放血使血液流出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make trickle, e.g. liquid from a tree or tank
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使液体缓缓流出，例如使树液或罐内液体涓涓流出。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause someone distress or anger
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人苦恼或愤怒。

collocations.en: tap a tree to release its sap

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fasad it-tank qabel ma beda x-xogħol tat-tindif.
formal.en: The worker drained the tank before starting the cleaning work.
formal.zh: 工人在开始清洁工作前排空了储液罐。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex it-tank vojt? Toni: Il-plamer fasad it-tank dalgħodu biex inaddfu.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the tank empty? Toni: The plumber drained it this morning to clean it.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：水箱为什么空了？托尼：水管工今天早上把水放空了，好清洗水箱。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 水箱为什么空了？
messages.en: Why is the tank empty?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-plamer fasad it-tank dalgħodu biex inaddfu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-plamer fasad it-tank dalgħodu biex inaddfu.
messages.zh: 水管工今天早上把水放空了，好清洗水箱。
messages.en: The plumber drained the tank this morning to clean it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fasad 配上“罐中液体慢慢流出”的画面；遇到人物情绪语境时，再切换到使人苦恼或生气的义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To design something or draw up a plan that sets out its form, details, or intended actions.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设计事物的形式和细节，或拟订说明行动安排的计划。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel disinn jew pjan li juri l-għamla, id-dettalji jew il-passi ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 设计。

sense_translations.en_definition: to draw up a blueprint for sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为某事物绘制蓝图或拟订详细方案。
规划某事；为某事作计划。
设计师；设计者。
裁缝；量体裁衣的人。
女装裁缝；女装制作者。
设计；塑造。
计划；筹划。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat fassal pjan ta' ħidma b'għanijiet ċari u dati għat-tlestija.
formal.en: The committee drew up a work plan with clear objectives and completion dates.
formal.zh: 委员会拟订了一份工作计划，列明了清晰的目标和完成日期。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min fassal din il-libsa? Rita: Oħti. Għamlet id-disinn apposta għalija.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who designed this dress? Rita: My sister. She made the design especially for me.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这条连衣裙是谁设计的？丽塔：我姐姐。她专门为我设计的。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这条连衣裙是谁设计的？
messages.en: Who designed this dress?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我姐姐。她专门为我设计的。
messages.en: My sister. She made the design especially for me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象先在纸上画出衣服，再列出制作步骤：用这两个画面把 fassal 的“设计”和“规划”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wean a child or young animal off milk; also to help someone give up a habit or dependence.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使婴幼儿或幼小动物断奶；也可指帮助某人戒除习惯或摆脱依赖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iwaqqaf it-treddigħ ta' tarbija jew annimal żgħir; jista' jfisser ukoll li jgħin lil xi ħadd jaqta' vizzju jew dipendenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使断奶。
分开；分割。

sense_translations.en_definition: to help overcome a bad habit
sense_translations.zh_definition: 帮助戒除坏习惯。
使断奶，即停止给幼儿或幼小动物喂奶。
使逐步戒除；使摆脱对某物的依赖。

formal.mt: Ir-raħħal fatam il-ħaruf u kompla jieħu ħsiebu mal-bqija tal-merħla.
formal.en: The farmer weaned the lamb and continued caring for it with the rest of the flock.
formal.zh: 农场主给羔羊断了奶，之后继续把它与其余羊群一起照料。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ir-raħħal fatam il-ħaruf diġà? Pawlu: Iva, issa jiekol waħdu mal-bqija tal-merħla.
colloquial.en: Lina: Has the farmer weaned the lamb already? Pawlu: Yes, it now eats on its own with the rest of the flock.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：农场主已经给那只羔羊断奶了吗？保罗：是的，它现在和其他羊一起自己吃东西。

messages.speaker: Lina (农场访客)
messages.zh: 农场主已经给那只羔羊断奶了吗？
messages.en: Has the farmer weaned the lamb already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农场工人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa jiekol waħdu mal-bqija tal-merħla.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa jiekol waħdu mal-bqija tal-merħla.
messages.zh: 是的，它现在和其他羊一起自己吃东西。
messages.en: Yes, it now eats on its own with the rest of the flock.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“小羊从吃奶转向独立进食”的画面记 fatam；再把停止依赖的概念联系到戒除习惯这一义项。

gloss_zh: 吃早餐；吃午餐；开斋；流露感情

teaching_sense.en_definition: To eat breakfast or lunch, or to end a fast by eating.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吃早餐或午餐；也可指进食以结束禁食，即开斋。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiekol il-kolazzjon jew l-ikla ta' nofsinhar, jew itemm is-sawm billi jiekol.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃早餐。
吃午餐。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have lunch, to eat lunch
sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃午饭；用午餐。
结束禁食而进食；开斋。
无意中显露或泄露感情。

collocations.en: have a meal with the family

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fatar f'nofsinhar qabel ma kompla x-xogħol tiegħu.
formal.en: The worker had lunch at noon before continuing his work.
formal.zh: 那名工人在中午吃了午饭，然后继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Fejn fatar Mark illum? Ġanni: Fatar id-dar ma' oħtu.
colloquial.en: Marija: Where did Mark have lunch today? Ġanni: He had lunch at home with his sister.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：马克今天在哪里吃的午饭？詹尼：他在家和姐姐一起吃的。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: 马克今天在哪里吃的午饭？
messages.en: Where did Mark have lunch today?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (同事)
messages.zh: 他在家和姐姐一起吃的。
messages.en: He had lunch at home with his sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fatar 放在餐桌画面里，借时间词辨认早餐、午餐或开斋；若宾语涉及感情，则记作无意流露。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A ghost or spectre: the spirit of a dead person as imagined in stories or beliefs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鬼魂或幽灵，即故事或信仰中被想象为死者灵魂的存在。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spirtu ta' persuna mejta li, skont stejjer jew twemmin, jidher lill-ħajjin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 幽灵；鬼影。
鬼；幽灵，语气较口语化。
鬼魂；亡灵。
鬼魂；幽灵。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, fatat jidher fil-kastell kull lejl u jbeżża' lill-viżitaturi.
formal.en: In the story, a ghost appears in the castle every night and frightens the visitors.
formal.zh: 在故事中，一个幽灵每晚都会出现在城堡里，吓唬来访者。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Rajt fatat fit-tieqa! Sam: Dak kien il-purtier jiċċaqlaq mar-riħ!
colloquial.en: Ella: I saw a ghost in the window! Sam: That was the curtain moving in the wind!
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：我看见窗户里有个鬼影！萨姆：那是窗帘被风吹动了！

messages.speaker: Ella (朋友)
messages.zh: 我看见窗户里有个鬼影！
messages.en: I saw a ghost in the window!

messages.speaker: Sam (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是窗帘被风吹动了！
messages.en: That was the curtain moving in the wind!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fatat 配一幅“夜晚城堡窗边浮现鬼影”的故事插图，看到这个名词就回想幽灵的形象。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bush or dwarf bean of the species Phaseolus vulgaris; in another sense, the name refers to chickling vetch, Lathyrus sativus.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指普通菜豆中的矮生类型；另一个义项指山黧豆，两者是不同植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip baxx ta' fażola tal-ispeċi Phaseolus vulgaris; f'tifsira oħra, l-isem jirreferi għall-pjanta Lathyrus sativus.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 矮生菜豆。
矮生菜豆，即普通菜豆（Phaseolus vulgaris）的矮生类型。
山黧豆（Lathyrus sativus），与普通菜豆不同的植物。

formal.mt: F'din il-lezzjoni, il-kelma favetta tirreferi għat-tip baxx ta' fażola tal-ispeċi Phaseolus vulgaris.
formal.en: In this lesson, the word favetta refers to the dwarf type of bean belonging to the species Phaseolus vulgaris.
formal.zh: 在本课中，favetta 一词指普通菜豆（Phaseolus vulgaris）的矮生类型。

colloquial.mt: Marta: X'se nkabbru f'din ir-rokna tal-ġnien? Luqa: Il-favetta. Għandi ż-żerriegħa lesta.
colloquial.en: Marta: What shall we grow in this corner of the garden? Luqa: Bush beans. I have the seeds ready.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：花园这个角落我们种什么？卢卡：矮生菜豆。我已经准备好种子了。

messages.speaker: Marta (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 花园这个角落我们种什么？
messages.en: What shall we grow in this corner of the garden?

messages.speaker: Luqa (园艺伙伴)
messages.zh: 矮生菜豆。我已经准备好种子了。
messages.en: Bush beans. I have the seeds ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 favetta 制作两张植物卡：一张写矮生菜豆及 Phaseolus vulgaris，另一张写山黧豆及 Lathyrus sativus，借学名分清义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To fill a container so completely that its contents overflow, or to make a liquid boil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把容器灌得满到溢出，或使液体沸腾。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Timla reċipjent tant li l-likwidu joħroġ minn fuq, jew iġġiegħel likwidu jagħli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌满至溢出。
使沸腾；煮沸。

sense_translations.en_definition: to rise to the surface and produce air bubbles (used of fish)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （鱼）浮到水面并吐出气泡。
使液体溢出的行为或过程。
使产生蒸汽的行为或过程。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fill to the brim; to cause to overflow
sense_translations.zh_definition: 灌满至容器边缘；使溢出。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fawwar it-tank, u l-ilma beda joħroġ minn fuq.
formal.en: The worker filled the tank to overflowing, and water began spilling over the top.
formal.zh: 工人把水箱灌得过满，水开始从顶部溢出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min fawwar it-tazza? Mark: Jien. Se nimsaħ il-mejda issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who filled the cup to overflowing? Mark: I did. I'll wipe the table now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把杯子倒得溢出来了？Mark：我。我现在就擦桌子。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把杯子倒得溢出来了？
messages.en: Who filled the cup to overflowing?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我。我现在就擦桌子。
messages.en: I did. I'll wipe the table now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用杯中液体越过杯沿的画面记住 fawwar 的满溢义，再另记煮沸义；这是记忆画面，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A spring where water emerges from the ground, or a fountain from which water flows.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地下水自然涌出的泉，或有水流出的喷泉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għajn minn fejn joħroġ l-ilma mill-art, jew fontana minn fejn joħroġ l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 泉；地下水自然涌出的地方。
泉；喷泉。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi fawwara naturali ħdejn il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The map shows a natural spring beside the path.
formal.zh: 地图标出小径旁有一处天然泉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tisma' l-ilma? Pawlu: Iva, hemm fawwara wara dawk is-siġar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Can you hear the water? Pawlu: Yes, there's a spring behind those trees.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你听到水声了吗？Pawlu：听到了，那些树后面有一处泉。

messages.speaker: Lara (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 你听到水声了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear the water?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm fawwara wara dawk is-siġar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm fawwara wara dawk is-siġar.
messages.zh: 听到了，那些树后面有一处泉。
messages.en: Yes, there's a spring behind those trees.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fawwara 放进林间泉眼的画面：听见水声，再看见水从地下涌出，用场景记住泉的意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bunch or bundle of things, such as garlic or spring onions; also a streak, stripe, or beam.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一束或一捆东西，如大蒜或青葱；也可指条痕、条纹或光束。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' affarijiet miġbura flimkien, bħat-tewm jew il-basal aħdar; ukoll strixxa jew raġġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: sheaf (of vegetables such as garlic or spring onion)
sense_translations.zh_definition: （大蒜、青葱等蔬菜的）一束；一捆。
条痕；一道细长的痕迹。
条纹。
条纹；条痕；光束。
枯木；枯死的木质部分。
束；捆。
大量；一大批。

formal.mt: Faxx dawl daħal mit-tieqa u dawwal il-mejda.
formal.en: A beam of light entered through the window and lit up the table.
formal.zh: 一道光束从窗户射入，照亮了桌子。

colloquial.mt: Anna: X'għandna nixtru mis-suq? Ġanni: Faxx tewm u ftit tadam.
colloquial.en: Anna: What do we need to buy at the market? Ġanni: A bunch of garlic and some tomatoes.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我们要去市场买什么？Ġanni：一束大蒜和一些番茄。

messages.speaker: Anna (家人)
messages.zh: 我们要去市场买什么？
messages.en: What do we need to buy at the market?

messages.speaker: Ġanni (家人)
messages.zh: 一束大蒜和一些番茄。
messages.en: A bunch of garlic and some tomatoes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张卡片分别记 faxx tewm 的一束大蒜和 faxx dawl 的一道光束；其他义项另列，避免混成一个意思。

gloss_zh: 绷带；条带；绶带；墙面水平饰带

teaching_sense.en_definition: A bandage used to wrap an injured part of the body; also a strip or sash.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 包扎受伤部位的绷带；也可指条带或绶带。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Strixxa ta' drapp li tintuża biex titgeżwer parti midruba tal-ġisem; ukoll strixxa jew żigarella li tintlibes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绷带；包扎带。
条带；长条形的一片。
绶带；佩带在肩上或腰间的宽带。
（建筑）墙面上横向延伸、略微凸出的水平饰带。

formal.mt: L-infermiera poġġiet faxxa nadifa mal-ferita.
formal.en: The nurse placed a clean bandage over the wound.
formal.zh: 护士用干净的绷带包扎了伤口。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hi l-faxxa? Sara: Fil-kaxxa ż-żgħira, ħdejn il-qoton.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the bandage? Sara: In the small box, next to the cotton wool.
colloquial.zh: Mark：绷带在哪里？Sara：在小盒子里，棉花旁边。

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 绷带在哪里？
messages.en: Where's the bandage?

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 在小盒子里，棉花旁边。
messages.en: In the small box, next to the cotton wool.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faxxa 配上绕住手臂的绷带图，再配上肩上的绶带图，用长条带状的视觉特征辅助区分各义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With little difficulty or effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 做某事时困难很少或不需要费多少力气；容易地、轻松地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bi ftit diffikultà jew mingħajr ħafna sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易地；轻易地；不费力地。

formal.mt: L-istruzzjonijiet huma ċari sabiex il-qarrej ikun jista' jifhem il-proċess faċilment.
formal.en: The instructions are clear so that the reader can understand the process easily.
formal.zh: 说明写得清楚，使读者能够轻松理解整个过程。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Sibt id-dar faċilment? David: Iva, in-numru jidher sew mit-triq.
colloquial.en: Marta: Did you find the house easily? David: Yes, the number is clearly visible from the street.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你很容易就找到这所房子了吗？戴维：是的，从街上就能清楚看到门牌号。

messages.speaker: Marta (主人)
messages.zh: 你很容易就找到这所房子了吗？
messages.en: Did you find the house easily?

messages.speaker: David (访客)
messages.zh: 是的，从街上就能清楚看到门牌号。
messages.en: Yes, the number is clearly visible from the street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象顺着清楚的门牌一下就找到朋友家，把整个“不费劲就做到”的动作配上 faċilment，记住它修饰做事的方式。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easy to do or understand, requiring little effort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 容易做或理解的，不需要花很多力气的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tista' tagħmlu jew tifhmu mingħajr ħafna sforz.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易的；轻松的。
不难的；没有多大困难的。
很可能；有较大可能。

formal.mt: It-test huwa faċli biex tifhmu għax juża kliem sempliċi u eżempji ċari.
formal.en: The text is easy to understand because it uses simple words and clear examples.
formal.zh: 这篇文章容易理解，因为它使用简单的词语和清楚的例子。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan l-eżerċizzju faċli? Mark: Iva, faċli ħafna. Trid biss tqabbel il-kliem mal-istampi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this exercise easy? Mark: Yes, very easy. You just need to match the words to the pictures.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这道练习简单吗？马克：是的，很简单。你只需要把词语和图片配起来。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 这道练习简单吗？
messages.en: Is this exercise easy?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, faċli ħafna. Trid biss tqabbel il-kliem mal-istampi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, faċli ħafna. Trid biss tqabbel il-kliem mal-istampi.
messages.zh: 是的，很简单。你只需要把词语和图片配起来。
messages.en: Yes, very easy. You just need to match the words to the pictures.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faċli 贴在一张轻松完成的练习旁，记住“容易”；再用 faċli li jiġri 提醒自己它也能表示“很可能发生”。

gloss_zh: 建筑正面；页；假象；大屁股；在对面

teaching_sense.en_definition: The front or outward-facing surface of a building, especially its main exterior face.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 建筑朝外的正面，尤其指主要的外立面。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti ta' quddiem ta' bini, speċjalment il-wiċċ ewlieni tiegħu minn barra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物的正面；外立面。
书籍、报刊或文件的一页；页面。
掩饰真实情况的外表；伪装；具有欺骗性的表面假象。
肥大的臀部；大屁股。
面对；在……前面；在……对面。
在前面；在对面；面对着。

formal.mt: Il-faċċata tal-bini se tiġi rrestawrata biex jinżammu d-dettalji oriġinali tagħha.
formal.en: The facade of the building will be restored to preserve its original details.
formal.zh: 这座建筑的正面将进行修复，以保留其原有细节。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn hu l-kafetterija? Ben: Faċċata tal-bank, fil-bini bil-faċċata safra.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where is the café? Ben: Opposite the bank, in the building with the yellow facade.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：咖啡馆在哪里？本：在银行对面，就是正面为黄色的那栋楼。

messages.speaker: Anna (游客)
messages.zh: 咖啡馆在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the café?

messages.speaker: Ben (当地居民)
messages.zh: 在银行对面，就是正面为黄色的那栋楼。
messages.en: Opposite the bank, in the building with the yellow facade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三幅画区分常用义：看楼的“正面”、翻书的“一页”、站在银行“对面”；假象和大屁股义另配语境记忆。

gloss_zh: 伪君子；两面派的；毛发颜色不一的

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who pretends to have beliefs, feelings, or standards that their actions do not support.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表面宣称某种信念、感情或道德标准，实际行为却与之不符的人；伪君子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li taparsi għandha twemmin, sentimenti jew prinċipji li l-imġiba tagħha ma taqbilx magħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 伪君子；言行不一、假装正直或真诚的人。
两面派的；当面一套、背后一套的。
毛发具有不同颜色的；毛色不一的。

collocations.zh: 当面一套、背后一套的男子

formal.mt: Fir-rumanz, il-protagonist iqis lil sieħbu bħala faċċol għax jipprietka l-onestà iżda jigdeb biex jiggwadanja.
formal.en: In the novel, the protagonist considers his companion a hypocrite because he preaches honesty but lies for personal gain.
formal.zh: 在小说中，主人公认为同伴是个伪君子，因为他嘴上宣扬诚实，却为了个人利益说谎。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Quddiemi jgħid li x-xogħol tiegħi tajjeb, imma wara dahri jikkritikani. Karl: Mela qed ikun faċċol miegħek.
colloquial.en: Rita: To my face he says my work is good, but behind my back he criticizes me. Karl: Then he is being two-faced with you.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：他当着我的面说我工作做得好，背后却批评我。卡尔：那他对你就是当面一套、背后一套。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Quddiemi jgħid li x-xogħol tiegħi tajjeb, imma wara dahri jikkritikani.
messages.mt_standard: Quddiemi jgħid li x-xogħol tiegħi tajjeb, imma wara dahri jikkritikani.
messages.zh: 他当着我的面说我工作做得好，背后却批评我。
messages.en: To my face he says my work is good, but behind my back he criticizes me.

messages.speaker: Karl (同事)
messages.zh: 那他对你就是当面一套、背后一套。
messages.en: Then he is being two-faced with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画一个当面微笑、背后说坏话的人来记“伪君子、两面派”；再另画一只杂色猫，区分毛色义。

gloss_zh: 使人流鼻血；玷污；使失贞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to bleed from the nose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人的鼻子出血，即使人流鼻血。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd joħroġlu d-demm minn imnieħru.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人流鼻血。
玷污；使失贞。
使鼻子出血；使鼻部流血。

collocations.en: he caused someone to have a nosebleed
he gave his companion a nosebleed with a blow
collocations.zh: 他一击打得同伴流了鼻血

formal.mt: Waqt il-logħba, il-ballun laqat lit-tifel f'wiċċu u faġar lit-tifel.
formal.en: During the game, the ball hit the boy in the face and gave him a nosebleed.
formal.zh: 比赛时，球打中了男孩的脸，使他流了鼻血。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Pawlu waqt il-logħba? Mark: Il-ballun faġar lil Pawlu, imma issa waqaf id-demm.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Paul during the game? Mark: The ball gave Paul a nosebleed, but the bleeding has stopped now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗比赛时怎么了？马克：球打得保罗流了鼻血，不过现在已经止血了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗比赛时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Paul during the game?

messages.speaker: Mark (队友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ballun faġar lil Pawlu, imma issa waqaf id-demm.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ballun faġar lil Pawlu, imma issa waqaf id-demm.
messages.zh: 球打得保罗流了鼻血，不过现在已经止血了。
messages.en: The ball gave Paul a nosebleed, but the bleeding has stopped now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“球碰到鼻子，鼻子出血”的画面记住 faġar 的鼻血义；把“玷污、使失贞”放在另一张义项卡上，避免把不同语境混在一起。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Charcoal or coal used as fuel.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用作燃料的木炭或煤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Materjal iswed li jintuża bħala fjuwil, bħal faħam tal-injam jew faħam tal-ġebel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 木炭。
煤；煤炭。
钱；金钱。

collocations.en: a bag of charcoal or coal

formal.mt: Il-faħam tal-injam jintuża bħala fjuwil biex jissajjar l-ikel fuq il-gradilja.
formal.en: Charcoal is used as fuel to cook food on a grill.
formal.zh: 木炭被用作燃料，在烤架上烹调食物。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandna faħam għall-barbikju? Mark: Iva, xtrajt borża faħam dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do we have charcoal for the barbecue? Mark: Yes, I bought a bag of charcoal this morning.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：我们有烧烤用的木炭吗？马克：有，我今天早上买了一袋木炭。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们有烧烤用的木炭吗？
messages.en: Do we have charcoal for the barbecue?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我今天早上买了一袋木炭。
messages.en: Yes, I bought a bag of charcoal this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两袋黑色燃料，一袋标 faħam tal-injam“木炭”，另一袋标 faħam tal-ġebel“煤”；“钱”另用钱包图记忆，避免只记住燃料义。

gloss_zh: 变黑的；煤黑色的；似煤的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Blackened, coal-coloured, or resembling coal in appearance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容物体已经变黑、呈煤一般的黑色，或外观像煤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li sar iswed, għandu l-kulur tal-faħam, jew jixbah lill-faħam fid-dehra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变黑的；被熏黑或弄黑的
煤黑色的；具有煤一般黑色的
似煤的；外观像煤的

formal.mt: Wara t-tindif taċ-ċumnija, il-ħaddiem kellu wiċċ faħmi.
formal.en: After cleaning the chimney, the worker had a blackened face.
formal.zh: 清理烟囱后，工人的脸被熏得乌黑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek wiċċ faħmi? Mark: Kont qed innaddaf iċ-ċumnija.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is your face all black? Mark: I was cleaning the chimney.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的脸怎么黑乎乎的？Mark：我刚才在清理烟囱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的脸怎么黑乎乎的？
messages.en: Why is your face all black?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我刚才在清理烟囱。
messages.en: I was cleaning the chimney.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faħmi 和一张清理烟囱后乌黑的脸联系起来，同时记住“变黑、煤黑、似煤”三个相近意思。

gloss_zh: 淫秽的；下流的；令人愤慨的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Obscene or indecent, especially of speech or swearing; also outrageous.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容言语或咒骂淫秽、下流，也可形容事情过分得令人愤慨。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jkun oxxen jew indiċenti, speċjalment fid-diskors u fid-dagħa; ukoll li jkun skandaluż.

sense_translations.en_definition: obscene (used especially of foul language or cursing)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 淫秽的；粗鄙下流的，尤用于脏话或咒骂
淫秽的；骇人的；过分得令人愤慨的
（言语）不雅的、猥亵的、下流的

collocations.zh: 不雅的言论；猥亵的谈话

formal.mt: Ir-regolamenti tal-iskola jipprojbixxu l-użu ta' kliem faħxi fil-klassi.
formal.en: The school regulations prohibit the use of obscene language in the classroom.
formal.zh: 学校规定禁止在课堂上使用淫秽言语。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Dak il-kliem faħxi ma jogħġobnix. Pawlu: Sewwa, ngħidha b'mod aktar edukat.
colloquial.en: Sara: I don't like that obscene language. Pawlu: All right, I'll put it more politely.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我不喜欢那些下流话。Pawlu：好，我会说得礼貌一些。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我不喜欢那些下流话。
messages.en: I don't like that obscene language.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我会说得礼貌一些。
messages.en: All right, I'll put it more politely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 faħxi 固定放进 kliem faħxi“下流话”中记忆，想到听见不雅言语时皱眉的表情。

gloss_zh: 一种鬼笔菌；淫秽、猥亵（同 faħx）

teaching_sense.en_definition: The common stinkhorn fungus, Phallus impudicus; in another sense, a synonym of faħx, meaning obscenity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指普通臭角菌，即一种鬼笔菌（Phallus impudicus）；另一个义项与 faħx 同义，指淫秽、猥亵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' faqqiegħ magħruf bħala Phallus impudicus; f'sens ieħor, kelma bl-istess tifsira bħal faħx.

sense_translations.en_definition: the fungus known as the common stinkhorn (phallus impudicus)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 普通臭角菌，一种鬼笔菌（Phallus impudicus）
与 faħx 同义，指淫秽、猥亵或下流内容

formal.mt: Fir-rapport, il-kampjun ġie identifikat bħala faħxija, Phallus impudicus.
formal.en: In the report, the specimen was identified as common stinkhorn, Phallus impudicus.
formal.zh: 报告将该标本鉴定为普通臭角菌（Phallus impudicus）。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan il-faqqiegħ fir-ritratt? Toni: Fil-ktieb jismu faħxija.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this mushroom in the photo? Toni: The book calls it common stinkhorn.
colloquial.zh: Lara：照片里这是什么蘑菇？Toni：书上把它叫作 faħxija，也就是普通臭角菌。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 照片里这是什么蘑菇？
messages.en: What is this mushroom in the photo?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 书上把它叫作 faħxija，也就是普通臭角菌。
messages.en: The book calls it common stinkhorn.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 faħxija 画两张语境卡：自然观察卡写“鬼笔菌”，言语评价卡写“淫秽”，靠上下文区分两义。

gloss_zh: 赞扬；奉承；奉承者；颂扬上帝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To express approval or admiration for someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达对某人或某事的认可、欣赏或赞扬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid kliem ta' tifħir jew turi ammirazzjoni għal xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赞扬；称赞。
奉承；讨好地称赞。
奉承他人的人。
谄媚者；阿谀奉承的人。
赞美、颂扬或荣耀上帝。

collocations.zh: 他赞扬了学生们的努力

formal.mt: Fir-rapport tiegħu, id-direttur faħħar ix-xogħol tat-tim u l-attenzjoni tiegħu għad-dettall.
formal.en: In his report, the director praised the team's work and its attention to detail.
formal.zh: 主任在报告中赞扬了团队的工作，以及团队对细节的重视。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'qallek l-għalliem dwar il-proġett? Mark: Faħħar ix-xogħol tiegħi u qalli li l-eżempji kienu ċari.
colloquial.en: Lara: What did the teacher tell you about the project? Mark: He praised my work and told me that the examples were clear.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：老师怎么评价你的项目？马克：他表扬了我的作品，还说例子很清楚。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 老师怎么评价你的项目？
messages.en: What did the teacher tell you about the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Faħħar ix-xogħol tiegħi u qalli li l-eżempji kienu ċari.
messages.mt_standard: Faħħar ix-xogħol tiegħi u qalli li l-eżempji kienu ċari.
messages.zh: 他表扬了我的作品，还说例子很清楚。
messages.en: He praised my work and told me that the examples were clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象老师举起优秀作业说赞扬的话，用 faħħar 记“称赞”；再对照讨好别人的奉承场景。名词指“奉承者”，宗教语境则可指“赞美上帝”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A distinct stage or period within a process, development, or cycle.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某一过程、发展或周期中可以区分出来的阶段或时期。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stadju jew perjodu partikolari fi proċess, fi żvilupp jew f'ċiklu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阶段；某一过程中的特定时期。
阶段；时期；周期。

formal.mt: L-ewwel fażi tal-istudju tinkludi l-ġbir tad-data.
formal.en: The first phase of the study includes data collection.
formal.zh: 这项研究的第一阶段包括数据收集。

colloquial.mt: Nina: F'liema fażi wasalt bil-proġett? David: Għadni fl-ewwel fażi, qed niġbor l-ideat.
colloquial.en: Nina: What phase have you reached with the project? David: I'm still in the first phase, gathering ideas.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你的项目进行到哪个阶段了？David：还在第一阶段，正在收集想法。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 你的项目进行到哪个阶段了？
messages.en: What phase have you reached with the project?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni fl-ewwel fażi, qed niġbor l-ideat.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni fl-ewwel fażi, qed niġbor l-ideat.
messages.zh: 还在第一阶段，正在收集想法。
messages.en: I'm still in the first phase, gathering ideas.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在时间线上画几个分段，把当前一段标成 fażi；搭配 l-ewwel fażi 记住第一阶段的表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Beans in general, including French beans or green beans.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 豆类的统称，也可具体指菜豆或四季豆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isem ġenerali għal diversi tipi ta' fażola, fosthom il-fażola ħadra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 菜豆；四季豆。
四季豆；供食用的嫩菜豆荚。
豆类的统称。
豆；豆子。

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta tinkludi fażola ħadra, patata u żejt taż-żebbuġa.
formal.en: The recipe includes green beans, potatoes, and olive oil.
formal.zh: 这份食谱的食材包括四季豆、土豆和橄榄油。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Trid ftit fażola ħadra mal-patata? Luqa: Iva, grazzi. Togħġobni ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marija: Would you like some green beans with the potatoes? Luqa: Yes, thanks. I like them a lot.
colloquial.zh: Marija：土豆旁边要配一些四季豆吗？Luqa：要，谢谢。我很喜欢吃。

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 土豆旁边要配一些四季豆吗？
messages.en: Would you like some green beans with the potatoes?

messages.speaker: Luqa (儿子)
messages.zh: 要，谢谢。我很喜欢吃。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. I like them a lot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 fażola 先想到餐盘里的豆类，再用 fażola ħadra 对应绿色四季豆，通过食物图片记搭配。

teaching_sense.en_definition: What remains after some has been used, taken, or eaten; also an amount beyond what is needed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用、取走或吃掉一部分后留下的东西；也可指超过所需的余量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li jibqa' wara li parti tkun intużat, ittieħdet jew ittieklet; ukoll ammont aktar milli hemm bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 剩余部分；余下的数量。
余量；超过所需的部分。
剩余物；用剩或吃剩的东西。
其余部分；剩下的部分。
剩余量；过剩部分。

formal.mt: Il-fdal tal-flus se jintuża biex jinxtara materjal għall-klassi.
formal.en: The remaining money will be used to buy materials for the class.
formal.zh: 剩下的钱将用于购买课堂材料。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Hemm xi fdal tal-ikel? Ben: Iva, fadal ftit ross fil-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is there any leftover food? Ben: Yes, there's some rice left in the fridge.
colloquial.zh: Sara：有剩下的食物吗？Ben：有，冰箱里还剩一些米饭。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 有剩下的食物吗？
messages.en: Is there any leftover food?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.zh: 有，冰箱里还剩一些米饭。
messages.en: Yes, there's some rice left in the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一盘食物吃掉大半后留下的一小份，把留下的部分标为 fdal；再把同一画面换成剩下的钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To redeem or ransom someone or something, or to recover money spent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 赎回某人或某物，使其获释或获救；也可指收回已经支出的费用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħeles lil xi ħadd jew ġab xi ħaġa lura bi ħlas; ukoll irkupra flus li kien nefaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赎回；赎救。
收回；弥补，尤指收回自己支出的费用。

sense_translations.en_definition: to redeem; to ransom; to deliver
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赎回；付赎金使获释；解救。

formal.mt: Il-bejjiegħ feda l-ispejjeż tiegħu mill-bejgħ tal-kotba.
formal.en: The seller recovered his expenses through book sales.
formal.zh: 卖家通过售书收回了支出的费用。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif mar Mark bil-bejgħ tal-kotba? Pawlu: Tajjeb. Feda l-ispejjeż kollha tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Lara: How did Mark do with the book sales? Pawlu: Well. He recovered all his expenses.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 的书卖得怎么样？Pawlu：不错。他收回了全部费用。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 的书卖得怎么样？
messages.en: How did Mark do with the book sales?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 不错。他收回了全部费用。
messages.en: Well. He recovered all his expenses.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画分别记 feda：一幅是付赎金后人获释，另一幅是卖书后收回成本；依宾语判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A system of government in which powers are divided between a central government and regional governments.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 中央政府与各地区政府分配和行使不同权力的一种政治制度或主张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' gvern li fiha s-setgħat jinqasmu bejn gvern ċentrali u gvernijiet reġjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 联邦主义；中央与各组成地区分享政府权力的制度或政治主张。

formal.mt: L-istudju jispjega kif il-federaliżmu jqassam is-setgħat bejn il-gvern ċentrali u l-gvernijiet reġjonali.
formal.en: The study explains how federalism distributes powers between the central government and regional governments.
formal.zh: 这项研究解释了联邦制如何在中央政府与各地区政府之间分配权力。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu l-federaliżmu? Mark: Huwa sistema fejn il-gvern ċentrali u l-gvernijiet reġjonali jaqsmu s-setgħat.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is federalism? Mark: It is a system in which the central government and regional governments share powers.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：什么是联邦制？马克：就是中央政府与各地区政府分享权力的一种制度。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 什么是联邦制？
messages.en: What is federalism?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa sistema fejn il-gvern ċentrali u l-gvernijiet reġjonali jaqsmu s-setgħat.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa sistema fejn il-gvern ċentrali u l-gvernijiet reġjonali jaqsmu s-setgħat.
messages.zh: 就是中央政府与各地区政府分享权力的一种制度。
messages.en: It is a system in which the central government and regional governments share powers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把政府权力画成中央与地区两层分工图，看到 federaliżmu 就联想“联邦分权”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To understand the meaning of something or realise that something is true.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 理解话语、情况等的含义，或意识到某件事情确实如此。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħraf it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa jew jintebaħ li xi ħaġa hija vera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 理解；明白某句话、概念或情况的意思。
意识到；认识到某个事实或情况。

formal.mt: Wara li qara r-rapport, id-direttur fehem li l-proġett kien jeħtieġ aktar ħin.
formal.en: After reading the report, the director realised that the project needed more time.
formal.zh: 读完报告后，主管意识到这个项目需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu fehem l-istruzzjonijiet? Sara: Iva, fehem kollox u diġà beda jaħdem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu understand the instructions? Sara: Yes, he understood everything and has already started working.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗看懂说明了吗？萨拉：看懂了，他全明白了，而且已经开始做了。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 保罗看懂说明了吗？
messages.en: Did Pawlu understand the instructions?

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fehem kollox u diġà beda jaħdem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fehem kollox u diġà beda jaħdem.
messages.zh: 看懂了，他全明白了，而且已经开始做了。
messages.en: Yes, he understood everything and has already started working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fehem 配上脑中灯泡亮起的画面：读懂一句话是“理解”，发现事实是“意识到”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opinion or standpoint about something, or an understanding of its meaning.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某事形成的意见、观点或立场，也可指对其含义的理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Opinjoni jew pożizzjoni dwar xi ħaġa, jew għarfien tat-tifsira tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意见；个人对某件事的看法。
立场；考虑或评价某件事时所持的观点。
理解；对某件事的意思或性质的认识。

collocations.en: a clear understanding of the subject

formal.mt: Fil-fehma tal-kumitat, il-proposta teħtieġ aktar diskussjoni qabel tittieħed deċiżjoni.
formal.en: In the committee's opinion, the proposal needs further discussion before a decision is made.
formal.zh: 委员会认为，在作出决定之前，这项提案还需要进一步讨论。

colloquial.mt: Mark: X'inhi l-fehma tiegħek dwar dan il-pjan? Maja: Fil-fehma tiegħi, għandna nibdew b'pass żgħir.
colloquial.en: Mark: What is your opinion of this plan? Maja: In my opinion, we should start with a small step.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你对这个计划有什么看法？玛雅：在我看来，我们应该先迈出一小步。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: X'inhi l-fehma tiegħek dwar dan il-pjan?
messages.mt_standard: X'inhi l-fehma tiegħek dwar dan il-pjan?
messages.zh: 你对这个计划有什么看法？
messages.en: What is your opinion of this plan?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fil-fehma tiegħi, għandna nibdew b'pass żgħir.
messages.mt_standard: Fil-fehma tiegħi, għandna nibdew b'pass żgħir.
messages.zh: 在我看来，我们应该先迈出一小步。
messages.en: In my opinion, we should start with a small step.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先整块记住 fil-fehma tiegħi“在我看来”，再把 fehma 联想到自己表达的观点或形成的理解。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The benefit, usefulness or practical value that something provides.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某件事物带来的益处、实际用处或实用价值。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġid, l-utilità jew il-valur prattiku li tagħti xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 益处；某件事所带来的好处。
价值；益处；用处，尤其指实际能带来的帮助或效果。

formal.mt: Il-gwida hija ta' fejda għall-istudenti li qed iħejju għall-eżami.
formal.en: The guide is useful for students who are preparing for the examination.
formal.zh: 这份指南对正在备考的学生很有帮助。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Din il-mappa għadha ta' fejda? Mark: Iva, turina fejn jinsab l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is this map still useful? Mark: Yes, it shows us where the station is.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张地图还有用吗？马克：有用，它能告诉我们车站在哪里。

messages.speaker: Sara (游客)
messages.zh: 这张地图还有用吗？
messages.en: Is this map still useful?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 有用，它能告诉我们车站在哪里。
messages.en: Yes, it shows us where the station is.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“能帮上忙吗”来记 fejda；把 ta' fejda“有用”和 bla fejda“无用”成对记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cure an illness or make a person or an injured part of the body healthy again.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 治好疾病，或使患者、受伤的身体部位恢复健康。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ineħħi marda jew iġib lura s-saħħa lil persuna jew lil parti midruba tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 治愈；治好疾病或病人。
治好；使伤处愈合或使身体恢复健康。

sense_translations.en_definition: to heal (make sound; give back health to)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使恢复健康；使患病或受伤的人或身体部位恢复良好状态。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, it-trattament fejjaq il-marda u l-pazjent reġa' lura għax-xogħol.
formal.en: According to the report, the treatment cured the illness and the patient returned to work.
formal.zh: 根据报告，治疗治好了疾病，患者已经重返工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Maja: It-trattament fejjaq il-ferita? Pawlu: Iva, issa l-ġilda reġgħet f'saħħitha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the treatment heal the wound? Pawlu: Yes, the skin is healthy again now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：治疗让伤口愈合了吗？保罗：是的，现在皮肤已经恢复健康了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 治疗让伤口愈合了吗？
messages.en: Did the treatment heal the wound?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (康复者)
messages.zh: 是的，现在皮肤已经恢复健康了。
messages.en: Yes, the skin is healthy again now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fejjaq 放进“治疗使人恢复健康”的完整画面中，抓住“把病或伤治好”的动作。

gloss_zh: 有益的；有帮助的；有利的；能获利的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Providing benefit, practical help or an advantage, sometimes including financial gain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能带来益处、实际帮助或优势的，有时也指能带来经济收益的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jagħti ġid, għajnuna prattika jew vantaġġ, u xi drabi qligħ finanzjarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有益的；能够带来好处或积极效果的。
有帮助的；能够提供实际帮助的。
有利的；能带来优势或丰厚经济收益的。

formal.mt: Il-kors kien fejjiedi għall-għalliema għax offra metodi prattiċi għat-tagħlim.
formal.en: The course was beneficial for the teachers because it offered practical teaching methods.
formal.zh: 这门课程为教师提供了实用的教学方法，因此对他们很有益处。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Kif sibt il-kors? Sara: Kien fejjiedi ħafna; issa naf kif norganizza l-istudju tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Mark: How did you find the course? Sara: It was very helpful; now I know how to organise my studying.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你觉得这门课程怎么样？萨拉：很有帮助；现在我知道该怎样安排学习了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 你觉得这门课程怎么样？
messages.en: How did you find the course?

messages.speaker: Sara (课程学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien fejjiedi ħafna; issa naf kif norganizza l-istudju tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Kien fejjiedi ħafna; issa naf kif norganizza l-istudju tiegħi.
messages.zh: 很有帮助；现在我知道该怎样安排学习了。
messages.en: It was very helpful; now I know how to organise my studying.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象给建议、课程或生意贴上“带来好处”的标签，标签上的形容词就是 fejjiedi。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to ask about or indicate a place or destination.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于询问或指明地点、位置或目的地，相当于“哪里”“在哪里”或“到哪里”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kelma li tintuża biex tistaqsi dwar post jew destinazzjoni, jew biex tindikahom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哪里；在哪里；到哪里，用于询问或引出地点。

formal.mt: Il-formola titlob lill-applikant jindika fejn joqgħod u fejn jaħdem.
formal.en: The form asks the applicant to indicate where they live and where they work.
formal.zh: 表格要求申请人注明居住地点和工作地点。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn sejjer, Mark? Mark: Sejjer il-ħanut ħdejn l-istazzjon.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are you going, Mark? Mark: I'm going to the shop next to the station.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，你要去哪里？马克：我要去车站旁边的商店。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克，你要去哪里？
messages.en: Where are you going, Mark?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要去车站旁边的商店。
messages.en: I'm going to the shop next to the station.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地图上的问号定位针，看到 fejn 就问“哪里”；结合后面的动词判断是住在哪里还是去哪里。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To walk slowly or very slowly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缓慢行走，或走得非常慢。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jimxi bil-mod jew bil-mod ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢慢走；缓步行走。
走得非常慢；以极慢的速度行走。

collocations.en: he walked slowly along the road
he walked very slowly towards home
collocations.zh: 他朝家里走去，走得很慢。

formal.mt: Wara mixja twila, ir-raġel fekren lejn id-dar u wasal qabel id-dlam.
formal.en: After a long walk, the man walked very slowly towards home and arrived before dark.
formal.zh: 走了很长一段路后，那名男子缓缓往家走，在天黑前到了家。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex Pawlu wasal daqshekk tard? Rita: Fekren it-triq kollha għax kien għajjien.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did Pawlu arrive so late? Rita: He walked very slowly the whole way because he was tired.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗怎么这么晚才到？丽塔：他累了，一路都走得很慢。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么这么晚才到？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu arrive so late?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fekren it-triq kollha għax kien għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Fekren it-triq kollha għax kien għajjien.
messages.zh: 他累了，一路都走得很慢。
messages.en: He walked very slowly the whole way because he was tired.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fekren 配上一段慢动作走路画面，边读边想“慢慢走”；用动作帮助记忆动词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tortoise or turtle, an animal with a protective shell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 龟或陆龟，也可指海龟；身体有保护性硬壳的动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal b'qoxra iebsa li tipproteġi ġismu; jista' jkun tal-art jew tal-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陆龟；主要在陆地上生活的龟。
龟；可指水龟或海龟，具体依语境判断。
陆龟或龟类动物，包括语境中的水龟、海龟。

formal.mt: L-istudenti qabblu fekruna tal-art ma' fekruna tal-baħar u ddeskrivew id-differenzi bejniethom.
formal.en: The students compared a tortoise with a sea turtle and described the differences between them.
formal.zh: 学生们比较了一只陆龟和一只海龟，并描述了它们之间的差异。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara dik il-fekruna ħdejn il-ġebla! Mark: Rajtha! Qed timxi bil-mod lejn il-ħaxix.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look at that tortoise beside the stone! Mark: I see it! It's walking slowly towards the grass.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看石头旁边那只陆龟！马克：我看到了！它正慢慢往草地那边走。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看石头旁边那只陆龟！
messages.en: Look at that tortoise beside the stone!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtha! Qed timxi bil-mod lejn il-ħaxix.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtha! Qed timxi bil-mod lejn il-ħaxix.
messages.zh: 我看到了！它正慢慢往草地那边走。
messages.en: I see it! It's walking slowly towards the grass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fekruna 画一只带壳的小龟，再用 tal-art 和 tal-baħar 两张标签分别记住陆龟、海龟。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To inspect or scrutinise something carefully in order to assess it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细检查或审视某事物，以了解细节并作出评估。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina xi ħaġa bir-reqqa biex jara d-dettalji tagħha u jevalwaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 检查；查看事物的情况。
细察；认真审视细节。
细察、仔细检查或评估。

collocations.zh: 他仔细检查了各项细节。

formal.mt: Qabel approva r-rapport, id-direttur fela kull tabella u qabbel iċ-ċifri mad-dokumenti oriġinali.
formal.en: Before approving the report, the director scrutinised every table and compared the figures with the original documents.
formal.zh: 批准报告之前，主管仔细检查了每张表格，并将数字与原始文件进行了核对。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Mark fela l-kuntratt qabel iffirma? Rita: Iva, qara kollox bir-reqqa u staqsa dwar il-ħlas.
colloquial.en: Anna: Did Mark scrutinise the contract before signing? Rita: Yes, he read everything carefully and asked about the payment.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：马克签字前仔细看过合同吗？丽塔：看过，他认真读了全部内容，还问了付款的事。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 马克签字前仔细看过合同吗？
messages.en: Did Mark scrutinise the contract before signing?

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, qara kollox bir-reqqa u staqsa dwar il-ħlas.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, qara kollox bir-reqqa u staqsa dwar il-ħlas.
messages.zh: 看过，他认真读了全部内容，还问了付款的事。
messages.en: Yes, he read everything carefully and asked about the payment.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fela 和放大镜检查合同的画面放在一起：逐项看细节，再作评估，帮助记住“细察”。

gloss_zh: 承受；负担得起；应付；强健；状况良好

teaching_sense.en_definition: To have the strength, ability or financial means to endure or manage something; also to be strong, healthy or successful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 有体力、能力或财力承受、应付或负担某事；也可表示强健、健康或顺利成功。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikollu s-saħħa, il-ħila jew il-mezzi finanzjarji biex jissaporti jew ilaħħaq ma' xi ħaġa; ikun ukoll b'saħħtu, f'saħħtu jew sejjer tajjeb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忍受；承受困难、痛苦或压力。
在经济上负担得起某物或某项开支。

sense_translations.en_definition: to manage sth. or sb. successfully
sense_translations.zh_definition: 成功应付某事或某人；有能力处理好。
强壮；有力量。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be able to afford, endure, or withstand
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有能力负担、忍受或抵挡。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be fine, healthy, or successful
sense_translations.zh_definition: 状况良好、身体健康或进展顺利、取得成功。

collocations.en: he could afford to pay the rent

formal.mt: Minkejja s-sħana qawwija, il-ħaddiem felaħ ikompli x-xogħol sal-ħin tal-mistrieħ.
formal.en: Despite the intense heat, the worker managed to continue working until the break.
formal.zh: 尽管天气酷热，那名工人仍坚持工作到了休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Pawlu felaħ iħallas il-kera dan ix-xahar? Rita: Iva, kellu biżżejjed flus.
colloquial.en: Marta: Could Pawlu afford to pay the rent this month? Rita: Yes, he had enough money.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：保罗这个月付得起房租吗？丽塔：付得起，他的钱够用。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu felaħ iħallas il-kera dan ix-xahar?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu felaħ iħallas il-kera dan ix-xahar?
messages.zh: 保罗这个月付得起房租吗？
messages.en: Could Pawlu afford to pay the rent this month?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 付得起，他的钱够用。
messages.en: Yes, he had enough money.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“撑得住、付得起、应付得来”三幅画记 felaħ，再补上身体强健和事情顺利的语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wedge used to hold or separate things, or a splinter or small piece of material.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来固定或撑开物体的楔子；也可指碎屑、碎片或一小块材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa li tintuża biex iżżomm xi ħaġa f'postha jew tifred żewġ affarijiet; ukoll laqx jew biċċa żgħira ta' materjal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个楔子；用于固定或撑开物体的楔形物。
楔子；楔形垫块。

sense_translations.en_definition: a splinter or any small piece
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片碎屑、碎片，或任何一小块东西。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem daħħal feles taħt il-bieb biex iżommu miftuħ waqt li kien qed iġorr il-kaxxi.
formal.en: The worker inserted a wedge under the door to keep it open while carrying the boxes.
formal.zh: 工人把一个楔形挡块塞到门下，让门在搬箱子时保持打开。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-bieb qed jingħalaq waħdu. Għandek feles? Lara: Iva, ħu dan u poġġih taħt il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: The door keeps closing by itself. Have you got a wedge? Lara: Yes, take this one and put it under the door.
colloquial.zh: 马克：门老是自己关上。你有楔形门挡吗？拉拉：有，拿这个放到门下面。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-bieb qed jingħalaq waħdu. Għandek feles?
messages.mt_standard: Il-bieb qed jingħalaq waħdu. Għandek feles?
messages.zh: 门老是自己关上。你有楔形门挡吗？
messages.en: The door keeps closing by itself. Have you got a wedge?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ħu dan u poġġih taħt il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ħu dan u poġġih taħt il-bieb.
messages.zh: 有，拿这个放到门下面。
messages.en: Yes, take this one and put it under the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 feles 写在门下的小楔块旁，再画一片木屑，借两幅实物图分别记住“楔子”和“小碎片”。

gloss_zh: 切片；切开；使脚跟裂开；翻碎土壤

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cut something into slices; in other senses, to make a cut or crack, or to break up soil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西切成片；其他义项包括切开、使皮肤裂开，以及翻碎土壤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qata' xi ħaġa f'biċċiet irqaq; f'tifsiriet oħra, għamel qatgħa jew xaqq, jew farrak il-ħamrija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 切片；把东西切成片。

sense_translations.en_definition: to open up a crack or a gash (especially in one's heel)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使皮肤裂开一道口子或伤口，尤指使脚跟开裂。
切成一片一片。
切开一道口子；作切口。
把土壤翻松、弄碎。

formal.mt: Il-kok fellel il-ħobż f'biċċiet irqaq u poġġiehom fuq platt qabel serva l-ikla.
formal.en: The cook sliced the bread thinly and placed the slices on a plate before serving the meal.
formal.zh: 厨师把面包切成薄片，放到盘子里，然后上餐。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min fellel il-ħobż għall-pranzu? Pawlu: Jien; ħallejt il-biċċiet fuq il-platt.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who sliced the bread for lunch? Pawlu: I did; I left the slices on the plate.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：谁把午餐要吃的面包切片了？保罗：我切的，面包片放在盘子上了。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把午餐要吃的面包切片了？
messages.en: Who sliced the bread for lunch?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我切的，面包片放在盘子上了。
messages.en: I did; I left the slices on the plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“刀把面包切成片”记住 fellel 的动作义，再分别建立皮肤裂口、切口和碎土的场景卡片。

gloss_zh: 楔住；发芽；铸币；孵出小鸡

teaching_sense.en_definition: To insert a wedge or secure something with one; separate senses refer to plants sprouting, minting money, and producing or hatching chicks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 插入楔子或用楔子固定东西；另有植物发芽、铸造钱币，以及繁育或孵出小鸡等独立义项。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħħal feles jew waħħal xi ħaġa bih; għandu wkoll tifsiriet marbuta mat-tkabbir tal-blanzuni, mal-produzzjoni tal-muniti u mat-tfaqqis tal-flieles.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入楔子。

sense_translations.en_definition: to sprout or grow buds (used of plants)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发芽或长出芽苞，用于植物。
铸造钱币。
萌芽；长出芽苞。

sense_translations.en_definition: to produce offspring (used of chickens producing chicks)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 繁育后代，指鸡繁育出小鸡。
孵出小鸡。
长芽；萌发。
用楔子楔住、撑住或固定。

formal.mt: Il-lewż felles fil-bidu tar-rebbiegħa, u l-ġardinar osserva l-blanzuni l-ġodda fuq il-friegħi.
formal.en: The almond tree sprouted buds at the beginning of spring, and the gardener observed the new buds on the branches.
formal.zh: 杏树在初春萌芽，园丁观察了枝条上新长出的芽苞。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex il-bieb baqa' miftuħ? Toni: Missieri felles il-bieb biex ma jingħalaqx bir-riħ.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did the door stay open? Toni: My father wedged the door so the wind wouldn't close it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：门怎么一直开着？托尼：我爸爸用楔子撑住了门，免得风把它吹关。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 门怎么一直开着？
messages.en: Why did the door stay open?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Missieri felles il-bieb biex ma jingħalaqx bir-riħ.
messages.mt_standard: Missieri felles il-bieb biex ma jingħalaqx bir-riħ.
messages.zh: 我爸爸用楔子撑住了门，免得风把它吹关。
messages.en: My father wedged the door so the wind wouldn't close it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 felles 画四张独立记忆卡：楔住门、树发芽、铸钱币、孵小鸡；靠具体语境选择义项，不强行串成词源故事。

gloss_zh: 片；瓣；部分；脚跟皮肤裂口；臀部

teaching_sense.en_definition: A slice, section, or segment, such as a slice of bread or a segment of an orange.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 切下的一片，或整体中的一部分、一瓣，例如面包片或橙子瓣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa maqtugħa jew parti minn ħaġa sħiħa, bħal biċċa ħobż jew parti minn larinġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一片；切下的薄片。
一瓣；一个分瓣，例如橙子的一瓣。
部分；分段；片。
脚跟皮肤上的裂口。
臀部；屁股。

formal.mt: Għall-kolazzjon, ġew servuti felli tal-ħobż bil-ġobon u platt frott frisk għall-mistednin.
formal.en: For breakfast, slices of bread with cheese and a plate of fresh fruit were served to the guests.
formal.zh: 早餐时，客人们享用了配奶酪的面包片和一盘新鲜水果。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Trid felli tal-ħobż mal-ġobon? David: Iva, grazzi; poġġihom fuq il-platt tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Would you like slices of bread with the cheese? David: Yes, thanks; put them on my plate.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你要面包片配奶酪吗？戴维：要，谢谢，放在我的盘子上吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要面包片配奶酪吗？
messages.en: Would you like slices of bread with the cheese?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi; poġġihom fuq il-platt tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi; poġġihom fuq il-platt tiegħi.
messages.zh: 要，谢谢，放在我的盘子上吧。
messages.en: Yes, thanks; put them on my plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用盘中的面包片和橙子瓣记住 felli 的“片、瓣、部分”；脚跟裂口和臀部另设语境卡，避免混用。

gloss_zh: 能切片的；具有切片能力的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Capable of slicing something into pieces or thin sections.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有把东西切成片的能力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-ħila jaqta' xi ħaġa f'biċċiet irqaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 具有切片能力的；能够把东西切成片的。

collocations.zh: 一台具有切片功能的设备

formal.mt: Fil-kċina jintuża apparat fellieli biex il-ħobż jinqata' f'biċċiet irqaq tal-istess ħxuna.
formal.en: A slicing device is used in the kitchen to cut bread into thin slices of equal thickness.
formal.zh: 厨房使用具有切片功能的设备，把面包切成厚度一致的薄片。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Liema sikkien nuża biex naqta' l-ħobż f'biċċiet irqaq? Mark: Ħu dan is-sikkien fellieli; jaqta' tajjeb.
colloquial.en: Elena: Which knife should I use to cut the bread into thin slices? Mark: Take this slicing knife; it cuts well.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：我要把面包切成薄片，该用哪把刀？马克：拿这把能切片的刀吧，它很好切。

messages.speaker: Elena (烹饪学员)
messages.mt_spoken: Liema sikkien nuża biex naqta' l-ħobż f'biċċiet irqaq?
messages.mt_standard: Liema sikkien nuża biex naqta' l-ħobż f'biċċiet irqaq?
messages.zh: 我要把面包切成薄片，该用哪把刀？
messages.en: Which knife should I use to cut the bread into thin slices?

messages.speaker: Mark (烹饪教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħu dan is-sikkien fellieli; jaqta' tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Ħu dan is-sikkien fellieli; jaqta' tajjeb.
messages.zh: 拿这把能切片的刀吧，它很好切。
messages.en: Take this slicing knife; it cuts well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fellieli 写在一把切片刀的图片旁，记成“具备切片能力的”；它描述能力或功能，不表示一次切片动作。

gloss_zh: 强壮的；精力旺盛的；强壮的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physically strong and vigorous, especially when describing a person capable of hard work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容人身体强壮、精力旺盛，能够从事费力劳动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa fiżika u enerġija, speċjalment meta wieħed jitkellem fuq persuna kapaċi tagħmel xogħol iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的，用于描述有力气的人。
一个强壮的人；身强力壮者。
强壮的；精力旺盛的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fellieħ għen lill-kollegi tiegħu jerfgħu t-tagħmir tqil u jqegħduh fil-post magħżul.
formal.en: The strong worker helped his colleagues lift the heavy equipment and place it in the designated location.
formal.zh: 这位强壮的工人帮助同事抬起沉重的设备，并把它放到指定位置。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taħseb li Ġorġ jista' jgħinna nċaqalqu l-armarju? Samwel: Iva, hu raġel fellieħ u għandu ħafna saħħa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you think Ġorġ can help us move the wardrobe? Samwel: Yes, he's a strong man and has plenty of strength.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你觉得乔治能帮我们搬衣柜吗？萨姆韦尔：能，他身强力壮，很有力气。

messages.speaker: Rita (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taħseb li Ġorġ jista' jgħinna nċaqalqu l-armarju?
messages.mt_standard: Taħseb li Ġorġ jista' jgħinna nċaqalqu l-armarju?
messages.zh: 你觉得乔治能帮我们搬衣柜吗？
messages.en: Do you think Ġorġ can help us move the wardrobe?

messages.speaker: Samwel (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu raġel fellieħ u għandu ħafna saħħa.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu raġel fellieħ u għandu ħafna saħħa.
messages.zh: 能，他身强力壮，很有力气。
messages.en: Yes, he's a strong man and has plenty of strength.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位能帮忙搬衣柜的人：修饰这个人时记“强壮的”，单独指称这个人时记“强壮者”，留意词性区别。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A chick: a young chicken that has not yet grown into an adult.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 雏鸡；尚未长成成鸡的小鸡。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiġieġ żgħir li għadu ma kiberx.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鸡；雏鸡。
雏鸡；年幼的鸡。
怀疑；疑心。

collocations.en: a chick under the hen's wings
collocations.zh: 一只躲在母鸡翅膀下的小鸡

formal.mt: Il-fellus baqa' qrib it-tiġieġa, li kienet tipproteġih u żżommu sħun taħt il-ġwienaħ tagħha.
formal.en: The chick stayed close to the hen, which protected it and kept it warm under her wings.
formal.zh: 小鸡一直待在母鸡身旁，母鸡保护着它，并用翅膀为它保暖。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Ara dak il-fellus isfar ħdejn it-tiġieġa! Mario: Kemm hu żgħir! Ejja narawh minn hawn biex ma nbeżżgħuhx.
colloquial.en: Lina: Look at that yellow chick beside the hen! Mario: It's so small! Let's watch it from here so we don't frighten it.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：看母鸡旁边那只黄色的小鸡！马里奥：它真小！我们就在这里看，免得吓到它。

messages.speaker: Lina (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak il-fellus isfar ħdejn it-tiġieġa!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak il-fellus isfar ħdejn it-tiġieġa!
messages.zh: 看母鸡旁边那只黄色的小鸡！
messages.en: Look at that yellow chick beside the hen!

messages.speaker: Mario (农场访客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu żgħir! Ejja narawh minn hawn biex ma nbeżżgħuhx.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu żgħir! Ejja narawh minn hawn biex ma nbeżżgħuhx.
messages.zh: 它真小！我们就在这里看，免得吓到它。
messages.en: It's so small! Let's watch it from here so we don't frighten it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 fellus 和母鸡身边的黄色小鸡配对；“怀疑”义另用问号卡片记忆，两个义项依靠上下文区分。

gloss_zh: 幼驹；小公马；不成熟、缺乏经验的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A young horse or donkey that has been weaned but has not yet reached adulthood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 已经断奶但尚未成年的幼马或幼驴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żiemel jew ħmar żgħir li diġà nfatam iżda għadu ma sarx adult.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小公马；雄性幼马。

sense_translations.en_definition: foal, colt (a preadult horse or ass which has been weaned)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 幼驹；已经断奶但尚未成年的马或驴。
不成熟、缺乏经验的人。

formal.mt: Il-felu kien diġà nfatam u kien jirgħa fil-mergħa taħt is-superviżjoni ta' min jieħu ħsiebu.
formal.en: The foal had already been weaned and was grazing in the pasture under its caretaker's supervision.
formal.zh: 这匹幼驹已经断奶，正在照料者的看护下于牧场吃草。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Dak il-felu diġà jiekol waħdu? Ġużi: Iva, diġà nfatam, imma għadu żgħir u jeħtieġ il-kura.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does that foal already eat on its own? Ġużi: Yes, it has already been weaned, but it's still young and needs care.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：那匹幼驹已经能自己吃东西了吗？朱齐：是的，它已经断奶了，但还小，需要照料。

messages.speaker: Anna (马场访客)
messages.zh: 那匹幼驹已经能自己吃东西了吗？
messages.en: Does that foal already eat on its own?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (马场饲养员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, diġà nfatam, imma għadu żgħir u jeħtieġ il-kura.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, diġà nfatam, imma għadu żgħir u jeħtieġ il-kura.
messages.zh: 是的，它已经断奶了，但还小，需要照料。
messages.en: Yes, it has already been weaned, but it's still young and needs care.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“已断奶、尚未成年”的幼驹画面记 felu；用于人时另记“尚不成熟、经验不足”，注意语境中的评价意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strength, sturdiness or vigour: the power or energy needed to act or withstand strain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 力量、结实程度或活力，指行动或承受负荷所需的力气与精力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saħħa, robustezza jew enerġija li tippermetti li wieħed jaħdem jew jissaporti t-tbatija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 力量；力气。
结实程度；强健、坚实的状态。
活力；充沛的精力。

formal.mt: Wara ftit mistrieħ, il-ħaddiem reġa' kellu biżżejjed felħ biex ikompli x-xogħol.
formal.en: After a short rest, the worker once again had enough strength to continue working.
formal.zh: 稍作休息后，那名工人又有了足够的力气，可以继续工作。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Illum m'għandix felħ biex inġorr din il-kaxxa. Marta: Ħalliha hawn; inġorruha flimkien aktar tard.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: I haven't got the strength to carry this box today. Marta: Leave it here; we'll carry it together later.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：今天我没力气搬这个箱子。玛尔塔：先放在这里吧，晚点我们一起搬。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum m'għandix felħ biex inġorr din il-kaxxa.
messages.mt_standard: Illum m'għandix felħ biex inġorr din il-kaxxa.
messages.zh: 今天我没力气搬这个箱子。
messages.en: I haven't got the strength to carry this box today.

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħalliha hawn; inġorruha flimkien aktar tard.
messages.mt_standard: Ħalliha hawn; inġorruha flimkien aktar tard.
messages.zh: 先放在这里吧，晚点我们一起搬。
messages.en: Leave it here; we'll carry it together later.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felħ 想成身体的“力气电量”：电量充足就有力量，电量耗尽就说 m'għandix felħ。

gloss_zh: 强壮的；结实的；精力充沛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong, sturdy or vigorous; having physical strength and energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 强壮、结实或精力充沛的，形容有体力、有活力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa u enerġija; robust u kapaċi jagħmel sforz fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的；有力量的。
结实的；体格健壮的。
强壮而有活力的；精力充沛的。

collocations.zh: 一个身体结实、精力充沛的工人

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem kien felħan u seta' jġorr il-kaxxi tqal mingħajr diffikultà.
formal.en: The worker was strong and could carry the heavy boxes without difficulty.
formal.zh: 那名工人身体强壮，搬运沉重的箱子毫不费力。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min se jgħinna nċaqalqu l-mejda? Mark: Pawlu jista' jgħinna; hu felħan u għandu l-ħin.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who's going to help us move the table? Mark: Pawlu can help us; he's strong and has time.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁来帮我们搬桌子？马克：保罗可以帮忙，他力气大，也有时间。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 谁来帮我们搬桌子？
messages.en: Who's going to help us move the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu jista' jgħinna; hu felħan u għandu l-ħin.
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu jista' jgħinna; hu felħan u għandu l-ħin.
messages.zh: 保罗可以帮忙，他力气大，也有时间。
messages.en: Pawlu can help us; he's strong and has time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 felħan 配一位轻松搬起重箱的人物，用“他很强壮”整句记忆，明确它是形容词。

gloss_zh: 强壮的；结实的；精力旺盛的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Strong, sturdy or vigorous; physically robust and full of energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体强壮、体格结实或精力旺盛的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu b'saħħtu, robust u mimli enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的；有力气的。
结实的；身体健壮的。
强壮且精力旺盛的；有活力的。

collocations.zh: 一个强壮而精力旺盛的男人

formal.mt: Għalkemm ix-xogħol kien fiżikament diffiċli, il-ħaddiem felħani kellu biżżejjed enerġija biex ikomplih.
formal.en: Although the work was physically demanding, the vigorous worker had enough energy to complete it.
formal.zh: 尽管这项工作很耗体力，那名精力旺盛的工人仍有足够的精力把它完成。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Nannuk għadu jaħdem fil-ġnien kuljum? Lara: Iva, għadu felħani u jieħu gost jaħdem barra.
colloquial.en: Rita: Does your grandfather still work in the garden every day? Lara: Yes, he's still strong and vigorous, and he enjoys working outdoors.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你爷爷现在还每天在花园里干活吗？拉拉：是啊，他依然身体强健、精力充沛，很喜欢在户外干活。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 你爷爷现在还每天在花园里干活吗？
messages.en: Does your grandfather still work in the garden every day?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadu felħani u jieħu gost jaħdem barra.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadu felħani u jieħu gost jaħdem barra.
messages.zh: 是啊，他依然身体强健、精力充沛，很喜欢在户外干活。
messages.en: Yes, he's still strong and vigorous, and he enjoys working outdoors.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felħani 写在一位每天精神十足地打理花园的老人旁，记住“身体结实、精力旺盛”的形容词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Physically strong and vigorous, with the strength and energy to do demanding work.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体强壮、精力充沛，能够承担费力工作的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu saħħa fiżika u enerġija biex jagħmel xogħol iebes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 强壮的；有力气的。
强壮而精力充沛的。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem felħi għen lit-tim iġorr il-kaxxi tqal mill-maħżen sal-vann.
formal.en: The strong worker helped the team carry the heavy boxes from the storeroom to the van.
formal.zh: 这位强壮的工人帮助团队把沉重的箱子从仓库搬到货车上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min se jgħinni nġorr din il-mejda? Mark: Nista' ngħinek jien; jien felħi biżżejjed.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who will help me carry this table? Mark: I can help you; I'm strong enough.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁来帮我搬这张桌子？马克：我可以帮你，我的力气够大。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min se jgħinni nġorr din il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Min se jgħinni nġorr din il-mejda?
messages.zh: 谁来帮我搬这张桌子？
messages.en: Who will help me carry this table?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' ngħinek jien; jien felħi biżżejjed.
messages.mt_standard: Nista' ngħinek jien; jien felħi biżżejjed.
messages.zh: 我可以帮你，我的力气够大。
messages.en: I can help you; I'm strong enough.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 felħi 和“有力气搬重桌的人”这一画面配对记忆，重点记住它描述强壮、有活力的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The grammatical gender called feminine, used to classify words and describe their forms.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 语法中的阴性，用于说明词的性别类别及相应形式。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ġens grammatikali li jissejjaħ femminil u li jintuża biex jiġu kklassifikati l-kliem u l-forom tagħhom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 阴性；语法中的阴性类别。
阴性；与阳性相对应的语法性别。

formal.mt: F'dan l-eżerċizzju, l-istudenti għandhom ibiddlu l-aġġettivi mill-maskil għall-femminil.
formal.en: In this exercise, the students should change the adjectives from masculine to feminine.
formal.zh: 在这个练习中，学生应把形容词从阳性形式改为阴性形式。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif ngħid 'sabiħ' fil-femminil? Pawlu: Tgħid 'sabiħa'.
colloquial.en: Marija: How do I say 'sabiħ' in the feminine? Pawlu: You say 'sabiħa'.
colloquial.zh: Marija：sabiħ 的阴性形式怎么说？Pawlu：说 sabiħa。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: sabiħ 的阴性形式怎么说？
messages.en: How do I say 'sabiħ' in the feminine?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 说 sabiħa。
messages.en: You say 'sabiħa'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 femminil 记成语法分类标签“阴性”，并连同 fil-femminil“用阴性形式”一起记忆；这里说的是词的语法类别。

gloss_zh: 阴性的；女性的；具有女性特征的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to women or feminine characteristics, or belonging to the feminine grammatical gender.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与女性或女性特征有关的；在语法上属于阴性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam man-nisa jew ma' karatteristiċi femminili, jew li hu tal-ġens grammatikali femminil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 女性的；具有女性特征的；语法上阴性的。

formal.mt: Il-kelma 'dar' hija nom femminili, għalhekk ngħidu 'dar kbira'.
formal.en: The word 'dar' is a feminine noun, so we say 'dar kbira'.
formal.zh: dar（房子）是阴性名词，因此我们说 dar kbira（一所大房子）。

colloquial.mt: Marija: 'Dar' hija nom femminili? Pawlu: Iva, għalhekk ngħidu 'dar kbira'.
colloquial.en: Marija: Is 'dar' a feminine noun? Pawlu: Yes, so we say 'dar kbira'.
colloquial.zh: Marija：dar 是阴性名词吗？Pawlu：是的，所以我们说 dar kbira。

messages.speaker: Marija (学生)
messages.zh: dar 是阴性名词吗？
messages.en: Is 'dar' a feminine noun?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，所以我们说 dar kbira。
messages.en: Yes, so we say 'dar kbira'.

cognitive_memory_aid: 并排记忆 femminil“阴性这一类别”和 femminili“阴性的”：在 nom femminili 中，后者像中文“的”字短语一样修饰名词。

gloss_zh: 使筋疲力尽；使心力交瘁

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exhaust someone or wear them down, especially in spirit.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人精疲力竭或受到持续消耗，尤其指精神上心力交瘁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jgħejja ħafna lil xi ħadd jew jeżawrih, speċjalment fl-ispirtu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人筋疲力尽；耗尽某人的精力。

sense_translations.en_definition: to exhaust (somebody), to tire out (especially spiritually)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人疲惫不堪，尤其指使其精神疲惫、心力交瘁。

collocations.zh: 工作使 Mark 精疲力竭
忧虑使 Marija 心力交瘁

formal.mt: Ix-xogħol bla waqfien fena lil Mark, u kellu bżonn il-mistrieħ.
formal.en: The nonstop work exhausted Mark, and he needed rest.
formal.zh: 不停歇的工作使 Mark 精疲力竭，他需要休息。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Mark jidher daqshekk għajjien? Pawlu: Ix-xogħol fena lil Mark; għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why does Mark look so tired? Pawlu: Work has exhausted Mark; he needs to rest.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Mark 为什么看起来这么累？Pawlu：工作把 Mark 累坏了，他需要休息。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 为什么看起来这么累？
messages.en: Why does Mark look so tired?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ix-xogħol fena lil Mark; għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
