messages.mt_standard: Ix-xogħol fena lil Mark; għandu bżonn jistrieħ.
messages.zh: 工作把 Mark 累坏了，他需要休息。
messages.en: Work has exhausted Mark; he needs to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“工作或忧虑把人耗尽”的画面记 fena：让精力条逐渐清空，特别联想到精神疲惫；句中受累的人是动作的承受者。

gloss_zh: 招架；插上话；滚动；获利；插入词句

teaching_sense.en_definition: To get a word into a conversation; in another use, to roll an object, including a receptacle towards a mark in a traditional game.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在谈话中插上话；另一个用法是使物体滚动，包括在传统游戏中把容器滚向标记。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jirnexxilu jgħid kelma f'konversazzjoni; f'użu ieħor, li jgerbeb oġġett, fosthom reċipjent lejn marka f'logħba tradizzjonali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 招架；抵挡或应付。
插上话；在别人说话时找到机会说上一句。

sense_translations.en_definition: to roll a receptacle towards a mark (used in the context of a traditional game)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把容器滚向一个标记；用于传统游戏的语境。
使物体滚动；滚着移动或推进。
有利可图；能够带来收益。

sense_translations.en_definition: to interpolate (to introduce something, such as words, between other things, such as other words)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 插入；在已有内容之间加入词语等内容。

collocations.en: rolled the can towards the mark

formal.mt: Fil-logħba tradizzjonali, Mark fenda l-bott lejn il-marka.
formal.en: In the traditional game, Mark rolled the can towards the mark.
formal.zh: 在这项传统游戏中，Mark 把罐子滚向标记。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'għamel Mark fil-logħba? Pawlu: Fenda l-bott lejn il-marka, u waqaf qrib ħafna tagħha.
colloquial.en: Marija: What did Mark do in the game? Pawlu: He rolled the can towards the mark, and it stopped very close to it.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Mark 在游戏里做了什么？Pawlu：他把罐子滚向标记，罐子停在了离标记很近的地方。

messages.speaker: Marija (观众)
messages.zh: Mark 在游戏里做了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark do in the game?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fenda l-bott lejn il-marka, u waqaf qrib ħafna tagħha.
messages.mt_standard: Fenda l-bott lejn il-marka, u waqaf qrib ħafna tagħha.
messages.zh: 他把罐子滚向标记，罐子停在了离标记很近的地方。
messages.en: He rolled the can towards the mark, and it stopped very close to it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fenda 做分义卡片：“插话”配对话气泡，“滚动”配滚向标记的罐子，“获利”配收益；用语境分别提取，不把所有义项硬套成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A rabbit: a small mammal with long ears, a short tail, and strong hind legs.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 兔子；一种耳朵长、尾巴短、后腿有力的小型哺乳动物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal mammiferu żgħir b'widnejn twal, denb qasir u saqajn ta' wara b'saħħithom.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 兔子。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa jidher fenek abjad b'widnejn twal ħdejn siġra.
formal.en: The picture shows a white rabbit with long ears beside a tree.
formal.zh: 图片中，一只长耳朵的白兔在一棵树旁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Tara dak il-fenek ħdejn is-siġra? Pawlu: Iva, kemm hu żgħir! Għandu widnejn twal.
colloquial.en: Marija: Do you see that rabbit beside the tree? Pawlu: Yes, it's so small! It has long ears.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你看到树旁那只兔子了吗？Pawlu：看到了，真小啊！它的耳朵很长。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到树旁那只兔子了吗？
messages.en: Do you see that rabbit beside the tree?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kemm hu żgħir! Għandu widnejn twal.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kemm hu żgħir! Għandu widnejn twal.
messages.zh: 看到了，真小啊！它的耳朵很长。
messages.en: Yes, it's so small! It has long ears.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在 fenek 的词卡上画长耳朵、短尾巴的小兔，再配 fenek abjad“白兔”；把拼写、动物轮廓和短语同时记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure or wound someone, causing physical harm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人身体受伤；造成伤口或身体损伤。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jweġġa' lil xi ħadd jew jikkawżalu ferita fil-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 提出；提供。
出价；报价。
使受伤；使身体受到损伤或出现伤口。

formal.mt: Il-ħġieġ miksur fera lil Mark f'idu waqt li kien qed inaddaf il-kamra.
formal.en: The broken glass wounded Mark in the hand while he was cleaning the room.
formal.zh: Mark 打扫房间时，碎玻璃划伤了他的手。

colloquial.mt: Marija: X'ġara lil Mark? Pawlu: Il-ħġieġ miksur fera lil Mark f'idu waqt li kien qed inaddaf.
colloquial.en: Marija: What happened to Mark? Pawlu: The broken glass wounded Mark in the hand while he was cleaning.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Mark 怎么了？Pawlu：他打扫时，碎玻璃划伤了他的手。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: Mark 怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Mark?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħġieġ miksur fera lil Mark f'idu waqt li kien qed inaddaf.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħġieġ miksur fera lil Mark f'idu waqt li kien qed inaddaf.
messages.zh: 他打扫时，碎玻璃划伤了他的手。
messages.en: The broken glass wounded Mark in the hand while he was cleaning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fera 的“受伤”义配成“碎玻璃划伤手”的画面；“提出”和“出价”另设语境卡。尤其看清它没有 feraħ 末尾的 ħ，避免把受伤和高兴混淆。

gloss_zh: 分开；隔开；分出通路；给头发分缝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate or part things, move them apart to make a passage, or make a parting in someone's hair.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把事物分开、隔开，或使其向两边分开形成通路；也指给头发分缝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jifred affarijiet minn xulxin, iwarrabhom biex jiftaħ passaġġ, jew jagħmel firda fix-xagħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分开；使彼此分离。
使保持分开；撑开或隔开。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make a parting in one's hair
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给头发分缝；把头发沿一条线分向两侧。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pass through something, to split, part, e.g. the sea (of a boat), a crowd (of a person), hair (of a comb)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 穿过某物并使其分开，例如船破开海水、人穿开人群或梳子分开头发。
分开；分割；使分离。

collocations.en: parted his hair in the middle

formal.mt: Il-parrukkier feraq ix-xagħar ta' Mark fin-nofs qabel beda jaqtgħu.
formal.en: The hairdresser parted Mark's hair in the middle before starting to cut it.
formal.zh: 理发师开始剪发之前，先把 Mark 的头发分成中分。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif għamel il-parrukkier ix-xagħar tiegħek? Mark: Feraq xagħri fin-nofs, kif tlabtu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How did the hairdresser style your hair? Mark: He parted my hair in the middle, as I asked him to.
colloquial.zh: Marija：理发师给你做了什么发型？Mark：他按我的要求，把我的头发分成了中分。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 理发师给你做了什么发型？
messages.en: How did the hairdresser style your hair?

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.zh: 他按我的要求，把我的头发分成了中分。
messages.en: He parted my hair in the middle, as I asked him to.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 feraq 想成“中间出现一道分界”：头发向两侧分、人群让出通道、船分开水面，都可用分开的画面帮助记忆；具体含义仍看宾语。

gloss_zh: 感到高兴；祝贺；祝愿顺利

teaching_sense.en_definition: To feel happy or glad, or to congratulate someone and wish them well.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到高兴、欣喜；也可指向某人表示祝贺或送上美好祝愿。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss ferħ jew ikun kuntent, jew li jawgura lil xi ħadd u jifraħlu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 感到高兴；处于快乐的状态。
感到欣喜；因某事而高兴。
向某人表示祝贺。
祝愿某人顺利、幸福或一切安好。
感到高兴、喜悦；满怀欣喜。
表示祝贺；道贺。

formal.mt: Mark feraħ bl-aħbar li ħabibu għadda mill-eżami, u feraħ lil ħabibu għas-suċċess tiegħu.
formal.en: Mark was delighted by the news that his friend had passed the exam, and he congratulated his friend on his success.
formal.zh: Mark 得知朋友通过考试后很高兴，并向朋友祝贺这一成功。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Mark feraħ meta sema' li għaddejt mill-eżami? Pawlu: Iva, feraħ ħafna u qalli prosit!
colloquial.en: Marija: Was Mark happy when he heard that you had passed the exam? Pawlu: Yes, he was very happy and said well done!
colloquial.zh: Marija：Mark 听说你通过考试时高兴吗？Pawlu：是啊，他很高兴，还对我说“真棒”！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark feraħ meta sema' li għaddejt mill-eżami?
messages.mt_standard: Mark feraħ meta sema' li għaddejt mill-eżami?
messages.zh: Mark 听说你通过考试时高兴吗？
messages.en: Was Mark happy when he heard that you had passed the exam?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (考生)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, feraħ ħafna u qalli prosit!
messages.mt_standard: Iva, feraħ ħafna u qalli prosit!
messages.zh: 是啊，他很高兴，还对我说“真棒”！
messages.en: Yes, he was very happy and said well done!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“听到好消息先高兴，再向朋友道贺”的连续画面记 feraħ：一个词串起自己的喜悦和对别人的祝贺，并特别保留末尾字母 ħ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A part growing out from a tree; also a branch of an organization or a subsidiary company.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从树干长出的枝条；也指机构的分支或子公司。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti li toħroġ miz-zokk ta' siġra; ukoll taqsima ta' organizzazzjoni jew kumpanija sussidjarja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分支；可指树枝或机构的分支。
树枝；细枝。
子公司；隶属于另一家公司的企业。

formal.mt: Il-bank ħabbar li se jiftaħ fergħa ġdida biex jaqdi lir-residenti taż-żona.
formal.en: The bank announced that it would open a new branch to serve the area's residents.
formal.zh: 银行宣布将开设一家新分行，为该地区的居民提供服务。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara dik il-fergħa miksura. Mark: Iva, ejja ma noqogħdux taħtha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at that broken branch. Mark: Yes, let's not stand under it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看那根断裂的树枝。马克：是啊，我们别站在它下面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看那根断裂的树枝。
messages.en: Look at that broken branch.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，我们别站在它下面。
messages.en: Yes, let's not stand under it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把树干伸出的枝条与银行伸向各区的分行并排想象，用同一幅分支图记住这个词；子公司义另作公司关系理解。

gloss_zh: 放肆行事；表现傲慢；出汗、咒骂

teaching_sense.en_definition: To behave without restraint or act arrogantly; other supplied senses are to sweat or curse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 行为不加约束、放肆，或表现得傲慢；其他所列义项为出汗或咒骂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu bla rażan jew b'arroganza; f'tifsiriet oħra, jagħraq jew jisħet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 行为不加约束；放肆行事。
表现得傲慢；态度目中无人。
出汗；咒骂。

collocations.en: behaved without restraint during the meeting
acted without restraint and began shouting

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel fergħen waqt il-laqgħa u ma ħalliex lill-oħrajn jitkellmu.
formal.en: According to the report, the man behaved without restraint during the meeting and did not let the others speak.
formal.zh: 据报告所述，该男子在会议期间行为放肆，不让其他人发言。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex telaq kulħadd? Mark: Għax Pawlu fergħen u beda jgħajjat.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did everyone leave? Mark: Because Pawlu behaved without restraint and started shouting.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：大家为什么都走了？马克：因为保罗放肆起来，开始大喊大叫。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 大家为什么都走了？
messages.en: Why did everyone leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax Pawlu fergħen u beda jgħajjat.
messages.mt_standard: Għax Pawlu fergħen u beda jgħajjat.
messages.zh: 因为保罗放肆起来，开始大喊大叫。
messages.en: Because Pawlu behaved without restraint and started shouting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用会议上有人抢话、大喊的画面记住放肆义，再把傲慢、出汗、咒骂分别写成义项卡片，不把它们强串成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A wicked or unscrupulous person; also a devil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 邪恶或不讲道德的人；也可指魔鬼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna ħażina jew bla skrupli; ukoll xitan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 恶人；心地邪恶的人。
魔鬼；恶魔。
邪恶之人；行事不择手段、没有道德顾忌的人。
一个魔鬼；一个恶魔。

collocations.en: a devil in the fairy tale

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-kittieb ipinġi lill-ħakkiem bħala fergħun li jqarraq bin-nies biex jikseb il-poter.
formal.en: In the story, the writer portrays the ruler as a wicked person who deceives people to gain power.
formal.zh: 在故事中，作者把统治者描写成一个为获取权力而欺骗民众的恶人。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min hu dak il-karattru fil-ktieb? Toni: Huwa fergħun li jipprova jbeżża' lit-tfal.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who is that character in the book? Toni: He is a devil who tries to frighten the children.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：书里的那个角色是谁？托尼：他是一个企图吓唬孩子们的魔鬼。

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.zh: 书里的那个角色是谁？
messages.en: Who is that character in the book?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa fergħun li jipprova jbeżża' lit-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa fergħun li jipprova jbeżża' lit-tfal.
messages.zh: 他是一个企图吓唬孩子们的魔鬼。
messages.en: He is a devil who tries to frighten the children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两张角色卡，一张写现实中的无良恶人，一张画故事里的魔鬼；两张都标上这个名词，帮助区分人物评价与幻想角色。

gloss_zh: 面包炉拨火长木杆；干草叉

teaching_sense.en_definition: A long piece of wood used to stir fuel in a baker's oven; also a pitchfork.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于拨动面包炉内燃料的长木杆；也指干草叉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa injam twila li tintuża biex jitqalleb il-fjuwil fil-forn tal-furnar; ukoll għodda bis-snien biex jintrefa' l-ħuxlief.

sense_translations.en_definition: long piece of wood used to stir the fuel in a baker's oven
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用于拨动面包师烤炉内燃料的长木杆。
干草叉；用于叉起干草等物料的长柄叉。

collocations.zh: 面包师使用的拨火长木杆

formal.mt: Il-furnar uża ferkun biex iqalleb il-fjuwil fil-forn qabel beda jaħmi l-ħobż.
formal.en: The baker used a long wooden tool to stir the fuel in the oven before he began baking the bread.
formal.zh: 面包师开始烤面包前，用一根拨火长木杆翻动了炉内的燃料。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Biex se niġbru dan il-ħuxlief? Toni: Bil-ferkun. Qiegħed ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Mark: What shall we use to gather this hay? Toni: The pitchfork. It's by the door.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我们用什么收拢这些干草？托尼：用干草叉。它就在门边。

messages.speaker: Mark (农场帮工)
messages.zh: 我们用什么收拢这些干草？
messages.en: What shall we use to gather this hay?

messages.speaker: Toni (农场主)
messages.zh: 用干草叉。它就在门边。
messages.en: The pitchfork. It's by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个工具使用场景：面包炉里用长木杆拨燃料，农场里用长柄叉搬干草；以使用地点区分同一词的两个工具义。

gloss_zh: 很；非常；强壮结实的；稳定持久的

teaching_sense.en_definition: To a high degree or very much, used to strengthen a description or comparison.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示程度很高，用来加强描述或比较，相当于很、非常或……得多。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fi grad għoli, biex isaħħaħ deskrizzjoni jew paragun; ħafna jew wisq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 很；非常，用于加强程度。
非常；很大程度上。
强壮的；体格结实的。
稳定的；恒定的；持续不变的。

formal.mt: Huwa ferm importanti li l-istudenti jaqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel jibdew l-eżerċizzju.
formal.en: It is very important for students to read the instructions before starting the exercise.
formal.zh: 学生在开始练习之前阅读说明非常重要。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ktieb huwa aktar faċli mill-ieħor? Mark: Iva, huwa ferm aktar faċli, u l-eżempji huma ċari.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this book easier than the other one? Mark: Yes, it is much easier, and the examples are clear.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这本书比另一本容易吗？马克：是的，容易得多，而且例子很清楚。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-ktieb huwa aktar faċli mill-ieħor?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-ktieb huwa aktar faċli mill-ieħor?
messages.zh: 这本书比另一本容易吗？
messages.en: Is this book easier than the other one?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa ferm aktar faċli, u l-eżempji huma ċari.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa ferm aktar faċli, u l-eżempji huma ċari.
messages.zh: 是的，容易得多，而且例子很清楚。
messages.en: Yes, it is much easier, and the examples are clear.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferm 想成程度旋钮：放在重要前是非常重要，放在更好前是好得多；另用形容词卡单独记强壮和稳定两义。

gloss_zh: 明亮地燃烧；火焰熊熊燃起

teaching_sense.en_definition: To burn brightly or blaze, said of a fire.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指火明亮地燃烧，呈现熊熊火焰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħraq b'dawl qawwi jew b'fjamma qawwija, meta jingħad għan-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 明亮地燃烧；燃烧时发出强烈光亮。
指火熊熊燃烧；火焰旺盛地燃起。

formal.mt: Meta żdied l-injam niexef, in-nar fernaq u dawwal il-kamra kollha.
formal.en: When dry wood was added, the fire blazed and lit up the whole room.
formal.zh: 添入干木柴后，火熊熊燃烧起来，照亮了整个房间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ara kif fernaq in-nar! Toni: Iva, l-injam kien niexef ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Look how brightly the fire flared up! Toni: Yes, the wood was very dry.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：看，火一下子烧得多旺！托尼：是啊，木柴特别干。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 看，火一下子烧得多旺！
messages.en: Look how brightly the fire flared up!

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，木柴特别干。
messages.en: Yes, the wood was very dry.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象壁炉添入干柴后，火焰突然明亮、照亮整间屋子的画面；把这个词与旺盛发亮的燃烧动作一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pour a substance from a container, or to empty a container of its contents.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把容器里的东西倒出来，或把容器倒空。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ il-kontenut minn reċipjent billi jmejlu, jew ibattal reċipjent mill-kontenut tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 倒；倾倒。
倒空；清空里面的东西。
分枝；向不同方向伸展。
生出；长出；产生。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem ferragħ l-ilma mill-barmil għal ġo kontenitur akbar.
formal.en: The worker poured the water from the bucket into a larger container.
formal.zh: 工人把桶里的水倒进一个更大的容器。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ferragħ l-ilma kollu fil-borma? Mark: Jien. Issa l-flixkun vojt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who poured all the water into the pot? Mark: I did. The bottle is empty now.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把水全倒进锅里了？Mark：我倒的。现在瓶子空了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把水全倒进锅里了？
messages.en: Who poured all the water into the pot?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我倒的。现在瓶子空了。
messages.en: I did. The bottle is empty now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferragħ 和倾斜水桶的画面绑定：接水的是倒入，原来的桶则被倒空；用同一动作记住两个常用义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate people or things, including keeping people who are fighting apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或物分开，也可指把打架的人拉开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred nies jew affarijiet minn xulxin, ukoll meta jżomm nies li qed jiġġieldu 'l bogħod minn xulxin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分开；使彼此分离。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hold apart (used of people in a fight who are separated)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把打架的人拉开，并使他们保持距离。

sense_translations.en_definition: to interpose (to intervene in a dispute, or in a conversation)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 介入争执或谈话；从中干预或插话。
分发；分配。

formal.mt: L-għalliem ferraq liż-żewġ studenti li kienu qed jiġġieldu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The teacher separated the two students who were fighting in the playground.
formal.zh: 老师把在操场上打架的两名学生拉开了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ferraq il-karti qabel il-laqgħa? Mark: Jien. Poġġejt waħda fuq kull siġġu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who distributed the papers before the meeting? Mark: I did. I put one on each chair.
colloquial.zh: Maja：开会前是谁分发的纸张？Mark：我发的。我在每把椅子上放了一张。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 开会前是谁分发的纸张？
messages.en: Who distributed the papers before the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Poġġejt waħda fuq kull siġġu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Poġġejt waħda fuq kull siġġu.
messages.zh: 我发的。我在每把椅子上放了一张。
messages.en: I did. I put one on each chair.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个具体动作记 ferraq：双手把争吵的人分开，再把一叠纸分给大家；分别对应分开和分发。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone feel happy or bring them joy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到高兴，给某人带来喜悦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħossu kuntent jew jagħtih il-ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人高兴。
使喜悦；使欣慰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to bear young ones (used of animals)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 产仔；生下幼崽，用于动物。
结果；结出果实。
使振作；使开心。
繁殖后代；产下幼崽。

formal.mt: Is-suċċess tal-proġett ferraħ lill-membri kollha tat-tim.
formal.en: The success of the project brought joy to all the team members.
formal.zh: 项目的成功让全体团队成员感到高兴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ir-rigal tiegħek ferraħ lil ħija ħafna. Mark: Tajjeb! Kont naf li jħobb il-kotba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Your present made my brother very happy. Mark: Great! I knew he liked books.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你的礼物让我弟弟特别高兴。Mark：太好了！我知道他喜欢书。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ir-rigal tiegħek ferraħ lil ħija ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Ir-rigal tiegħek ferraħ lil ħija ħafna.
messages.zh: 你的礼物让我弟弟特别高兴。
messages.en: Your present made my brother very happy.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb! Kont naf li jħobb il-kotba.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb! Kont naf li jħobb il-kotba.
messages.zh: 太好了！我知道他喜欢书。
messages.en: Great! I knew he liked books.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 ferraħ 就想象送礼后对方露出笑容，记住它表示让别人高兴这一动作；产仔和结果另用动物、果树画面记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To scatter or spread something over an area or surface, or to make something reach more people or places.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西撒开或铺在某个范围、表面上，也可指使事物传播到更多人或地方。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iferrak jew iqassam xi ħaġa fuq żona jew wiċċ, jew iwassalha għand aktar nies jew f'aktar postijiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 驱散；使分散。
撒开；撒散。
散布；传播；铺开。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread out; to spread something over a surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 摊开；把某物铺撒或涂抹在表面上。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread; to increase the area of influence of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 传播；扩大某事物的影响范围。

formal.mt: Il-ġardinar ferrex iż-żerriegħa fuq il-ħamrija niedja.
formal.en: The gardener scattered the seeds over the moist soil.
formal.zh: 园丁把种子撒在湿润的土壤上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min ferrex l-aħbar dwar il-festa? Mark: Jien għedt lil sħabi, u huma qalu lill-oħrajn.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who spread the news about the party? Mark: I told my friends, and they told the others.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把聚会的消息传开了？Mark：我告诉了朋友，他们又告诉了其他人。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把聚会的消息传开了？
messages.en: Who spread the news about the party?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien għedt lil sħabi, u huma qalu lill-oħrajn.
messages.mt_standard: Jien għedt lil sħabi, u huma qalu lill-oħrajn.
messages.zh: 我告诉了朋友，他们又告诉了其他人。
messages.en: I told my friends, and they told the others.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferrex 画成由一点向四周散开的箭头：种子撒向土地，消息传向人群，帮助联记具体散布和抽象传播。

gloss_zh: 无忧无虑的；快活的；喜悦的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cheerful and happy, often with a carefree attitude.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心情愉快、性情快活的，常带有无忧无虑的意味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħoss jew juri ferħ u spiss ma joqgħodx jinkwieta ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无忧无虑的；不大为事情操心的。
快活的；乐呵呵的。
高兴的；喜悦的；快乐的。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, it-tifel ferrieħ jilqa' kull ġurnata bi tbissima.
formal.en: In the story, the cheerful boy welcomes each day with a smile.
formal.zh: 在故事中，那个快活的男孩每天都带着微笑迎接新的一天。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk dejjem ferrieħ hekk? Mark: Iva, dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ġġiegħlu jidħak.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother always this cheerful? Mark: Yes, he always finds something that makes him laugh.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥总是这么快活吗？Mark：是啊，他总能找到让自己发笑的事情。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥总是这么快活吗？
messages.en: Is your brother always this cheerful?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ġġiegħlu jidħak.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, dejjem isib xi ħaġa li ġġiegħlu jidħak.
messages.zh: 是啊，他总能找到让自己发笑的事情。
messages.en: Yes, he always finds something that makes him laugh.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferrieħ 贴在一个总带笑容、很少发愁的人物旁边，记住它描述人的快乐状态或性情，是形容词。

gloss_zh: 无忧无虑的；有活力的；欢快的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Cheerful, joyous, or lively in mood or manner.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 心情或表现欢快、喜悦、有活力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li juri ferħ, ħeġġa jew enerġija fl-imġiba tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 无忧无虑的；乐天的。
精力充沛的；有活力的。
欢快的；愉悦的，此处指快乐的情绪或气氛。
高兴的；喜悦的；快乐的。

formal.mt: L-attur deher fuq il-palk b'wiċċ ferrieħi u sellem lill-udjenza.
formal.en: The actor appeared on stage with a cheerful face and greeted the audience.
formal.zh: 演员满面笑容地走上舞台，向观众致意。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Illum tidher ferrieħi ħafna! Mark: Iva, għadni kif irċevejt aħbar tajba.
colloquial.en: Maja: You look very cheerful today! Mark: Yes, I have just received some good news.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你今天看起来特别开心！Mark：是啊，我刚收到一个好消息。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 你今天看起来特别开心！
messages.en: You look very cheerful today!

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għadni kif irċevejt aħbar tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għadni kif irċevejt aħbar tajba.
messages.zh: 是啊，我刚收到一个好消息。
messages.en: Yes, I have just received some good news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用笑脸加轻快步伐来记 ferrieħi：笑脸提示欢喜，步伐提示活力；它与 ferrieħ 的快乐义有重叠，不必强行划清界限。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A railway transport system or a train that runs on railway tracks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 铁路运输系统，也可指在铁轨上行驶的火车。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sistema ta' trasport fuq il-binarji, jew il-vettura li timxi fuqhom u ġġorr passiġġieri jew merkanzija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 铁路。
火车；列车。
铁路；铁路运输系统。
火车；作为交通工具的列车。

formal.mt: Il-ferrovija telqet mill-istazzjon fid-disgħa ta' filgħodu u waslet fil-belt fil-ħdax.
formal.en: The train left the station at nine in the morning and arrived in the city at eleven.
formal.zh: 火车上午九点离站，十一点抵达该市。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta titlaq il-ferrovija tagħna? Mark: Fl-għaxra. Għandna ħin nixtru l-biljetti.
colloquial.en: Maja: When does our train leave? Mark: At ten. We have time to buy the tickets.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们坐的火车什么时候开？Mark：十点。我们还有时间买票。

messages.speaker: Maja (同行旅客)
messages.zh: 我们坐的火车什么时候开？
messages.en: When does our train leave?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行旅客)
messages.zh: 十点。我们还有时间买票。
messages.en: At ten. We have time to buy the tickets.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferrovija 放进一张铁路旅行图：看整条运输线路时记铁路，看正在进站的车辆时记火车，再配火车站和车票一起复习。

gloss_zh: 喜悦；幸福；后代；幼兽，尤指小猫

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of joy or happiness; in a separate sense, offspring or a young animal, especially a kitten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 喜悦或幸福的感受；另一个独立义项指后代或幼小动物，尤其是小猫。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' hena jew kuntentizza; f'tifsira oħra, wild jew annimal żgħir, speċjalment qattus żgħir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦；欢喜。
幸福；快乐。
后代；所生的幼体。
幼崽；幼小动物。
喜悦；欣喜；幸福快乐。

sense_translations.en_definition: a young animal, especially a kitten
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一只幼小动物，尤其指一只小猫。

formal.mt: L-aħbar tas-suċċess tal-istudenti ġabet ferħ kbir lill-familji tagħhom.
formal.en: The news of the students' success brought great joy to their families.
formal.zh: 学生们取得成功的消息给他们的家人带来了巨大的喜悦。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara, ferħ ta' qattus ħdejn il-bieb! Mark: Kemm hu żgħir! Ejja nfittxu lil ommu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look, a kitten by the door! Mark: It's so small! Let's look for its mother.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，门边有一只小猫！马克：它好小啊！我们找找它妈妈吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, ferħ ta' qattus ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.mt_standard: Ara, ferħ ta' qattus ħdejn il-bieb!
messages.zh: 看，门边有一只小猫！
messages.en: Look, a kitten by the door!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu żgħir! Ejja nfittxu lil ommu.
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu żgħir! Ejja nfittxu lil ommu.
messages.zh: 它好小啊！我们找找它妈妈吧。
messages.en: It's so small! Let's look for its mother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给这个词做双面卡：正面是收到好消息后的喜悦，背面是一只小猫；用情绪与幼兽两幅图分别记忆，读句子时依语境选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling happy, glad, or full of joy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到高兴、欣喜或充满喜悦的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jħossu kuntent jew mimli ferħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 高兴的；快乐的。
欣喜的；充满喜悦的；快乐的。

formal.mt: Fl-ittra tiegħu, l-istudent kiteb li kien ferħan bir-riżultat tal-eżami.
formal.en: In his letter, the student wrote that he was happy with his examination result.
formal.zh: 这名学生在信中写道，他对自己的考试成绩感到高兴。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kif qed tħossok wara l-eżami? Mark: Ferħan ħafna! Għaddejt!
colloquial.en: Lara: How are you feeling after the exam? Mark: Very happy! I passed!
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：考完试后你感觉怎么样？马克：特别高兴！我通过了！

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 考完试后你感觉怎么样？
messages.en: How are you feeling after the exam?

messages.speaker: Mark (男学生)
messages.zh: 特别高兴！我通过了！
messages.en: Very happy! I passed!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ferħ 的喜悦名词义与 ferħan 的高兴形容词义配成学习卡：一个写心中的喜悦，一个写人的高兴状态，借词形相似帮助辨认词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap something closely, or to remove the shell, husk, or pod from something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物紧紧包裹起来，或去掉某物的壳、外皮、荚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Igeżwer xi ħaġa sewwa, jew ineħħi l-qoxra jew il-miżwed minn xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裹住；用布等包扎或包裹起来。
包；包裹。

sense_translations.en_definition: to remove shell, husk or pod
sense_translations.zh_definition: 去掉壳、外皮或荚。
剥壳；去皮；脱壳。

formal.mt: Il-kok fesdaq il-piżelli qabel żiedhom mas-soppa.
formal.en: The cook shelled the peas before adding them to the soup.
formal.zh: 厨师先剥好豌豆，再把它们加进汤里。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min fesdaq il-piżelli kollha? Mark: Jien. Issa nistgħu nibdew insajru.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who shelled all the peas? Mark: I did. Now we can start cooking.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把豌豆都剥好了？Mark：我剥的。现在可以开始做饭了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把豌豆都剥好了？
messages.en: Who shelled all the peas?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我剥的。现在可以开始做饭了。
messages.en: I did. Now we can start cooking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fesdaq 配两张学习卡：一张用布裹住婴儿，一张打开豆荚取出豌豆；靠宾语和场景区分包裹与剥壳两组意思。

gloss_zh: 低声耳语；说闲话；发出嘶嘶声

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say something very quietly, often so that only someone nearby can hear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用很轻的声音说话，常指只让身旁的人听见的耳语。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħid xi ħaġa b'leħen baxx ħafna, spiss biex jismagħha biss xi ħadd qrib tiegħek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 低声说；耳语
说闲话；议论他人的私事
发出嘶嘶声

formal.mt: Waqt il-laqgħa, is-segretarju fesfes f'widnet il-president biex ma jinterrompix id-diskussjoni.
formal.en: During the meeting, the secretary whispered in the president's ear so as not to interrupt the discussion.
formal.zh: 会议期间，秘书在主席耳边低声说话，以免打断讨论。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'fesfes Mark f'widnek? Lara: Qalli li ċ-ċwievet qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Maja: What did Mark whisper in your ear? Lara: He told me that the keys are on the table.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克在你耳边低声说了什么？拉拉：他告诉我钥匙在桌上。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在你耳边低声说了什么？
messages.en: What did Mark whisper in your ear?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qalli li ċ-ċwievet qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
messages.mt_standard: Qalli li ċ-ċwievet qegħdin fuq il-mejda.
messages.zh: 他告诉我钥匙在桌上。
messages.en: He told me that the keys are on the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fesfes 的重复音节当作轻声练习口令：先想象贴近耳边小声说话，再联想到窃窃私语和嘶嘶声；这只是记忆联想。

gloss_zh: 节庆；主保圣人庆典；聚会；圣名日；假期

teaching_sense.en_definition: A celebration or festive occasion, especially a local feast honouring a patron saint.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 庆祝活动或节庆场合，尤其指地方上为纪念主保圣人而举行的庆典。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ċelebrazzjoni jew okkażjoni ta' ferħ, speċjalment dik li ssir f'raħal jew belt ad unur il-qaddis patrun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 盛宴；节日庆典

sense_translations.en_definition: village feast dedicated to a patron saint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 村镇为纪念主保圣人而举行的节庆
欢庆活动；节庆
盛宴；庆祝活动；聚会
圣名日，即与本人名字相对应的圣人的纪念日
假日；假期

formal.mt: Il-programm tal-festa tar-raħal jinkludi purċissjoni u kunċert fil-pjazza.
formal.en: The programme for the village feast includes a procession and a concert in the square.
formal.zh: 村庄节庆的活动安排包括巡游和广场音乐会。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Se tiġi għall-festa tar-raħal illejla? Nina: Iva, niltaqgħu ħdejn il-knisja fit-tmienja.
colloquial.en: Mark: Are you coming to the village feast tonight? Nina: Yes, let's meet near the church at eight.
colloquial.zh: 马克：你今晚来参加村里的节庆吗？妮娜：来，我们八点在教堂旁边见吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今晚来参加村里的节庆吗？
messages.en: Are you coming to the village feast tonight?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 来，我们八点在教堂旁边见吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's meet near the church at eight.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张节庆日历记 festa：村庄庆典、生日聚会、圣名日和假日都放进日历格；读句子时再由搭配判断具体是哪一种。

gloss_zh: 撕开；拆线；患疝气；使失去童贞

teaching_sense.en_definition: To open a sewn seam by undoing or tearing its stitches.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 拆开或扯断缝线，使缝合处打开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiftaħ ħjata billi tħoll jew tqatta' l-punti tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 撕开；扯破
拆线；拆开缝合处
患上疝气；出现疝

sense_translations.en_definition: to unstitch, unseam, rip the seam of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆掉缝线；拆开或扯开……的接缝
使（某人）失去童贞

formal.mt: Il-ħajjat fetaq il-ħjata tal-ġakketta biex ibiddel il-kisja ta' ġewwa.
formal.en: The tailor unpicked the jacket's seam to replace the lining.
formal.zh: 裁缝拆开了夹克的接缝，以便更换内衬。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħajjat fetaq il-ħjata? Mark: Iva, għax ried ibiddel il-forma tal-kmiem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the tailor unpick the seam? Mark: Yes, because he wanted to change the shape of the sleeves.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：裁缝把接缝拆开了吗？马克：拆开了，因为他想改一下袖子的形状。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 裁缝把接缝拆开了吗？
messages.en: Did the tailor unpick the seam?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għax ried ibiddel il-forma tal-kmiem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għax ried ibiddel il-forma tal-kmiem.
messages.zh: 拆开了，因为他想改一下袖子的形状。
messages.en: Yes, because he wanted to change the shape of the sleeves.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 fetaq 和“拆开接缝”的动作绑定：手指挑出缝线，布料随之分开。疝气和性相关义另设词义卡，不把拆线画面当成它们的定义。

gloss_zh: 说话含糊；结巴；咬字不清

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak indistinctly or with interruptions and repeated sounds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 说话含糊不清，或说话时出现停顿、语音重复等结巴现象。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Titkellem b'mod mhux ċar jew b'waqfiet u ripetizzjoni ta' ħsejjes.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 说话含糊；吐字不清
结巴；口吃
结巴；因某些语音发音不清而咬字含混

formal.mt: Waqt il-preżentazzjoni, l-istudent fetfet għall-ewwel, iżda kompla jitkellem bil-kalma.
formal.en: During the presentation, the student initially stuttered but continued speaking calmly.
formal.zh: 作报告时，这名学生起初有些结巴，但随后继续平静地讲了下去。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Mark fetfet meta wieġeb? Maja: Iva, stennejna sakemm spiċċa jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did Mark stutter when he answered? Maja: Yes, we waited until he finished speaking.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：马克回答时结巴了吗？玛雅：是的，我们等他把话说完。

messages.speaker: Nina (同学)
messages.zh: 马克回答时结巴了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark stutter when he answered?

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 是的，我们等他把话说完。
messages.en: Yes, we waited until he finished speaking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看见 fetfet 的重复字形，就用它提醒自己“话音可能重复或不够清楚”；同时区分 fesfes 的低声耳语，音量小并不等于说话结巴。

gloss_zh: 反复缝拆；拆线；逐点挑剔；吹毛求疵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To repeatedly work over sewing by stitching and unstitching, or to pick at details in work or an argument.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缝了又拆、反复修改针线活；也指对工作或论证的细节反复挑剔。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Terġa' taħdem fuq ħjata billi tħit u tħoll il-punti, jew toqgħod issib difetti fid-dettalji ta' xogħol jew argument.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 缝了又拆、拆了又缝
在争论中逐点挑剔或反驳

sense_translations.en_definition: to fuss over a piece of work
sense_translations.zh_definition: 对一件活计反复琢磨、挑剔或修改
对细节或规则极其较真

sense_translations.en_definition: to unstitch, unseam, rip the seam of
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拆掉缝线；拆开或扯开……的接缝
挑小毛病；吹毛求疵

formal.mt: Fir-reviżjoni tiegħu, il-kritiku fettaq l-argument tal-awtur u ddiskuta kull dettall separatament.
formal.en: In his review, the critic picked apart the author's argument and discussed each detail separately.
formal.zh: 评论者在评论中逐点剖析并挑剔了作者的论证，对每个细节分别作了讨论。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Kif mar ix-xogħol ma' Mark? Lara: Fettaq fuq kull dettall, anki fuq il-kulur tat-titlu.
colloquial.en: Nina: How did the work with Mark go? Lara: He nitpicked every detail, even the colour of the title.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：和马克一起做事怎么样？拉拉：他每个细节都要挑，连标题的颜色也不放过。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 和马克一起做事怎么样？
messages.en: How did the work with Mark go?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Fettaq fuq kull dettall, anki fuq il-kulur tat-titlu.
messages.mt_standard: Fettaq fuq kull dettall, anki fuq il-kulur tat-titlu.
messages.zh: 他每个细节都要挑，连标题的颜色也不放过。
messages.en: He nitpicked every detail, even the colour of the title.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“缝一针、拆一针”的反复动作记 fettaq，再联想到讨论中逐点挑细节。把双写 t 当作拼写提醒；这不是词形规则或词源解释。

gloss_zh: 扩大开口；展开论述；摇动使混合

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make an existing opening wider; also to develop an explanation or argument in greater detail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把已有的开口扩大；也可指进一步展开说明或论证。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel fetħa eżistenti usa'; ukoll tiżviluppa spjegazzjoni jew argument b'aktar dettall.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 扩大开口
在论证中详细阐述
把开口加宽
进一步展开说明；详细阐述
摇动；摇晃使混合

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fettaħ il-fetħa fil-ħajt biex ikun jista' jgħaddi pajp akbar.

formal.zh: 工人扩大了墙上的开口，以便让更粗的管道穿过去。

colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he widen the hole? Mark: Because the new pipe wouldn't fit through it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么把孔扩大了？马克：因为新管子穿不过去。

messages.speaker: Maja (住户)

messages.en: Why did he widen the hole?

messages.speaker: Mark (维修工)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax il-pajp il-ġdid ma kienx jgħaddi minnha.
messages.mt_standard: Għax il-pajp il-ġdid ma kienx jgħaddi minnha.

gloss_zh: 弄温；加热至微温；缠绕；扭转；争吵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To warm something gently until it is lukewarm rather than hot.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物稍稍加热，使其达到温而不烫的程度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Issaħħan xi ħaġa ftit sakemm issir fietla, mingħajr ma ssir taħraq.

sense_translations.en_definition: to warm up to a mild temperature
sense_translations.zh_definition: 稍稍加热至温和的温度
缠绕；绞合
争吵；发生口角
扭转；捻拧
使某物变得微温、温而不烫

formal.mt: Il-kok fettel il-ħalib qabel ma żied il-ħmira mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The cook warmed the milk until it was lukewarm before adding the yeast to the mixture.
formal.zh: 厨师先把牛奶加热至微温，再把酵母加入混合物。

colloquial.en: Maja: Did Mark warm the milk until it was lukewarm? Nina: Yes, it's lukewarm now and ready for you to drink.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克把牛奶热温了吗？妮娜：热好了，现在温温的，你可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克把牛奶热温了吗？
messages.en: Did Mark warm the milk until it was lukewarm?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa hu fietel u lest biex tixorbu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa hu fietel u lest biex tixorbu.
messages.zh: 热好了，现在温温的，你可以喝了。
messages.en: Yes, it's lukewarm now and ready for you to drink.

gloss_zh: 把饼干、面包等浸入咖啡或茶；把面包等切成片

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dip biscuits, bread or rusks into coffee or tea; also, to slice bread or cut something into slices.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把饼干、面包或烤面包干浸入咖啡或茶中；也表示切面包，或把某物切成片。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把饼干、面包或烤面包干等浸入咖啡或茶中。

colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：这块饼干太硬了。保罗：把饼干浸到茶里，让它软一点。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)

gloss_zh: 小事；无足轻重或价值不大的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small matter or thing that has little importance or value.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaġa żgħira li ftit għandha importanza jew valur.
