cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把烦恼写在一张很小的便条上：事情小、分量轻，用这个画面记住“小事、无足轻重之物”。

gloss_zh: 开口；缺口；空隙；漏洞；通气孔；运气；自豪；腹泻

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening or gap through which something can pass.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可供物体、空气等通过的开口、缺口或空隙。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju miftuħ jew vojt li minnu tista' tgħaddi xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 开口；孔口
破口；被突破而形成的缺口
间隙；缺口
可供利用的漏洞
通气孔；排气口
敞开的地方；空隙；缺口
运气
自豪；骄傲
腹泻；拉肚子

formal.mt: Il-pjanta turi fetħa fil-ħajt biex l-arja tkun tista' tgħaddi bejn iż-żewġ kmamar.
formal.en: The plan shows an opening in the wall to allow air to pass between the two rooms.
formal.zh: 平面图标出了墙上的一个开口，让空气能在两个房间之间流通。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Minn fejn dieħla l-arja kiesħa? Mark: Hemm fetħa żgħira ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where is the cold air coming in from? Mark: There's a small gap near the window.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：冷风从哪里进来的？马克：窗户旁边有条小缝。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 冷风从哪里进来的？
messages.en: Where is the cold air coming in from?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 窗户旁边有条小缝。
messages.en: There's a small gap near the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画墙上的一个开口来记 fetħa，再分别标上缺口、空隙和通气孔。运气、自豪、腹泻另列三张词义卡，避免用同一幅图硬套全部意思。

gloss_zh: 打嗝；使人打嗝；给婴儿拍嗝

teaching_sense.en_definition: To release air from the stomach through the mouth, or to help someone, especially a baby, do this.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使胃里的气体从口中排出，即打嗝；也指帮助他人，尤其是婴儿，排出胃里的气体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħareġ arja mill-istonku minn ħalqu, jew għen lil xi ħadd, speċjalment tarbija, jagħmel hekk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打嗝；使胃中的气体从口中排出。
使某人打嗝，尤指给婴儿拍嗝以帮助排气。

formal.mt: Il-missier fewwaq lit-tarbija wara li xorbot il-ħalib.
formal.en: The father burped the baby after she drank her milk.
formal.zh: 婴儿喝完奶后，父亲给她拍了嗝。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex daħaq Ben? Pawlu: Għax fewwaq wara li xorob il-luminata.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did Ben laugh? Pawlu: Because he burped after drinking the lemonade.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：本为什么笑了？保罗：因为他喝完柠檬汽水后打了个嗝。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 本为什么笑了？
messages.en: Why did Ben laugh?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax fewwaq wara li xorob il-luminata.
messages.mt_standard: Għax fewwaq wara li xorob il-luminata.
messages.zh: 因为他喝完柠檬汽水后打了个嗝。
messages.en: Because he burped after drinking the lemonade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住胃里一口气从嘴里排出的画面：自己排气是打嗝，帮助宝宝排气是拍嗝，两种用法一起记。

gloss_zh: 使散发香气；茁壮生长；为求好处而奉承

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give something a pleasant smell or make a place smell fragrant.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物带有香味，或使某处弥漫令人愉快的香气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta riħa tajba lil xi ħaġa jew mela post b'riħa tfuħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物散发香气。
使带有香味；使变香。
茁壮生长；兴旺发展。

sense_translations.en_definition: to flatter someone to win a favour
sense_translations.zh_definition: 为了获得某人的帮助或好处而奉承对方。

formal.mt: Il-bukkett tal-fjuri fewwaħ il-kamra fejn saret il-laqgħa.
formal.en: The bouquet of flowers filled the room where the meeting was held with fragrance.
formal.zh: 这束鲜花使开会的房间弥漫着香气。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'riħa tajba hawn! Toni: Il-ġiżimin fewwaħ id-dar kollha.
colloquial.en: Sara: It smells lovely here! Toni: The jasmine has filled the whole house with fragrance.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这里真香！托尼：茉莉花让整个屋子都充满了香气。

messages.speaker: Sara (来访朋友)
messages.zh: 这里真香！
messages.en: It smells lovely here!

messages.speaker: Toni (主人)
messages.zh: 茉莉花让整个屋子都充满了香气。
messages.en: The jasmine has filled the whole house with fragrance.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“一束花让满屋变香”记主要义；另设“植物长得旺”和“求人先奉承”两张情境卡，分别记其他义。

gloss_zh: 微风轻吹；给房间通风；使空气流通

teaching_sense.en_definition: To blow gently, as a breeze does; also, to let fresh air circulate through a room or another space.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指微风轻轻吹动；也指让新鲜空气在房间或其他空间中流通。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nefaħ bil-mod, bħalma tagħmel fewġa; ukoll, ħalla arja friska tiċċirkola f'kamra jew f'post ieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to blow (used of a gentle breeze)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻轻吹动，用于描述微风。
给房间通风；让房间里的空气流通。
通风；使空气流通。

formal.mt: L-għalliem fewweġ il-klassi qabel il-bidu tal-lezzjoni.
formal.en: The teacher aired the classroom before the lesson began.
formal.zh: 老师在上课前给教室通了风。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Hawn ħafna sħana ġewwa. Anna: Fewweġ il-kamra; iftaħ iż-żewġ twieqi.
colloquial.en: Mark: It's very hot in here. Anna: Air the room; open both windows.
colloquial.zh: 马克：屋里太热了。安娜：给房间通通风，把两扇窗都打开。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 屋里太热了。
messages.en: It's very hot in here.

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.zh: 给房间通通风，把两扇窗都打开。
messages.en: Air the room; open both windows.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用开窗后的空气流动画面记忆：室外是微风轻吹，室内则是给房间通风，把两个场景并排联想。

gloss_zh: 散发香气的东西；芳香的；好闻的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that produces a pleasant smell or makes its surroundings smell sweet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 能散发悦人香气，或使周围环境变香的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tagħti riħa tajba jew tagħmel l-inħawi jfuħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: sth. that causes a sweet smell
sense_translations.zh_definition: 能产生香气或使环境变香的东西。
芳香的；气味好闻的。

formal.mt: Il-fewwieħ tal-kamra tqiegħed ħdejn id-daħla biex jagħti riħa pjaċevoli lill-ispazju.
formal.en: The room freshener was placed near the entrance to give the space a pleasant smell.
formal.zh: 室内芳香剂放在入口附近，让这个空间散发宜人的气味。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Xtrajt fewwieħ ġdid għall-kamra? Lara: Iva, għandu riħa tal-lumi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you buy a new room freshener? Lara: Yes, it has a lemon scent.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你给房间买了新的芳香剂吗？拉拉：是的，是柠檬香味的。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 你给房间买了新的芳香剂吗？
messages.en: Did you buy a new room freshener?

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 是的，是柠檬香味的。
messages.en: Yes, it has a lemon scent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把“香”分成物品和性质两张卡：名词指带来香气的东西，形容词说明某物闻起来香，读句子时先判断词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A gentle, light wind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 轻轻吹动的风，即微风或轻风。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Riħ ħafif li jonfoħ bil-mod.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 微风；轻柔的风。

formal.mt: Fewġa ħafifa mill-baħar għamlet il-mixja tul ix-xatt aktar pjaċevoli.
formal.en: A light breeze from the sea made the walk along the shore more pleasant.
formal.zh: 海上吹来的一阵微风，让沿岸散步更加惬意。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid noqogħdu barra? Mark: Iva, hemm fewġa friska hawn.
colloquial.en: Anna: Shall we sit outside? Mark: Yes, there's a cool breeze here.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我们坐外面好吗？马克：好，这里有凉爽的微风。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们坐外面好吗？
messages.en: Shall we sit outside?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，这里有凉爽的微风。
messages.en: Yes, there's a cool breeze here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗帘只轻轻摆动、脸上感觉微凉的画面，把这个词与轻柔的微风联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To come into view or become visible suddenly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 突然进入视野，或原本看不见的事物一下子显现出来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jidher f'daqqa jew isir viżibbli wara li ma kienx jidher.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 突然出现；一下子进入视野。
出现；显现，常带有突然出现的意味。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, dawl qawwi feġġ fuq l-orizzont.
formal.en: During the observation, a bright light suddenly appeared on the horizon.
formal.zh: 观测期间，地平线上突然出现了一道强光。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt min feġġ fil-bieb? Pawlu: Iva, kien Mark! Ma kontx qed nistennieh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see who suddenly appeared at the door? Pawlu: Yes, it was Mark! I wasn't expecting him.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你看到谁突然出现在门口了吗？保罗：看到了，是马克！我没想到他会来。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你看到谁突然出现在门口了吗？
messages.en: Did you see who suddenly appeared at the door?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien Mark! Ma kontx qed nistennieh.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien Mark! Ma kontx qed nistennieh.
messages.zh: 看到了，是马克！我没想到他会来。
messages.en: Yes, it was Mark! I wasn't expecting him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象空空的门口突然冒出一位朋友，用这个“突然入镜”的画面记住 feġġ。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Work or action, including something that a person has done.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 工作或行动，也可指某人已经做出的事情。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xogħol jew azzjoni, inkluż xi ħaġa li persuna tkun għamlet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工作；所做的工作。
做过的事情；已经实施的行为。
工作；行动；行为。

collocations.en: good work or a good deed

formal.mt: L-għajnuna li ta lill-ġirien kienet fgħal ta' solidarjetà.
formal.en: The help he gave his neighbours was an act of solidarity.
formal.zh: 他向邻居提供帮助，是一种团结互助的行动。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għent lil Rosa ġġorr il-basktijiet id-dar. Mark: Dak kien fgħal tajjeb min-naħa tiegħek.
colloquial.en: Maja: I helped Rosa carry the bags home. Mark: That was a good deed on your part.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我帮罗莎把袋子提回了家。马克：你做了一件好事。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għent lil Rosa ġġorr il-basktijiet id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Għent lil Rosa ġġorr il-basktijiet id-dar.
messages.zh: 我帮罗莎把袋子提回了家。
messages.en: I helped Rosa carry the bags home.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kien fgħal tajjeb min-naħa tiegħek.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kien fgħal tajjeb min-naħa tiegħek.
messages.zh: 你做了一件好事。
messages.en: That was a good deed on your part.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张记录“今天做了什么”的清单：完成的工作、具体的行动、做过的事情，都围绕“实际所做之事”来记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Clear enough for someone to understand.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表达清楚、让人能够理解其意思的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li wieħed jista' jifhem għax it-tifsir tiegħu huwa ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 可以理解的；意思能够被领会的。
表达清楚、能够听懂或读懂的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport għandu jkun miktub bi kliem fhumi biex il-qarrejja jifhmu r-riżultati.
formal.en: The report should be written in intelligible language so that readers understand the results.
formal.zh: 报告应使用清楚易懂的语言撰写，让读者理解结果。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan it-test fhumi għalik? Pawlu: Iva, nifhem kollox ħlief l-aħħar sentenza.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this text understandable to you? Pawlu: Yes, I understand everything except the last sentence.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这篇文章你能读懂吗？Pawlu：能，除了最后一句，我都明白。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这篇文章你能读懂吗？
messages.en: Is this text understandable to you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nifhem kollox ħlief l-aħħar sentenza.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nifhem kollox ħlief l-aħħar sentenza.
messages.zh: 能，除了最后一句，我都明白。
messages.en: Yes, I understand everything except the last sentence.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fhumi 和“读完能明白”连在一起记：看到 test fhumi，就想象一篇不用反复猜意思的文章。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The precious metal silver, or objects such as cutlery made from silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 银这种贵金属，也可指银制的餐具等器物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Metall prezzjuż ta' lewn ċar u tleqq, jew oġġetti magħmula minnu, bħal pożati.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银；一种颜色明亮、带有光泽的贵金属。
银器；银制餐具等器物的统称。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesebixxi ġabra ta' pożati tal-fidda tas-seklu dsatax.
formal.en: The museum exhibits a collection of nineteenth-century silver cutlery.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出了一批十九世纪的银制餐具。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan iċ-ċurkett tal-fidda? Mark: Iva, imma l-kaxxa mhix inkluża fil-prezz.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is this ring made of silver? Mark: Yes, but the box is not included in the price.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这枚戒指是银的吗？Mark：是的，不过价格不包含盒子。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这枚戒指是银的吗？
messages.en: Is this ring made of silver?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma l-kaxxa mhix inkluża fil-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma l-kaxxa mhix inkluża fil-prezz.
messages.zh: 是的，不过价格不包含盒子。
messages.en: Yes, but the box is not included in the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“银戒指”和“银餐具”两个画面：fidda 既能说材料“银”，也能集合地说“银器”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cover the surface of an object with a layer of silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在物体表面镀上或覆上一层银。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kesa l-wiċċ ta' oġġett b'saff ta' fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 给物体镀银；在其表面加上一层银。
给物体表面覆上银层。

collocations.en: he coated the frame with silver

formal.mt: L-artiġjan fidded il-wiċċ tat-trej b'saff irqiq ta' fidda.
formal.en: The craftsman coated the surface of the tray with a thin layer of silver.
formal.zh: 工匠给托盘表面覆上了一层薄银。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Min fidded din il-kuċċarina? Toni: L-artiġjan ħdejn id-dar tagħna; issa tidher qisha ġdida.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who silver-plated this spoon? Toni: The craftsman near our house; now it looks like new.
colloquial.zh: Nina：谁给这把勺子镀了银？Toni：我们家附近的工匠；现在看起来像新的一样。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁给这把勺子镀了银？
messages.en: Who silver-plated this spoon?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: L-artiġjan ħdejn id-dar tagħna; issa tidher qisha ġdida.
messages.mt_standard: L-artiġjan ħdejn id-dar tagħna; issa tidher qisha ġdida.
messages.zh: 我们家附近的工匠；现在看起来像新的一样。
messages.en: The craftsman near our house; now it looks like new.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fidded 记成一个动作画面：工匠拿起旧勺子，在表面加上银层，重点是“镀银”这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having a colour or shine that resembles silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 颜色或光泽像银一样的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu lewn jew tleqqija bħal tal-fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银色的；具有银一般光泽的。

formal.mt: Id-dawl fiddi tal-qamar kien jidher fuq wiċċ il-baħar.
formal.en: The silvery light of the moon was visible on the surface of the sea.
formal.zh: 海面上可见月亮洒下的银色光芒。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema kulur trid għar-rota? Ben: Irrid lewn fiddi; jogħġobni kif jidher fix-xemx.
colloquial.en: Sara: What colour do you want for the bicycle? Ben: I want a silvery colour; I like how it looks in the sun.
colloquial.zh: Sara：自行车你想要什么颜色？Ben：我想要银色；我喜欢它在阳光下的样子。

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 自行车你想要什么颜色？
messages.en: What colour do you want for the bicycle?

messages.speaker: Ben (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Irrid lewn fiddi; jogħġobni kif jidher fix-xemx.
messages.mt_standard: Irrid lewn fiddi; jogħġobni kif jidher fix-xemx.
messages.zh: 我想要银色；我喜欢它在阳光下的样子。
messages.en: I want a silvery colour; I like how it looks in the sun.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想到月光在海面闪成银色，就记住 fiddi 描写“像银的颜色或光泽”，月光也可以这样形容。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A craftsperson who makes or repairs objects made of silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 制作或修理银制器物的工匠。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Artiġjan li jagħmel jew isewwi oġġetti tal-fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银匠；以制作或修理银器为业的工匠。

formal.mt: Il-fiddied irrestawra l-kalċi tal-fidda u rreġistra kull stadju tax-xogħol.
formal.en: The silversmith restored the silver chalice and recorded every stage of the work.
formal.zh: 银匠修复了银制圣爵，并记录了工作的每个阶段。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Taf fiddied li jista' jsewwi din il-brazzuletta? Luqa: Iva, hemm wieħed ħdejn il-pjazza.
colloquial.en: Rita: Do you know a silversmith who can repair this bracelet? Luqa: Yes, there is one near the square.
colloquial.zh: Rita：你认识能修这条手链的银匠吗？Luqa：认识，广场附近有一位。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Taf fiddied li jista' jsewwi din il-brazzuletta?
messages.mt_standard: Taf fiddied li jista' jsewwi din il-brazzuletta?
messages.zh: 你认识能修这条手链的银匠吗？
messages.en: Do you know a silversmith who can repair this bracelet?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.zh: 认识，广场附近有一位。
messages.en: Yes, there is one near the square.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fiddied 配一张职业卡：工作台上放着银戒指和银手链，桌旁负责制作、修理的人就是银匠。

gloss_zh: 银色的；银光闪闪的；银匠；田地

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having the colour or bright shine of silver.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 具有银的颜色或明亮银光的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu l-lewn jew it-tleqqija tal-fidda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 银色的；呈现银一般色泽的。
像银一样闪亮的；泛着银光的。
银匠；制作或修理银制器物的人。
田地；用于耕种的土地。

formal.mt: Fl-istampa, il-wiċċ tal-ilma għandu lewn fiddien minħabba d-dawl tal-qamar.
formal.en: In the picture, the surface of the water has a silvery colour because of the moonlight.
formal.zh: 画中，水面因月光而呈现银色的色泽。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Ara dak id-dawl fiddien fuq l-ilma! Ġanni: Iva, ġej mill-qamar; ejja nieħdu ritratt.
colloquial.en: Marta: Look at that silvery light on the water! Ġanni: Yes, it comes from the moon; let's take a photo.
colloquial.zh: Marta：看水面上那片银光！Ġanni：是啊，是月光；我们拍张照片吧。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara dak id-dawl fiddien fuq l-ilma!
messages.mt_standard: Ara dak id-dawl fiddien fuq l-ilma!
messages.zh: 看水面上那片银光！
messages.en: Look at that silvery light on the water!

messages.speaker: Ġanni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ġej mill-qamar; ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ġej mill-qamar; ejja nieħdu ritratt.
messages.zh: 是啊，是月光；我们拍张照片吧。
messages.en: Yes, it comes from the moon; let's take a photo.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 fiddien 分开做词义卡：形容词画银光，名词分别画银匠和田地；阅读时先看词性，再结合上下文选义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Faith or belief in someone or something, especially in a religious context.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人或某事的信任、信念，尤指宗教信仰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Twemmin jew fiduċja f'xi ħadd jew f'xi ħaġa, speċjalment f'kuntest reliġjuż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赎回或赎救的行为。
信仰；信念；对某人或某事的信任。

formal.mt: L-awtur jispjega kif il-fidi għenet lill-komunità tgħaddi minn żmien diffiċli.
formal.en: The author explains how faith helped the community through a difficult time.
formal.zh: 作者说明了信仰如何帮助这个群体渡过艰难时期。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għad għandek fidi fil-proġett tagħna? David: Iva, nemmen li nistgħu nlestuh jekk naħdmu flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you still have faith in our project? David: Yes, I believe we can finish it if we work together.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你对我们的项目还有信心吗？David：有，我相信只要一起努力，我们就能完成。

messages.speaker: Anna (同事)
messages.zh: 你对我们的项目还有信心吗？
messages.en: Do you still have faith in our project?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nemmen li nistgħu nlestuh jekk naħdmu flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nemmen li nistgħu nlestuh jekk naħdmu flimkien.
messages.zh: 有，我相信只要一起努力，我们就能完成。
messages.en: Yes, I believe we can finish it if we work together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fidi 的“信仰、信念”联想到心中的相信；另用一张“赎回”动作卡记另一义，避免把不同义项混成一句。

gloss_zh: 忠实的；忠诚的；准确的；驯顺的；天真的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Remaining loyal and dependable toward a person, group, or commitment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人、团体或承诺保持忠诚、值得信赖的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibqa' leali u ta' min joqgħod fuqu lejn persuna, grupp jew impenn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忠实的；始终信守关系或承诺的。
忠诚的；坚定支持某人或某团体的。
驯顺的；用于动物，尤其指宠物温顺、亲近人。
天真坦率的；没有心机的。
忠实、忠诚的；对人或承诺坚定可靠的。
忠于原内容的；准确、精确的。
经过驯养的；驯服、温顺的。
天真的；缺乏经验、容易轻信的。

collocations.en: a faithful account of the event

formal.mt: L-istudju jippreżenta rakkont fidil tal-ġrajja, ibbażat fuq id-dokumenti disponibbli.
formal.en: The study presents a faithful account of the event, based on the available documents.
formal.zh: 这项研究依据现有文件，对事件作出了如实叙述。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Il-kelb tiegħek dejjem jibqa' ħdejk. Mark: Iva, huwa fidil ħafna u jistenna lili kuljum ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Elena: Your dog always stays by your side. Mark: Yes, he is very faithful and waits for me by the door every day.
colloquial.zh: Elena：你的狗总是守在你身边。Mark：是啊，它很忠实，每天都在门边等我。

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的狗总是守在你身边。
messages.en: Your dog always stays by your side.

messages.speaker: Mark (宠物主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, huwa fidil ħafna u jistenna lili kuljum ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, huwa fidil ħafna u jistenna lili kuljum ħdejn il-bieb.
messages.zh: 是啊，它很忠实，每天都在门边等我。
messages.en: Yes, he is very faithful and waits for me by the door every day.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用四幅小图记 fidil：守约的朋友、忠实的叙述、温顺的宠物、天真的孩子；先看它修饰什么，再判断具体意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of confidence in yourself or trust in another person's ability, honesty, or reliability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对自己的能力抱有信心，或相信他人的能力、诚实与可靠性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' ċertezza fil-ħila tiegħek jew twemmin fil-ħila, fl-onestà jew fl-affidabbiltà ta' persuna oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 信心；对自身能力或事情结果的把握。
信任；相信他人可靠、诚实或值得依靠。
信心；信任。

formal.mt: Il-kors għandu l-għan li jsaħħaħ il-fiduċja tal-istudenti fil-ħila tagħhom li jitkellmu bil-Malti.
formal.en: The course aims to strengthen students' confidence in their ability to speak Maltese.
formal.zh: 本课程旨在增强学生对自己说马耳他语能力的信心。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi ftit biża' nitkellem quddiem kulħadd. Mark: Għandi fiduċja fik. Int ippreparajt sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm a little afraid to speak in front of everyone. Mark: I have confidence in you. You've prepared well.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我有点害怕在大家面前讲话。Mark：我对你有信心。你准备得很充分。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi ftit biża' nitkellem quddiem kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi ftit biża' nitkellem quddiem kulħadd.
messages.zh: 我有点害怕在大家面前讲话。
messages.en: I'm a little afraid to speak in front of everyone.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi fiduċja fik. Int ippreparajt sew.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi fiduċja fik. Int ippreparajt sew.
messages.zh: 我对你有信心。你准备得很充分。
messages.en: I have confidence in you. You've prepared well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fiduċja 放进两个画面记忆：面对演讲相信自己是“信心”，把任务交给可靠的朋友是“信任”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be useful or bring a practical benefit to someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人有用，或给某人带来实际帮助和好处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun ta' użu jew jagħti benefiċċju prattiku lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有用；具有实际用途。
溢出；因过满而流出。
证明有用；在实际使用中发挥帮助作用。
使某人受益；对某人有利。

collocations.en: the book was very useful to me

formal.mt: It-taħriġ fied lit-tim, li wara temm ix-xogħol b'inqas żbalji.
formal.en: The training benefited the team, which subsequently completed the work with fewer mistakes.
formal.zh: 培训使团队受益，之后团队完成工作时出现的错误更少了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Il-ktieb li selliftek fiedek? Pawlu: Iva, fiedni ħafna. Fl-aħħar fhimt il-lezzjoni.
colloquial.en: Sara: Was the book I lent you useful? Pawlu: Yes, it helped me a lot. I finally understood the lesson.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我借给你的书有用吗？Pawlu：有，对我帮助很大。我终于弄懂那一课了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 我借给你的书有用吗？
messages.en: Was the book I lent you useful?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fiedni ħafna. Fl-aħħar fhimt il-lezzjoni.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fiedni ħafna. Fl-aħħar fhimt il-lezzjoni.
messages.zh: 有，对我帮助很大。我终于弄懂那一课了。
messages.en: Yes, it helped me a lot. I finally understood the lesson.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“建议帮上忙”的画面记住 fied 的“有益”；另把“溢出”单独配上满杯流水的画面，按语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To explain something to someone so that they understand it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 向某人说明某件事，使对方理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jispjega xi ħaġa lil xi ħadd biex dan jifhimha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释；说明某事的意思、原因或做法。
使某人明白；帮助某人理解。

collocations.mt: fiehem lil kulħadd kif taħdem il-magna
collocations.en: he explained to everyone how the machine works
collocations.zh: 他向大家解释了机器如何运作

formal.mt: L-għalliem fiehem lill-istudenti kif jużaw ir-regola permezz ta' żewġ eżempji.
formal.en: The teacher used two examples to explain to the students how to apply the rule.
formal.zh: 老师通过两个例子，向学生们解释了如何运用这条规则。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għadni ma fhimtx kif taħdem il-magna. Toni: Mark fiehem lil kulħadd dalgħodu. Ejja nistaqsuh jerġa' jispjega.
colloquial.en: Lara: I still haven't understood how the machine works. Toni: Mark explained it to everyone this morning. Let's ask him to explain again.
colloquial.zh: Lara：我还是没弄懂这台机器怎么用。Toni：Mark 今天早上给大家解释过。我们请他再解释一遍吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni ma fhimtx kif taħdem il-magna.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni ma fhimtx kif taħdem il-magna.
messages.zh: 我还是没弄懂这台机器怎么用。
messages.en: I still haven't understood how the machine works.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark fiehem lil kulħadd dalgħodu. Ejja nistaqsuh jerġa' jispjega.
messages.mt_standard: Mark fiehem lil kulħadd dalgħodu. Ejja nistaqsuh jerġa' jispjega.
messages.zh: Mark 今天早上给大家解释过。我们请他再解释一遍吧。
messages.en: Mark explained it to everyone this morning. Let's ask him to explain again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住 fiehem 的课堂画面：老师把规则讲清楚，学生点头明白；把“解释”和“使人理解”连在一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become healthy again after illness or injury, or for a wound to heal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 患病或受伤后恢复健康，或伤口愈合。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jkun f'saħħtu wara marda jew korriment, jew jingħalaq u jissaħħaħ meta jingħad għal ferita.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 愈合；痊愈。
病后康复；逐渐恢复健康和体力。
康复；恢复健康。
在金融交易中收回成本；达到不赚不赔。
康复；痊愈；愈合。

formal.mt: Il-pazjent fieq għal kollox wara l-kura u reġa' beda l-attivitajiet ta' kuljum.
formal.en: The patient recovered completely after treatment and resumed his daily activities.
formal.zh: 患者经过治疗后完全康复，并恢复了日常活动。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif inhu ħuk issa? David: Fieq għal kollox. Ilbieraħ reġa' mar għax-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Marija: How is your brother now? David: He's recovered completely. He went back to work yesterday.
colloquial.zh: Marija：你哥哥现在怎么样了？David：已经完全康复了。他昨天回去上班了。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥现在怎么样了？
messages.en: How is your brother now?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fieq għal kollox. Ilbieraħ reġa' mar għax-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Fieq għal kollox. Ilbieraħ reġa' mar għax-xogħol.
messages.zh: 已经完全康复了。他昨天回去上班了。
messages.en: He's recovered completely. He went back to work yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fieq 配上病人重新回去上班的画面，记“康复”；遇到交易语境，则想到成本收回、账目不赚不赔。

gloss_zh: 轻浮的；徒劳的；空洞的；无意义的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Lacking serious purpose, useful effect, or meaningful content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺少严肃目的、实际效果或有意义内容的；轻浮、徒劳或空洞的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma għandux skop serju, effett utli jew kontenut li jagħmel sens.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮的；不严肃的。
徒劳的；无法产生预期效果的。
空洞无聊的；缺乏意义或思想的。
琐碎的；无关紧要的。
徒劳的；无结果的。
空的；空无内容的。
无实际用途的；徒劳的；空洞的；无意义的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jitlob azzjoni konkreta, għax kliem fieragħ ma jsolvix il-problema.
formal.en: The report calls for concrete action, because empty words do not solve the problem.
formal.zh: 报告呼吁采取具体行动，因为空话无法解决问题。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Reġa' qal li se jgħinna, imma ma għamel xejn. Samwel: Dak kollu kliem fieragħ. Għandna bżonn l-għajnuna llum.
colloquial.en: Rita: He said again that he'd help us, but he hasn't done anything. Samwel: That's all empty talk. We need help today.
colloquial.zh: Rita：他又说会帮我们，可是什么也没做。Samwel：那全是空话。我们今天就需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Rita (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Reġa' qal li se jgħinna, imma ma għamel xejn.
messages.mt_standard: Reġa' qal li se jgħinna, imma ma għamel xejn.
messages.zh: 他又说会帮我们，可是什么也没做。
messages.en: He said again that he'd help us, but he hasn't done anything.

messages.speaker: Samwel (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak kollu kliem fieragħ. Għandna bżonn l-għajnuna llum.
messages.mt_standard: Dak kollu kliem fieragħ. Għandna bżonn l-għajnuna llum.
messages.zh: 那全是空话。我们今天就需要帮助。
messages.en: That's all empty talk. We need help today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“说了一大堆，却没有内容也没有行动”的画面记 fieragħ；先记搭配 kliem fieragħ，就是“空话”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate people from one another, especially by holding apart people who are fighting.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人彼此分开，尤其指将正在打斗的人拉开。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jifred lin-nies minn xulxin, speċjalment billi jżomm lil dawk li jkunu qed jiġġieldu 'l bogħod minn xulxin.

sense_translations.en_definition: to hold apart (used of people in a fight who are separated)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把打斗中的人拉开并保持分离。

sense_translations.en_definition: to separate people from one another
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把人彼此分开；使人相互隔开。

collocations.mt: fieraq lil dawk li kienu qed jiġġieldu
collocations.en: he held apart those who were fighting
collocations.zh: 他拉开了正在打斗的人

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan fieraq liż-żewġ subien li kienu qed jiġġieldu fil-bitħa.
formal.en: The guard separated the two boys who were fighting in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 保安把正在院子里打架的两个男孩拉开了。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min fieraq liż-żewġ subien? Ben: Il-gwardjan. Issa qegħdin jitkellmu bil-kalma.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who separated the two boys? Ben: The guard. They're talking calmly now.
colloquial.zh: Anna：谁把那两个男孩拉开了？Ben：保安。他们现在正平静地说话。

messages.speaker: Anna (旁观者)
messages.zh: 谁把那两个男孩拉开了？
messages.en: Who separated the two boys?

messages.speaker: Ben (旁观者)
messages.zh: 保安。他们现在正平静地说话。
messages.en: The guard. They're talking calmly now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象保安站到两个打架者中间，把双方拉开并留出距离；用这个完整动作记住 fieraq 的“把人分开”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A knight or a man riding a horse.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 骑士，或骑在马背上的男子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kavallier jew raġel li jkun riekeb fuq żiemel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 骑士。
骑马的男子；骑士；骑手。
波斯人。

collocations.en: a horseman on a white horse

formal.mt: Fl-illustrazzjoni tal-ktieb, fieres bl-armatura jidher fuq żiemel quddiem il-bieb tal-kastell.
formal.en: In the book's illustration, a knight in armour is shown on a horse in front of the castle gate.
formal.zh: 书中的插图画着一位身穿盔甲的骑士，骑马停在城堡大门前。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Min hu dak fuq iż-żiemel fl-istampa? Nannu: Dak fieres. Ara l-armatura tiegħu!
colloquial.en: Ella: Who is that on the horse in the picture? Grandpa: That's a knight. Look at his armour!
colloquial.zh: Ella：图里那个骑在马上的人是谁？爷爷：那是一位骑士。看看他身上的盔甲！

messages.speaker: Ella (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak fuq iż-żiemel fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak fuq iż-żiemel fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图里那个骑在马上的人是谁？
messages.en: Who is that on the horse in the picture?

messages.speaker: Nannu (爷爷)
messages.zh: 那是一位骑士。看看他身上的盔甲！
messages.en: That's a knight. Look at his armour!

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“白马加盔甲”的插图记 fieres 的骑士、骑手义；另做一张“波斯人”义项卡，避免把人物身份与骑马动作混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool with a strong, pointed metal head and a handle, used to break up hard ground or rock.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种带有坚硬尖头金属镐头和手柄的工具，用来刨开硬土或凿碎岩石。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda b'ras tal-metall iebsa u bil-ponta u b'manku, li tintuża biex tkisser art iebsa jew blat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 镐；用于刨开硬土或岩石的尖头工具。
十字镐；带有金属镐头和长柄的挖掘工具。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem uża l-fies biex ikisser is-saff ta' art iebsa qabel beda jħaffer.
formal.en: The worker used the pickaxe to break up the layer of hard ground before he began digging.
formal.zh: 工人先用镐刨开坚硬的土层，然后开始挖掘。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Fejn hu l-fies? Din l-art iebsa wisq. Pawlu: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibu u nkissruha ftit.
colloquial.en: Mark: Where's the pickaxe? This ground is too hard. Pawlu: By the door. Bring it and we'll break the ground up a little.
colloquial.zh: Mark：镐在哪里？这块地太硬了。Pawlu：在门旁边。拿过来，我们把土刨松一点。

messages.speaker: Mark (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-fies? Din l-art iebsa wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-fies? Din l-art iebsa wisq.
messages.zh: 镐在哪里？这块地太硬了。
messages.en: Where's the pickaxe? This ground is too hard.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibu u nkissruha ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ħdejn il-bieb. Ġibu u nkissruha ftit.
messages.zh: 在门旁边。拿过来，我们把土刨松一点。
messages.en: By the door. Bring it and we'll break the ground up a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fies 和“硬土—举镐—刨开”的动作画面绑定，看到这个词就想起手握镐柄破土的场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To deceive or betray someone, or to anticipate another person's action by acting first.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欺骗或背叛某人；也可指预先判断他人的行动并抢先采取行动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd jew jittradih; jista' wkoll ifisser li jaġixxi qabel ħaddieħor għax jara minn qabel x'se jagħmel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；以不诚实的手段使某人吃亏。
预先料到并抢先行动；赶在他人之前采取行动。
欺骗、背叛；违背某人对自己的信任。

collocations.zh: 他料到对手的行动并抢先一步

formal.mt: In-negozjant fiet lil sieħbu meta ħeba informazzjoni importanti dwar il-ftehim.
formal.en: The businessman cheated his partner when he concealed important information about the agreement.
formal.zh: 这名商人隐瞒了有关协议的重要信息，欺骗了自己的伙伴。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Naħseb li dak il-bejjiegħ fiet lil Mark. Sara: Għaliex? Ma tahx dak li wiegħdu?
colloquial.en: Maja: I think that seller cheated Mark. Sara: Why? Didn't he give him what he promised?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我觉得那个卖家骗了 Mark。Sara：为什么？他没把答应的东西给他吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Naħseb li dak il-bejjiegħ fiet lil Mark.
messages.mt_standard: Naħseb li dak il-bejjiegħ fiet lil Mark.
messages.zh: 我觉得那个卖家骗了 Mark。
messages.en: I think that seller cheated Mark.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex? Ma tahx dak li wiegħdu?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex? Ma tahx dak li wiegħdu?
messages.zh: 为什么？他没把答应的东西给他吗？
messages.en: Why? Didn't he give him what he promised?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅情境卡记 fiet：交易中隐瞒信息对应“欺骗”，对手行动前先出招对应“预判并抢先”；依上下文选择义项。

gloss_zh: 温的；微温的；不冷不热的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moderately warm rather than hot, especially of a liquid that feels only slightly warm.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 温度适中而不烫的，尤指液体只有微微的温热感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li hu kemxejn sħun iżda mhux jaħraq, speċjalment meta nitkellmu dwar likwidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 温的；带有适度暖意的。
微温的；不冷不热的。

sense_translations.en_definition: lukewarm; tepid (having a temperature close to room temperature or human body temperature)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 微温的；不冷不热的，温度接近室温或人体温度。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, ħallat il-ħmira ma' ftit ilma fietel.
formal.en: For this recipe, mix the yeast with a little lukewarm water.
formal.zh: 按照这份食谱，将酵母与少量温水混合。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-ħalib għadu jaħraq? Nina: Le, issa fietel. Tista' tixorbu.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the milk still hot? Nina: No, it's lukewarm now. You can drink it.
colloquial.zh: Lara：牛奶还烫吗？Nina：不烫了，现在温温的。可以喝了。

messages.speaker: Lara (女儿)
messages.zh: 牛奶还烫吗？
messages.en: Is the milk still hot?

messages.speaker: Nina (母亲)
messages.zh: 不烫了，现在温温的。可以喝了。
messages.en: No, it's lukewarm now. You can drink it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fietel 放在“冷—微温—烫”的温度线上间位置，想象一杯放凉到入口舒适的温水，记住其微温含义。

gloss_zh: 散发香气；享有好名声；稀少

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give off a pleasant smell or fragrance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 散发令人愉快的气味或香气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Joħroġ riħa tajba jew fwieħa pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 带有芬芳气味；散发香甜的气息。
享有好名声；有良好的声誉。

sense_translations.en_definition: to have a good smell, scent, be fragrant
sense_translations.zh_definition: 有好闻的气味；散发香气；芬芳。
稀少；短缺；供应不足。

collocations.en: the jasmine gave off a sweet scent
the roses gave off their fragrance in the garden
collocations.zh: 玫瑰在花园里散发香气

formal.mt: Il-ġiżimin fieħ fil-bitħa, u r-riħa tiegħu daħlet mit-tieqa miftuħa.
formal.en: The jasmine gave off its fragrance in the courtyard, and its scent came through the open window.
formal.zh: 院子里的茉莉散发出芬芳，香气从敞开的窗户飘了进来。

colloquial.mt: Nina: X'riħa sabiħa hawn! Luqa: Il-ġiżimin fieħ fil-bitħa. Ħallejt it-tieqa miftuħa.
colloquial.en: Nina: What a lovely smell in here! Luqa: The jasmine gave off its fragrance in the courtyard. I left the window open.
colloquial.zh: Nina：这里真香啊！Luqa：院子里的茉莉散发出了香气。我把窗户开着了。

messages.speaker: Nina (来访的朋友)
messages.zh: 这里真香啊！
messages.en: What a lovely smell in here!

messages.speaker: Luqa (主人)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ġiżimin fieħ fil-bitħa. Ħallejt it-tieqa miftuħa.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ġiżimin fieħ fil-bitħa. Ħallejt it-tieqa miftuħa.
messages.zh: 院子里的茉莉散发出了香气。我把窗户开着了。
messages.en: The jasmine gave off its fragrance in the courtyard. I left the window open.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用窗边闻到茉莉香的画面记 fieħ；“好名声”和“稀少”另列语义卡片，不把所有义项硬套进花香画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A visible or drawn shape, or the physical shape and proportions of a person's body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 可见或画出的图形、形体，也可指一个人身体的外形和比例，即身材。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Forma li tidher jew li tkun impinġija; tista' wkoll tkun il-forma u l-proporzjonijiet tal-ġisem ta' persuna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个图形或形体；具有可辨认轮廓的形象。
人的身材、体形；身体的外形与比例。
图形；形体；也可指人的体形，具体含义依上下文确定。

formal.mt: L-istudent pinġa figura ġeometrika u kiteb isimha taħtha.
formal.en: The student drew a geometric figure and wrote its name underneath it.
formal.zh: 学生画了一个几何图形，并在下面写出它的名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Din il-ġakketta taqbel mal-figura tiegħi? Sara: Iva, toqgħodlok tajjeb ħafna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Does this jacket suit my figure? Sara: Yes, it fits you very well.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这件夹克适合我的身材吗？Sara：适合，你穿着很合身。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.zh: 这件夹克适合我的身材吗？
messages.en: Does this jacket suit my figure?

messages.speaker: Sara (店员)
messages.zh: 适合，你穿着很合身。
messages.en: Yes, it fits you very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“轮廓”串联 figura 的两个常用场景：纸上的轮廓是图形，人的身体轮廓是身材，再靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Out of every hundred, used after a number to express a percentage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示每一百份中所占的份数，放在数字之后表达百分比。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Minn kull mija; tintuża wara numru biex turi proporzjon.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 百分之；用于数字后，表示每一百份中有多少份。
以百分比计；用于说明增加、减少或其他变化的比例。

collocations.en: a discount of twenty per cent
collocations.zh: 百分之二十的折扣，即八折

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, sittin fil-mija tal-parteċipanti qablu mal-proposta.
formal.en: According to the report, sixty per cent of the participants agreed with the proposal.
formal.zh: 根据报告，百分之六十的参与者赞成这项提议。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hu l-iskont fuq din il-borża? Mark: Għoxrin fil-mija; kienet ħamsin ewro u issa tiswa erbgħin.
colloquial.en: Lara: How much is the discount on this bag? Mark: Twenty per cent; it was fifty euros and now it costs forty.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这个包打多少折？Mark：减价百分之二十，原来五十欧元，现在四十欧元。

messages.speaker: Lara (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Kemm hu l-iskont fuq din il-borża?
messages.mt_standard: Kemm hu l-iskont fuq din il-borża?
messages.zh: 这个包打多少折？
messages.en: How much is the discount on this bag?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin fil-mija; kienet ħamsin ewro u issa tiswa erbgħin.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin fil-mija; kienet ħamsin ewro u issa tiswa erbgħin.
messages.zh: 减价百分之二十，原来五十欧元，现在四十欧元。
messages.en: Twenty per cent; it was fifty euros and now it costs forty.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一张分成一百格的表：数字后接 fil-mija，就数出其中多少格；għaxra fil-mija 就是百分之十。

gloss_zh: 使筋疲力尽；使瘫痪；使无法正常运作

teaching_sense.en_definition: To exhaust someone, to cause physical paralysis, or figuratively to prevent something from functioning properly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人极度疲惫，使身体瘫痪，或比喻严重妨碍某事物，使其无法正常运作。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jgħejji ħafna lil xi ħadd, jikkawża paraliżi, jew, b'mod figurattiv, iżomm xi ħaġa milli taħdem kif suppost.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人筋疲力尽；使某人非常疲惫。
使瘫痪；使身体失去正常活动能力。

sense_translations.en_definition: to paralyse, cause to become paralysed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使瘫痪；导致身体或身体某部分进入无法正常活动的状态。

sense_translations.en_definition: to paralyse, cripple, hamstring (prevent from functioning properly)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使陷于瘫痪；严重削弱或阻碍，使其无法正常发挥作用或运作。

collocations.en: the lack of funds crippled the project
collocations.zh: 资金短缺使项目陷入瘫痪

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' fondi fileġ il-proġett u waqqaf ix-xogħol għal diversi xhur.
formal.en: The lack of funds crippled the project and halted work for several months.
formal.zh: 资金短缺使项目陷入瘫痪，工作停顿了数月。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ix-xogħol tal-lum fileġ lil Mark. Pawlu: Mela ħallih jistrieħ ftit; aħna nkomplu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Today's work exhausted Mark. Pawlu: Then let him rest a little; we'll carry on.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天的工作把 Mark 累坏了。Pawlu：那就让他休息一会儿，我们继续。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 今天的工作把 Mark 累坏了。
messages.en: Today's work exhausted Mark.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela ħallih jistrieħ ftit; aħna nkomplu.
messages.mt_standard: Mela ħallih jistrieħ ftit; aħna nkomplu.
messages.zh: 那就让他休息一会儿，我们继续。
messages.en: Then let him rest a little; we'll carry on.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fileġ 记成三张情境卡：人被累垮、身体瘫痪、项目停摆；共同画面是活动能力受到严重影响，但三个义项要分别辨认。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the evening, the part of the day after the afternoon and before night.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在傍晚或晚间，即下午之后、入夜前后的时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-ħin tal-ġurnata wara nofsinhar u qabel il-lejl.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在傍晚；在晚上，用于说明动作发生的时间。
傍晚；晚间，指一天中下午之后、夜晚来临的时段。

collocations.zh: 傍晚时分；晚间较早的时候

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa se ssir filgħaxija, fis-sebgħa, fis-sala tal-iskola.
formal.en: The meeting will take place in the evening, at seven, in the school hall.
formal.zh: 会议将于晚上七点在学校礼堂举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Niltaqgħu filgħaxija? Mark: Iva, wara x-xogħol. Fis-sebgħa tajjeb għalik?
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we meet this evening? Mark: Yes, after work. Is seven good for you?
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们今晚见面吗？Mark：好，下班以后。七点你方便吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们今晚见面吗？
messages.en: Shall we meet this evening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, wara x-xogħol. Fis-sebgħa tajjeb għalik?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, wara x-xogħol. Fis-sebgħa tajjeb għalik?
messages.zh: 好，下班以后。七点你方便吗？
messages.en: Yes, after work. Is seven good for you?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filgħaxija 写在“下班后、晚饭前后”的日程格里，整词联想傍晚见面的场景；副词用法回答“什么时候”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: During the morning, the part of the day before noon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在早晨或上午，即一天中中午之前的时段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Fil-parti tal-ġurnata qabel nofsinhar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在早晨；在上午，用于说明动作发生在中午之前。

formal.mt: Il-kors jibda fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu u jintemm f'nofsinhar.
formal.en: The course starts at eight in the morning and ends at noon.
formal.zh: 课程早上八点开始，中午结束。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għada tiġi filgħodu? Pawlu: Iva, nasal fid-disgħa. Nieħdu kafè flimkien?
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you coming tomorrow morning? Pawlu: Yes, I'll arrive at nine. Shall we have a coffee together?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你明天上午来吗？Pawlu：来，我九点到。我们一起喝杯咖啡好吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天上午来吗？
messages.en: Are you coming tomorrow morning?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, nasal fid-disgħa. Nieħdu kafè flimkien?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, nasal fid-disgħa. Nieħdu kafè flimkien?
messages.zh: 来，我九点到。我们一起喝杯咖啡好吗？
messages.en: Yes, I'll arrive at nine. Shall we have a coffee together?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filgħodu 和“起床、早餐、上午上课”的连续画面绑定；与表示晚间的 filgħaxija 配对练习，用一天的时间线帮助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The study of fundamental questions about existence, knowledge, and values, or a set of principles that guides thought and action.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 研究存在、知识与价值等根本问题的学科，也可指指导思考与行动的一套理念。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-istudju ta' mistoqsijiet fundamentali dwar l-eżistenza, l-għarfien u l-valuri, jew sett ta' prinċipji li jiggwidaw il-ħsieb u l-imġiba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哲学；对存在、知识、价值等问题的系统思考，也可指个人或团体的基本理念。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-filosofija jħeġġeġ lill-istudenti jeżaminaw l-argumenti dwar il-ġustizzja u l-għarfien.
formal.en: The philosophy course encourages students to examine arguments about justice and knowledge.
formal.zh: 这门哲学课程鼓励学生审视有关正义与知识的论证。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għażilt il-filosofija? Lara: Għax inħobb nistaqsi għaliex naħsbu li xi ħaġa hi tajba jew ħażina.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you choose philosophy? Lara: Because I like asking why we think something is right or wrong.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么选哲学？Lara：因为我喜欢追问，我们为什么认为一件事是对的或错的。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么选哲学？
messages.en: Why did you choose philosophy?

messages.speaker: Lara (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax inħobb nistaqsi għaliex naħsbu li xi ħaġa hi tajba jew ħażina.
messages.mt_standard: Għax inħobb nistaqsi għaliex naħsbu li xi ħaġa hi tajba jew ħażina.
messages.zh: 因为我喜欢追问，我们为什么认为一件事是对的或错的。
messages.en: Because I like asking why we think something is right or wrong.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 filosofija 和课堂上不断追问“为什么”的画面相连；它既能指哲学这门学科，也能指指导生活的理念。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to philosophy or concerned with fundamental questions about life, knowledge, and values.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与哲学有关的，或探讨人生、知识和价值等根本问题的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-filosofija jew ma' mistoqsijiet fundamentali dwar il-ħajja, l-għarfien u l-valuri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 哲学的；涉及根本问题的思考或带有哲理的。

formal.mt: L-awtur jippreżenta argument filosofiku dwar ir-relazzjoni bejn il-libertà u r-responsabbiltà.
formal.en: The author presents a philosophical argument about the relationship between freedom and responsibility.
formal.zh: 作者提出了一项关于自由与责任之间关系的哲学论证。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dan il-film għandu xi ħsieb filosofiku? Maja: Iva, iġiegħlek taħseb dwar xi jfisser li tgħix ħajja tajba.
colloquial.en: Mark: Does this film contain any philosophical ideas? Maja: Yes, it makes you think about what it means to live a good life.
colloquial.zh: Mark：这部电影有什么哲学思想吗？Maja：有，它让你思考怎样才算过上美好的人生。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-film għandu xi ħsieb filosofiku?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-film għandu xi ħsieb filosofiku?
messages.zh: 这部电影有什么哲学思想吗？
messages.en: Does this film contain any philosophical ideas?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, iġiegħlek taħseb dwar xi jfisser li tgħix ħajja tajba.

messages.en: Yes, it makes you think about what it means to live a good life.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一对短语记忆：filosofija 是“哲学”，ħsieb filosofiku 是“哲学思想”；把本词放在所描述的思想或论证旁边练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The provision or arrangement of money to pay for a project, activity, or purchase.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为项目、活动或购买事项提供或筹措所需资金。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti jew l-arranġament tal-flus meħtieġa għal proġett, attività jew xiri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 资金支持；为项目或活动提供的经费。
融资；为项目、经营或购买事项筹措和安排资金。

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni applikat għal finanzjament biex tiftaħ ċentru ġdid għaż-żgħażagħ.
formal.en: The organization applied for funding to open a new youth centre.
formal.zh: 该组织申请了资金支持，用于开设一个新的青年中心。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għandkom il-flus biex tibdew il-proġett? Mark: Għadna qed infittxu finanzjament; il-pjan diġà lest.
colloquial.en: Lara: Do you have the money to start the project? Mark: We're still looking for funding; the plan is already ready.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你们有启动项目的资金了吗？Mark：我们还在寻找资金支持，计划已经准备好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 你们有启动项目的资金了吗？
messages.en: Do you have the money to start the project?

messages.speaker: Mark (项目负责人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadna qed infittxu finanzjament; il-pjan diġà lest.
messages.mt_standard: Għadna qed infittxu finanzjament; il-pjan diġà lest.
messages.zh: 我们还在寻找资金支持，计划已经准备好了。
messages.en: We're still looking for funding; the plan is already ready.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象项目计划已经画好，旁边还缺一个装钱的信封；finanzjament 就是让项目获得所需资金的支持或融资安排。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Related to money, financial resources, or the management of income and spending.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与金钱、资金或收支管理有关的；财务的或金融的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-flus, mar-riżorsi ta' flus jew mal-ġestjoni tad-dħul u l-infiq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 财务的；金融的；与资金、收支或财务管理有关的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport finanzjarju jippreżenta d-dħul u l-infiq tal-organizzazzjoni matul is-sena.
formal.en: The financial report presents the organization's income and expenditure during the year.
formal.zh: 这份财务报告列出了该组织本年度的收入与支出。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ktibt l-ispejjeż kollha? Lara: Biex nagħmel pjan finanzjarju u nkun naf kemm nista' nonfoq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did you write down all the expenses? Lara: To make a financial plan and know how much I can spend.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么把所有开销都记下来了？Lara：为了做个财务计划，弄清楚自己能花多少钱。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么把所有开销都记下来了？
messages.en: Why did you write down all the expenses?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex nagħmel pjan finanzjarju u nkun naf kemm nista' nonfoq.
messages.mt_standard: Biex nagħmel pjan finanzjarju u nkun naf kemm nista' nonfoq.
messages.zh: 为了做个财务计划，弄清楚自己能花多少钱。
messages.en: To make a financial plan and know how much I can spend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 finanzjarju 贴在账本、预算和报告旁边，记成“与钱和收支有关的”；用 rapport finanzjarju 整组记住形容词用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: From Finland or related to Finland, its people, or its language.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自芬兰的，或与芬兰、芬兰人及芬兰语有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Finlandja jew li għandu x'jaqsam ma' dan il-pajjiż, man-nies tiegħu jew mal-lingwa tiegħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芬兰的；芬兰人的；芬兰语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to Finland
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自芬兰的，或与芬兰有关的。
芬兰人；指人的名词，此形式可用于男性。
芬兰语；指语言名称的名词。

formal.mt: Student finlandiż ipparteċipa fis-seminar u ppreżenta eżempji bil-Finlandiż.
formal.en: A Finnish student participated in the seminar and presented examples in Finnish.
formal.zh: 一名芬兰学生参加了研讨会，并用芬兰语展示例子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dak l-istudent finlandiż jitkellem bil-Malti? Mark: Iva, u jien qed nitgħallem il-Finlandiż miegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does that Finnish student speak Maltese? Mark: Yes, and I'm learning Finnish with him.
colloquial.zh: Maja：那个芬兰学生会说马耳他语吗？Mark：会，而且我正在跟他学芬兰语。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那个芬兰学生会说马耳他语吗？
messages.en: Does that Finnish student speak Maltese?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u jien qed nitgħallem il-Finlandiż miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u jien qed nitgħallem il-Finlandiż miegħu.
messages.zh: 会，而且我正在跟他学芬兰语。
messages.en: Yes, and I'm learning Finnish with him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画三张卡片分别写“属性、人、语言”：student finlandiż 表属性，指人时是芬兰人，nitgħallem il-Finlandiż 则表示学习芬兰语。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Finland, a country in Northern Europe whose official name is the Republic of Finland.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芬兰，位于北欧的国家，正式名称为芬兰共和国。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa li l-isem uffiċjali tiegħu huwa r-Repubblika tal-Finlandja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芬兰；北欧国家的专有名称。

sense_translations.en_definition: Finland (a country in Northern Europe; official name: Repubblika tal-Finlandja)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 芬兰，位于北欧的国家，正式名称为芬兰共和国。

formal.mt: Il-Finlandja hija pajjiż fit-Tramuntana tal-Ewropa, u l-isem uffiċjali tagħha huwa r-Repubblika tal-Finlandja.
formal.en: Finland is a country in Northern Europe, and its official name is the Republic of Finland.
formal.zh: 芬兰是一个位于北欧的国家，正式名称为芬兰共和国。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejjer għall-vaganzi? Mark: Se mmur il-Finlandja biex inżur ħabib.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Mark: I'm going to Finland to visit a friend.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你打算去哪里度假？Mark：我要去芬兰看望一个朋友。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se mmur il-Finlandja biex inżur ħabib.
messages.mt_standard: Se mmur il-Finlandja biex inżur ħabib.
messages.zh: 我要去芬兰看望一个朋友。
messages.en: I'm going to Finland to visit a friend.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Finlandja 写在北欧地图的国家标签上，再用“去芬兰”练习 il-Finlandja；记住它指国家，与表示人或语言的 finlandiż 区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To separate people or things, or to divide something into distinct parts or groups.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把人或事物分开，或把某物分成不同部分或组别。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iżomm persuni jew affarijiet mifrudin minn xulxin, jew jaqsam xi ħaġa f'partijiet jew gruppi distinti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 分开；使原本在一起的人或事物彼此分离。
划分；把整体分成不同部分或组别。
分割；使某物分成两个或多个部分。

collocations.en: he separated the papers by colour
collocations.zh: 他按颜色把纸张分开了

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiem fired il-karti bojod minn dawk ikkuluriti qabel ir-riċiklaġġ.
formal.en: The worker separated the white papers from the coloured ones before recycling.
formal.zh: 工人在回收之前，把白色纸张与彩色纸张分开了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min fired il-karti bojod minn dawk blu? Lara: Mark fired il-karti skont il-kulur biex insibuhom aktar malajr.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who separated the white papers from the blue ones? Lara: Mark separated the papers by colour so we can find them more quickly.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把白纸和蓝纸分开了？Lara：Mark 按颜色把纸分开了，这样我们找起来更快。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Min fired il-karti bojod minn dawk blu?
messages.mt_standard: Min fired il-karti bojod minn dawk blu?
messages.zh: 谁把白纸和蓝纸分开了？
messages.en: Who separated the white papers from the blue ones?

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark fired il-karti skont il-kulur biex insibuhom aktar malajr.
messages.mt_standard: Mark fired il-karti skont il-kulur biex insibuhom aktar malajr.
messages.zh: Mark 按颜色把纸分开了，这样我们找起来更快。
messages.en: Mark separated the papers by colour so we can find them more quickly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象双手把混在一起的白纸和蓝纸分成两堆，用 fired 配这个动作来记“分开”；在这里按马耳他语词义理解，避免套用英语同形词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To spread something out over a surface so that it lies flat or covers an area.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西铺在一个表面上，使其展开、平整或覆盖一定范围。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tiftaħ jew tqassam xi ħaġa fuq wiċċ biex tkun mifruxa jew tgħatti dak il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使平整；把表面弄平。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread over a flat surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在平面上铺开或摊开。
像毯子一样覆盖；全面铺盖。

sense_translations.en_definition: to disperse over a wide area
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使散布到广阔区域。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spread out, to spread something over a surface
sense_translations.zh_definition: 展开；把某物铺在一个表面上。

collocations.en: spread the blanket over the bed
spread the papers out on the table

formal.mt: Qabel il-laqgħa, is-segretarju firex id-dokumenti fuq il-mejda biex kulħadd ikun jista' jarahom.
formal.en: Before the meeting, the secretary spread the documents out on the table so that everyone could see them.
formal.zh: 会议开始前，秘书把文件摊在桌上，让所有人都能看见。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min firex il-kutra fuq is-sufan? Mark: Jien, biex il-qattus ikollu fejn jorqod.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who spread the blanket over the sofa? Mark: I did, so the cat would have somewhere to sleep.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把毯子铺在沙发上了？马克：我铺的，好让猫有个地方睡觉。

messages.zh: 谁把毯子铺在沙发上了？

messages.mt_spoken: Jien, biex il-qattus ikollu fejn jorqod.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, biex il-qattus ikollu fejn jorqod.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象把卷起的毯子展开铺满床面：从一团变成一片，就记住 firex 的“铺开、覆盖”。

gloss_zh: 用襁褓包裹婴儿；襁褓包裹

teaching_sense.en_definition: To wrap a baby in swaddling cloths.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用襁褓布把婴儿包裹起来。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tgeżwer tarbija fi ħrieqi jew fi drapp tal-fisqija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用襁褓包裹。
婴儿的襁褓包裹（此处保留名词用法）。
用襁褓包裹婴儿。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, il-missier fisqa lit-tarbija b'ċarruta ratba u qagħad ħdejha.
formal.en: In the story, the father swaddled the baby in a soft cloth and sat beside her.
formal.zh: 故事中，父亲用柔软的布把女婴包裹起来，然后坐在她身边。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Min fisqa lit-tarbija? Pawlu: Missierha; issa rieqda ħdejh.
colloquial.en: Lara: Who swaddled the baby? Pawlu: Her father; she's sleeping beside him now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：谁给宝宝裹的襁褓？保罗：她爸爸；她现在正睡在他旁边。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 谁给宝宝裹的襁褓？
messages.en: Who swaddled the baby?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 她爸爸；她现在正睡在他旁边。
messages.en: Her father; she's sleeping beside him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用画面区分动作和物品：看见大人把布裹到宝宝身上，就联想 fisqa 的“裹襁褓”动作。

gloss_zh: 襁褓布；婴儿摇篮；护腰带

teaching_sense.en_definition: A cloth or set of cloths used to swaddle a baby.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用来包裹婴儿的一块或一套襁褓布。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Drapp jew sett ta' ħrieqi li jintużaw biex titgeżwer tarbija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 用来包裹幼儿的襁褓衣布。
供婴幼儿使用的摇篮。
襁褓衣布；包裹婴儿的布。

sense_translations.en_definition: sort of bandage worn as protection against backache
sense_translations.zh_definition: 佩戴在腰背部、用于防护腰背疼痛的一种包扎带或护腰带。
襁褓布；一块或多块包裹婴儿的布。

formal.mt: Fir-ritratt tidher fisqija bajda tal-qoton li kienet tintuża biex titgeżwer it-tarbija.
formal.en: The photograph shows a white cotton swaddling cloth that was used to wrap the baby.
formal.zh: 照片中可以看到一块白色棉质襁褓布，当时用来包裹婴儿。

colloquial.en: Maja: Where did you put the baby's swaddling cloth? Mark: In the drawer, next to the clean clothes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你把宝宝的襁褓布放哪儿了？马克：放在抽屉里，干净衣服旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)

teaching_sense.en_definition: To pamper someone by giving them special attention or indulging their wishes.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 格外宠爱某人，给予特别照顾，或纵容其愿望和要求。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħti lil xi ħadd ħafna attenzjoni u kura, jew taqtagħlu wisq xewqat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 宠坏；因过度迁就而使人养成任性习惯。

sense_translations.en_definition: to pamper or otherwise indulge sb.'s whims
sense_translations.zh_definition: 娇宠某人，或以其他方式纵容其任性要求。
爱抚；温柔地抚摸。

sense_translations.en_definition: to spoil; to pamper; to be indulgent with
sense_translations.zh_definition: 宠坏；娇宠；对某人宽纵、迁就。
爱抚；轻轻抚摸。

formal.zh: 探访期间，祖父送礼物并给予特别关照，十分宠爱自己的孙辈。

messages.en: Yes, he bought him another toy!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象爷爷一边摸摸孩子的头，一边又送玩具：温柔抚摸是“爱抚”，事事迁就是“娇宠”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make the meaning of something clear by explaining or interpreting it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过说明或解读，把某事物的含义讲清楚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħmel it-tifsira ta' xi ħaġa ċara billi tispjegaha jew tinterpretaha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 解释；说明清楚。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mean; to have a meaning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 意味着；具有某种含义。
解释；阐释或解读。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who explains or interprets the meaning of a text, idea, or other subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 解释或阐释文本、观点等内容及其含义的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tispjega jew tinterpreta t-tifsira ta' test, idea jew suġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 作出解释的人；说明者。
解释者；阐释者；解读含义的人。

colloquial.en: Lara: Do we need someone to interpret this text? Pawlu: Yes, there are many symbols we don't understand.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这篇文本需要找人来阐释吗？保罗：需要，里面有很多我们看不懂的符号。

messages.speaker: Lara (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna bżonn fissier għal dan it-test?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna bżonn fissier għal dan it-test?
messages.zh: 这篇文本需要找人来阐释吗？
messages.en: Do we need someone to interpret this text?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (读书会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hemm ħafna simboli li ma nifhmux.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hemm ħafna simboli li ma nifhmux.
messages.zh: 需要，里面有很多我们看不懂的符号。
messages.en: Yes, there are many symbols we don't understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用人物卡片记忆 fissier：卡片上是一位拿着文本、为大家讲解含义的人，重点记“解释者”这个身份。

gloss_zh: 一个屁；无声的屁；爱传闲话或多管闲事的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: An instance of passing gas from the bowels, including one that makes no sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从肠道经肛门排出的一股气，即一个屁，也可指无声的屁。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħruġ ta' gass mill-imsaren minn wara, li jista' jkun bla ħoss.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一个屁；一次肠道排气。

sense_translations.en_definition: sb. who gossips or can't be trusted with a secret (figurative)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱传闲话或守不住秘密的人（比喻义）。
无声的屁。
爱管闲事、插手他人事情的人。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont umoristiku, il-karattru għamel fiswa bla ħoss waqt li kien bilqiegħda waħdu.
formal.en: In the humorous story, the character let out a silent fart while sitting alone.
formal.zh: 在这篇幽默故事中，人物独自坐着时放了一个无声的屁。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel fiswa? Mark: Ma nafx; ejja niftħu t-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who farted? Mark: I don't know; let's open the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁放屁了？马克：不知道，咱们开窗吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁放屁了？
messages.en: Who farted?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 不知道，咱们开窗吧。
messages.en: I don't know; let's open the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“有人放屁，室友开窗”的小场景记住本义；人物比喻另记成“嘴不严、爱插手”，避免混用。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become lukewarm, neither hot nor cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得温温的，处于不热也不冷的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jsir fietel, la sħun u lanqas kiesaħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得微温；变得不冷不热。
争吵；发生口角。

sense_translations.en_definition: to twine (used of rope or thread)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把绳或线捻合、绞在一起。
扭转；拧；捻。
变得温温的；变得不冷不热。

formal.mt: Il-kafè fitel waqt li l-istudent kien qed jaqra r-rapport.
formal.en: The coffee became lukewarm while the student was reading the report.
formal.zh: 学生阅读报告时，咖啡渐渐变得温温的。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Il-kafè għadu sħun? Pawlu: Le, fitel waqt li kont qed nistenna.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the coffee still hot? Pawlu: No, it became lukewarm while I was waiting.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：咖啡还热吗？保罗：不热了，我等着的时候就变温了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 咖啡还热吗？
messages.en: Is the coffee still hot?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, fitel waqt li kont qed nistenna.
messages.mt_standard: Le, fitel waqt li kont qed nistenna.
messages.zh: 不热了，我等着的时候就变温了。
messages.en: No, it became lukewarm while I was waiting.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fitel 分配三张独立画面卡：咖啡变温、两人争吵、双手捻绳；靠句中对象选择词义，不强编共同来源。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To try to find a person, thing, information, or solution.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 设法找到某个人、物品、信息或解决办法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jipprova jsib persuna, ħaġa, informazzjoni jew soluzzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搜寻；查找。
寻求；谋求。

sense_translations.en_definition: to wish for the company of sb.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 希望有人陪伴；想与某人相处。
讲究细节；对细节一丝不苟。
起诉；向某人提起诉讼。
赶快行动；抓紧去做。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ensure that sth. is the case
sense_translations.zh_definition: 确保某种情况属实或某件事得到落实。

sense_translations.en_definition: to search; to seek; to look for
sense_translations.zh_definition: 搜索；寻求；寻找。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur fittex informazzjoni dwar l-istorja tal-belt fl-arkivju.
formal.en: The researcher searched the archive for information about the city's history.
formal.zh: 研究人员在档案馆中查找有关这座城市历史的信息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ma nistax insib iċ-ċwievet. Mark: Fittex fil-borża l-blu; forsi qegħdin hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: I can't find the keys. Mark: Look in the blue bag; they might be there.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我找不到钥匙。Mark：找找那个蓝色的包，也许就在里面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我找不到钥匙。
messages.en: I can't find the keys.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fittex fil-borża l-blu; forsi qegħdin hemm.
messages.mt_standard: Fittex fil-borża l-blu; forsi qegħdin hemm.
messages.zh: 找找那个蓝色的包，也许就在里面。
messages.en: Look in the blue bag; they might be there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fittex 和翻包找钥匙的动作绑定记忆：需要设法找到东西，就想到“寻找”。其他义项再结合具体语境区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone confused or disturb their ability to think clearly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人困惑，或干扰其清楚思考的能力。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitħawwad jew ma jkunx jista' jaħseb ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使困惑；使混淆。
打扰；扰乱；使人困惑。

formal.mt: L-użu ta' żewġ termini differenti għall-istess kunċett fixel lill-istudent.
formal.en: Using two different terms for the same concept confused the student.
formal.zh: 用两个不同的术语表示同一个概念，使这名学生感到困惑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex waqaft taqra? Pawlu: Dan l-eżempju fixel il-ħsieb tiegħi. Tista' tispjegah?
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you stop reading? Pawlu: This example disrupted my thinking. Can you explain it?
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么停下来不读了？Pawlu：这个例子把我的思路弄乱了。你能解释一下吗？

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 你怎么停下来不读了？
messages.en: Why did you stop reading?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-eżempju fixel il-ħsieb tiegħi. Tista' tispjegah?
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-eżempju fixel il-ħsieb tiegħi. Tista' tispjegah?
messages.zh: 这个例子把我的思路弄乱了。你能解释一下吗？
messages.en: This example disrupted my thinking. Can you explain it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读例句时脑中的线团被搅乱，把 fixel 记成“使人困惑、打乱思路”；用困惑的表情辅助记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To interfere with an activity, hinder progress, or make someone confused.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 干扰某项活动、阻碍事情进展，或使某人困惑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ifixkel attività, ixekkel il-progress jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitħawwad.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使困惑；使混淆。
使计划或企图受挫；阻挠其实现。
扰乱；打断正常进行的活动。
阻挡；妨碍；阻碍。
使困惑；扰乱。

formal.mt: Il-qtugħ tad-dawl fixkel ix-xogħol fl-uffiċċju għal sagħtejn.
formal.en: The power cut disrupted work in the office for two hours.
formal.zh: 停电使办公室的工作受到干扰，持续了两个小时。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Irnexxielek tispiċċa x-xogħol? David: Għadni le. L-istorbju fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Nina: Did you manage to finish the work? David: Not yet. The noise disrupted my concentration.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你把工作做完了吗？David：还没有。噪声让我无法集中注意力。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.zh: 你把工作做完了吗？
messages.en: Did you manage to finish the work?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadni le. L-istorbju fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tiegħi.
messages.mt_standard: Għadni le. L-istorbju fixkel il-konċentrazzjoni tiegħi.
messages.zh: 还没有。噪声让我无法集中注意力。
messages.en: Not yet. The noise disrupted my concentration.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fixkel 配上“会议被噪声打断”的画面：事情进行中遇到干扰或阻碍，也可能因此让人困惑。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Radish, a vegetable with a crisp, often peppery root that is commonly eaten raw.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 小萝卜，一种根部爽脆、常带辛辣味的蔬菜，通常可以生吃。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaxix b'għerq tqarmeċ u spiss b'togħma xi ftit taħraq, li ħafna drabi jittiekel nej.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小萝卜；根部爽脆、常用于生食或拌沙拉的蔬菜。

formal.mt: Aħsel il-fiġel sew u aqtagħlu l-weraq qabel iżżidu mal-insalata.
formal.en: Wash the radish thoroughly and remove its leaves before adding it to the salad.
formal.zh: 将小萝卜充分洗净并去掉叶子，再加入沙拉。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit fiġel mal-insalata? Mark: Iva, imma aqtagħu rqiq, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some radish with the salad? Mark: Yes, but slice it thinly, please.
colloquial.zh: Maja：沙拉里要加一点小萝卜吗？Mark：要，不过请切薄一点。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 沙拉里要加一点小萝卜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some radish with the salad?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma aqtagħu rqiq, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma aqtagħu rqiq, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 要，不过请切薄一点。
messages.en: Yes, but slice it thinly, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 fiġel 就想象沙拉里爽脆、略带辣味的小萝卜薄片，把词形与切片、入口的感觉一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become useful or turn out to be helpful in a particular situation.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某种情况下变得有用，或实际证明能够提供帮助。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir utli jew jirriżulta li jkun ta' għajnuna f'sitwazzjoni partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得有用；开始发挥用处。
证明有用；实际派上用场。

formal.mt: Il-parir tal-għalliem fjad waqt it-tħejjija għat-taħdita.
formal.en: The teacher's advice proved useful during preparation for the talk.
formal.zh: 老师的建议在准备演讲时派上了用场。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Il-parir li tajtek fjad? Samwel: Iva, fjad ħafna meta kont qed inħejji t-taħdita.
colloquial.en: Rita: Did the advice I gave you prove useful? Samwel: Yes, it was very useful when I was preparing the talk.
colloquial.zh: Rita：我给你的建议派上用场了吗？Samwel：是的，我准备演讲时，它帮了大忙。

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 我给你的建议派上用场了吗？
messages.en: Did the advice I gave you prove useful?

messages.speaker: Samwel (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, fjad ħafna meta kont qed inħejji t-taħdita.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, fjad ħafna meta kont qed inħejji t-taħdita.
messages.zh: 是的，我准备演讲时，它帮了大忙。
messages.en: Yes, it was very useful when I was preparing the talk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一条建议起初只是记在纸上，后来解决了实际问题；把 fjad 与“终于派上用场”这一刻联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Weak or lacking physical strength and energy.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体虚弱、力气不足或缺乏精力的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dgħajjef jew bla saħħa u enerġija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 营养不良的。
衰弱的；无力的。
质量差的；水平低的。
虚弱的；力量不足的。
饥饿的；肚子饿的。
漠不关心的；缺乏热情的。

formal.mt: L-argument fir-rapport huwa fjakk għax ma jinkludix biżżejjed evidenza.
formal.en: The argument in the report is weak because it does not include enough evidence.
formal.zh: 报告中的论证较为薄弱，因为其中没有提供足够的证据。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid tiġi timxi magħna? Ġużi: Illum le, qed inħossni fjakk u rrid nistrieħ.
colloquial.en: Anna: Do you want to come for a walk with us? Ġużi: Not today; I'm feeling weak and want to rest.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你想和我们一起去散步吗？Ġużi：今天不去了，我觉得没力气，想休息一下。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想和我们一起去散步吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come for a walk with us?

messages.speaker: Ġużi (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum le, qed inħossni fjakk u rrid nistrieħ.
messages.mt_standard: Illum le, qed inħossni fjakk u rrid nistrieħ.
messages.zh: 今天不去了，我觉得没力气，想休息一下。
messages.en: Not today; I'm feeling weak and want to rest.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fjakk 放进“累得坐下休息”的画面，先记“虚弱、无力”；形容论证时，也可联想为缺少支撑、显得薄弱。

gloss_zh: 不诚实地行事；耍两面手法

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act insincerely or dishonestly toward someone, especially by double-dealing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不真诚或不诚实地对待某人，尤其指耍两面手法。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib ruħu b'qerq jew mingħajr sinċerità ma' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 怀着不诚实的意图行事；缺乏诚意地行事。
耍两面手法；表面合作而暗中欺骗。
变得虚伪；开始表里不一。
变得怀疑起来；开始起疑。

collocations.en: acted in bad faith toward the customers

formal.mt: In-negozjant flaz mal-klijenti tiegħu meta ħeba l-ispejjeż addizzjonali.
formal.en: The trader acted in bad faith toward his customers when he concealed the additional costs.
formal.zh: 这名商人隐瞒额外费用，不诚实地对待自己的顾客。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex m'għadekx tafdah? Toni: Flaz miegħi: wegħedni ħaġa u minn wara dahri għamel oħra.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why don't you trust him anymore? Toni: He double-dealt with me: he promised me one thing and did another behind my back.
colloquial.zh: Marta：你为什么不再信任他了？Toni：他对我耍两面手法，答应我一套，背着我又做另一套。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么不再信任他了？
messages.en: Why don't you trust him anymore?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Flaz miegħi: wegħedni ħaġa u minn wara dahri għamel oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Flaz miegħi: wegħedni ħaġa u minn wara dahri għamel oħra.
messages.zh: 他对我耍两面手法，答应我一套，背着我又做另一套。
messages.en: He double-dealt with me: he promised me one thing and did another behind my back.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“当面答应、背后变卦”的小故事记 flaz 的不诚实义；另把“开始起疑”单独做一张义项卡，避免混淆行为与心理。

teaching_sense.en_definition: With another person or other people, or as a group.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人或其他人一起，或作为一个群体共同做某事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma' persuna oħra jew ma' persuni oħra, jew bħala grupp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一起；共同；在一处。

formal.mt: L-istudenti ħadmu flimkien biex iħejju rapport dwar l-ambjent.
formal.en: The students worked together to prepare a report about the environment.
formal.zh: 学生们共同完成了一份关于环境的报告。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Trid nieklu flimkien illum? Luqa: Iva, niltaqgħu quddiem il-kafetterija f'nofsinhar.
colloquial.en: Sara: Would you like us to eat together today? Luqa: Yes, let's meet outside the cafeteria at noon.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天一起吃饭好吗？Luqa：好，我们中午在自助餐厅门口见。

messages.speaker: Sara (同学)
messages.zh: 今天一起吃饭好吗？

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)

messages.en: Yes, let's meet outside the cafeteria at noon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人并肩工作、同桌吃饭，把 flimkien 贴在两人中间，记住它表示“一起、共同”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A container, usually with a narrow neck, used for holding liquids.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常带有较窄瓶颈、用来盛放液体的容器。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Reċipjent, ġeneralment b'għonq dejjaq, li jintuża biex jinżammu fih likwidi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 瓶；瓶子。

formal.mt: Jekk jogħġbok, poġġi flixkun ilma fuq kull mejda qabel tibda l-laqgħa.
formal.en: Please place a bottle of water on each table before the meeting begins.
formal.zh: 请在会议开始前，在每张桌子上放一瓶水。

colloquial.en: Mark: Can I have a bottle of water, please? Rita: Of course. Would you like it cold or at room temperature?
colloquial.zh: Mark：请给我一瓶水，好吗？Rita：当然。你要冰的还是常温的？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu flixkun ilma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu flixkun ilma, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一瓶水，好吗？

messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Tridu kiesaħ jew f'temperatura tal-kamra?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Tridu kiesaħ jew f'temperatura tal-kamra?
