gloss_zh: 上衣；衬衫；活结；艏三角帆

teaching_sense.en_definition: A garment worn on the upper body, such as a T-shirt, blouse or jumper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在上半身的衣物，例如T恤、女式衬衫或套头毛衣。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa lbies li tintlibes fuq il-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem, bħal T-shirt, blusa jew ġerżi.

sense_translations.en_definition: any upper garment (e.g. t-shirt, blouse, jumper)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 任何穿在上半身的衣物，例如T恤、女式衬衫或套头毛衣。
衬衫。
活结；拉动绳端即可松开或调节的绳结。
艏三角帆；设在船首一侧的三角形前帆。

formal.mt: Għall-attività sportiva, kull parteċipant għandu jilbes flokk abjad u żraben komdi.
formal.en: For the sporting activity, each participant should wear a white top and comfortable shoes.
formal.zh: 参加体育活动时，每位参与者应穿白色上衣和舒适的鞋子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Liema flokk se tilbes illum? Mark: Il-flokk blu, għax huwa komdu ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: Which top are you going to wear today? Mark: The blue top, because it is very comfortable.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天要穿哪件上衣？马克：蓝色那件，因为它很舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天要穿哪件上衣？
messages.en: Which top are you going to wear today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-flokk blu, għax huwa komdu ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Il-flokk blu, għax huwa komdu ħafna.
messages.zh: 蓝色那件，因为它很舒服。
messages.en: The blue top, because it is very comfortable.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象衣柜里一排上衣，每拿起一件就说 flokk；绳结和帆的意思另配图片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Money used to pay for goods and services or kept as savings.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于购买商品、支付服务费用或储蓄的钱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Dak li nużaw biex inħallsu għal oġġetti u servizzi, jew li nfaddlu għal aktar tard.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 钱；用于付款、交易或储蓄的金钱。
货币；某个国家或地区使用的支付媒介。

formal.mt: Il-flus miġbura waqt l-attività se jintużaw biex jinxtraw kotba għal-librerija.
formal.en: The money collected during the event will be used to buy books for the library.
formal.zh: 活动期间筹集的钱将用于为图书馆购买书籍。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek flus għall-biljett? Pawlu: Iva, għandi biżżejjed għalina t-tnejn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have money for the ticket? Pawlu: Yes, I have enough for both of us.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你有买票的钱吗？保罗：有，我的钱够我们两个人用。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有买票的钱吗？
messages.en: Do you have money for the ticket?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我的钱够我们两个人用。
messages.en: Yes, I have enough for both of us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 flus 放进钱包的画面里：买票要用钱，存钱也用这个词；常见搭配是省钱和花钱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make something deeper or to become deeper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某物的深度增加，或自身变得更深。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa aktar fonda jew isir aktar fond.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 加深；使某物变得更深。
变深；自身的深度增加。

formal.mt: Wara x-xita qawwija, il-foss fnad minħabba l-erożjoni tal-ħamrija.
formal.en: After the heavy rain, the ditch became deeper because of soil erosion.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，沟因土壤侵蚀而变深了。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Dan il-foss fnad minn meta ġejna l-aħħar darba. Toni: Veru! Ejja nimxu ftit aktar 'il bogħod minnu.
colloquial.en: Lara: This ditch has become deeper since we last came here. Toni: You're right! Let's walk a little farther away from it.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这条沟比我们上次来时更深了。托尼：确实！我们走得离它远一点吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-foss fnad minn meta ġejna l-aħħar darba.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-foss fnad minn meta ġejna l-aħħar darba.
messages.zh: 这条沟比我们上次来时更深了。
messages.en: This ditch has become deeper since we last came here.

messages.speaker: Toni (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ejja nimxu ftit aktar 'il bogħod minnu.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ejja nimxu ftit aktar 'il bogħod minnu.
messages.zh: 确实！我们走得离它远一点吧。
messages.en: You're right! Let's walk a little farther away from it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画出同一条沟的前后对比：浅沟变深沟，用 fnad 记住深度增加这个动作。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A single thin, flat piece of material, especially paper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一张或一片薄而平的材料，尤其指纸张。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa waħda rqiqa u ċatta ta' materjal, speċjalment karta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水疱；皮肤上鼓起、内有液体的小泡。
书页；书中的一叶或一页。
一张纸或一片薄材料。

formal.mt: Kull student għandu jikteb ismu fin-naħa ta' fuq tal-folja.
formal.en: Each student should write their name at the top of the sheet.
formal.zh: 每位学生应在纸张上方写上自己的姓名。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Tista' tagħtini folja vojta? Emma: Żgur, ħu din. Trid pinna wkoll?
colloquial.en: Ben: Can you give me a blank sheet? Emma: Sure, take this one. Do you want a pen too?
colloquial.zh: 本：你能给我一张白纸吗？艾玛：当然，拿这张吧。你还要笔吗？

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 你能给我一张白纸吗？
messages.en: Can you give me a blank sheet?

messages.speaker: Emma (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur, ħu din. Trid pinna wkoll?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur, ħu din. Trid pinna wkoll?
messages.zh: 当然，拿这张吧。你还要笔吗？
messages.en: Sure, take this one. Do you want a pen too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 folja 做三张图卡：一张纸、一页书、一个水疱；用图像分别记住不同义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large group of people gathered together in one place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集在同一地点的一大群人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd kbir ta' nies miġbura flimkien fl-istess post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 人群；聚集在一起的许多人。
密集的人群；拥挤聚集的大群人。

formal.mt: Folla kbira nġabret fil-pjazza biex tara l-kunċert.
formal.en: A large crowd gathered in the square to watch the concert.
formal.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上观看音乐会。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Ara kemm hemm nies! Kif se ngħaddu minn din il-folla? Ġużeppi: Ejja ngħaddu mit-triq l-oħra.
colloquial.en: Marija: Look how many people there are! How are we going to get through this crowd? Ġużeppi: Let's take the other street.
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：看，人真多！我们怎么穿过这群人？朱塞佩：我们走另一条街吧。

messages.speaker: Marija (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hemm nies! Kif se ngħaddu minn din il-folla?
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hemm nies! Kif se ngħaddu minn din il-folla?
messages.zh: 看，人真多！我们怎么穿过这群人？
messages.en: Look how many people there are! How are we going to get through this crowd?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (同行朋友)
messages.zh: 我们走另一条街吧。
messages.en: Let's take the other street.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象广场上挤满观众，一整群人就是 folla；与 folja 的纸张图卡分开记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Extending a long way down from the surface or top.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从表面或顶部向下延伸距离很大的；深的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinżel ħafna 'l isfel mill-wiċċ jew min-naħa ta' fuq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 深的；从表面到底部距离较大的。

sense_translations.en_definition: depth (that which is deep below; the deepest part)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 深处；位于下方很深的地方或最深的部分。
底部；最下面的部分或底面。
基金；为特定用途筹集或留存的一笔资金。

formal.mt: Il-bir huwa fond ħafna, għalhekk il-kejl għandu jsir b'tagħmir adattat.
formal.en: The well is very deep, so measurements should be taken with suitable equipment.
formal.zh: 这口井很深，因此应使用合适的设备进行测量。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Dan il-pixxina fond? David: Iva, f'din in-naħa. In-naħa l-oħra għandha ilma baxx.
colloquial.en: Lina: Is this pool deep? David: Yes, on this side. The other side has shallow water.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：这个游泳池深吗？戴维：这一边深，另一边的水浅。

messages.speaker: Lina (游泳同伴)
messages.zh: 这个游泳池深吗？
messages.en: Is this pool deep?

messages.speaker: David (游泳同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, f'din in-naħa. In-naħa l-oħra għandha ilma baxx.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, f'din in-naħa. In-naħa l-oħra għandha ilma baxx.
messages.zh: 这一边深，另一边的水浅。
messages.en: Yes, on this side. The other side has shallow water.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用深井记形容词 fond，用井的深处和底部记空间名词，再用储蓄罐单独记基金义。

gloss_zh: 集市；空腔；地面凹陷；深壑；旅店

teaching_sense.en_definition: A deep hollow or chasm in the ground.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 地面上的深坑、深凹处或深壑。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħofra fonda jew xaqq fond fl-art.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 集市；有多家摊位或店铺集中交易的市场。
空腔；物体内部或表面的空洞。

sense_translations.en_definition: a declivity or dip in the land
sense_translations.zh_definition: 地面的下斜处或凹陷地带。
深壑；地面或岩石间很深的裂隙。
旅店；供旅客住宿的客栈或酒店。

formal.mt: Il-mappa turi fondoq qrib il-mogħdija, u s-sinjali jwissu lill-mixi biex iżommu distanza mix-xifer.
formal.en: The map shows a chasm near the path, and the signs warn walkers to keep their distance from the edge.
formal.zh: 地图标示步道附近有一道深壑，标牌提醒步行者与边缘保持距离。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ara, hemm fondoq wara dak il-blat. Pietru: Rajtu. Ejja nibqgħu fuq il-mogħdija.
colloquial.en: Anna: Look, there is a chasm behind that rock. Pietru: I saw it. Let's stay on the path.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：看，那块岩石后面有一道深壑。彼得：我看到了。我们沿着步道走吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara, hemm fondoq wara dak il-blat.
messages.mt_standard: Ara, hemm fondoq wara dak il-blat.
messages.zh: 看，那块岩石后面有一道深壑。
messages.en: Look, there is a chasm behind that rock.

messages.speaker: Pietru (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 我看到了。我们沿着步道走吧。
messages.en: I saw it. Let's stay on the path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 fondoq 建五格图像卡：集市、空腔、地面凹陷、深壑、旅店；分别配图，避免混淆义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large area of land covered mainly with trees.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 主要由大量树木覆盖的大片土地，即森林。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Medda kbira ta' art miksija l-aktar bis-siġar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 森林；大片树木生长的地区。

formal.mt: Il-proġett għandu l-għan li jipproteġi l-foresta u l-annimali li jgħixu fiha.
formal.en: The project aims to protect the forest and the animals that live in it.
formal.zh: 该项目旨在保护森林及生活在其中的动物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għal mixja fil-foresta għada? Mark: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu fit-triq immarkata.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come for a walk in the forest tomorrow? Mark: Yes, but let's stay on the marked path.
colloquial.zh: Maja：明天想一起去森林散步吗？Mark：想，不过我们沿着有标记的小路走吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tiġi għal mixja fil-foresta għada?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tiġi għal mixja fil-foresta għada?
messages.zh: 明天想一起去森林散步吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come for a walk in the forest tomorrow?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu fit-triq immarkata.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja nibqgħu fit-triq immarkata.
messages.zh: 想，不过我们沿着有标记的小路走吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's stay on the marked path.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 foresta 和一整片树木的画面相连，再用“在森林中散步”这个场景记住它。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure used for executing a person by hanging.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于执行绞刑的架子或刑台。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li tintuża biex persuna tingħata l-piena tal-mewt bit-tgħalliq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 绞刑架；用于执行绞刑的装置。
刑台；此处指执行绞刑所用的平台或架台。
绞架；用于绞刑或悬挂示众的架子。
绞刑架；绞架。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu tal-mużew jiddeskrivi mudell ta' forka espost fis-sala dwar l-istorja tal-pieni.
formal.en: The museum catalogue describes a model of a gallows displayed in the room about the history of punishments.
formal.zh: 博物馆目录介绍了惩罚史展厅中陈列的一件绞刑架模型。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhu dan il-mudell? Pawlu: Huwa mudell ta' forka; it-tabella tispjega għal xiex kienet tintuża.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is this model? Pawlu: It's a model of a gallows; the label explains what it was used for.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这是什么模型？Pawlu：这是绞刑架模型，说明牌解释了它过去的用途。

messages.speaker: Lara (参观者)
messages.zh: 这是什么模型？
messages.en: What is this model?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (博物馆讲解员)
messages.mt_spoken: Huwa mudell ta' forka; it-tabella tispjega għal xiex kienet tintuża.
messages.mt_standard: Huwa mudell ta' forka; it-tabella tispjega għal xiex kienet tintuża.
messages.zh: 这是绞刑架模型，说明牌解释了它过去的用途。
messages.en: It's a model of a gallows; the label explains what it was used for.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 forka 放进博物馆刑罚史展厅的画面中记忆；本组义项都围绕绞刑架或刑台。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The shape or form of something, or a mould used to give something a particular shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物的形状或形式，也可指使材料形成特定形状的模具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sura ta' xi ħaġa, jew reċipjent li jagħti sura partikolari lil materjal li jitqiegħed fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形状；物体的外形或轮廓。
模具；用于使材料形成特定形状的器具。
形式；形态；形状。

formal.mt: Il-forma tal-kejk tagħti lill-għaġina forma tonda waqt il-ħami.
formal.en: The cake mould gives the batter a round shape during baking.
formal.zh: 蛋糕模具在烘烤过程中使面糊形成圆形。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Liema forma tal-kejk se nużaw? Nina: Dik tonda, għax irrid kejk f'forma ta' ċirku.
colloquial.en: Sara: Which cake mould are we going to use? Nina: The round one, because I want a circle-shaped cake.
colloquial.zh: Sara：我们用哪个蛋糕模具？Nina：圆的那个，因为我想做一个圆形蛋糕。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们用哪个蛋糕模具？
messages.en: Which cake mould are we going to use?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dik tonda, għax irrid kejk f'forma ta' ċirku.
messages.mt_standard: Dik tonda, għax irrid kejk f'forma ta' ċirku.
messages.zh: 圆的那个，因为我想做一个圆形蛋糕。
messages.en: The round one, because I want a circle-shaped cake.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“模具决定形状”串起 forma 的两个具体义项：装面糊的是模具，烤出来呈现的是形状。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The process of forming something, or the arrangement produced when things come together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物形成或组成的过程，也可指由各部分构成的排列形态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-proċess li bih tinħoloq jew tingħaqad xi ħaġa, jew l-arranġament tal-partijiet tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 形成；组成；形成的结构或排列。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jispjega kif it-temperatura u l-umdità jinfluwenzaw il-formazzjoni tas-sħab.
formal.en: The report explains how temperature and humidity influence the formation of clouds.
formal.zh: 报告解释了温度和湿度如何影响云的形成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif sejra l-formazzjoni tal-grupp tal-qari? Mark: Tajjeb, diġà sibna sitt persuni li jridu jingħaqdu magħna.
colloquial.en: Maja: How is the formation of the reading group going? Mark: Well, we've already found six people who want to join us.
colloquial.zh: Maja：读书小组组建得怎么样了？Mark：挺顺利，我们已经找到六个想加入的人了。

messages.speaker: Maja (读书活动组织者)

messages.en: How is the formation of the reading group going?

messages.speaker: Mark (读书活动组织者)
messages.mt_spoken: Tajjeb, diġà sibna sitt persuni li jridu jingħaqdu magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Tajjeb, diġà sibna sitt persuni li jridu jingħaqdu magħna.
messages.zh: 挺顺利，我们已经找到六个想加入的人了。
messages.en: Well, we've already found six people who want to join us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“两幅形成中的画面”记住 formazzjoni：水汽形成云，人们组成小组，重点都在形成过程。

gloss_zh: Formosa（马耳他姓氏，可音译为“福尔莫萨”）

teaching_sense.en_definition: A Maltese family name, written Formosa with an initial capital letter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他姓氏 Formosa，作为专有名词书写时首字母大写。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kunjom Malti li jinkiteb Formosa, b'ittra kbira fil-bidu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他姓氏 Formosa。
姓氏；此处为 Formosa。

formal.mt: Is-Sinjura Formosa se tippreżenta r-rapport waqt il-laqgħa ta' għada.
formal.en: Ms Formosa will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.
formal.zh: Formosa 女士将在明天的会议上介绍这份报告。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għandi appuntament mas-Sur Formosa. Lara: Iva, qed jistenniek fl-uffiċċju.
colloquial.en: Anna: I have an appointment with Mr Formosa. Lara: Yes, he's waiting for you in the office.
colloquial.zh: Anna：我和 Formosa 先生有预约。Lara：好的，他正在办公室等你。

messages.speaker: Anna (访客)
messages.zh: 我和 Formosa 先生有预约。
messages.en: I have an appointment with Mr Formosa.

messages.speaker: Lara (接待员)

messages.en: Yes, he's waiting for you in the office.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象办公室门牌写着“Sur Formosa”，用称谓加姓氏的组合记住它，并注意姓氏首字母大写。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An enclosed appliance or chamber used to bake or roast food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用封闭空间中的热量烘烤食物的设备，即烤箱或烤炉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat jew spazju magħluq li fih jissajjar l-ikel bis-sħana.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烤箱；用于烘烤食物的烤炉。

collocations.en: put the bread in the oven

formal.mt: Saħħan il-forn għal 180 grad Celsius qabel iddaħħal it-taġen bil-kejk.
formal.en: Heat the oven to 180 degrees Celsius before putting in the cake tin.
formal.zh: 放入蛋糕烤盘前，先将烤箱加热至摄氏180度。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Il-forn diġà sħun? Pawlu: Iva, tista' ddaħħal il-pizza issa.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is the oven hot already? Pawlu: Yes, you can put the pizza in now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：烤箱已经热了吗？Pawlu：热了，现在可以把披萨放进去了。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 烤箱已经热了吗？
messages.en: Is the oven hot already?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 热了，现在可以把披萨放进去了。
messages.en: Yes, you can put the pizza in now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 forn 和“开门、放入面包、关门烘烤”三个动作绑定，记住它是容纳食物烘烤的烤箱。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be or become empty; also, for water or a tide to recede.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 处于空的状态或变空；也可指水退去或潮水回落。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikun jew isir vojt; jingħad ukoll għall-ilma jew għall-marea meta jonqsu jew jirtiraw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变空；原本装有东西或有人的地方空下来。
是空的；变空；处于或进入空无内容的状态。
退去；回落；指水位下降或潮水退落。

formal.mt: Wara xhur mingħajr xita, il-ġibjun forogħ u ma baqax ilma għat-tisqija.
formal.en: After months without rain, the reservoir became empty and no water remained for irrigation.
formal.zh: 数月无雨后，蓄水池空了，没有水可供灌溉。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Il-maħżen forogħ wara li ħadtu l-kaxxi kollha? Sara: Iva, issa hemm biss l-ixkafef.
colloquial.en: Mark: Did the storeroom become empty after you took all the boxes? Sara: Yes, now only the shelves are there.
colloquial.zh: Mark：你们把所有箱子搬走后，储藏室就空了吗？Sara：是的，现在只剩架子了。

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-maħżen forogħ wara li ħadtu l-kaxxi kollha?
messages.mt_standard: Il-maħżen forogħ wara li ħadtu l-kaxxi kollha?
messages.zh: 你们把所有箱子搬走后，储藏室就空了吗？
messages.en: Did the storeroom become empty after you took all the boxes?

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: 是的，现在只剩架子了。
messages.en: Yes, now only the shelves are there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“内容减少直到空下来”的连续画面记 forogħ，再把水向后退的画面关联到退水、退潮义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Used to say that something is possible but not certain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示某事有可能发生或成立，但说话者并不确定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex turi li xi ħaġa hija possibbli iżda mhix ċerta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 也许；可能；表示不确定的可能性。
也许；或许；表示推测或尚未确定。

formal.mt: Forsi jkun meħtieġ aktar żmien biex titlesta l-analiżi.
formal.en: Perhaps more time will be needed to complete the analysis.
formal.zh: 完成分析或许需要更多时间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Se tiġi magħna llejla? Maja: Forsi, għadni ma nafx x'ħin se nispiċċa x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Are you coming with us tonight? Maja: Maybe, I don't know yet what time I'll finish work.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今晚你和我们一起去吗？Maja：也许吧，我还不知道几点能下班。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今晚你和我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Are you coming with us tonight?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Forsi, għadni ma nafx x'ħin se nispiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.mt_standard: Forsi, għadni ma nafx x'ħin se nispiċċa x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 也许吧，我还不知道几点能下班。
messages.en: Maybe, I don't know yet what time I'll finish work.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象朋友问今晚来不来，你还没确定，便回答 forsi；把它与“也许吧”的语气一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A protective covering, such as an insect's cocoon, a shell, or a seed pod.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 起保护作用的外层包裹物，可指昆虫的茧、坚硬的壳或包着种子的荚。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kisja li tipproteġi, bħal dik ta' dudu tal-ħarir, qoxra iebsa jew għata li fiha jkun hemm iż-żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茧；某些昆虫在发育过程中形成的保护性包裹物。
壳；荚；包裹果实或种子的外层结构。

formal.mt: Id-dudu tal-ħarir jagħmel fosdqa madwaru qabel ma jinbidel f'farfett.
formal.en: The silkworm makes a cocoon around itself before turning into a moth.
formal.zh: 蚕在变成蛾之前，会在身体周围结一个茧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'hemm f'din il-fosdqa tal-piżelli? Pawlu: Iftaħha bil-mod u tara l-piżelli ġewwa.
colloquial.en: Maja: What's in this pea pod? Pawlu: Open it gently and you'll see the peas inside.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个豌豆荚里有什么？Pawlu：轻轻打开，就能看见里面的豌豆。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这个豌豆荚里有什么？
messages.en: What's in this pea pod?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iftaħha bil-mod u tara l-piżelli ġewwa.
messages.mt_standard: Iftaħha bil-mod u tara l-piżelli ġewwa.
messages.zh: 轻轻打开，就能看见里面的豌豆。
messages.en: Open it gently and you'll see the peas inside.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把茧、果壳和豆荚想成三种保护小屋，用共同的“外层包裹”画面记住 fosdqa。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Among or within a group of people or things.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示处于一群人或一组事物之中，或属于其中的一部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Juri li xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa qiegħed jew qiegħda fi grupp jew jagħmel jew tagħmel parti minnu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……之中；在一群人或一组事物当中。
在……之间或之中；表示置身于某个群体或集合内。

formal.mt: Fost il-parteċipanti kien hemm għalliema, studenti u riċerkaturi.
formal.en: Among the participants were teachers, students, and researchers.
formal.zh: 参与者中有教师、学生和研究人员。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Rajt lil Mark fost in-nies? Luqa: Iva, kien ħdejn il-bieb ma' sħabu.
colloquial.en: Sara: Did you see Mark among the people? Luqa: Yes, he was by the door with his friends.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你在人群里看见 Mark 了吗？Luqa：看见了，他和朋友们在门边。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你在人群里看见 Mark 了吗？
messages.en: Did you see Mark among the people?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, kien ħdejn il-bieb ma' sħabu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, kien ħdejn il-bieb ma' sħabu.
messages.zh: 看见了，他和朋友们在门边。
messages.en: Yes, he was by the door with his friends.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象在人群合照中圈出一个人：他就在大家“当中”，用这个位置画面记住 fost。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The art, skill, or practice of making images with a camera.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使用相机制作影像的艺术、技术或实践活动，即摄影。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-arti, il-ħila jew il-prattika li jinħolqu immaġnijiet permezz ta' kamera.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 摄影；用相机制作影像的艺术、技术或活动。

formal.mt: Il-kors tal-fotografija jinkludi lezzjonijiet dwar id-dawl u l-kompożizzjoni.
formal.en: The photography course includes lessons on lighting and composition.
formal.zh: 这门摄影课程包括用光和构图方面的教学。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex qed iġġorr il-kamera llum? Mark: Qed nitgħallem il-fotografija u rrid nipprattika fil-park.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are you carrying the camera today? Mark: I'm learning photography and want to practise in the park.
colloquial.zh: Nina：你今天为什么带着相机？Mark：我在学摄影，想去公园练习。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天为什么带着相机？
messages.en: Why are you carrying the camera today?

messages.speaker: Mark (摄影学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed nitgħallem il-fotografija u rrid nipprattika fil-park.
messages.mt_standard: Qed nitgħallem il-fotografija u rrid nipprattika fil-park.
messages.zh: 我在学摄影，想去公园练习。
messages.en: I'm learning photography and want to practise in the park.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“带相机上摄影课”的完整场景记 fotografija，重点联想摄影这项技艺和活动。

gloss_zh: 欺骗；坑害；毁坏（粗俗用语）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cheat or deceive someone, or to ruin or damage someone or something; a vulgar expression.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欺骗、坑害某人，或使某人、某物遭到毁坏或严重损害；属于粗俗表达。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iqarraq b'xi ħadd, jew iħassar jew jagħmel ħsara lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa; kelma vulgari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺骗；以不诚实的手段占别人便宜，属粗俗说法。
毁了某人；使某人的处境、生活或前途遭受严重损害，属粗俗说法。
欺诈；蒙骗某人，使其受骗或吃亏，属粗俗说法。
毁坏；损害；把某人或某物弄糟，属粗俗说法。

collocations.zh: 把一切都搞砸了（粗俗说法）

formal.mt: Fis-sentenza 'Il-bejjiegħ fotta lill-klijent', il-verb jesprimi qerq b'lingwaġġ vulgari.
formal.en: In the sentence 'The seller screwed the customer over', the verb expresses deception in vulgar language.
formal.zh: 在“卖家把顾客给坑了”这个句子中，该动词以粗俗措辞表达欺骗。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dak il-bejjiegħ fotta lil ħija; biegħlu telefon li ma jaħdimx. Sara: Xi ħasra! Ħuk talab flusu lura?
colloquial.en: Mark: That seller screwed my brother over; he sold him a phone that doesn't work. Sara: What a shame! Did your brother ask for his money back?
colloquial.zh: Mark：那个卖家坑了我兄弟，卖给他一部坏手机。Sara：真糟糕！你兄弟要求退款了吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客的兄弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-bejjiegħ fotta lil ħija; biegħlu telefon li ma jaħdimx.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-bejjiegħ fotta lil ħija; biegħlu telefon li ma jaħdimx.
messages.zh: 那个卖家坑了我兄弟，卖给他一部坏手机。
messages.en: That seller screwed my brother over; he sold him a phone that doesn't work.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi ħasra! Ħuk talab flusu lura?
messages.mt_standard: Xi ħasra! Ħuk talab flusu lura?
messages.zh: 真糟糕！你兄弟要求退款了吗？
messages.en: What a shame! Did your brother ask for his money back?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“被坑了”和“全搞砸了”两个场景记 fotta，同时给这个词贴上粗俗语气标签。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fashionable style of dress, or clothing that follows such a style.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 流行的穿衣风格，或符合这种风格的时髦服装。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Stil ta' lbies li jkun fil-moda, jew ħwejjeġ li jsegwu dak l-istil.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 时尚；流行的穿着风格。
时髦服装；符合流行风尚的衣物。

formal.mt: Il-wirja turi kif il-foġġa tal-ilbies inbidlet matul is-snin.
formal.en: The exhibition shows how the style of dress has changed over the years.
formal.zh: 展览展示了穿衣风格多年来的变化。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Togħġbok il-foġġa ta' din il-ġakketta? Rita: Iva, imma nippreferi kulur aktar ċar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Do you like the style of this jacket? Rita: Yes, but I prefer a lighter colour.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你喜欢这件夹克的款式吗？丽塔：喜欢，不过我更喜欢浅一点的颜色。

messages.speaker: Nina (购物同伴)
messages.zh: 你喜欢这件夹克的款式吗？
messages.en: Do you like the style of this jacket?

messages.speaker: Rita (购物同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nippreferi kulur aktar ċar.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nippreferi kulur aktar ċar.
messages.zh: 喜欢，不过我更喜欢浅一点的颜色。
messages.en: Yes, but I prefer a lighter colour.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象橱窗里的流行穿搭，把 foġġa 同时连到穿衣风尚和时髦衣服两幅画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become poor or lose the financial resources one previously had.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得贫穷，或失去原有的经济资源而陷入贫困。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir fqir jew jitlef il-mezzi finanzjarji li kellu qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陷入贫困；经济状况恶化而变穷。
变得贫穷；从原来的经济状况转为贫困。

collocations.en: became poor after losing his job

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, ir-raġel fqar wara li tilef xogħlu u nefaq it-tfaddil kollu tiegħu.
formal.en: According to the report, the man became impoverished after losing his job and spending all his savings.
formal.zh: 报告指出，这名男子在失业并花光全部积蓄后陷入了贫困。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Kif spiċċa f'din is-sitwazzjoni? Pawlu: Fqar wara li tilef xogħlu; issa qed ifittex xogħol ieħor.
colloquial.en: Anna: How did he end up in this situation? Pawlu: He became poor after losing his job; now he's looking for another one.
colloquial.zh: Anna：他怎么落到了这个境地？Pawlu：他失业后变穷了，现在正在找另一份工作。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 他怎么落到了这个境地？
messages.en: How did he end up in this situation?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fqar wara li tilef xogħlu; issa qed ifittex xogħol ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Fqar wara li tilef xogħlu; issa qed ifittex xogħol ieħor.
messages.zh: 他失业后变穷了，现在正在找另一份工作。
messages.en: He became poor after losing his job; now he's looking for another one.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fqar 配上一条存款逐渐下降的箭头，记住它表达“变穷”这一变化过程。

gloss_zh: 贫穷的；内容贫乏的；穷人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having little money or few resources, or lacking substance or adequate content.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 钱财或资源很少的；也可形容内容不足、缺乏实质的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu ftit flus jew riżorsi, jew li għandu ftit kontenut jew sustanza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 贫穷的；经济资源不足的。
内容贫乏的；缺乏实质内容或充实论据的。
穷人；生活贫困、经济资源很少的人。
匮乏的；贫穷的；缺少所需资源或经济能力有限的。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi kif raġel fqir seta' jibbenefika mill-għajnuna soċjali.
formal.en: The report describes how a poor man was able to benefit from social assistance.
formal.zh: 这份报告描述了一名贫困男子如何获得社会救助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan l-argument fqir wisq; ma fih ebda eżempju. Luqa: Għandek raġun, se nżid xi fatti u eżempji.
colloquial.en: Maja: This argument is too thin; it doesn't contain any examples. Luqa: You're right, I'll add some facts and examples.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个论证太空洞了，一个例子都没有。Luqa：你说得对，我会补上一些事实和例子。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan l-argument fqir wisq; ma fih ebda eżempju.
messages.mt_standard: Dan l-argument fqir wisq; ma fih ebda eżempju.
messages.zh: 这个论证太空洞了，一个例子都没有。
messages.en: This argument is too thin; it doesn't contain any examples.

messages.speaker: Luqa (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun, se nżid xi fatti u eżempji.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun, se nżid xi fatti u eżempji.
messages.zh: 你说得对，我会补上一些事实和例子。
messages.en: You're right, I'll add some facts and examples.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fqir 连到“钱包空”和“论证空”两幅图：既能说钱少，也能说内容贫乏。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small broken pieces or crumbs, or a very small quantity of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 细小的碎片、碎屑，尤其是食物碎屑；也可表示极少的数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet żgħar li jinqalgħu minn xi ħaġa, speċjalment mill-ikel, jew kwantità żgħira ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 碎片；物体破裂或分散后形成的小部分。
小块；零碎的部分。
碎屑；尤指面包等食物掉落的小碎块。
一粒或一些碎屑；细小的食物碎块。
少量；一点点，强调数量很少。
一点；稍微，用来表示程度或数量较小。
有点；略微，表示有限的程度。

formal.mt: Wara l-ikla, il-persunal neħħa l-frak tal-ħobż minn fuq l-imwejjed.
formal.en: After the meal, the staff removed the bread crumbs from the tables.
formal.zh: 用餐结束后，工作人员清除了桌上的面包屑。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex hemm daqshekk frak fuq il-mejda? Ben: Kilt xi gallettini; issa nnaddaf kollox.
colloquial.en: Nina: Why are there so many crumbs on the table? Ben: I ate some biscuits; I'll clean everything up now.
colloquial.zh: Nina：桌上怎么有这么多碎屑？Ben：我吃了些饼干，现在就收拾干净。

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm daqshekk frak fuq il-mejda?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm daqshekk frak fuq il-mejda?
messages.zh: 桌上怎么有这么多碎屑？
messages.en: Why are there so many crumbs on the table?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kilt xi gallettini; issa nnaddaf kollox.
messages.mt_standard: Kilt xi gallettini; issa nnaddaf kollox.
messages.zh: 我吃了些饼干，现在就收拾干净。
messages.en: I ate some biscuits; I'll clean everything up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想桌上细小的面包屑，再把“小小一点”的画面用于数量和程度，串联 frak 的各项用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A business arrangement that allows someone to operate under another company's name and business system.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 获准使用另一家公司的品牌及经营体系开展业务的安排，也可指相应的经营权。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Arranġament kummerċjali li jippermetti lil xi ħadd juża l-isem u s-sistema ta' kumpanija oħra biex imexxi negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特许经营；通过授权他人使用品牌及经营体系来开展业务的方式。
特许经营权；获准使用某一品牌及其经营体系的授权。

formal.mt: Il-kumpanija se tiftaħ ħwienet ġodda permezz ta' sistema ta' frankiġja.
formal.en: The company will open new shops through a franchising system.
formal.zh: 公司将通过特许经营体系开设新店。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Dan il-ħanut huwa tiegħek? Pawlu: Iva, imma nuża l-marka ta' kumpanija oħra permezz ta' frankiġja.
colloquial.en: Marta: Is this shop yours? Pawlu: Yes, but I use another company's brand through a franchise.
colloquial.zh: Marta：这家店是你的吗？Pawlu：是的，不过我通过特许经营使用另一家公司的品牌。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 这家店是你的吗？
messages.en: Is this shop yours?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma nuża l-marka ta' kumpanija oħra permezz ta' frankiġja.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma nuża l-marka ta' kumpanija oħra permezz ta' frankiġja.
messages.zh: 是的，不过我通过特许经营使用另一家公司的品牌。
messages.en: Yes, but I use another company's brand through a franchise.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frankiġja 联想到“自己的店铺挂上获授权的品牌招牌”，同时记住经营方式和经营权两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: France, a country located primarily in Western Europe.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 法国，一个主要位于西欧的国家。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pajjiż li jinsab prinċipalment fl-Ewropa tal-Punent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法国。

sense_translations.en_definition: France (a country located primarily in Western Europe)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 法国（一个主要位于西欧的国家）。

formal.mt: Il-konferenza internazzjonali se ssir fi Franza.
formal.en: The international conference will take place in France.
formal.zh: 国际会议将在法国举行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Fejn sejra għall-vaganzi? Nina: Se mmur Franza ma' oħti.
colloquial.en: Lara: Where are you going on holiday? Nina: I'm going to France with my sister.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你准备去哪里度假？Nina：我要和姐妹一起去法国。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你准备去哪里度假？
messages.en: Where are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 我要和姐妹一起去法国。
messages.en: I'm going to France with my sister.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Franza 与英语 France 配对记忆，再用 fi Franza 和 minn Franza 分别练习“在法国”和“来自法国”。

gloss_zh: 法语；法国人；法国产品；法国的

teaching_sense.en_definition: The French language; also a French person or a product from France.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 法语；也可指法国人或来自法国的产品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-lingwa Franċiża; jista' jirreferi wkoll għal persuna jew prodott minn Franza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法语。
来自法国的人或产品。
法国的；法国人的；法语的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or pertaining to France
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自法国的；与法国有关的。
法国男子；男性法国人。
法语；作为语言名称使用。

formal.mt: Il-kittieb Franċiż ta taħdita bil-Franċiż dwar il-letteratura ta' pajjiżu.
formal.en: The French writer gave a talk in French about the literature of his country.
formal.zh: 这位法国作家用法语作了一场关于本国文学的演讲。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Titkellem bil-Franċiż? Mark: Ftit biss; għadni qed nitgħallem, imma nista' nordna kafè.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you speak French? Mark: Only a little; I'm still learning, but I can order a coffee.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你会说法语吗？Mark：只会一点，我还在学，不过已经能点咖啡了。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你会说法语吗？
messages.en: Do you speak French?

messages.speaker: Mark (法语学习者)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftit biss; għadni qed nitgħallem, imma nista' nordna kafè.
messages.mt_standard: Ftit biss; għadni qed nitgħallem, imma nista' nordna kafè.
messages.zh: 只会一点，我还在学，不过已经能点咖啡了。
messages.en: Only a little; I'm still learning, but I can order a coffee.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一位法国作家用法语介绍法国产品，把人、语言、产品和“法国的”放进同一场景记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: February, the second month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 二月，一年中的第二个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: It-tieni xahar tas-sena.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 二月。
二月；一年中的第二个月。

formal.mt: Il-kors il-ġdid se jibda fi Frar u jintemm f'Mejju.
formal.en: The new course will begin in February and end in May.
formal.zh: 新课程将于二月开始，五月结束。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Meta għandek għeluq sninek? Mark: Fi Frar. Din is-sena se nagħmel festa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Sara: When is your birthday? Mark: In February. This year I'm having a small party.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你的生日是什么时候？Mark：在二月。今年我准备办个小聚会。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？
messages.en: When is your birthday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fi Frar. Din is-sena se nagħmel festa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Fi Frar. Din is-sena se nagħmel festa żgħira.
messages.zh: 在二月。今年我准备办个小聚会。
messages.en: In February. This year I'm having a small party.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在日历第二格写上 Frar，再连读 fi Frar，利用“第二个月”的位置记住二月。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A brotherhood or association whose members are united by a shared purpose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成员因共同宗旨而结合的兄弟会或联谊团体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għaqda ta' persuni magħqudin minn għan komuni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 释义不明。

sense_translations.en_definition: brotherhood (an association of any purpose, a fraternity)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 兄弟会；为某种宗旨成立的团体或联谊组织。

formal.mt: Il-fratellanza torganizza attivitajiet għall-membri tagħha kull xahar.
formal.en: The brotherhood organizes activities for its members every month.
formal.zh: 兄弟会每月为成员组织活动。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Int membru ta' din il-fratellanza? Luqa: Iva, niltaqgħu darba fix-xahar u norganizzaw attivitajiet flimkien.
colloquial.en: Anna: Are you a member of this brotherhood? Luqa: Yes, we meet once a month and organize activities together.
colloquial.zh: Anna：你是这个兄弟会的成员吗？Luqa：是的，我们每月见一次，一起组织活动。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你是这个兄弟会的成员吗？
messages.en: Are you a member of this brotherhood?

messages.speaker: Luqa (兄弟会成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, niltaqgħu darba fix-xahar u norganizzaw attivitajiet flimkien.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, niltaqgħu darba fix-xahar u norganizzaw attivitajiet flimkien.
messages.zh: 是的，我们每月见一次，一起组织活动。
messages.en: Yes, we meet once a month and organize activities together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一群有共同宗旨的成员围坐开会，把 fratellanza 与“兄弟会这个团体”联系起来记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A phrase or sentence used to express an idea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于表达意思的一组词，可指短语，也可指句子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Grupp ta' kliem li jesprimi idea u jista' jkun espressjoni jew sentenza.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 短语；组合起来表达一定意思的词组。
句子；表达一个完整意思的语言单位。
句子；短语。

formal.mt: Għal dan l-eżerċizzju, ikteb frażi li tinkludi l-kelma l-ġdida.
formal.en: For this exercise, write a sentence that includes the new word.
formal.zh: 在这道练习中，请写一个包含新词的句子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi tfisser din il-frażi? Ben: Tfisser li għandna nistennew ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does this phrase mean? Ben: It means that we should wait a little.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这个短语是什么意思？Ben：意思是我们应该稍等一下。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 这个短语是什么意思？
messages.en: What does this phrase mean?

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.zh: 意思是我们应该稍等一下。
messages.en: It means that we should wait a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frażi 与英语 phrase 对照记忆，同时在旁边写上“也可指句子”，提醒自己根据语境判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: How often something happens; also attendance at classes or other scheduled activities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 某事发生的频繁程度；也指出席课程或其他定期活动的情况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kemm-il darba tiġri xi ħaġa; ukoll l-attendenza għal-lezzjonijiet jew għal attivitajiet regolari oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 频率；某事在一定时间内发生的次数或频繁程度。
出勤；出席课程或活动的情况。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport juri l-frekwenza tal-istudenti matul is-sena skolastika.
formal.en: The report shows student attendance during the school year.
formal.zh: 报告列出了学生在该学年的出勤情况。

colloquial.mt: Sara: B'liema frekwenza jgħaddi l-karozza tal-linja? Mark: Kull għaxar minuti, bejn wieħed u ieħor.
colloquial.en: Sara: How often does the bus come? Mark: About every ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: Sara：公交车多久来一班？Mark：大约每十分钟一班。

messages.speaker: Sara (乘客)
messages.zh: 公交车多久来一班？
messages.en: How often does the bus come?

messages.speaker: Mark (同行朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kull għaxar minuti, bejn wieħed u ieħor.
messages.mt_standard: Kull għaxar minuti, bejn wieħed u ieħor.
messages.zh: 大约每十分钟一班。
messages.en: About every ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个画面记 frekwenza：公交车多久来一次表示频率，课堂签到表表示出勤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be emptied or become empty, with the contents no longer remaining inside.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被清空或逐渐变空，里面原有的东西不再留存。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitbattal jew jispiċċa bla xejn ġewwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被清空；被排空。
变空；里面的东西逐渐耗尽或流尽。

formal.mt: Il-ġibjun friegħ bil-mod sakemm ma baqax ilma fih.
formal.en: The reservoir slowly emptied until no water remained in it.
formal.zh: 蓄水池慢慢变空，直到里面没有水了。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għad hemm ilma fil-ġibjun? Pawlu: Le, friegħ għalkollox.
colloquial.en: Nina: Is there still water in the reservoir? Pawlu: No, it has emptied completely.
colloquial.zh: Nina：蓄水池里还有水吗？Pawlu：没有，已经完全空了。

messages.speaker: Nina (住户)
messages.zh: 蓄水池里还有水吗？
messages.en: Is there still water in the reservoir?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.zh: 没有，已经完全空了。
messages.en: No, it has emptied completely.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象蓄水池的水位一路降到底，用 friegħ 记住“变空或被排空”这一变化过程。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bedding, including sheets and blankets, especially the bedsheet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 床单、毯子等床上用品，尤其指床单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Lożor u kutri li jintużaw fuq sodda, speċjalment il-liżar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 床单。
毯子；床上盖用的毛毯。
床上用品，尤其指床单。

formal.mt: Il-persunal ibiddel il-friex qabel il-wasla ta' kull mistieden.
formal.en: The staff change the bedding before each guest arrives.
formal.zh: 工作人员会在每位客人到来前更换床上用品。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħed il-friex nadif? Omm: Fl-armarju. Ħu dak u ibdel il-friex ta' sododkom.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the clean bedding? Mum: In the cupboard. Take it and change the bedding on your beds.
colloquial.zh: Maja：干净的床上用品在哪里？妈妈：在柜子里。拿去给你们的床换上吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (女儿)
messages.zh: 干净的床上用品在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the clean bedding?

messages.speaker: Omm (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Fl-armarju. Ħu dak u ibdel il-friex ta' sododkom.
messages.mt_standard: Fl-armarju. Ħu dak u ibdel il-friex ta' sododkom.
messages.zh: 在柜子里。拿去给你们的床换上吧。
messages.en: In the cupboard. Take it and change the bedding on your beds.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象换床时把床单和毯子一起取下，用 friex 统记床上用品，并重点联想到床单。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fresh rather than stale, or pleasantly cool in temperature.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 形容食物等新鲜、不陈旧，或形容气温凉爽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għadu tajjeb u mhux qadim, bħal ikel, jew li għandu temperatura pjaċevoli u xi ftit kiesħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 凉爽的；温度偏低而使人感觉舒适的。
新鲜的；尚未变陈或失去新鲜状态的。
新鲜的；凉爽的，具体含义取决于所修饰的事物。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ibigħ ħobż frisk kull filgħodu.
formal.en: The shop sells fresh bread every morning.
formal.zh: 这家商店每天早晨出售新鲜面包。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Noħorġu nimxu? Mark: Iva, illum it-temp frisk u pjaċevoli.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go out for a walk? Mark: Yes, the weather is cool and pleasant today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们出去散步好吗？马克：好啊，今天天气凉爽，很舒服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们出去散步好吗？
messages.en: Shall we go out for a walk?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, illum it-temp frisk u pjaċevoli.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, illum it-temp frisk u pjaċevoli.
messages.zh: 好啊，今天天气凉爽，很舒服。
messages.en: Yes, the weather is cool and pleasant today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画记 frisk：早晨的新鲜面包和傍晚的凉爽天气；遇到食物想“新鲜”，遇到天气想“凉爽”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An electrical appliance that keeps food and drinks cold.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使食物和饮料保持低温的电器，即冰箱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Apparat elettriku li jżomm l-ikel u x-xorb kesħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 冰箱；英语口语中对冷藏电器的常用称呼。
电冰箱；用于低温储存食物和饮料的电器。
冰箱，指使食物和饮料保持低温的家用电器。

collocations.en: put the milk in the fridge

formal.mt: Wara li tiftaħ il-flixkun, żomm il-ħalib fil-friġġ.
formal.en: After opening the bottle, keep the milk in the fridge.
formal.zh: 打开瓶子后，请将牛奶放在冰箱里保存。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-meraq? Mark: Fil-friġġ, ħdejn il-ħalib.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the juice? Mark: In the fridge, next to the milk.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：果汁在哪里？马克：在冰箱里，牛奶旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 果汁在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the juice?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 在冰箱里，牛奶旁边。
messages.en: In the fridge, next to the milk.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 friġġ 和打开冰箱拿牛奶的画面绑定，连着记 fil-friġġ，意思就是“在冰箱里”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Deliberate deception used to obtain money or another advantage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为取得金钱或其他利益而故意实施的欺骗行为。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qerq intenzjonat biex wieħed jikseb flus jew xi vantaġġ ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 欺诈活动；以欺骗方式谋取利益的行为。
骗局；骗取他人钱财或利益的欺骗行为。
欺诈，欺骗；故意使他人受骗的行为。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jiddeskrivi każ ta' frodi li fih intużaw dokumenti foloz.
formal.en: The report describes a case of fraud in which false documents were used.
formal.zh: 报告描述了一起使用虚假文件的欺诈案件。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-messaġġ iwiegħed ħafna flus jekk inħallas illum. Mark: Jista' jkun frodi; tħallasx qabel tivverifika.
colloquial.en: Maja: This message promises a lot of money if I pay today. Mark: It could be fraud; don't pay before checking.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这条消息说，只要我今天付款，就能得到很多钱。马克：这可能是欺诈；核实之前别付款。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-messaġġ iwiegħed ħafna flus jekk inħallas illum.
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-messaġġ iwiegħed ħafna flus jekk inħallas illum.
messages.zh: 这条消息说，只要我今天付款，就能得到很多钱。
messages.en: This message promises a lot of money if I pay today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jista' jkun frodi; tħallasx qabel tivverifika.
messages.mt_standard: Jista' jkun frodi; tħallasx qabel tivverifika.
messages.zh: 这可能是欺诈；核实之前别付款。
messages.en: It could be fraud; don't pay before checking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frodi 放进“先交钱就能发财”的骗局画面里，重点记住它指欺骗行为，而不只是错误信息。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flexible implement, often with a handle, used for striking or making a cracking sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通常带有手柄、可挥动抽打或发出响声的柔韧器具，即鞭子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda flessibbli, spiss b'manku, li tintuża biex wieħed jagħti daqqa jew jagħmel ħoss qawwi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 鞭子；可挥动抽打的长条状柔韧器具。

formal.mt: Fil-vetrina tal-mużew hemm frosta tal-ġilda b'manku tal-injam.
formal.en: In the museum display case there is a leather whip with a wooden handle.
formal.zh: 博物馆的展柜里有一条带木柄的皮鞭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dik il-frosta parti mill-kostum? Mark: Iva, se nużaha bħala oġġett fix-xena.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is that whip part of the costume? Mark: Yes, I'll use it as a prop in the scene.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那条鞭子是戏服配件吗？马克：是的，我会把它用作这场戏的道具。

messages.speaker: Maja (服装师)
messages.zh: 那条鞭子是戏服配件吗？
messages.en: Is that whip part of the costume?

messages.speaker: Mark (演员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, se nużaha bħala oġġett fix-xena.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, se nużaha bħala oġġett fix-xena.
messages.zh: 是的，我会把它用作这场戏的道具。
messages.en: Yes, I'll use it as a prop in the scene.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 frosta 想成展柜里盘着的一条皮鞭，再用 daqqa ta' frosta“鞭子的一击”巩固它是器具名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A dish made from beaten eggs cooked in a pan; figuratively, a mess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把打散的鸡蛋放入平底锅煎成的蛋饼；也可比喻混乱或一团糟。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn bajd imħabbat u msajjar f'taġen; b'mod figurattiv, taħwid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 煎蛋饼；将打散的鸡蛋煎熟制成的食物。
一团糟；比喻混乱、弄乱或处理得很糟的情况。

collocations.en: to make a mess of everything

formal.mt: Għall-ikla ta' nofsinhar, ipprepara froġa bil-ġobon u serviha ma' insalata.
formal.en: For lunch, prepare a cheese omelette and serve it with a salad.
formal.zh: 午餐可准备一份奶酪煎蛋饼，搭配沙拉食用。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kif mar ix-xogħol fuq il-lista? Mark: Ħawwadt l-ismijiet u n-numri; għamilt froġa minn kollox!
colloquial.en: Maja: How did the work on the list go? Mark: I mixed up the names and numbers; I made a mess of everything!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：名单整理得怎么样了？马克：我把姓名和号码弄混了，搞得一团糟！

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 名单整理得怎么样了？
messages.en: How did the work on the list go?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħawwadt l-ismijiet u n-numri; għamilt froġa minn kollox!
messages.mt_standard: Ħawwadt l-ismijiet u n-numri; għamilt froġa minn kollox!
messages.zh: 我把姓名和号码弄混了，搞得一团糟！
messages.en: I mixed up the names and numbers; I made a mess of everything!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象鸡蛋被搅在一起：餐桌上是 froġa“蛋饼”，工作中全搅乱则是“一团糟”；这只是帮助区分词义的联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A lack of substance or serious purpose, expressed as frivolity, vanity, or a sense of emptiness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 缺乏实质内容或认真目的的状态，可指轻浮、虚荣、空洞或空虚感。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Nuqqas ta' sustanza jew ta' skop serju, li jista' jidher bħala ħeffa żejda, vanità jew sens ta' vojt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 轻浮；不够认真、只顾无关紧要之事的态度或表现。
虚荣；过分在意自己的外表、形象或他人的赞赏。
空洞乏味；言谈或内容缺乏思想与实质。
空虚；缺乏内容、意义或充实感的状态。
空虚、无所事事、虚荣或空洞无意义，具体含义依语境而定。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz jiddeskrivi s-sens ta' frugħa li jħoss il-protagonist minkejja s-suċċess tiegħu.
formal.en: The novel describes the sense of emptiness the protagonist feels despite his success.
formal.zh: 这部小说描写了主人公虽已成功却仍然感到空虚的心境。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kien hemm xi ideat utli fil-laqgħa? Mark: Le, ħafna diskors u ħafna frugħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Were there any useful ideas at the meeting? Mark: No, lots of talk and lots of empty words.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：会上有什么有用的想法吗？马克：没有，话说了不少，全是空话。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kien hemm xi ideat utli fil-laqgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Kien hemm xi ideat utli fil-laqgħa?
messages.zh: 会上有什么有用的想法吗？
messages.en: Were there any useful ideas at the meeting?

messages.speaker: Mark (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, ħafna diskors u ħafna frugħa.
messages.mt_standard: Le, ħafna diskors u ħafna frugħa.
messages.zh: 没有，话说了不少，全是空话。
messages.en: No, lots of talk and lots of empty words.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“外表热闹，里面空空”的画面串联 frugħa：言谈可空洞，内心可空虚，态度可轻浮，追求外表可表现为虚荣。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The boundary between countries, or the area close to that boundary.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 国家之间的分界线，或靠近该分界线的边境地区。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-linja li tifred pajjiż minn ieħor, jew iż-żona qrib dik il-linja.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 边境；一国与另一国相接的界线或邻近区域。
边界、国界或边境地区。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġaturi għandhom iżommu d-dokumenti lesti għall-kontrolli fil-fruntiera.
formal.en: Travellers should keep their documents ready for border checks.
formal.zh: 旅客应准备好证件，以便接受边境检查。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għadna 'l bogħod mill-fruntiera? Mark: Le, naslu fi żmien għaxar minuti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are we still far from the border? Mark: No, we'll get there within ten minutes.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们离边境还远吗？马克：不远，十分钟内就到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (乘客)
messages.zh: 我们离边境还远吗？
messages.en: Are we still far from the border?

messages.speaker: Mark (司机)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, naslu fi żmien għaxar minuti.
messages.mt_standard: Le, naslu fi żmien għaxar minuti.
messages.zh: 不远，十分钟内就到了。
messages.en: No, we'll get there within ten minutes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画两个国家，中间画一道线并标上 fruntiera；再想象车辆过线，把“国界”和“越境”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pampering or indulging someone, especially by giving them excessive attention or allowing them too much.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 对某人格外宠爱、迁就或放任，尤其指过度照顾和满足要求的娇惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-għoti ta' ħafna attenzjoni u kumdità lil xi ħadd, speċjalment meta wieħed jaqtagħlu wisq xewqat jew iħallih jagħmel li jrid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 对某人的娇惯；因过分迁就而把人宠坏。
宠爱、迁就或纵容；宽松地满足某人的愿望和要求。
娇惯、宠溺、纵容；给予过多照顾或过分满足某人的要求。

formal.mt: Il-gwida għall-ġenituri tagħmel distinzjoni bejn l-għożża u l-fsied żejjed.
formal.en: The parenting guide distinguishes between affection and excessive pampering.
formal.zh: 这份育儿指南区分了关爱与过度宠溺。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tixtrilu ġugarell ieħor? Mark: Le, diġà għandu biżżejjed; wisq fsied ma jagħmillux ġid.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to buy him another toy? Mark: No, he already has enough; too much indulgence isn't good for him.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你还要再给他买一个玩具吗？马克：不了，他已经有够多了；太娇惯对他没有好处。

messages.speaker: Maja (母亲)
messages.zh: 你还要再给他买一个玩具吗？
messages.en: Are you going to buy him another toy?

messages.speaker: Mark (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, diġà għandu biżżejjed; wisq fsied ma jagħmillux ġid.
messages.mt_standard: Le, diġà għandu biżżejjed; wisq fsied ma jagħmillux ġid.
messages.zh: 不了，他已经有够多了；太娇惯对他没有好处。
messages.en: No, he already has enough; too much indulgence isn't good for him.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象孩子每提一个要求，大人就立刻答应：用这个画面记 fsied“娇惯、宠溺”，搭配 żejjed 就强调“过度”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bring someone or something back to mind, or to keep a fact or task in mind.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在脑海中想起某人或某事，或把事实、任务等记在心里。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġib lil xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa f'moħħu, jew iżomm fatt jew biċċa xogħol f'moħħu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 记得或想起某件事；把某事记在心里。
记得；回想起来；保留或唤起记忆。

collocations.en: remembered that he had an appointment

formal.mt: Qabel telaq mill-uffiċċju, Daniel ftakar li kellu jibgħat ir-rapport lill-maniġer.
formal.en: Before leaving the office, Daniel remembered that he had to send the report to the manager.
formal.zh: 离开办公室之前，丹尼尔想起自己得把报告发给经理。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ftakar iġġib iċ-ċwievet! Mark: Iva, qegħdin fil-but tiegħi.
colloquial.en: Maja: Remember to bring the keys! Mark: Yes, they're in my pocket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：记得带钥匙！马克：好，钥匙在我口袋里。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 记得带钥匙！
messages.en: Remember to bring the keys!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，钥匙在我口袋里。
messages.en: Yes, they're in my pocket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ftakar 想成出门前脑中的提醒铃：钥匙、预约、待办事项，一响就“记起来”。

gloss_zh: 仔细审视；检查；闲逛；逗留

teaching_sense.en_definition: To examine or inspect something carefully; in a separate sense, to linger or loiter.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仔细审视或检查某物；另一个独立义项表示闲逛或逗留。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jeżamina jew jispezzjona xi ħaġa bir-reqqa; f'tifsira oħra, idum f'post bla għan ċar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 仔细审视；认真查看细节。
闲逛；无明确目的地逗留或磨蹭。
检查；查看某物或某处的状况。

formal.mt: L-ispettur ftaqad il-bini bir-reqqa qabel kiteb ir-rapport dwar il-kundizzjoni tiegħu.
formal.en: The inspector examined the building carefully before writing the report on its condition.
formal.zh: 检查员仔细检查了建筑物，然后撰写了有关其状况的报告。

colloquial.mt: Maja: L-ispettur ġie dalgħodu? Mark: Iva, ftaqad il-post u qal li kollox kien sew.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did the inspector come this morning? Mark: Yes, he inspected the place and said everything was fine.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：检查员今天早上来了吗？马克：来了，他检查了这里，说一切正常。

messages.speaker: Maja (店主)
messages.zh: 检查员今天早上来了吗？
messages.en: Did the inspector come this morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ftaqad il-post u qal li kollox kien sew.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ftaqad il-post u qal li kollox kien sew.
messages.zh: 来了，他检查了这里，说一切正常。
messages.en: Yes, he inspected the place and said everything was fine.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 ftaqad 分开画两幅记忆图：检查员仔细查看现场，以及有人无目的地逗留；用上下文区分义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To speak with excessive pride about yourself, your achievements, or something you possess.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 过分自豪地谈论自己、自己的成就或拥有的东西，即夸耀或自吹自擂。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jitkellem b'ħafna kburija dwaru nnifsu, dwar dak li għamel jew dwar dak li għandu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 夸耀；吹嘘自己或自己的成就、财物等。

formal.mt: Waqt id-diskors, il-maniġer ftaħar bis-suċċess tiegħu mingħajr ma semma x-xogħol tat-tim.
formal.en: During the speech, the manager boasted about his success without mentioning the team's work.
formal.zh: 经理在演讲中夸耀自己的成功，却没有提及团队的工作。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex iddejjaqt b'Mark? Lara: Għax ftaħar bil-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did Mark annoy you? Lara: Because he boasted about his new car the whole time.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克为什么让你觉得烦？拉拉：因为他一直在炫耀自己的新车。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克为什么让你觉得烦？
messages.en: Why did Mark annoy you?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ftaħar bil-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ftaħar bil-karozza l-ġdida tiegħu l-ħin kollu.
messages.zh: 因为他一直在炫耀自己的新车。
messages.en: Because he boasted about his new car the whole time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个人反复展示奖杯、夸自己厉害，把 ftaħar 与“夸耀自己的成绩”这个场景一起记。

gloss_zh: 协议；约定；共识；妥协；条约；合同

teaching_sense.en_definition: An agreement or mutual understanding between people or groups about what they will do or accept.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 个人或群体就将要采取的行动或接受的条件达成的协议、约定或相互理解。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qbil jew fehma komuni bejn nies jew gruppi dwar dak li se jagħmlu jew jaċċettaw.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 协议；约定；各方达成的一致意见。
协定；各方正式或共同认可的一致安排。
妥协；各方作出让步后达成的折中安排。
盟约；各方承诺遵守的协议。
条约；国家等主体之间正式订立的协议。
合同；规定各方权利和义务的契约。
相互理解；彼此认可的共识或默契。
协议、交易约定或盟约；各方商定的安排。

formal.mt: Iż-żewġ kumpaniji ffirmaw ftehim dwar il-prezzijiet u d-dati tal-kunsinna.
formal.en: The two companies signed an agreement on prices and delivery dates.
formal.zh: 两家公司就价格和交货日期签署了协议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandna ftehim: jien insajjar u int taħsel il-platti. Mark: Sewwa, nibda hekk kif nispiċċaw nieklu.
colloquial.en: Maja: We have a deal: I cook and you wash the dishes. Mark: All right, I'll start as soon as we finish eating.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们说好了：我做饭，你洗碗。马克：好，吃完我就开始洗。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ftehim: jien insajjar u int taħsel il-platti.
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ftehim: jien insajjar u int taħsel il-platti.
messages.zh: 我们说好了：我做饭，你洗碗。
messages.en: We have a deal: I cook and you wash the dishes.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Sewwa, nibda hekk kif nispiċċaw nieklu.
messages.mt_standard: Sewwa, nibda hekk kif nispiċċaw nieklu.
messages.zh: 好，吃完我就开始洗。
messages.en: All right, I'll start as soon as we finish eating.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象两个人握手后把商定内容写在纸上：那份“说好的安排”就是名词 ftehim，既可用于日常约定，也可用于正式协议。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become separated from another person or group, to part, or to be kept apart.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人或群体分开、离别，或处于被隔开的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jinqata' minn persuna jew grupp, jitbiegħed minnhom, jew jinżamm separat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被分开；与他人或其他事物处于分离状态。
被隔开；被安排或维持在彼此分离的状态。
分开；分离；与他人或群体各走各的路。

formal.mt: Waqt iż-żjara, tifel fteraq mill-grupp, iżda l-għalliem sabu ftit wara ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: During the visit, a boy became separated from the group, but the teacher found him shortly afterwards near the entrance.
formal.zh: 参观期间，一个男孩与队伍走散了，但老师不久后就在入口附近找到了他。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Mark: Fteraq minna ħdejn l-istazzjon; qal li sejjer id-dar.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's Pawlu? Mark: He parted from us near the station; he said he was going home.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗在哪里？马克：他在车站附近和我们分开了，说要回家。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 保罗在哪里？
messages.en: Where's Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fteraq minna ħdejn l-istazzjon; qal li sejjer id-dar.
messages.mt_standard: Fteraq minna ħdejn l-istazzjon; qal li sejjer id-dar.
messages.zh: 他在车站附近和我们分开了，说要回家。
messages.en: He parted from us near the station; he said he was going home.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同行的人走到岔路口后各自离开，把 fteraq 记成“原本在一起，后来分开”的动作或状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To reach an agreement with another person or group about a plan, arrangement, or deal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与另一个人或群体就计划、安排或交易达成一致，即商定或谈妥。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaqbel ma' persuna jew grupp dwar pjan, arranġament jew negozju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 同意；与对方商定或达成一致。

sense_translations.en_definition: to agree (among each other); to reach an agreement or deal
sense_translations.zh_definition: 彼此商定；相互达成一致；谈妥协议或交易。

collocations.en: agreed on the price with the seller
agreed on the time with his friends

formal.mt: Il-klijent ftiehem mal-fornitur dwar id-data tal-kunsinna qabel iffirma l-kuntratt.
formal.en: The client agreed on the delivery date with the supplier before signing the contract.
formal.zh: 客户在签署合同之前，先与供应商商定了交货日期。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ftiehem ma' Lara dwar il-ħin, jekk jogħġbok. Mark: Sewwa, inċemplilha issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Please agree on the time with Lara. Mark: All right, I'll call her now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：请和拉拉商定一下时间。马克：好，我现在就给她打电话。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ftiehem ma' Lara dwar il-ħin, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Ftiehem ma' Lara dwar il-ħin, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 请和拉拉商定一下时间。
messages.en: Please agree on the time with Lara.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我现在就给她打电话。
messages.en: All right, I'll call her now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用动作和结果配对记忆：ftiehem 是双方“谈妥”的动作，ftehim 是谈妥后形成的“协议”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thread or strip of material in a candle or lamp that draws up fuel and burns to produce a flame.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜡烛或灯中吸取燃料并燃烧产生火焰的线状或条状材料，即烛芯或灯芯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħajta jew strixxa ta' materjal f'xemgħa jew lampa li tiġbed il-fjuwil u tinħaraq biex tagħti fjamma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 灯芯；烛芯；吸取燃料并供火焰燃烧的芯线。
灯等照明器具中的芯线；灯芯或类似的燃烧用芯。

formal.mt: Il-ftila tal-lampa tiġbed iż-żejt lejn il-fjamma, u b'hekk il-lampa tibqa' tixgħel.
formal.en: The lamp's wick draws oil towards the flame, allowing the lamp to keep burning.
formal.zh: 灯芯把油吸向火焰，使灯能够持续燃烧。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ix-xemgħa mhix tixgħel? Mark: Il-ftila hi qasira wisq; ejja nużaw xemgħa oħra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why won't the candle light? Mark: The wick is too short; let's use another candle.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这支蜡烛为什么点不着？马克：烛芯太短了，我们换一支吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 这支蜡烛为什么点不着？
messages.en: Why won't the candle light?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ftila hi qasira wisq; ejja nużaw xemgħa oħra.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ftila hi qasira wisq; ejja nużaw xemgħa oħra.
messages.zh: 烛芯太短了，我们换一支吧。
messages.en: The wick is too short; let's use another candle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 盯住蜡烛火焰中央那根细线，把 ftila 与“火焰下面的芯”连在一起；灯里是灯芯，蜡烛里是烛芯。

gloss_zh: 扁面包；常呈环形的三明治用面包；扁平物；一团乱

teaching_sense.en_definition: A flat loaf of bread, usually ring-shaped, that is often filled and eaten as a sandwich.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种扁平、通常呈环形的面包，常夹入馅料，当作三明治食用。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħobża ċatta, ġeneralment f'għamla ta' ċirku b'toqba fin-nofs, li spiss timtela u tittiekel bħala sandwich.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一块扁面包；形状较扁平的面包。

sense_translations.en_definition: a kind of flat, usually ring-shaped bread, often used for sandwiches
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种扁平、通常呈环形的面包，常用于制作三明治。
任何扁平或被压扁的东西。
一团乱；乱糟糟的东西或局面。

formal.mt: Il-menu jinkludi ftira mimlija bit-tonn, bit-tadam u biż-żebbuġ, servuta għall-ikel ta' nofsinhar.
formal.en: The menu includes a ftira filled with tuna, tomatoes, and olives, served for lunch.
formal.zh: 菜单上有夹金枪鱼、番茄和橄榄的扁面包，作为午餐供应。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Nista' nieħu ftira bit-tonn, jekk jogħġbok? Lara: Żgur. Trid it-tadam u ż-żebbuġ magħha?
colloquial.en: Mark: Could I have a tuna ftira, please? Lara: Of course. Would you like tomatoes and olives with it?
colloquial.zh: 马克：请给我一份夹金枪鱼的扁面包，好吗？拉拉：当然。要加番茄和橄榄吗？

messages.speaker: Mark (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Nista' nieħu ftira bit-tonn, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.mt_standard: Nista' nieħu ftira bit-tonn, jekk jogħġbok?
messages.zh: 请给我一份夹金枪鱼的扁面包，好吗？
messages.en: Could I have a tuna ftira, please?

messages.speaker: Lara (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Żgur. Trid it-tadam u ż-żebbuġ magħha?
messages.mt_standard: Żgur. Trid it-tadam u ż-żebbuġ magħha?
messages.zh: 当然。要加番茄和橄榄吗？
messages.en: Of course. Would you like tomatoes and olives with it?

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用画面记住 ftira：扁扁的面包夹着金枪鱼和番茄；再把“扁平物”和“一团乱”作为独立义项分别记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Small in amount or number; used with things that can or cannot be counted.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示数量或分量不多，可修饰可数或不可数的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jindika kwantità jew għadd żgħir ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一点儿；少量。
一点点；稍微。
几个；少数几个。
少数的；少量的。
很少；程度或数量不大。

formal.mt: Għall-ewwel laqgħa attendew ftit studenti biss.
formal.en: Only a few students attended the first meeting.
formal.zh: 只有少数学生参加了第一次会议。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ilma? Mark: Iva, grazzi. Ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like a little water? Mark: Yes, thanks. Just a little, please.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你要喝点水吗？马克：好的，谢谢。请给我一点点就行。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要喝点水吗？
messages.en: Would you like a little water?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, grazzi. Ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, grazzi. Ftit biss, jekk jogħġbok.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。请给我一点点就行。
messages.en: Yes, thanks. Just a little, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ftit 和“小小一份”一起记：水是一点，人数是几个，等待则是一会儿。

gloss_zh: 开口；开启；开幕；开放态度

teaching_sense.en_definition: An opening or the act of opening; also the beginning of an event or a willingness to accept ideas.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 指开口或打开的行为，也可指活动的开幕或愿意接纳想法的开放态度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Spazju miftuħ jew l-att li tiftaħ; ukoll il-bidu ta' avveniment jew ir-rieda li taċċetta ideat.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 建筑物或其他结构上的开口、孔口。
活动的开幕或开始。
对某事物持开放、接纳的态度。
动词 fetaħ 的动名词，表示打开或开启这一行为。
打开；开启；开口。
开篇；序幕；序言。
天意；上天的眷顾或安排。

formal.mt: Il-ftuħ uffiċjali tal-wirja se jsir nhar il-Ġimgħa fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The official opening of the exhibition will take place on Friday at six in the evening.
formal.zh: 展览的正式开幕将于星期五晚上六点举行。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'ħin hu l-ftuħ tal-wirja? Mark: Fis-sitta. Niltaqgħu hemm?
colloquial.en: Maja: What time is the exhibition opening? Mark: At six. Shall we meet there?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：展览几点开幕？马克：六点。我们在那里见面好吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 展览几点开幕？
messages.en: What time is the exhibition opening?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 六点。我们在那里见面好吗？
messages.en: At six. Shall we meet there?

cognitive_memory_aid: 用三个“打开”场景记 ftuħ：墙上打开一个口，展览打开序幕，思想打开接纳新点子的大门。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A fireplace, hearth, or stove where a fire is used for heating or cooking.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 生火取暖或烹饪的壁炉、炉床或炉灶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Post jew apparat fejn jitqabbad in-nar biex isaħħan jew biex jissajjar l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 壁炉。
炉子；炉灶。
炉床；壁炉；生火的炉内区域。

formal.mt: Fis-sala prinċipali hemm fuklar tal-ġebel li jintuża biex isaħħan il-kamra fix-xitwa.
formal.en: In the main hall there is a stone fireplace used to heat the room in winter.
formal.zh: 大厅里有一座石砌壁炉，冬天用来给房间取暖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Hawn il-bard! Mark: Ejja poġġi ħdejn il-fuklar.
colloquial.en: Maja: It's cold here! Mark: Come and sit beside the fireplace.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这里好冷啊！马克：来，坐到壁炉旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (客人)
messages.zh: 这里好冷啊！
messages.en: It's cold here!

messages.speaker: Mark (主人)
messages.zh: 来，坐到壁炉旁边。
messages.en: Come and sit beside the fireplace.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用冬夜取暖的画面记 fuklar：人坐在炉旁，火在炉里，整个房间暖起来。

gloss_zh: 留心的；注意的；谨慎留意的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Paying careful attention to advice, instructions, or what is happening.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认真留意建议、指示或周围情况的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li joqgħod attent għall-pariri, għall-istruzzjonijiet jew għal dak li jkun qed jiġri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 留心的；认真注意并顾及提醒或指示的。

formal.mt: L-istudent fukran jisma' sew l-istruzzjonijiet qabel jibda x-xogħol.
formal.en: The heedful student listens carefully to the instructions before starting the work.
formal.zh: 认真留心的学生会在开始工作前仔细听清指示。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Mark hu fukran; dejjem jagħti kas tal-pariri. Pawlu: Veru, u jistaqsi meta ma jifhimx.
colloquial.en: Maja: Mark is heedful; he always pays attention to advice. Pawlu: True, and he asks when he doesn't understand.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克很留心，总会认真听取建议。保罗：确实，而且他不懂时会提问。

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Mark hu fukran; dejjem jagħti kas tal-pariri.
messages.mt_standard: Mark hu fukran; dejjem jagħti kas tal-pariri.
messages.zh: 马克很留心，总会认真听取建议。
messages.en: Mark is heedful; he always pays attention to advice.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru, u jistaqsi meta ma jifhimx.
messages.mt_standard: Veru, u jistaqsi meta ma jifhimx.
messages.zh: 确实，而且他不懂时会提问。
messages.en: True, and he asks when he doesn't understand.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 fukran 贴在“认真听提醒的人”身上：听清指示、顾及建议、不懂就问。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A structure from which water flows or sprays, often used to decorate a square or garden.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 让水流出或喷出的设施，常用于装饰广场或花园。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Struttura li minnha joħroġ jew jitla' l-ilma, spiss biex iżżejjen pjazza jew ġnien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 喷泉；喷水设施。

formal.mt: Fiċ-ċentru tal-ġnien hemm funtana mdawra bil-fjuri.
formal.en: In the centre of the garden there is a fountain surrounded by flowers.
formal.zh: 花园中央有一座喷泉，四周环绕着鲜花。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn se niltaqgħu? Mark: Ħdejn il-funtana fil-pjazza, fil-ħamsa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where shall we meet? Mark: Beside the fountain in the square, at five.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们在哪里见面？马克：五点，在广场的喷泉旁。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们在哪里见面？
messages.en: Where shall we meet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 五点，在广场的喷泉旁。
messages.en: Beside the fountain in the square, at five.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 funtana 设成约会地标：广场中央水花喷起，两位朋友约在喷泉旁见面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: On a surface or above something; also used to introduce the topic being discussed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 表示位于某物表面上或其上方，也可引出谈论的主题，意为“关于”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tindika pożizzjoni fuq wiċċ jew f'livell ogħla minn xi ħaġa; tintuża wkoll biex tindika s-suġġett ta' diskussjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……上方。
在……上；位于……表面。
在……上方；从……上方经过。
向……上面；往……上方。
在……之上。
在楼上；到楼上。

sense_translations.en_definition: on; upon (at the top, on the surface of)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……顶上；在……表面上。

sense_translations.en_definition: over; above (at a higher position than)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在……上方；位置高于……。
关于；就……而言，用于引出话题。
向上；在上面。

formal.mt: Fuq il-mejda tal-għalliem hemm ktieb fuq l-istorja ta' Malta.
formal.en: On the teacher's table there is a book about the history of Malta.
formal.zh: 老师的桌子上有一本关于马耳他历史的书。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ktieb fuq Malta? Mark: Fuq il-mejda, ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the book about Malta? Mark: On the table, beside the window.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：那本关于马耳他的书在哪里？马克：在桌子上，窗户旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 那本关于马耳他的书在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the book about Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 在桌子上，窗户旁边。
messages.en: On the table, beside the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用 fuq 想象书在桌上，再读书的主题：fuq il-mejda 是位置，fuq Malta 是关于马耳他。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A pirate or buccaneer who attacks and robs ships at sea.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在海上袭击船只并抢劫财物的海盗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tattakka u tisraq bastimenti fuq il-baħar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 海盗；在海上袭击并抢劫船只的人。
海盗；海上劫掠者。

formal.mt: Fir-rakkont, furban jattakka bastiment u jisraq it-tagħbija tiegħu.
formal.en: In the story, a pirate attacks a ship and steals its cargo.
formal.zh: 故事中，一名海盗袭击了一艘船，并抢走了船上的货物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għandek kostum ta' furban? Mark: Għada hemm festa, u se nilbes ta' furban.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you have a pirate costume? Mark: There's a party tomorrow, and I'm going to dress as a pirate.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么有一套海盗服装？马克：明天有个派对，我要装扮成海盗。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么有一套海盗服装？
messages.en: Why do you have a pirate costume?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għada hemm festa, u se nilbes ta' furban.
messages.mt_standard: Għada hemm festa, u se nilbes ta' furban.
messages.zh: 明天有个派对，我要装扮成海盗。
messages.en: There's a party tomorrow, and I'm going to dress as a pirate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 furban 放进海上冒险故事：船上出现海盗；再联想派对上的海盗服装，巩固人物含义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An eating utensil with several pointed prongs, used to pick up or hold food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带有数根尖齿、用来叉取或固定食物的餐具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għodda tal-ikel b'diversi snien li tintuża biex taqbad jew iżżomm l-ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 叉子；用尖齿叉取东西的器具。
餐叉；进餐时用来叉取食物的餐具。

formal.mt: Qabel l-ikla, poġġi furketta fuq in-naħa tax-xellug ta' kull platt.
formal.en: Before the meal, place a fork on the left side of each plate.
formal.zh: 用餐前，在每个盘子的左侧放一把餐叉。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Tista' tagħtini furketta, jekk jogħġbok? | Mark: Żgur, hawn waħda ħdejn il-platt.
colloquial.en: Lara: Could you give me a fork, please? | Mark: Sure, there's one here beside the plate.
colloquial.zh: Lara：请递给我一把叉子，好吗？ | Mark：当然，这里盘子旁边有一把。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 请递给我一把叉子，好吗？
messages.en: Could you give me a fork, please?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 当然，这里盘子旁边有一把。
messages.en: Sure, there's one here beside the plate.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象用餐叉卷起意大利面，一边做叉取动作一边读 furketta，把词形与餐桌上的叉子联系起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job is to make and bake bread and other baked foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以制作和烘烤面包等烘焙食品为职业的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha hu li tagħmel u taħmi l-ħobż u ikel ieħor moħmi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面包师；制作并烘烤面包等食品的人。

formal.mt: Il-furnar jibda jaħdem kmieni biex il-ħobż ikun lest qabel jinfetaħ il-ħanut.
formal.en: The baker starts work early so that the bread is ready before the shop opens.
formal.zh: 面包师很早就开始工作，以便面包在商店开门前烤好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għamel dan il-ħobż? | Pawlu: Il-furnar tar-raħal. Xtrajtu dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who made this bread? | Pawlu: The village baker. I bought it this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这面包是谁做的？ | Pawlu：村里的面包师。我今天早上买的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这面包是谁做的？
messages.en: Who made this bread?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 村里的面包师。我今天早上买的。
messages.en: The village baker. I bought it this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 furnar 记成清晨把面包送进烤炉的那个人；看到围裙和热面包，就回想这个职业名称。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A shaft on which a wheel or another rotating part turns, or which turns with that part.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供车轮或其他旋转部件绕着转动，或与该部件一起转动的轴杆。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Virga li rota jew parti oħra ddur madwarha, jew li ddur flimkien ma' dik il-parti.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 车轴；支承车轮或传递旋转运动的轴杆。
纺锤；用于纺纱的旋转杆，也可指机器中的细长旋转轴。
车轴；转轴；物体围绕其旋转的轴线。

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni, il-mekkanik sab ħsara fil-fus ta' wara tal-vettura.
formal.en: During the inspection, the mechanic found damage to the vehicle's rear axle.
formal.zh: 检查期间，机械师发现车辆的后车轴有损坏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex qed tiċċaqlaq hekk ir-rota tal-karrettun? | Toni: Il-fus mgħawweġ. Irridu nibdluh.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why is the cart's wheel wobbling like that? | Toni: The axle is bent. We need to replace it.
colloquial.zh: Sara：手推车的轮子为什么这样晃？ | Toni：车轴弯了。我们得换掉它。

messages.speaker: Sara (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex qed tiċċaqlaq hekk ir-rota tal-karrettun?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex qed tiċċaqlaq hekk ir-rota tal-karrettun?
messages.zh: 手推车的轮子为什么这样晃？
messages.en: Why is the cart's wheel wobbling like that?

messages.speaker: Toni (维修工)
messages.zh: 车轴弯了。我们得换掉它。
messages.en: The axle is bent. We need to replace it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画两个车轮，再用一根直杆连接，把 fus 写在杆上；另画纺锤，帮助区分不同语境中的轴与纺锤。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sport in which two teams try to score goals by kicking a ball into the opposing team's goal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 两队主要通过踢球，将球送入对方球门以争取得分的运动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sport bejn żewġ timijiet li jippruvaw jiskurjaw billi jagħtu bis-sieq lill-ballun biex jidħol fil-lasta tat-tim l-ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 足球运动。
足球运动；美式英语通常称为 soccer 的运动。

formal.mt: L-iskola torganizza taħriġ tal-futbol għall-istudenti kull nhar ta' Erbgħa.
formal.en: The school organizes football training for students every Wednesday.
formal.zh: 学校每周三为学生组织足球训练。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Trid tilgħab il-futbol magħna wara l-iskola? | Lara: Iva! Niltaqgħu fil-grawnd fl-erbgħa.
colloquial.en: Ben: Do you want to play football with us after school? | Lara: Yes! Let's meet at the pitch at four.
colloquial.zh: Ben：放学后想和我们一起踢足球吗？ | Lara：想！我们四点在球场见。

messages.speaker: Ben (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Trid tilgħab il-futbol magħna wara l-iskola?
messages.mt_standard: Trid tilgħab il-futbol magħna wara l-iskola?
messages.zh: 放学后想和我们一起踢足球吗？
messages.en: Do you want to play football with us after school?

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 想！我们四点在球场见。
messages.en: Yes! Let's meet at the pitch at four.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 futbol 与熟悉的英语 football 对照记忆，再默念 jilgħab il-futbol，把单词放进踢足球的动作场景。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time that has not yet come, and the events or conditions that may exist then.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未到来的时间，以及届时可能出现的事情或状况。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li għadu ma wasalx, u l-ġrajjiet jew il-kundizzjonijiet li jistgħu jeżistu fih.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 未来；将来；尚未到来的时间。
未来的；将来的；将在以后出现或发生的。
期货合约；约定在未来指定时间按约定价格买卖某项标的的标准化合约。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza l-importanza tal-edukazzjoni għall-futur tal-pajjiż.
formal.en: The report emphasizes the importance of education for the country's future.
formal.zh: 报告强调教育对于国家未来的重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid tagħmel fil-futur? | Mark: Nixtieq insir għalliem u naħdem mat-tfal.
colloquial.en: Maja: What do you want to do in the future? | Mark: I'd like to become a teacher and work with children.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你将来想做什么？ | Mark：我想成为老师，从事和孩子们有关的工作。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你将来想做什么？
messages.en: What do you want to do in the future?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nixtieq insir għalliem u naħdem mat-tfal.
messages.mt_standard: Nixtieq insir għalliem u naħdem mat-tfal.
messages.zh: 我想成为老师，从事和孩子们有关的工作。
messages.en: I'd like to become a teacher and work with children.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在时间轴右端写 futur，表示尚未到来的未来；另做形容词和期货合约两张卡片，分别记住词性与语境。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pottery or ceramic objects made from clay and hardened by firing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用黏土成形并经烧制而变硬的陶器或陶瓷制品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġetti magħmula mit-tafal u mwebbsa bin-nar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 陶瓷；陶瓷制品。
陶器；陶制品。
陶瓷器物；陶器。

formal.mt: Il-mużew jesponi diversi oġġetti tal-fuħħar, fosthom platti u vażetti.
formal.en: The museum displays various pottery objects, including plates and jars.
formal.zh: 博物馆展出多种陶器，包括盘子和罐子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-vażett tal-fuħħar kemm jiswa? Pawlu: Għaxar ewro. Trid tara wieħed ikbar?
colloquial.en: Maja: How much is this pottery jar? Pawlu: Ten euros. Would you like to see a bigger one?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个陶罐多少钱？保罗：十欧元。你想看看大一点的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个陶罐多少钱？
messages.en: How much is this pottery jar?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (店主)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxar ewro. Trid tara wieħed ikbar?
messages.mt_standard: Għaxar ewro. Trid tara wieħed ikbar?
messages.zh: 十欧元。你想看看大一点的吗？
messages.en: Ten euros. Would you like to see a bigger one?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象陶器店里一排陶罐和陶盘，把 fuħħar 与这些烧制成形的器物一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Water in its gaseous form, especially when produced by heating, or another substance in vapour form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 水变成的气态物质，尤其指加热产生的水蒸气；也可指其他物质的蒸气。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilma f'forma ta' gass, speċjalment meta jissaħħan, jew sustanza oħra f'forma ta' gass.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 水蒸气；通常由水受热产生的蒸汽。
蒸气；某种物质呈气态时的形式。
蒸汽；水蒸气；其他物质的蒸气。

formal.mt: Meta l-ilma fil-borma jibda jagħli, joħroġ ħafna fwar.
formal.en: When the water in the pot starts boiling, a lot of steam comes out.
formal.zh: 锅里的水开始沸腾时，会冒出大量蒸汽。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Għaliex il-mera kollha mċajpra? | Adam: Minħabba l-fwar tad-doċċa. Niftaħ it-tieqa?
colloquial.en: Nina: Why is the mirror all fogged up? | Adam: Because of the steam from the shower. Shall I open the window?
colloquial.zh: Nina：镜子怎么全蒙上雾了？ | Adam：是淋浴产生的水汽。我把窗户打开好吗？

messages.speaker: Nina (室友)
messages.zh: 镜子怎么全蒙上雾了？
messages.en: Why is the mirror all fogged up?

messages.speaker: Adam (室友)
messages.zh: 是淋浴产生的水汽。我把窗户打开好吗？
messages.en: Because of the steam from the shower. Shall I open the window?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象热水壶冒出蒸汽，镜子随后蒙上水雾，把 fwar 与热水和空气中的水汽画面一起记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An organ in the body that processes nutrients and other substances and produces bile; also this organ used as food.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 身体中处理营养物质及其他物质、产生胆汁的器官；也指作为食物的动物肝脏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Organu fil-ġisem li jipproċessa n-nutrijenti u sustanzi oħra u jipproduċi l-bili; ukoll dan l-organu meta jintuża bħala ikel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 肝脏；也指供食用的动物肝脏。

formal.mt: Il-fwied jipproduċi l-bili u jgħin lill-ġisem jipproċessa n-nutrijenti.
formal.en: The liver produces bile and helps the body process nutrients.
formal.zh: 肝脏产生胆汁，并帮助身体处理营养物质。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għandek fwied tat-tiġieġ illum? | Toni: Iva, kemm trid? | Sara: Nofs kilo, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Sara: Do you have chicken liver today? | Toni: Yes, how much would you like? | Sara: Half a kilo, please.
colloquial.zh: Sara：今天有鸡肝吗？ | Toni：有，你要多少？ | Sara：请给我半公斤。

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 今天有鸡肝吗？
messages.en: Do you have chicken liver today?

messages.speaker: Toni (肉店店员)
messages.zh: 有，你要多少？
messages.en: Yes, how much would you like?

messages.speaker: Sara (顾客)
messages.zh: 请给我半公斤。
messages.en: Half a kilo, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在人体图的肝脏位置写 fwied，再配一张鸡肝食材图，把身体器官和食物这两个使用场景连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become fragrant or begin to give off a pleasant smell.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得芳香，或开始散发令人愉快的气味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Isir ifuħ jew jibda joħroġ riħa pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变得芳香；开始散发香气。
变得公然恶劣；变得明显且令人无法容忍。

collocations.en: the garden became fragrant with flowers
collocations.zh: 花园因花朵而变得芳香

collocations.en: the bread began to smell fragrant in the oven
collocations.zh: 面包在烤炉里开始散发香气

formal.mt: Meta nfetħu l-fjuri fir-rebbiegħa, il-ġnien fwieħ b'riħa ħelwa.
formal.en: When the flowers opened in spring, the garden became fragrant with a sweet scent.
formal.zh: 春天花朵绽放时，花园里开始弥漫甜美的香气。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm fwieħ il-ġnien illum! | Mark: Iva, fetħu l-fjuri ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Lara: The garden has become so fragrant today! | Mark: Yes, the flowers by the door have opened.
colloquial.zh: Lara：今天花园变得好香啊！ | Mark：是啊，门边的花开了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 今天花园变得好香啊！
messages.en: The garden has become so fragrant today!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，门边的花开了。
