messages.en: What did the nurse do before the examination?

messages.speaker: Ben (护理教师)
messages.zh: 他征得患者同意后脱去了患者的衣服。
messages.en: He stripped the patient with his consent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一组动作与状态来记：għarwen 是“把衣服脱去”的动作，għarwien 是“赤裸”的状态。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Having no clothes on, or having no covering over a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 没有穿衣服的；也可形容表面没有覆盖物、裸露着的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bla ħwejjeġ, jew mingħajr għata fuq il-wiċċ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赤裸的；没有穿衣服的。
裸体的，亦用于描述艺术作品中的裸体形象。
裸露的；没有遮盖物或覆盖物的。

formal.mt: L-istatwa turi raġel għarwien u tenfasizza l-forma tal-ġisem.
formal.en: The statue depicts a nude man and emphasizes the form of the body.
formal.zh: 这座雕像呈现了一名裸体男子，突出了人体的形态。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ir-raġel f'din il-pittura huwa għarwien? Toni: L-artist ried jistudja l-forma tal-ġisem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the man in this painting naked? Toni: The artist wanted to study the form of the body.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这幅画里的男人为什么没穿衣服？托尼：画家想研究人体的形态。

messages.speaker: Maja (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex ir-raġel f'din il-pittura huwa għarwien?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex ir-raġel f'din il-pittura huwa għarwien?
messages.zh: 这幅画里的男人为什么没穿衣服？
messages.en: Why is the man in this painting naked?

messages.speaker: Toni (美术教师)
messages.zh: 画家想研究人体的形态。
messages.en: The artist wanted to study the form of the body.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把裸体雕像与裸露岩石并排想象：两者都没有覆盖物，用这个共同画面记住 għarwien。

gloss_zh: 挤压；拧干；榨汁；施压；另有下午及宗教祈祷义

teaching_sense.en_definition: To press something firmly, especially to extract liquid, or figuratively to put pressure on someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力挤压某物，尤其指挤出液体、拧干或榨汁；也可比喻向某人施压。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħfas xi ħaġa bis-saħħa, speċjalment biex joħroġ il-likwidu minnha, jew jagħmel pressjoni fuq xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 挤；挤压。
拧干，例如拧出湿布中的水。
向某人施加压力；逼迫某人。
下午；午后时段。
挤压；按压。
榨汁；将液体挤出。
基督宗教日课中的晚祷。
伊斯兰教的晡礼，即下午举行的礼拜。

formal.mt: Il-kok għasar lumija u żied il-meraq mat-taħlita.
formal.en: The cook squeezed a lemon and added the juice to the mixture.
formal.zh: 厨师挤了一颗柠檬的汁，并将柠檬汁加入混合物中。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min għasar il-lumija? Pawlu: Jien. Il-meraq qiegħed f'din it-tazza.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who squeezed the lemon? Pawlu: I did. The juice is in this glass.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁挤了柠檬汁？保罗：我挤的。汁就在这个玻璃杯里。

messages.speaker: Marta (室友)
messages.zh: 谁挤了柠檬汁？
messages.en: Who squeezed the lemon?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 我挤的。汁就在这个玻璃杯里。
messages.en: I did. The juice is in this glass.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用双手挤柠檬、拧湿布的画面记动词 għasar；再单独记名词的下午、晚祷和晡礼义，避免混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A sweet, thick substance produced by bees and used to sweeten food or drinks.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 蜜蜂酿成的甜而黏稠的物质，可用于给食物或饮料增添甜味。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sustanza ħelwa u ħoxna li jipproduċu n-naħal u li tintuża biex tagħti ħlewwa lill-ikel jew lix-xorb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 蜂蜜。
糖蜜；浓稠的糖浆。
蜂蜜，即蜜蜂酿成的黏稠甜味物质。

formal.mt: Għal din ir-riċetta, żid kuċċarina għasel ma' tazza jogurt naturali.
formal.en: For this recipe, add a teaspoon of honey to a cup of plain yogurt.
formal.zh: 制作这道食谱时，在一杯原味酸奶中加入一茶匙蜂蜜。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Trid ftit għasel fit-te? David: Iva, kuċċarina żgħira, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Would you like some honey in your tea? David: Yes, a small teaspoon, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你的茶里要加点蜂蜜吗？戴维：要，请加一小茶匙。

messages.speaker: Anna (主人)
messages.zh: 你的茶里要加点蜂蜜吗？
messages.en: Would you like some honey in your tea?

messages.speaker: David (客人)
messages.zh: 要，请加一小茶匙。
messages.en: Yes, a small teaspoon, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一茶匙金黄黏稠的蜂蜜缓缓流进茶杯，把甜味、黏度和 għasel 一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bird commonly seen near houses and gardens, often feeding on seeds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种常见于房屋和花园附近的小鸟，常以种子为食，即麻雀。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għasfur żgħir li spiss jidher qrib id-djar u fil-ġonna u jiekol iż-żrieragħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻雀。
家麻雀（Passer domesticus）。

formal.mt: Waqt l-osservazzjoni, l-istudenti raw għasfur tal-bejt jiġbor iż-żrieragħ fil-bitħa.
formal.en: During the observation, the students saw a sparrow gathering seeds in the courtyard.
formal.zh: 观察期间，学生们看到一只麻雀在院子里啄拾种子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'inhu dak l-għasfur ħdejn it-tieqa? Luqa: Għasfur tal-bejt. Ara, qiegħed jiekol iż-żrieragħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: What's that bird by the window? Luqa: A sparrow. Look, it's eating the seeds!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：窗边那是什么鸟？卢卡：一只麻雀。看，它正在吃种子！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 窗边那是什么鸟？
messages.en: What's that bird by the window?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għasfur tal-bejt. Ara, qiegħed jiekol iż-żrieragħ!
messages.mt_standard: Għasfur tal-bejt. Ara, qiegħed jiekol iż-żrieragħ!
messages.zh: 一只麻雀。看，它正在吃种子！
messages.en: A sparrow. Look, it's eating the seeds!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗边一只小麻雀低头啄种子，每次看见这个画面就完整读出 għasfur tal-bejt，整组记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A staff, wooden rod, or branch, which may be used for support or as a simple tool.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 手杖、木杆或树枝，可用来支撑身体或充当简单工具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Bastun, virga tal-injam jew fergħa li tista' tintuża bħala appoġġ jew għodda sempliċi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一根手杖或长杖。
一根木杆。
一根树枝。
手杖；用于支撑的长杖。
木制的杆或棍。

formal.mt: Il-bidwi waħħal għasluġ fl-art biex isostni x-xitla.
formal.en: The farmer fixed a wooden rod in the ground to support the young plant.
formal.zh: 农夫把一根木杆插稳在土里，用来支撑幼苗。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ħadt għasluġ miegħek? Mark: Biex jgħinni nimxi; il-mogħdija hija wieqfa.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did you bring a staff with you? Mark: To help me walk; the path is steep.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么带了一根手杖？马克：帮助我走路；这条小路很陡。

messages.speaker: Rita (徒步伙伴)
messages.zh: 你为什么带了一根手杖？
messages.en: Why did you bring a staff with you?

messages.speaker: Mark (徒步伙伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex jgħinni nimxi; il-mogħdija hija wieqfa.
messages.mt_standard: Biex jgħinni nimxi; il-mogħdija hija wieqfa.
messages.zh: 帮助我走路；这条小路很陡。
messages.en: To help me walk; the path is steep.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根树枝拿在手里作手杖、插进土里作支撑杆，用同一根木条串起 għasluġ 的几个义项。

gloss_zh: 守卫；监视；警察局；警卫队

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of keeping watch over someone or something; also a group assigned to guard duty or a police station.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 看守或监视人、地点或物品的活动；也可指执行守卫任务的队伍或警察局。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħarsien ta' persuna, post jew oġġett; ukoll grupp ta' nies li jagħmlu dan ix-xogħol jew stazzjon tal-pulizija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 站岗；执行守卫任务。
监视；持续留意人或地点的情况。
警察局；处理警务的办公地点。
警卫队；共同执行看守任务的一组人员。

sense_translations.en_definition: quarters of a guard, police station
sense_translations.zh_definition: 警卫驻所；警察局。

formal.mt: Il-gwardji jagħmlu l-għassa fid-daħla tal-bini matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The guards keep watch at the entrance to the building during the night.
formal.zh: 警卫夜间在大楼入口处值守。

colloquial.mt: Lina: Fejn hi l-għassa tal-pulizija? Pawlu: Ħdejn il-pjazza. Immur miegħek.
colloquial.en: Lina: Where is the police station? Pawlu: Near the square. I'll go with you.
colloquial.zh: 莉娜：警察局在哪里？保罗：在广场附近。我陪你去。

messages.speaker: Lina (游客)
messages.zh: 警察局在哪里？
messages.en: Where is the police station?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 在广场附近。我陪你去。
messages.en: Near the square. I'll go with you.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一处有人站岗的警察局，把“守卫活动、警卫队、警察局”三个画面串起来记；具体意思由上下文判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To mix things together or knead dough; also to muddle things or carry out a task badly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西混合在一起或揉面团；也指把东西弄乱，或把任务做坏、搞砸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħallat affarijiet flimkien jew taħdem l-għaġina; ukoll tħawwad l-affarijiet jew tagħmel xogħol ħażin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把不同的东西混合在一起。
揉面团；反复揉压面团。
弄得一团糟；把东西弄乱。
把一项任务做坏；笨拙地处理任务。
弄混；把事物或次序搞乱。
搞砸；因处理不当而做坏。

formal.mt: Il-furnar għassed l-għaġina qabel ħallieha tistrieħ.
formal.en: The baker kneaded the dough before leaving it to rest.
formal.zh: 面包师揉好面团后，让它静置。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min għassed ix-xogħol? Toni: Jien. Ħallatt il-paġni; issa nirranġahom.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who botched the job? Toni: I did. I mixed up the pages; I'll put them in order now.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：谁把这项工作搞砸了？托尼：是我。我把页面弄混了，现在就整理好。

messages.speaker: Marta (同事)
messages.zh: 谁把这项工作搞砸了？
messages.en: Who botched the job?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.zh: 是我。我把页面弄混了，现在就整理好。
messages.en: I did. I mixed up the pages; I'll put them in order now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅动作画面记忆：揉面时把材料混合，办事时却把页面弄混。看到面团想到“揉”，看到任务想到“搞砸”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To keep watch, remain alert, or guard a person, place or thing.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 持续留意情况、保持警觉，或看守和保护某人、某地或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toqgħod attent għal dak li jiġri jew tħares persuna, post jew oġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 值守；持续观察周围情况。
保持警觉；留心可能出现的危险或变化。
看守；守护某人或某物。

formal.mt: Il-gwardjan għasses id-daħla tal-maħżen matul il-lejl.
formal.en: The guard watched over the warehouse entrance during the night.
formal.zh: 警卫夜间看守了仓库入口。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Min għasses il-bagalji waqt li konna fil-ħanut? Mark: Jien. Kollox għadu hawn.
colloquial.en: Sara: Who watched the luggage while we were in the shop? Mark: I did. Everything is still here.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：我们进商店时，是谁看着行李的？马克：是我。东西都还在这里。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għasses il-bagalji waqt li konna fil-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Min għasses il-bagalji waqt li konna fil-ħanut?
messages.zh: 我们进商店时，是谁看着行李的？
messages.en: Who watched the luggage while we were in the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我。东西都还在这里。
messages.en: I did. Everything is still here.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词配上一双警觉的眼睛：盯着入口是“看守”，留意危险是“警觉”，照看行李是“守护”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person whose job or responsibility is to guard, supervise or watch over people, a place or property.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 负责守护、看守或监督人员、场所或财物的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li xogħolha jew ir-responsabbiltà tagħha hi li tħares nies, post jew proprjetà.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 守护者；负责保护或照看的人。
看守员；负责监管某一场所或其中人员的人。
看守人；负责值守和留意安全的人。
警卫；执行看守任务的人。

formal.mt: L-għassies tal-mużew jiċċekkja li l-bibien ikunu magħluqa wara li jitilqu l-viżitaturi.
formal.en: The museum guard checks that the doors are closed after the visitors leave.
formal.zh: 参观者离开后，博物馆警卫会检查各扇门是否关好。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Lil min nista' nistaqsi fejn hu l-ħruġ? David: Staqsi lill-għassies ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Who can I ask where the exit is? David: Ask the guard by the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：我可以问谁出口在哪里？戴维：问门旁边的警卫吧。

messages.speaker: Nina (参观者)
messages.mt_spoken: Lil min nista' nistaqsi fejn hu l-ħruġ?
messages.mt_standard: Lil min nista' nistaqsi fejn hu l-ħruġ?
messages.zh: 我可以问谁出口在哪里？
messages.en: Who can I ask where the exit is?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 问门旁边的警卫吧。
messages.en: Ask the guard by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记住门边站着的那个人：għassies 指“看守的人”。再用夜间、博物馆、监狱三个场景练习不同岗位。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To suddenly force air out through the nose and mouth in a sneeze.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼻子受到刺激等情况下，突然从鼻子和嘴里喷出气流，即打喷嚏。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Toħroġ l-arja f'daqqa mill-imnieħer u mill-ħalq meta xi ħaġa tirrita l-imnieħer.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打喷嚏；突然从鼻子和嘴里喷出气流。

formal.mt: L-istudent għatas darbtejn wara li fetaħ ktieb mimli trab.
formal.en: The student sneezed twice after opening a dusty book.
formal.zh: 学生打开一本满是灰尘的书后，打了两次喷嚏。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Min għatas? Ġużeppi: Jien. Hawn ħafna trab!
colloquial.en: Marija: Who sneezed? Ġużeppi: I did. It's very dusty here!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽亚：谁打喷嚏了？朱塞佩：是我。这里灰尘真多！

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁打喷嚏了？
messages.en: Who sneezed?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我。这里灰尘真多！
messages.en: I did. It's very dusty here!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象翻开一本积灰的书，鼻子一痒就打喷嚏；把这个具体动作与 għatas 绑定，再加“打了两次”练习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The threshold at the bottom of a doorway or the step immediately outside a door.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 门洞底部需要跨过的门槛，或紧靠门外的台阶。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti t'isfel ta' fetħa ta' bieb li taqsam minn fuqha, jew it-tarġa eżatt barra l-bieb.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 门槛；门口底部横跨出入口的部分。
门口台阶；紧靠门外供人踏脚的地方。
门口台阶；门槛。

formal.mt: L-għatba tal-bieb hija għolja, għalhekk il-viżitaturi għandhom joqogħdu attenti meta jidħlu.
formal.en: The doorway has a high threshold, so visitors should take care when entering.
formal.zh: 这扇门的门槛较高，因此访客进入时应当留意脚下。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Fejn inħalli l-pakkett? Rita: Ħallih fuq l-għatba, jekk jogħġbok.
colloquial.en: Anna: Where shall I leave the parcel? Rita: Leave it on the doorstep, please.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：我把包裹放在哪里？丽塔：请放在门口台阶上。

messages.speaker: Anna (快递员)
messages.zh: 我把包裹放在哪里？
messages.en: Where shall I leave the parcel?

messages.speaker: Rita (住户)
messages.zh: 请放在门口台阶上。
messages.en: Leave it on the doorstep, please.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象进门时抬脚跨过门槛，出门时坐在门口台阶上；两个位置都紧贴门口，帮助记住 għatba 的两个义项。

gloss_zh: 盖住；遮藏；给人盖好被单

teaching_sense.en_definition: To put something over a person or thing, hide something from view, or draw bed sheets over someone.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把东西覆盖在人或物上；遮住使其看不见；也指给床上的人盖好被单。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tqiegħed xi ħaġa fuq persuna jew oġġett, taħbi xi ħaġa mill-vista, jew tiġbed il-lożor fuq xi ħadd fis-sodda.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 覆盖；用某物盖住人或东西。
遮藏；遮住某物，使其看不见。

sense_translations.en_definition: to draw sheets over sb. in bed
sense_translations.zh_definition: 给躺在床上的人拉上被单、盖好被单。

collocations.en: covered the boy with a blanket

formal.mt: Il-kok għatta l-borma biex iżomm l-ikel sħun.
formal.en: The cook covered the pot to keep the food warm.
formal.zh: 厨师盖好锅，让食物保持温热。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Min għatta lit-tifel bil-lożor? Pawlu: Jien. Kien rieqed u deher li kellu l-bard.
colloquial.en: Elena: Who covered the boy with the sheets? Pawlu: I did. He was asleep and seemed cold.
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：谁给男孩盖好被单了？保罗：是我。他睡着了，看起来有些冷。

messages.speaker: Elena (母亲)
messages.zh: 谁给男孩盖好被单了？
messages.en: Who covered the boy with the sheets?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Kien rieqed u deher li kellu l-bard.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Kien rieqed u deher li kellu l-bard.
messages.zh: 是我。他睡着了，看起来有些冷。
messages.en: I did. He was asleep and seemed cold.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“把东西放上去盖住”串联词义：锅上盖盖子、洞口加遮挡、孩子身上拉被单，都是 għatta 的动作画面。

gloss_zh: 使受伤；使丧失活动能力；使伤残

teaching_sense.en_definition: To injure someone or cause a loss of normal physical movement or ability.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人受伤，或使其正常的身体活动能力受损、丧失。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tweġġa' lil xi ħadd jew iġġiegħlu jitlef il-ħila li jiċċaqlaq jew juża ġismu bħas-soltu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使丧失正常活动能力；使身体功能受损。
使受伤；损伤身体。
使身体严重受损；使活动能力严重受限或造成伤残。

collocations.zh: 使那名男子的腿受了伤

formal.mt: L-inċident għattab lill-ħaddiem, li ma setax jerġa' lura għax-xogħol għal diversi xhur.
formal.en: The accident injured the worker, who was unable to return to work for several months.
formal.zh: 事故使这名工人受伤，导致他数月无法返回工作岗位。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-inċident għattab lil Mark? Toni: Iva, weġġa' siequ. Għalissa għandu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did the accident injure Mark? Toni: Yes, he hurt his leg. For now, he needs help walking.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：马克在事故中受伤了吗？托尼：是的，他伤到了腿，目前走路需要帮助。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克在事故中受伤了吗？
messages.en: Did the accident injure Mark?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, weġġa' siequ. Għalissa għandu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, weġġa' siequ. Għalissa għandu bżonn l-għajnuna biex jimxi.
messages.zh: 是的，他伤到了腿，目前走路需要帮助。
messages.en: Yes, he hurt his leg. For now, he needs help walking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“受伤后行动受限”的画面记忆：腿受伤、走路需要帮助。这个动词强调造成损伤，具体严重程度要结合上下文。

gloss_zh: 使凹陷；压碎；捣打；揉皱；压迫

teaching_sense.en_definition: To damage or change the shape of something by force, for example by denting, crushing, pounding or crumpling it; figuratively, to oppress or smother.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用力使某物凹陷、压碎、捣碎或揉皱；也可比喻压迫或压制。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel ħsara lil xi ħaġa jew tbiddlilha l-għamla billi tagħfasha jew tħabbatha; b'mod figurattiv, taħqar jew trażżan.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使表面凹陷；撞瘪。
压碎；压坏。
用力捶打；捣碎。
揉皱；使变皱或变形。
压迫；欺压。
压扁；挤扁。

sense_translations.en_definition: to squash; to crush; to thump
sense_translations.zh_definition: 压扁；压碎；重重捶打。
压迫；使窒息或受到压制。

formal.mt: Waqt it-trasport, tagħmir tqil għattan il-bott tal-metall u biddel l-għamla tiegħu.
formal.en: During transport, heavy equipment crushed the metal can and changed its shape.
formal.zh: 运输过程中，重型设备压坏了金属罐，使它变了形。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għattan il-bott? Mark: Jien, bi żball. Poġġejt il-kaxxa tqila fuqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who crushed the can? Mark: I did, by accident. I put the heavy box on it.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁把罐子压扁了？马克：是我，不小心的。我把那个重箱子放在上面了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 谁把罐子压扁了？
messages.en: Who crushed the can?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien, bi żball. Poġġejt il-kaxxa tqila fuqu.
messages.mt_standard: Jien, bi żball. Poġġejt il-kaxxa tqila fuqu.
messages.zh: 是我，不小心的。我把那个重箱子放在上面了。
messages.en: I did, by accident. I put the heavy box on it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把画面记成重箱压瘪罐子、双手揉皱纸张；再把这种受力压坏的感觉延伸到抽象的压迫义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to stumble or trip, for example by putting an obstacle in their path.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使人因脚下的障碍而绊倒或踉跄。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġġiegħel lil xi ħadd jitfixkel jew jaqa', pereżempju b'xi ostaklu f'saqajh.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使人踉跄；使人失足。
绊倒某人；使某人脚下受阻而踉跄。

formal.mt: Il-kejbil li kien mal-art għattar lill-ħaddiem waqt li kien miexi lejn il-bieb.
formal.en: The cable on the floor caused the worker to trip as he was walking towards the door.
formal.zh: 那名工人走向门口时，被地上的电缆绊了一下。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'ġara lil Pawlu? Ninu: Dak il-kejbil għattar lil Pawlu, imma ma waqax.
colloquial.en: Lara: What happened to Pawlu? Ninu: That cable tripped Pawlu, but he didn't fall.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：保罗怎么了？尼努：那根电缆绊了保罗一下，不过他没摔倒。

messages.speaker: Lara (同事)
messages.zh: 保罗怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Pawlu?

messages.speaker: Ninu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak il-kejbil għattar lil Pawlu, imma ma waqax.
messages.mt_standard: Dak il-kejbil għattar lil Pawlu, imma ma waqax.
messages.zh: 那根电缆绊了保罗一下，不过他没摔倒。
messages.en: That cable tripped Pawlu, but he didn't fall.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象地上的电缆让路人脚下一绊；这个动词强调使别人踉跄，结果不一定真的摔倒。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The need or desire to drink; figuratively, a strong longing for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要喝水的口渴感；也比喻对某事物的强烈渴望。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li tixrob; b'mod figurattiv, xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口渴；想喝水的感觉。
渴望；强烈的向往。

formal.mt: L-istudent wera għatx għall-għarfien billi qara kotba oħra dwar is-suġġett.
formal.en: The student showed a thirst for knowledge by reading additional books on the subject.
formal.zh: 这名学生阅读了更多有关该主题的书籍，表现出强烈的求知欲。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi għatx kbir wara din il-mixja. Mark: Hawn l-ilma. Ixrob ftit.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm very thirsty after this walk. Mark: Here's the water. Have a little.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：走完这一程，我渴得很。马克：水在这里，喝一点吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandi għatx kbir wara din il-mixja.
messages.mt_standard: Għandi għatx kbir wara din il-mixja.
messages.zh: 走完这一程，我渴得很。
messages.en: I'm very thirsty after this walk.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 水在这里，喝一点吧。
messages.en: Here's the water. Have a little.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 għandi għatx 表示我口渴，再把想喝水的强烈需要联想到对知识等事物的渴望。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feeling a need to drink, or having a strong longing for something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 感到口渴、想喝水的；也指对某事物怀有强烈渴望的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu bżonn jixrob, jew li għandu xewqa qawwija għal xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 口渴的；想喝水的。
渴望某事物的；对某事物怀有强烈向往的。

formal.mt: L-istudent għatxan għall-għarfien kompla jistaqsi mistoqsijiet wara t-taħdita.
formal.en: The student, thirsty for knowledge, continued asking questions after the lecture.
formal.zh: 这名渴求知识的学生在讲座结束后继续提问。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Jien għatxan ħafna. Għandek ftit ilma? Maja: Iva, ħu dan il-flixkun.
colloquial.en: Mark: I'm very thirsty. Do you have some water? Maja: Yes, take this bottle.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我很渴。你有水吗？玛雅：有，拿这瓶吧。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien għatxan ħafna. Għandek ftit ilma?
messages.mt_standard: Jien għatxan ħafna. Għandek ftit ilma?
messages.zh: 我很渴。你有水吗？
messages.en: I'm very thirsty. Do you have some water?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，拿这瓶吧。
messages.en: Yes, take this bottle.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għatx 记成口渴这种感觉，把 għatxan 记成口渴的人所处的状态；渴求知识时也可借用这种感觉。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To howl or give a pitiable cry, especially when an animal is in pain; also, to provoke someone or incite them to aggression or hatred against another person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 嚎叫或发出凄厉的叫声，尤其指动物因疼痛而叫；另指挑唆某人，煽动其攻击或仇恨别人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel għajta ta' wġigħ jew ta' ħasra, speċjalment meta jingħad għal annimal; ukoll, tipprovoka lil xi ħadd jew tqanqlu għall-aggressjoni jew għall-mibegħda kontra ħaddieħor.

sense_translations.en_definition: to howl in pain (usually used of animals such as dogs)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因疼痛而嚎叫，通常用于狗等动物。
嚎叫；发出令人怜悯的凄厉叫声。
挑唆、怂恿或激惹某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: to entice (someone) to aggression or hatred against (someone else)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 煽动某人对另一个人采取攻击行为或产生仇恨。

collocations.en: incited his companion against someone else

formal.mt: Il-kelb għawa bl-uġigħ meta pprova jqum, u sidu sejjaħ lill-veterinarju.
formal.en: The dog howled in pain when it tried to stand up, and its owner called the vet.
formal.zh: 那只狗试着站起来时痛得嚎叫，主人便联系了兽医。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Smajt lill-kelb? Għawa bl-uġigħ. Mark: Iva, ejja naraw x'ġara.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you hear the dog? It howled in pain. Mark: Yes, let's see what happened.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你听见那只狗了吗？它痛得嚎叫了。马克：听见了，我们去看看怎么回事。

messages.speaker: Lara (邻居)
messages.zh: 你听见那只狗了吗？它痛得嚎叫了。
messages.en: Did you hear the dog? It howled in pain.

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.zh: 听见了，我们去看看怎么回事。
messages.en: Yes, let's see what happened.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两个独立场景记忆：动物受伤发出哀嚎；有人挑唆同伴敌视别人。不要把这两个义项硬套成同一画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Gozo, the second-largest island of the Republic of Malta.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戈佐岛，马耳他共和国的第二大岛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-gżira ta' Għawdex, it-tieni l-akbar gżira tar-Repubblika ta' Malta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛这一地名。
戈佐岛。

sense_translations.en_definition: Gozo (the second-largest island of the Republic of Malta)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛，马耳他共和国的第二大岛。

formal.mt: Il-programm taż-żjara jinkludi jumejn f'Għawdex.
formal.en: The visit programme includes two days in Gozo.
formal.zh: 访问行程包括在戈佐岛停留两天。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tmur Għawdex fi tmiem il-ġimgħa? Mark: Iva, se nqatta' jumejn hemm.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going to Gozo at the weekend? Mark: Yes, I'm going to spend two days there.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你周末去戈佐岛吗？马克：去，我打算在那里待两天。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Se tmur Għawdex fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.mt_standard: Se tmur Għawdex fi tmiem il-ġimgħa?
messages.zh: 你周末去戈佐岛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to Gozo at the weekend?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 去，我打算在那里待两天。
messages.en: Yes, I'm going to spend two days there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Għawdex 当作地图上的岛名来记，并配对英文 Gozo；用 f'Għawdex 这张在岛上旅行的场景卡巩固记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A male person from Gozo.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 来自戈佐岛的人；此形式用于男性。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel jew tifel minn Għawdex.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 戈佐岛人，此形式指男性。
戈佐岛的；与戈佐岛有关的。
戈佐岛人，即来自戈佐岛的人，此形式指男性。

collocations.zh: 来自艾因西莱姆的戈佐岛男子

formal.mt: Il-kelliem mistieden huwa Għawdxi li jgħix u jaħdem Malta.
formal.en: The guest speaker is a Gozitan man who lives and works on the island of Malta.
formal.zh: 受邀发言者是一名在马耳他岛生活和工作的戈佐岛男子。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Int Għawdxi? Mark: Iva, minn Għajnsielem, imma issa noqgħod Malta.
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you Gozitan? Mark: Yes, from Għajnsielem, but I live on the island of Malta now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你是戈佐岛人吗？马克：是，来自艾因西莱姆，不过现在住在马耳他岛。

messages.speaker: Maja (新同学)
messages.zh: 你是戈佐岛人吗？
messages.en: Are you Gozitan?

messages.speaker: Mark (新同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn Għajnsielem, imma issa noqgħod Malta.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn Għajnsielem, imma issa noqgħod Malta.
messages.zh: 是，来自艾因西莱姆，不过现在住在马耳他岛。
messages.en: Yes, from Għajnsielem, but I live on the island of Malta now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 成对记忆 Għawdex 是岛名，Għawdxi 可指岛上的男性居民；放在作家等名词旁，又能表达戈佐岛的。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To turn one's gaze to one side or look at something askew.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把目光转向一侧，或斜着眼睛看。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iħares lejn naħa waħda jew iħares laġenba.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朝一侧看；把视线转向旁边。
斜眼看；斜着目光看。

formal.mt: Meta sema' ħoss fil-kuritur, għawwas lejn il-bieb mingħajr ma waqqaf il-qari.
formal.en: When he heard a noise in the corridor, he looked sideways towards the door without stopping his reading.
formal.zh: 听到走廊里的声音时，他朝门口侧目看了一眼，没有停下阅读。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex għawwas lejn il-bieb? Mark: Sema' lil xi ħadd dieħel.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he look sideways towards the door? Mark: He heard someone coming in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：他为什么侧目朝门口看？Mark：他听见有人进来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他为什么侧目朝门口看？
messages.en: Why did he look sideways towards the door?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 他听见有人进来。
messages.en: He heard someone coming in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象读书时眼睛往门口一偏，把这个侧目动作与 għawwas 配对记忆。

gloss_zh: 反复说；重申；重做；重犯旧习

teaching_sense.en_definition: To say or do something again, or return to a former habit, usually a bad one.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 再次或反复说某事、做某事，也指重新染上过去的习惯，通常是坏习惯。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jerġa' jgħid jew jagħmel xi ħaġa, jew jerġa' jaqbad drawwa ta' qabel, ġeneralment ħażina.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 反复说；一再说。
重申；再次强调已经说过的内容。

sense_translations.en_definition: to return to a former habit (usually a bad habit)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 恢复过去的习惯，通常指重犯坏习惯。
反复说；重申同一内容。
重复；把某个动作或事情再做一次。

collocations.en: returned to his old habit and started smoking again

formal.mt: Matul il-laqgħa, ir-rappreżentant għawwed l-istess talba biex jenfasizza l-importanza tagħha.
formal.en: During the meeting, the representative repeated the same request to emphasize its importance.
formal.zh: 会议期间，代表重申了同一项要求，以强调其重要性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu għawwed u reġa' beda jpejjep? Mark: Iva, wara xahar mingħajr sigaretti.
colloquial.en: Maja: Has Pawlu gone back to his old habit and started smoking again? Mark: Yes, after a month without cigarettes.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu 又犯老毛病，重新开始抽烟了吗？Mark：是啊，他之前已经一个月没抽了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Pawlu għawwed u reġa' beda jpejjep?
messages.mt_standard: Pawlu għawwed u reġa' beda jpejjep?
messages.zh: Pawlu 又犯老毛病，重新开始抽烟了吗？
messages.en: Has Pawlu gone back to his old habit and started smoking again?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是啊，他之前已经一个月没抽了。
messages.en: Yes, after a month without cigarettes.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“又来了”串联记忆：话又说一遍、事又做一次、老习惯又回来，都可帮助理解 għawwed 的重复意味。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone swim or cause something to float on water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人游泳，或使某物浮在水面上。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jgħum jew jagħmel xi ħaġa żżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使游泳；让某人或某动物游起来。
使浮起；把某物放到水面上漂浮。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make something float, make someone swim
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某物漂浮，或使某人游泳。

formal.mt: Waqt l-attività, l-għalliem għawwem dgħajsa tal-karti f'kontenitur bl-ilma.
formal.en: During the activity, the teacher set a paper boat afloat in a container of water.
formal.zh: 活动中，老师把一艘纸船放进盛水的容器里，让它浮在水面上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għawwem id-dgħajsa tal-karti? Mark: Ħija. Ara kif qed iżżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma!
colloquial.en: Maja: Who set the paper boat afloat? Mark: My brother. Look how it is staying on the surface!
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把纸船放到水上漂起来的？Mark：我哥哥。看，它正浮在水面上呢！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把纸船放到水上漂起来的？
messages.en: Who set the paper boat afloat?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħija. Ara kif qed iżżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma!
messages.mt_standard: Ħija. Ara kif qed iżżomm f'wiċċ l-ilma!
messages.zh: 我哥哥。看，它正浮在水面上呢！
messages.en: My brother. Look how it is staying on the surface!

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象手把纸船轻放到水面，让它浮起来；记住 għawwem 强调“使它游或浮”的动作。

gloss_zh: 弄弯；扭曲；歪曲；说方言或带乡村口音

teaching_sense.en_definition: To bend or contort something, distort facts, or speak in a dialect or with a village accent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使物体弯曲或扭曲，也可指歪曲事实，或使用方言、带乡村口音说话。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jagħmel xi ħaġa mgħawġa, ibiddel il-fatti b'mod qarrieqi, jew jitkellem b'djalett jew b'aċċent ta' raħal.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使弯曲；把某物弄弯。
使扭曲；使形状发生扭转。
说方言；用某种地方话表达。
使弯曲或扭曲。
歪曲或曲解，例如歪曲事实。

sense_translations.en_definition: to speak with a village accent
sense_translations.zh_definition: 带着乡村或某个村庄的地方口音说话。

formal.mt: L-awtur għawweġ il-fatti billi ħalla barra informazzjoni essenzjali.
formal.en: The author distorted the facts by leaving out essential information.
formal.zh: 作者省略了关键信息，从而歪曲了事实。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għawweġ il-wajer? Mark: Jien, biex nagħmel ganċ żgħir.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who bent the wire? Mark: I did, to make a small hook.
colloquial.zh: Maja：谁把金属丝弄弯了？Mark：是我，我想做一个小钩子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁把金属丝弄弯了？
messages.en: Who bent the wire?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是我，我想做一个小钩子。
messages.en: I did, to make a small hook.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一根弯掉的金属丝记住“弄弯”，再用被改歪的事实记住引申义；方言和乡村口音义另配一张卡片记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who swims.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 进行游泳的人；可指一般游泳者或参加比赛的泳手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li tgħum, kemm għall-gost kif ukoll f'kompetizzjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 游泳者；泳手。

formal.mt: L-għawwiem temm it-tellieqa u ħareġ mill-pixxina biex jistrieħ.
formal.en: The swimmer finished the race and got out of the pool to rest.
formal.zh: 这名泳手完成比赛后，走出泳池休息。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħuk għawwiem tajjeb? Mark: Iva, imur jgħum kull ġimgħa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is your brother a good swimmer? Mark: Yes, he goes swimming every week.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你哥哥游泳游得好吗？Mark：是的，他每周都去游泳。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥游泳游得好吗？
messages.en: Is your brother a good swimmer?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 是的，他每周都去游泳。
messages.en: Yes, he goes swimming every week.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għawwiem 写在泳池里那个人的图旁，记住它指“游泳的人”；与表示使游泳或漂浮的 għawwem 分卡比较。

gloss_zh: 麻烦；纷争；不正当行事；歪曲

teaching_sense.en_definition: Trouble or strife; also, crookedness or actions carried out in a dishonest or underhand way.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 麻烦、困境或纷争；也指歪曲、不正直的状态，以及偷偷摸摸或不正当的行事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inkwiet jew ġlied; ukoll, nuqqas ta' dritt jew għemil magħmul b'qerq u b'mod mhux onest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 麻烦；困境；令人烦恼的状况。
纷争；冲突；不和。

sense_translations.en_definition: actions undertaken in a crooked or underhand manner
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以不正当、欺诈或暗中使手段的方式进行的行为。
歪曲、不直；也可指不正直或奸诈。

formal.mt: In-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni ġab ħafna għawġ bejn iż-żewġ gruppi.
formal.en: The lack of communication caused a lot of trouble between the two groups.
formal.zh: 沟通不足给两个小组之间带来了许多麻烦。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Dħalt fl-għawġ għax tlift iċ-ċavetta. Maja: Tinkwetax, għandi kopja oħra.
colloquial.en: Mark: I've got into trouble because I lost the key. Maja: Don't worry, I have another copy.
colloquial.zh: 马克：我把钥匙丢了，这下麻烦了。玛雅：别担心，我还有一把备用钥匙。

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 我把钥匙丢了，这下麻烦了。
messages.en: I've got into trouble because I lost the key.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 别担心，我还有一把备用钥匙。
messages.en: Don't worry, I have another copy.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用走进一团乱线的画面记住 jidħol fl-għawġ，表示陷入麻烦；另把歪曲和暗中使手段作为单独的义项卡片复习。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Introduces the reason or cause for something: because or as a result of.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 引出某件事的原因或成因，表示“因为”或“由于”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tintuża biex tagħti r-raġuni jew il-kawża ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 因为；用于引出原因。
由于；因某种原因或情况而产生结果。
因为；连接陈述与说明其原因的分句。

collocations.en: because I have work to do

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa ġiet posposta għax diversi membri ma setgħux jattendu.
formal.en: The meeting was postponed because several members could not attend.
formal.zh: 由于几位成员无法出席，会议被推迟了。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex se tibqa' d-dar? Mark: Għax għandi ħafna xogħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you staying home? Mark: Because I have a lot of work to do.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么要待在家里？Mark：因为我有很多工作要做。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么要待在家里？
messages.en: Why are you staying home?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为我有很多工作要做。
messages.en: Because I have a lot of work to do.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用问答卡记忆：看到“为什么”，就用 għax 引出“因为”；每次在它后面补上一个具体原因。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The short attributive form of the number ten, used before a noun to state a quantity of ten.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数词“十”放在名词前修饰名词时使用的短形式，表示数量为十。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-forma qasira ta' għaxra li tintuża quddiem nom biex turi kwantità ta' għaxra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 第十；表示顺序中的第十位。
għaxra（十）在名词前作定语时使用的短形式。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti għandhom għaxar minuti biex jaqraw l-istruzzjonijiet qabel jibdew.
formal.en: Participants have ten minutes to read the instructions before they begin.
formal.zh: 参与者在开始前有十分钟阅读说明。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Kemm fadlilna ħin? Mark: Għaxar minuti, imbagħad nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Maja: How much time do we have left? Mark: Ten minutes, then we leave.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们还剩多少时间？Mark：十分钟，然后我们就出发。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们还剩多少时间？
messages.en: How much time do we have left?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 十分钟，然后我们就出发。
messages.en: Ten minutes, then we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 画十个小钟，并在旁边写 għaxar minuti，把名词前的数量“十”记牢；另用排在第十位的卡片记忆所列序数义。

gloss_zh: 晾挂衣物；十（名词前长形式）

teaching_sense.en_definition: To hang up clothes, for example after washing them.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把衣物挂起来，例如洗后晾挂衣服。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Idendel il-ħwejjeġ, pereżempju wara l-ħasil biex jinxfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 把衣服挂起来；晾挂衣物。
għaxra（十）在名词前作定语时使用的长形式。

formal.mt: Wara l-ħasil, għaxart il-ħwejjeġ fil-bitħa biex jinxfu.
formal.en: After washing them, I hung up the clothes in the yard to dry.
formal.zh: 洗完后，我把衣服晾挂在院子里，让它们晾干。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaxart il-ħwejjeġ? Mark: Iva, u issa qed nippakkja għall-vaganza ta' għaxart ijiem.
colloquial.en: Maja: Have you hung up the clothes? Mark: Yes, and now I am packing for the ten-day holiday.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你把衣服晾好了吗？Mark：晾好了，我现在正在为十天的假期收拾行李。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你把衣服晾好了吗？
messages.en: Have you hung up the clothes?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, u issa qed nippakkja għall-vaganza ta' għaxart ijiem.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, u issa qed nippakkja għall-vaganza ta' għaxart ijiem.
messages.zh: 晾好了，我现在正在为十天的假期收拾行李。
messages.en: Yes, and now I am packing for the ten-day holiday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 做两张同形词卡：衣绳上的衣服对应动词“晾挂”，日历上的十格对应数词“十”；依据句子判断词性，分开记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fainting: a brief loss of consciousness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 昏厥，即短暂失去知觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Telf tas-sensi għal ħin qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 昏厥；短暂失去知觉。
虚弱欲晕的；近乎失去知觉的。

formal.mt: Wara l-għaxi, il-parteċipant ma kompliex jieħu sehem fil-laqgħa.
formal.en: After fainting, the participant did not continue taking part in the meeting.
formal.zh: 昏厥之后，这名与会者没有继续参加会议。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Għaliex Pawlu telaq mil-laqgħa? Toni: Kellu għaxi u mar id-dar ma' ħuh.
colloquial.en: Marija: Why did Pawlu leave the meeting? Toni: He fainted and went home with his brother.
colloquial.zh: Marija：Pawlu为什么离开会议了？Toni：他晕倒了，后来和哥哥一起回家了。

messages.speaker: Marija (同事)
messages.zh: Pawlu为什么离开会议了？
messages.en: Why did Pawlu leave the meeting?

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu għaxi u mar id-dar ma' ħuh.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu għaxi u mar id-dar ma' ħuh.
messages.zh: 他晕倒了，后来和哥哥一起回家了。
messages.en: He fainted and went home with his brother.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għaxi放进“昏厥之后”的场景记忆：先记名词“昏厥”，再另记形容词“虚弱欲晕的”，不要混淆词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of delight, pleasure or enjoyment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 由美好事物或愉快经历带来的喜悦、乐趣或享受。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ferħ u pjaċir li persuna tħoss minn xi ħaġa sabiħa jew pjaċevoli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 魅力；使人喜爱、愉悦的吸引力。
喜悦；令人欣喜的事物。
享受；从活动或事物中获得的乐趣。
喜悦、愉快、享受。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien irrestawrat huwa għaxqa għall-għajn u joffri spazju kwiet għar-residenti.
formal.en: The restored garden is a delight to the eye and offers residents a quiet space.
formal.zh: 修复后的花园赏心悦目，并为居民提供了一处安静的空间。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'għaxqa ta' ġnien! Mark: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit hawn u ngawdu l-fjuri.
colloquial.en: Lara: What a delightful garden! Mark: Yes, let's sit here for a while and enjoy the flowers.
colloquial.zh: Lara：这花园真让人喜欢！Mark：是啊，我们在这里坐一会儿，欣赏一下花吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这花园真让人喜欢！
messages.en: What a delightful garden!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit hawn u ngawdu l-fjuri.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, ejja noqogħdu ftit hawn u ngawdu l-fjuri.
messages.zh: 是啊，我们在这里坐一会儿，欣赏一下花吧。
messages.en: Yes, let's sit here for a while and enjoy the flowers.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象看见漂亮花园时脱口而出的赞叹，把għaxqa与“赏心悦目、心生喜悦、享受其中”连成一幅画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The number ten, used when counting or giving a number on its own.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 数字十，用于计数或独立回答数量。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: In-numru li jiġi wara d-disgħa u qabel il-ħdax, użat fl-għadd jew waħdu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 十；数字10。
十，数词的独立形式，可用于单独计数或独立表示数量。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa tibda fl-għaxra ta' filgħodu fis-sala prinċipali.
formal.en: The meeting starts at ten o'clock in the morning in the main hall.
formal.zh: 会议于上午十点在主厅开始。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Kemm hemm siġġijiet madwar il-mejda? Mark: Għaxra. Hemm biżżejjed għal kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Lara: How many chairs are there around the table? Mark: Ten. There are enough for everyone.
colloquial.zh: Lara：桌子周围有多少把椅子？Mark：十把，够每个人坐。

messages.speaker: Lara (活动组织者)
messages.zh: 桌子周围有多少把椅子？
messages.en: How many chairs are there around the table?

messages.speaker: Mark (活动助手)
messages.zh: 十把，够每个人坐。
messages.en: Ten. There are enough for everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 伸出十根手指，独立回答“多少？”时说għaxra；再把钟面十点与这个词联系起来，形成数量和时间两个记忆点。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An episode of swooning or fainting, involving a brief loss of consciousness.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一次昏厥或晕倒发作，表现为短暂失去知觉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Episodju li fih persuna titlef is-sensi għal ħin qasir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一次昏厥或晕倒发作。
昏厥；晕倒发作。

formal.mt: Il-laqgħa twaqqfet wara li wieħed mill-parteċipanti kellu għaxwa.
formal.en: The meeting was stopped after one of the participants had a fainting spell.
formal.zh: 一名与会者发生昏厥后，会议被中止。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'ġara lil Ġanni waqt il-laqgħa? David: Kellu għaxwa qasira, u mbagħad ġie ħuh għalih.
colloquial.en: Sara: What happened to Ġanni during the meeting? David: He had a brief fainting spell, and then his brother came to pick him up.
colloquial.zh: Sara：Ġanni在开会时怎么了？David：他短暂晕倒了一次，后来他哥哥来接他了。

messages.speaker: Sara (同事)
messages.zh: Ġanni在开会时怎么了？
messages.en: What happened to Ġanni during the meeting?

messages.speaker: David (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Kellu għaxwa qasira, u mbagħad ġie ħuh għalih.
messages.mt_standard: Kellu għaxwa qasira, u mbagħad ġie ħuh għalih.
messages.zh: 他短暂晕倒了一次，后来他哥哥来接他了。
messages.en: He had a brief fainting spell, and then his brother came to pick him up.

cognitive_memory_aid: 学习时把għaxwa圈成一个完整事件：“发生了一次昏厥”。与għaxi并排记忆，用“一次发作”的场景帮助区分。

gloss_zh: 吃晚餐；给人食物；使大笑；使昏厥

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone food, especially an evening meal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 给某人提供食物，尤其是供给晚餐。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħti l-ikel lil xi ħadd, speċjalment għall-ikla ta' filgħaxija.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吃晚餐。
给别人提供食物；让别人有饭吃。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to laugh heartily
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人开怀大笑。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sb. to swoon or faint
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人昏厥或晕倒。
使某人失去知觉；使某人昏倒。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause someone to laugh heartily
sense_translations.zh_definition: 逗得某人开怀大笑。
使人因过量而生腻；津津有味地品尝、享用。

collocations.zh: 他给客人们提供了晚餐

formal.mt: Wara l-attività, il-kok għaxxa lill-mistednin fis-sala tal-komunità.
formal.en: After the event, the cook gave the guests dinner in the community hall.
formal.zh: 活动结束后，厨师在社区礼堂为客人们提供了晚餐。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Kif kien il-kummidjant ilbieraħ? Toni: Għaxxa lil kulħadd bid-daħk! Ħadt gost ħafna.
colloquial.en: Marta: How was the comedian yesterday? Toni: He made everyone laugh heartily! I really enjoyed it.
colloquial.zh: Marta：昨天那个喜剧演员表演得怎么样？Toni：他把大家逗得哈哈大笑！我看得特别开心。

messages.speaker: Marta (朋友)
messages.zh: 昨天那个喜剧演员表演得怎么样？
messages.en: How was the comedian yesterday?

messages.speaker: Toni (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxxa lil kulħadd bid-daħk! Ħadt gost ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxxa lil kulħadd bid-daħk! Ħadt gost ħafna.
messages.zh: 他把大家逗得哈哈大笑！我看得特别开心。
messages.en: He made everyone laugh heartily! I really enjoyed it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为għaxxa制作分格记忆卡：晚餐桌、给人送饭、逗人大笑、使人昏倒各占一格；这些只是分义场景，不表示词义的历史来源。

gloss_zh: 使喜悦；陷入困境；因自身行为惹出问题

teaching_sense.en_definition: To give someone great pleasure or delight.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到十分愉快或欣喜。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tagħti ferħ jew pjaċir kbir lil xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使喜悦；使十分愉快。

sense_translations.en_definition: to find oneself in a fix
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发现自己陷入困境或棘手的处境。

sense_translations.en_definition: to create a problem through one's actions
sense_translations.zh_definition: 因自己的行为而造成问题；自己惹出麻烦。

collocations.en: he delighted everyone with his singing

formal.mt: Il-kantant għaxxaq lill-udjenza bil-vuċi tiegħu waqt il-kunċert.
formal.en: The singer delighted the audience with his voice during the concert.
formal.zh: 音乐会上，歌手以歌声令观众陶醉。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Kif kien il-kunċert? David: Il-kantant għaxxaqni bil-vuċi tiegħu! Nixtieq nerġa' nisimgħu.
colloquial.en: Marija: How was the concert? David: The singer delighted me with his voice! I'd like to hear him again.
colloquial.zh: Marija：音乐会怎么样？David：那位歌手的嗓音让我陶醉！我还想再听他唱。

messages.speaker: Marija (朋友)
messages.zh: 音乐会怎么样？
messages.en: How was the concert?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kantant għaxxaqni bil-vuċi tiegħu! Nixtieq nerġa' nisimgħu.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kantant għaxxaqni bil-vuċi tiegħu! Nixtieq nerġa' nisimgħu.
messages.zh: 那位歌手的嗓音让我陶醉！我还想再听他唱。
messages.en: The singer delighted me with his voice! I'd like to hear him again.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先用“歌声使听众喜悦”记住għaxxaq的教学义；另画一张“自己惹出麻烦”的卡片，把困境义单独记，避免凭一个中文义套用所有句子。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To build a nest in a place.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在某处筑巢、搭建鸟窝。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tibni bejta f'xi post.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 筑巢；搭建鸟窝。

sense_translations.en_definition: to make sb. weak or feeble
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人虚弱无力。
营巢；筑巢。
依偎着蜷缩起来；舒适地偎靠。
使变弱；使虚弱。

collocations.en: it built a nest in a tree

formal.mt: L-għasfur għaxxex fis-siġra ħdejn l-iskola, fejn l-istudenti setgħu josservawh mit-tieqa.
formal.en: The bird built a nest in the tree beside the school, where the students could observe it from the window.
formal.zh: 这只鸟在学校旁的树上筑了巢，学生们可以从窗口观察它。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn għaxxex dak l-għasfur? Pawlu: Għaxxex taħt is-saqaf, ħdejn it-tieqa tal-kċina.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did that bird build its nest? Pawlu: It nested under the roof, beside the kitchen window.
colloquial.zh: Nina：那只鸟在哪里筑巢了？Pawlu：它在屋顶下面、厨房窗户旁边筑了巢。

messages.speaker: Nina (邻居)
messages.zh: 那只鸟在哪里筑巢了？
messages.en: Where did that bird build its nest?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaxxex taħt is-saqaf, ħdejn it-tieqa tal-kċina.
messages.mt_standard: Għaxxex taħt is-saqaf, ħdejn it-tieqa tal-kċina.
messages.zh: 它在屋顶下面、厨房窗户旁边筑了巢。
messages.en: It nested under the roof, beside the kitchen window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“鸟在树上筑巢”的画面记għaxxex，再分别补上“依偎蜷缩”和“使人虚弱”两张义项卡；画面只是助记，不用来推断词源。

gloss_zh: 惊叹；惊讶；大惊小怪；容易惊讶的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of amazement or awe; also excessive fuss, or a person who easily becomes amazed or makes a fuss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 惊讶、惊叹或敬畏的感受；也可指大惊小怪的反应，或容易惊讶、爱小题大做的人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sens ta' sorpriża kbira jew ammirazzjoni; ukoll storbju żejjed fuq xi ħaġa, jew persuna li tistagħġeb malajr.

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who tends to make an excessive fuss over things
sense_translations.zh_definition: 爱大惊小怪、常把事情闹得过于夸张的人。

sense_translations.en_definition: a person who is easily awed or startled
sense_translations.zh_definition: 容易感到惊叹或受到惊吓的人。
敬畏；令人震撼的惊叹。
惊讶；惊叹。
过度反应；大惊小怪。
惊叹、惊愕或意外之感。

formal.mt: Il-viżitaturi ħarsu b'għaġeb kbir lejn id-dettalji tal-pittura.
formal.en: The visitors looked at the details of the painting with great amazement.
formal.zh: 参观者十分惊叹地看着画作的细节。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan il-mużajk! Mark: Veru, ħaġa tal-għaġeb. Maja: Ejja nħarsu lejn id-dettalji.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how beautiful this mosaic is! Mark: Yes, an amazing thing. Maja: Let's look at the details.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看，这幅马赛克多美啊！马克：真的，太令人惊叹了。玛雅：我们看看细节吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan il-mużajk!
messages.mt_standard: Ara kemm hu sabiħ dan il-mużajk!
messages.zh: 看，这幅马赛克多美啊！
messages.en: Look how beautiful this mosaic is!

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 真的，太令人惊叹了。
messages.en: Yes, an amazing thing.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们看看细节吧。
messages.en: Let's look at the details.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象参观者看到精美画作时张大嘴巴：适度是“惊叹”，反应过头可成“大惊小怪”；再单独记住它也能指这样的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To work dough or another soft material by pressing and folding it, or to mould it into a particular shape.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 通过按压、折叠等动作揉面团或其他柔软材料，也可指将材料揉捏成特定形状。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaħdem għaġina jew materjal artab billi jagħfsu u jitwih, jew jagħtih forma partikolari.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉捏，尤其指揉面。

sense_translations.en_definition: to mould into a particular shape
sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉捏或塑造成特定形状。
揉面团等柔软材料。

formal.mt: Il-furnar għaġen l-għaġina sakemm saret lixxa u elastika.
formal.en: The baker kneaded the dough until it became smooth and elastic.
formal.zh: 面包师把面团揉至光滑而有弹性。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min għaġen l-għaġina? Mark: Jien, imma għadha twaħħal ftit. Maja: Ejja naħdmuha ftit ieħor flimkien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Who kneaded the dough? Mark: I did, but it is still a little sticky. Maja: Let's work it a little more together.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：谁揉的面团？马克：我揉的，不过还有点黏。玛雅：我们一起再揉一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 谁揉的面团？
messages.en: Who kneaded the dough?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我揉的，不过还有点黏。
messages.en: I did, but it is still a little sticky.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们一起再揉一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's work it a little more together.

cognitive_memory_aid: 边读 għaġen 边模拟双手揉面，再想象把黏土揉成小碗；用同一个手部动作连接“揉材料”和“塑成形状”两种用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pasta, a food made from dough shaped into pieces and usually cooked in boiling water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 意大利面：把面团制成条状或其他形状，通常用沸水煮熟的面食。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul minn għaġina f'forom differenti, li normalment jissajjar fl-ilma jagħli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 意大利面；由面团制成各种形状的面食

formal.mt: Għalli l-għaġin fl-ilma bil-melħ, imbagħad żid iz-zalza u servi.
formal.en: Boil the pasta in salted water, then add the sauce and serve.
formal.zh: 将意大利面放入盐水中煮熟，然后加入酱汁，即可上桌。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi trid tiekol illum? Mark: Nixtieq platt għaġin biz-zalza.
colloquial.en: Maja: What would you like to eat today? Mark: I'd like a plate of pasta with sauce.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你今天想吃什么？马克：我想吃一盘配酱汁的意大利面。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天想吃什么？
messages.en: What would you like to eat today?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我想吃一盘配酱汁的意大利面。
messages.en: I'd like a plate of pasta with sauce.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għaġin和一盘煮熟拌酱的意大利面一起记；再与għaġina“面团”对照，区分面食和制作材料。

gloss_zh: 面团；酥皮面团；酥皮糕点

teaching_sense.en_definition: A soft mixture of flour and liquid that is kneaded or shaped to make bread, pastry, or similar foods.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 面粉与液体混合后形成的柔软面团，可揉制或塑形，用来制作面包、酥皮糕点等食品。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Taħlita ratba ta' dqiq u likwidu li tinħadem biex isir il-ħobż, it-torti jew ikel ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 面团；面粉与水等液体混合后形成、可揉制和塑形的团状物
酥皮面团；用于制作馅饼等食品的面皮，也可指用这类面皮制成的糕点

formal.mt: Wara li tħallat id-dqiq mal-ilma, aħdem l-għaġina sakemm issir lixxa.
formal.en: After mixing the flour with the water, work the dough until it becomes smooth.
formal.zh: 将面粉与水混合后，揉制面团，直到表面光滑。

colloquial.mt: Lara: L-għaġina lesta għat-torta? Pawlu: Kważi; irrid naħdimha ftit ieħor.
colloquial.en: Lara: Is the pastry ready for the pie? Pawlu: Almost; I need to work it a little more.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：做馅饼的面团准备好了吗？保罗：快好了，我还要再揉一会儿。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 做馅饼的面团准备好了吗？
messages.en: Is the pastry ready for the pie?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 快好了，我还要再揉一会儿。
messages.en: Almost; I need to work it a little more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到għaġina就想象双手揉面团；用“面包面团”和“馅饼面皮”两个厨房画面连接它的常见义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Haste or hurry: the state of doing something quickly, often because there is little time.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 匆忙或急忙：通常因时间紧迫而快速行动的状态。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħeffa li biha tagħmel xi ħaġa, speċjalment meta jkollok ftit ħin.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 快速；行动或做事的速度
急忙；急于完成某事的状态
匆忙；急忙；迅速

collocations.zh: 过于急躁；不必要的匆忙

formal.mt: Aqra l-istruzzjonijiet mingħajr għaġla biex tevita żbalji.
formal.en: Read the instructions without rushing to avoid mistakes.
formal.zh: 仔细从容地阅读说明，以免出错。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex qed tiekol bl-għaġla? Mark: Għax il-karozza tal-linja tasal dalwaqt.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why are you eating in a hurry? Mark: Because the bus is arriving soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你为什么吃得这么急？马克：因为公交车马上就到了。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么吃得这么急？
messages.en: Why are you eating in a hurry?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 因为公交车马上就到了。
messages.en: Because the bus is arriving soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għaġla放进赶公交的画面：bl-għaġla是匆忙地，mingħajr għaġla是不慌不忙地，成对记更清楚。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To cause someone to feel surprise, astonishment, or amazement.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人感到意外、惊愕或惊叹，强调某件事对人的感受产生影响。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iġiegħel lil xi ħadd iħoss sorpriża jew għaġeb kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人十分惊讶；使某人惊愕。
使某人吃惊；使某人感到意外。
使惊叹、惊愕或惊讶。

formal.mt: Ir-riżultat tal-esperiment għaġġeb lir-riċerkaturi.
formal.en: The result of the experiment astonished the researchers.
formal.zh: 实验结果令研究人员十分惊讶。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Il-kant ta' Pawlu għaġġeb lil kulħadd. Mark: Veru! Ma kontx naf li jkanta daqshekk tajjeb. Maja: Lanqas jien.
colloquial.en: Maja: Pawlu's singing amazed everyone. Mark: It really did! I didn't know he sang so well. Maja: Neither did I.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：保罗的歌声让大家都惊叹了。马克：真的！我原来不知道他唱得这么好。玛雅：我也不知道。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-kant ta' Pawlu għaġġeb lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Il-kant ta' Pawlu għaġġeb lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 保罗的歌声让大家都惊叹了。
messages.en: Pawlu's singing amazed everyone.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru! Ma kontx naf li jkanta daqshekk tajjeb.
messages.mt_standard: Veru! Ma kontx naf li jkanta daqshekk tajjeb.
messages.zh: 真的！我原来不知道他唱得这么好。
messages.en: It really did! I didn't know he sang so well.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我也不知道。
messages.en: Neither did I.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把句子画成“精彩表演→观众惊叹”：għaġġeb 表示让别人产生惊讶。与名词 għaġeb 对照时，分别记“使人惊叹”和“惊叹的感受”。

gloss_zh: 赶快；匆忙行动；催促；加快

teaching_sense.en_definition: To act or move quickly, or to make someone or something proceed more quickly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 快速行动、赶紧做事；也可指催促他人，或使某件事加快进行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jaġixxi jew jimxi malajr, jew iġiegħel lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa jimxu aktar malajr.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 赶快；匆忙行动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to cause sth. to be done quickly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某事尽快完成；加快办事进度。
催促某人快一点。
迅速采取行动。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hurry; to be quick or hasty
sense_translations.zh_definition: 赶快；行动迅速或仓促。
加速；加快；促使提前发生或完成。

formal.mt: It-tim għaġġel ix-xogħol biex il-proġett jitlesta fil-ħin.
formal.en: The team sped up the work so that the project would be completed on time.
formal.zh: 团队加快了工作进度，以便项目按时完成。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaġġel ftit, Mark! Il-karozza tal-linja waslet. Mark: Ġej! Qed nieħu l-borża. Maja: Tajjeb, nistenniek ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Hurry up a little, Mark! The bus has arrived. Mark: Coming! I'm getting the bag. Maja: All right, I'll wait for you by the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克，快一点！公交车到了。马克：来了！我在拿包。玛雅：好，我在门边等你。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaġġel ftit, Mark! Il-karozza tal-linja waslet.
messages.mt_standard: Għaġġel ftit, Mark! Il-karozza tal-linja waslet.
messages.zh: 马克，快一点！公交车到了。
messages.en: Hurry up a little, Mark! The bus has arrived.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 来了！我在拿包。
messages.en: Coming! I'm getting the bag.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我在门边等你。
messages.en: All right, I'll wait for you by the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象公交车已到站，朋友喊“Għaġġel!”；把这声催促记成“快一点”，再延伸到加快步伐、加快工作和催别人行动。

gloss_zh: 慰唁；安慰丧亲者；旧时邻里为丧家做饭的习俗

teaching_sense.en_definition: To comfort someone who is mourning and express sympathy for their loss.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 安慰正在哀悼的人，并对其丧亲之痛表达慰问。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li tfarraġ lil xi ħadd wara l-mewt ta' persuna għażiża u tesprimi s-sogħba tiegħek għat-telfa tiegħu.

sense_translations.en_definition: to comfort sb. in times of mourning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在某人居丧、哀悼期间给予安慰。

sense_translations.en_definition: to comfort (someone) in times of mourning, to offer condolences, to console, to declare regret for someone's loss
sense_translations.zh_definition: 安慰丧亲者；致以慰唁；表达对某人失去亲友的悲伤与同情。

sense_translations.en_definition: a disused Maltese custom where neighbors cooked a meal for a grieving family, who refrained from cooking to avoid worsening the fire of purgatory
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一种已不再实行的马耳他习俗：邻居为丧亲家庭做饭；丧家不自行做饭，以免按这一习俗的观念加重炼狱之火。

collocations.en: he offered condolences to the family

formal.mt: Ir-rappreżentant tal-għaqda għaża lill-familja wara t-telfa ta' missierhom.
formal.en: The association's representative offered condolences to the family after the loss of their father.
formal.zh: 协会代表在这家人的父亲去世后，向他们致以慰唁。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Il-kappillan żar il-familja? Toni: Iva, żarhom dalgħodu u għaża lil kulħadd.
colloquial.en: Marija: Did the parish priest visit the family? Toni: Yes, he visited them this morning and consoled everyone.
colloquial.zh: Marija：堂区神父去探望那家人了吗？Toni：去了，他今天上午去看望了他们，并安慰了大家。

messages.speaker: Marija (邻居)
messages.zh: 堂区神父去探望那家人了吗？
messages.en: Did the parish priest visit the family?

messages.speaker: Toni (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, żarhom dalgħodu u għaża lil kulħadd.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, żarhom dalgħodu u għaża lil kulħadd.
messages.zh: 去了，他今天上午去看望了他们，并安慰了大家。
messages.en: Yes, he visited them this morning and consoled everyone.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把għaża放在“探望丧亲朋友、轻声表达慰问”的场景中记忆；动词记“慰唁”，名词另记题给的旧时邻里送饭习俗，明确区分词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dig or turn over soil with a hoe or another implement; figuratively, to work unsystematically or perform poorly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用锄头等工具挖土或翻土；也可比喻做事没有章法，或在考试、任务中表现不佳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħaffer jew qalleb il-ħamrija b'mgħażqa jew b'għodda oħra; f'sens figurattiv, ħadem bla ordni jew mar ħażin f'eżami jew f'xi biċċa xogħol.

sense_translations.en_definition: to dig using an implement such as a hoe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 用锄头等工具挖土。
翻土；把土壤翻松。
没有条理地做某事；做事缺乏章法。

sense_translations.en_definition: to dig (a field) over, to hoe
sense_translations.zh_definition: 翻耕田地；锄地。

sense_translations.en_definition: to do poorly (in an exam or task)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 在考试或任务中表现不佳；做得很差。

formal.mt: Qabel iż-żrigħ, il-bidwi għażaq l-għalqa biex iħejji l-ħamrija.
formal.en: Before sowing, the farmer hoed the field to prepare the soil.
formal.zh: 播种前，农民锄了田地，为播种整好土壤。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex il-ħamrija tidher daqshekk ratba? Pawlu: Missieri għażaq il-ġnien dalgħodu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the soil look so loose? Pawlu: My father hoed the garden this morning.
colloquial.zh: Maja：土怎么显得这么松？Pawlu：我爸爸今天早上给花园翻了土。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)

messages.en: My father hoed the garden this morning.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先把 għażaq 配上挥锄翻土的画面；再另记两个比喻标签：做事乱、成绩差，靠上下文区分。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A man who is not married; a bachelor.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尚未结婚的男子；单身汉。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Raġel li mhuwiex miżżewweġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 单身汉；未婚男子。
没有结婚的男子。
单身汉，指未婚男子。

formal.mt: Skont il-bijografija, l-awtur baqa' għażeb tul ħajtu.
formal.en: According to the biography, the author remained a bachelor throughout his life.
formal.zh: 根据传记记载，这位作家终身未婚。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Ħuk miżżewweġ? Mark: Le, għadu għażeb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Is your brother married? Mark: No, he is still a bachelor.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你兄弟结婚了吗？Mark：没有，他还未婚。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你兄弟结婚了吗？
messages.en: Is your brother married?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 没有，他还未婚。
messages.en: No, he is still a bachelor.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għażeb 放进婚姻状态卡片，旁边写上“未婚男子”；这里的 bachelor 要联想单身汉，不要联想学士学位。

gloss_zh: 选择；分开；区别；偏爱；纺线；发出呼噜声；亚麻布；渔网

teaching_sense.en_definition: To choose or select someone or something from the available possibilities.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从可供考虑的人或事物中作出选择；挑选。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa persuna jew ħaġa minn fost diversi possibbiltajiet skont dak li ried jew kellu bżonn.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 纺线；将纤维纺成线。
挑选；选取。
亚麻布。
选择；挑选。
分开；将不同事物分离。
区分；辨别事物之间的差别。
给予优待；偏爱；偏袒。
纺羊毛；将羊毛纺成线。
发出呼噜声，如猫发出的声音。
亚麻布；亚麻织物。
渔网；捕鱼用的网。
三层刺网，一种捕鱼用的渔网。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat għażel il-proposta li kienet l-aktar adattata għall-bżonnijiet tal-iskola.
formal.en: The committee selected the proposal that best suited the school's needs.
formal.zh: 委员会选出了最符合学校需求的方案。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Liema ktieb għażel Mark? Toni: Għażel dak dwar il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Lara: Which book did Mark choose? Toni: He chose the one about the sea.
colloquial.zh: Lara：Mark 选了哪本书？Toni：他选了那本讲海洋的书。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: Mark 选了哪本书？
messages.en: Which book did Mark choose?

messages.speaker: Toni (同学)
messages.zh: 他选了那本讲海洋的书。
messages.en: He chose the one about the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għażel 做分格词卡：选择、纺线、呼噜声各放一个动词画面，亚麻布和渔网另放名词格；同形要分义记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Dear, beloved, or cherished because someone or something has personal or emotional importance.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因感情深厚或具有个人意义而受到珍爱的；亲爱的；心爱的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Maħbub jew apprezzat ħafna minħabba rabta ta' mħabba jew importanza personali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 亲爱的；令人珍爱的。
心爱的；深受喜爱的。
受珍爱的；用于形容心爱的人。
亲爱的；倍受珍惜的。

formal.mt: Għażiż Sur Borg, nirringrazzjak tal-għajnuna li tajt lill-iskola tagħna.
formal.en: Dear Mr Borg, thank you for the help you gave our school.
formal.zh: 亲爱的 Borg 先生，感谢您对我们学校提供的帮助。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex iżżomm dan ir-ritratt? Lara: Fih ħabib għażiż li ilni ma nara.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why do you keep this photo? Lara: It shows a dear friend I have not seen for a long time.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你为什么留着这张照片？Lara：里面有一位我很久没见的亲密朋友。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么留着这张照片？
messages.en: Why do you keep this photo?

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fih ħabib għażiż li ilni ma nara.
messages.mt_standard: Fih ħabib għażiż li ilni ma nara.
messages.zh: 里面有一位我很久没见的亲密朋友。
messages.en: It shows a dear friend I have not seen for a long time.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għażiż 写在珍藏照片的背面，联想“亲爱的、心爱的”；再成对记 ħabib għażiż 与 tifkira għażiża。

gloss_zh: 选择；选项；挑选；建筑群；纺线活动

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act of choosing, or an option that someone can choose.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 作出挑选的行为，也指可供选择的一种方案或事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tagħżel bejn possibbiltajiet differenti, jew possibbiltà li tista' tagħżel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 选择；作出的选择。
选项；可供选择的方案。
挑选；选取。
选项；选择。
建筑群；由一组楼房组成的区块。
纺线这一活动；一次纺线。

formal.mt: L-għażla tal-kors għandha tqis l-interessi u l-għanijiet tal-istudent.
formal.en: The choice of course should take the student's interests and goals into account.
formal.zh: 课程的选择应考虑学生的兴趣和目标。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Immorru bil-karozza jew bil-karozza tal-linja? Sara: Il-karozza tal-linja hija għażla tajba; ma rridux infittxu parkeġġ.
colloquial.en: Mark: Shall we go by car or by bus? Sara: The bus is a good choice; we will not have to look for parking.
colloquial.zh: Mark：我们开车去还是坐公交车去？Sara：坐公交车是个好选择，我们就不用找停车位了。

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们开车去还是坐公交车去？
messages.en: Shall we go by car or by bus?

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-karozza tal-linja hija għażla tajba; ma rridux infittxu parkeġġ.
messages.mt_standard: Il-karozza tal-linja hija għażla tajba; ma rridux infittxu parkeġġ.
messages.zh: 坐公交车是个好选择，我们就不用找停车位了。
messages.en: The bus is a good choice; we will not have to look for parking.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għażla 想成菜单上可圈选的一项，同时记住它也能指挑选的过程；建筑群和纺线义另外分栏记。

gloss_zh: 珍视；珍爱；懒惰；精神不振；冷漠

teaching_sense.en_definition: To value or cherish someone or something and hold them dear.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 认为某人或某物十分重要而加以珍视、珍爱。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ta valur lil persuna jew ħaġa u żammha għażiża.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 重视；珍视。
珍爱；爱惜。

sense_translations.en_definition: to hold sth. or sb. dear
sense_translations.zh_definition: 将某人或某物视为珍贵；十分珍爱。
懒惰；不愿付出劳动的状态。
精神不振；倦怠；缺乏活力。
珍爱；珍惜；欣赏。
冷漠；漠不关心。

formal.mt: Matul ħajtu, Pawlu għażż lil familtu u dejjem sab ħin għaliha.
formal.en: Throughout his life, Pawlu cherished his family and always made time for them.
formal.zh: Pawlu 一生珍爱自己的家人，总会抽出时间陪伴他们。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex għadek fuq is-sufan? Mark: Għandi għażż illum, imma issa nqum u nibda x-xogħol.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why are you still on the sofa? Mark: I feel lazy today, but I will get up now and start working.
colloquial.zh: Lara：你怎么还在沙发上？Mark：今天有点犯懒，不过我现在就起来干活。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还在沙发上？

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)

messages.mt_standard: Għandi għażż illum, imma issa nqum u nibda x-xogħol.
messages.zh: 今天有点犯懒，不过我现在就起来干活。
messages.en: I feel lazy today, but I will get up now and start working.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为 għażż 画两张卡：动词卡上是珍爱家人，名词卡上是窝在沙发犯懒；先看词性，再选对应意思。

gloss_zh: 前往慰问；吊唁；表示哀悼；安慰

teaching_sense.en_definition: To visit or speak to someone after a loss in order to offer condolences, sympathy, or comfort.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在他人遭遇丧失或丧亲之痛后，前往慰问或向其表达哀悼、同情和安慰。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Żar jew kellem lil xi ħadd wara telfa biex joffrilu l-kondoljanzi u l-faraġ.

sense_translations.en_definition: to visit sb. to give condolences or sympathies
sense_translations.zh_definition: 前往探望某人，以表达吊唁、慰问或同情。

sense_translations.en_definition: to offer condolences, to console, to declare regret for someone's loss
sense_translations.zh_definition: 表示哀悼；安慰；对他人的丧失表达悲痛和惋惜。

formal.mt: Wara l-mewt tas-Sur Borg, ir-rappreżentant tal-għaqda għażża lill-familja tiegħu.
formal.en: After Mr Borg's death, the association's representative offered condolences to his family.
formal.zh: Borg 先生去世后，协会代表向他的家属表示哀悼。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Pawlu mar jara lil Mark wara li miet missieru? Toni: Iva, mar għandu lbieraħ u għażża lilu u lill-familja tiegħu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did Pawlu visit Mark after his father died? Toni: Yes, he went to see him yesterday and offered condolences to him and his family.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Mark 的父亲去世后，Pawlu 去看望他了吗？Toni：去了，他昨天去看了他，向他和家人表示了慰问。

messages.mt_standard: Pawlu mar jara lil Mark wara li miet missieru?

messages.en: Did Pawlu visit Mark after his father died?

messages.mt_standard: Iva, mar għandu lbieraħ u għażża lilu u lill-familja tiegħu.
messages.zh: 去了，他昨天去看了他，向他和家人表示了慰问。
messages.en: Yes, he went to see him yesterday and offered condolences to him and his family.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għażża 放进探望丧亲朋友的场景：登门、倾听、表达哀悼；这样把词义与具体慰问行为一起记住。

gloss_zh: 磨牙；研磨；啃咬；低吼；紧紧拥抱

teaching_sense.en_definition: To grind one's teeth; also used for grinding, gnawing, snarling or growling, and clasping someone tightly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 磨牙；也可表示研磨、啃咬、龇牙低吼，或把某人紧紧抱住，具体含义由语境决定。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħakk snienu ma' xulxin; jista' jfisser ukoll itħan, gidem ripetutament, gerger, jew għannaq lil xi ħadd bis-saħħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 磨牙；使上下牙齿相互摩擦。
研磨；磨碎。
啃；反复啃咬。
龇牙低吼；发出威胁性的低沉吼声。

sense_translations.en_definition: to embrace, to clasp someone tight
sense_translations.zh_definition: 拥抱；将某人紧紧抱住。

formal.mt: Meta sema' l-aħbar, ir-raġel għażżaż snienu u baqa' sieket.
formal.en: When he heard the news, the man ground his teeth and remained silent.
formal.zh: 听到消息后，那名男子磨了磨牙，依然一言不发。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex waqaft ħdejn il-bieb? Mark: Il-kelb għażżaż meta ersaqt, u bżajt nidħol.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why did you stop by the door? Mark: The dog growled when I approached, and I was afraid to go in.
colloquial.zh: Sara：你为什么停在门边？Mark：我一靠近，那只狗就低吼，我不敢进去。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To love someone and show that love through affectionate treatment.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 疼爱某人，并通过温柔、关怀的举动表达爱意。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħobb lil xi ħadd u turih imħabba u ħlewwa fil-mod kif tittrattah.

sense_translations.en_definition: to love or treat with affection
sense_translations.zh_definition: 疼爱；以亲切、温柔的态度对待。
充满爱意地对待；温柔呵护。

formal.mt: Matul ħajtu, Pawlu għażżeż lil uliedu u tahom l-imħabba u l-appoġġ li kellhom bżonn.

formal.zh: 保罗一生疼爱自己的孩子，给予他们所需的关爱与支持。
