gloss_zh: 懒惰的；懒人；无精打采的人

teaching_sense.en_definition: Unwilling to work, make an effort, or be active.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 不愿工作、付出努力或积极行动的；懒惰的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx irid jaħdem, jagħmel sforz jew ikun attiv.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 懒惰的；不愿付出努力的。
懒人；不愿工作或努力的人。
精神不振、缺乏活力的人。

formal.mt: L-għalliem evita li jsejjaħ lill-istudent għażżien u pprova jifhem għaliex ma kienx qed jagħmel ix-xogħol.
formal.en: The teacher avoided calling the student lazy and tried to understand why he was not doing the work.
formal.zh: 老师没有直接说这个学生懒惰，而是试着了解他为什么没有完成作业。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għaliex għadek ma ħsiltx il-platti? Mark: Illum qed inħossni għażżien, imma se naħsilhom issa.
colloquial.en: Sara: Why haven't you washed the dishes yet? Mark: I'm feeling lazy today, but I'll wash them now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你怎么还没洗碗？马克：我今天有点犯懒，不过我现在就去洗。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你怎么还没洗碗？
messages.en: Why haven't you washed the dishes yet?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Illum qed inħossni għażżien, imma se naħsilhom issa.
messages.mt_standard: Illum qed inħossni għażżien, imma se naħsilhom issa.
messages.zh: 我今天有点犯懒，不过我现在就去洗。
messages.en: I'm feeling lazy today, but I'll wash them now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用沙发上不想起身的人记 għażżien；再对比 għażżiel 的纺线工图片，特别留意词尾 n 和 l。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To disappear or cease to be visible or present.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 从视线中消失，或原本在某处的事物不见了。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ma tibqax tidher jew ma tibqax fil-post fejn kont.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 消失；不见；从视线或原处消失。

formal.mt: Skont ir-rapport, id-dgħajsa dehret qrib il-kosta qabel ma għeb kull sinjal tagħha.
formal.en: According to the report, the boat was seen near the coast before every trace of it disappeared.
formal.zh: 报告称，这艘船曾出现在海岸附近，随后便完全失去了踪迹。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn mar il-qattus? Luqa: Għeb wara s-sufan malli sema' l-bieb.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where did the cat go? Luqa: He disappeared behind the sofa as soon as he heard the door.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：猫跑到哪里去了？卢卡：它一听见门响，就躲到沙发后面不见了。

messages.speaker: Nina (姐姐)
messages.zh: 猫跑到哪里去了？
messages.en: Where did the cat go?

messages.speaker: Luqa (弟弟)
messages.mt_spoken: Għeb wara s-sufan malli sema' l-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Għeb wara s-sufan malli sema' l-bieb.
messages.zh: 它一听见门响，就躲到沙发后面不见了。
messages.en: He disappeared behind the sofa as soon as he heard the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象猫钻到沙发后，眼前只剩空地，把这一瞬间和 għeb 连起来记：刚才还在，现在不见。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become tired or fatigued after effort or activity.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 在付出体力或精力后变得疲倦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tibda tħossok għajjien wara xogħol, sforz jew attività.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 变累；开始感到疲倦。
变得疲劳；因消耗体力或精力而疲惫。
失去兴趣或动力；逐渐提不起干劲。
疲倦；感到累的状态。
疲劳；体力或精力消耗后的疲惫状态。
变得疲倦；由不累转为感到累。

formal.mt: Wara diversi sigħat ta' mixi, il-parteċipant għeja u waqaf biex jistrieħ qabel kompla r-rotta.
formal.en: After several hours of walking, the participant became tired and stopped to rest before continuing along the route.
formal.zh: 步行数小时后，这位参与者感到疲倦，停下来休息，然后才继续沿路线前进。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għaliex waqaf jimxi Ben? David: Għeja wara t-telgħa; ejja nistrieħu ftit miegħu.
colloquial.en: Anna: Why has Ben stopped walking? David: He got tired after the climb; let's rest with him for a bit.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：本怎么停下来不走了？戴维：他爬完坡累了；我们陪他休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Anna (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 本怎么停下来不走了？
messages.en: Why has Ben stopped walking?

messages.speaker: David (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għeja wara t-telgħa; ejja nistrieħu ftit miegħu.
messages.mt_standard: Għeja wara t-telgħa; ejja nistrieħu ftit miegħu.
messages.zh: 他爬完坡累了；我们陪他休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: He got tired after the climb; let's rest with him for a bit.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għeja 分两张卡记：人物走累了对应动词，电量不足的电池对应名词疲劳；读句子时先判断词性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To make someone tired or exhausted through effort, activity, or strain.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 使某人因活动、劳累或压力而感到疲倦或筋疲力尽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tagħmel lil xi ħadd għajjien jew bla saħħa minħabba sforz, attività jew tensjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 使某人感到累；使人疲倦。
使筋疲力尽；使疲惫不堪。

formal.mt: Il-vjaġġ twil għejja lit-tfal, u għalhekk l-għalliema tawhom ħin biex jistrieħu qabel iż-żjara.
formal.en: The long journey tired the children out, so the teachers gave them time to rest before the visit.
formal.zh: 长途旅行让孩子们十分疲倦，因此老师们在参观前给他们安排了休息时间。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex it-tfal raqdu daqshekk kmieni? Karl: Il-jum kollu fil-beraħ għejja lit-tfal sew.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why did the children fall asleep so early? Karl: The whole day outdoors really tired them out.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：孩子们怎么这么早就睡着了？卡尔：在户外待了一整天，把他们累坏了。

messages.speaker: Rita (母亲)
messages.zh: 孩子们怎么这么早就睡着了？
messages.en: Why did the children fall asleep so early?

messages.speaker: Karl (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-jum kollu fil-beraħ għejja lit-tfal sew.
messages.mt_standard: Il-jum kollu fil-beraħ għejja lit-tfal sew.
messages.zh: 在户外待了一整天，把他们累坏了。
messages.en: The whole day outdoors really tired them out.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记例句时画一条箭头：长途旅行指向疲倦的孩子，提醒自己 għejja 表示某事使别人累；同时留意双写 jj。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To rise in price or become more expensive.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 价格上升；变得比以前更贵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jiżdied fil-prezz jew isir jiswa aktar minn qabel.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 涨价；价格上涨。
沸腾；被煮沸。

sense_translations.en_definition: to be bitter; to feel bitterness
sense_translations.zh_definition: 发苦；感到苦涩或内心痛苦。

sense_translations.en_definition: to rise in price; to become expensive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 价格上升；变得昂贵。

formal.mt: Matul ix-xahar li għadda, il-fjuwil għela u żdiedet l-ispiża tat-trasport għall-kumpanija.
formal.en: During the past month, fuel became more expensive and the company's transport costs increased.
formal.zh: 过去一个月，燃油价格上涨，公司的运输成本也随之增加。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Għaliex ħallast aktar illum? Ġużeppi: Il-ħobż għela; l-istess ħobża issa tiswa aktar.
colloquial.en: Marta: Why did you pay more today? Ġużeppi: Bread has gone up in price; the same loaf now costs more.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：你今天怎么多花了钱？朱塞佩：面包涨价了；同样一条面包现在更贵了。

messages.speaker: Marta (妻子)
messages.zh: 你今天怎么多花了钱？
messages.en: Why did you pay more today?

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (丈夫)
messages.mt_spoken: Il-ħobż għela; l-istess ħobża issa tiswa aktar.
messages.mt_standard: Il-ħobż għela; l-istess ħobża issa tiswa aktar.
messages.zh: 面包涨价了；同样一条面包现在更贵了。
messages.en: Bread has gone up in price; the same loaf now costs more.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 għela 画三张情境卡：上升的价签、沸腾的水锅、苦涩的表情；靠上下文区分义项，不把它们混成一个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To successfully deal with a difficulty or defeat an opponent.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 成功克服困难，或在竞争、对抗中战胜对手。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jirnexxilek tegħleb diffikultà jew tirbaħ kontra avversarju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 克服；成功应对困难或障碍。
说服某人；争取到某人的认同或支持。

sense_translations.en_definition: to overcome, to defeat, to win out over
sense_translations.zh_definition: 克服；击败；在较量中胜过。

formal.mt: Minkejja bidu diffiċli, it-tim għeleb l-ostakli u temm il-proġett fiż-żmien stabbilit.
formal.en: Despite a difficult start, the team overcame the obstacles and completed the project within the agreed time.
formal.zh: 尽管开局困难，团队还是克服了障碍，并在约定时间内完成了项目。

colloquial.mt: Elena: Kif mar it-tim tiegħek ilbieraħ? Samwel: Għeleb lit-tim l-ieħor bi tliet gowls għal wieħed!
colloquial.en: Elena: How did your team do yesterday? Samwel: It beat the other team three goals to one!
colloquial.zh: 埃莱娜：你们队昨天踢得怎么样？萨姆韦尔：我们队以三比一击败了对方！

messages.speaker: Elena (朋友)
messages.zh: 你们队昨天踢得怎么样？
messages.en: How did your team do yesterday?

messages.speaker: Samwel (球队成员)
messages.mt_spoken: Għeleb lit-tim l-ieħor bi tliet gowls għal wieħed!
messages.mt_standard: Għeleb lit-tim l-ieħor bi tliet gowls għal wieħed!
messages.zh: 我们队以三比一击败了对方！
messages.en: It beat the other team three goals to one!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għeleb 放进越过障碍、赢得比赛、说服听众三幅画面，分别记住克服困难、战胜对手和争取支持。

gloss_zh: 裸露的；赤裸的；未穿衣服的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Bare or naked; without clothing or a covering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 裸露的、赤裸的，指没有穿衣服或没有遮盖。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ma jkunx liebes ħwejjeġ jew li jkun mingħajr għata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 裸露的；没有覆盖物的。
赤裸的；裸体的。
未穿衣服的；没有衣物遮身的。

formal.mt: L-istudenti studjaw kif l-artist pinġa l-ġisem għeri.
formal.en: The students studied how the artist painted the naked body.
formal.zh: 学生们研究了这位艺术家如何描绘裸体。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex it-tifel għadu għeri? Lara: Għadu kemm ħareġ mill-banju; se nlibbsu issa.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is the boy still naked? Lara: He has just come out of the bath; I'll dress him now.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：小男孩怎么还光着身子？拉拉：他刚洗完澡，我现在就给他穿衣服。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 小男孩怎么还光着身子？
messages.en: Why is the boy still naked?

messages.speaker: Lara (母亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Għadu kemm ħareġ mill-banju; se nlibbsu issa.
messages.mt_standard: Għadu kemm ħareġ mill-banju; se nlibbsu issa.
messages.zh: 他刚洗完澡，我现在就给他穿衣服。
messages.en: He has just come out of the bath; I'll dress him now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象洗澡后尚未穿衣的画面，把 għeri 和“赤裸、没有遮盖”一起记住。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A plant's root; also a nerve, or the source or beginning of something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 植物的根；也可指神经，或某件事的根源、起点。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti ta' pjanta li tikber fl-art; ukoll nerv, jew il-bidu jew l-oriġini ta' xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 根；植物通常长在土中、吸收水分和养分的部分。
神经；身体中传递感觉或运动信号的组织。
开始；开端；起源或根源。

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jidentifika n-nuqqas ta' komunikazzjoni bħala l-għerq tal-problema.
formal.en: The report identifies a lack of communication as the root of the problem.
formal.zh: 报告指出，缺乏沟通是问题的根源。

colloquial.mt: Mark: Għaliex din il-maduma telgħet? Pawlu: Għerq tas-siġra qed jimbuttaha minn taħt.
colloquial.en: Mark: Why has this tile lifted? Pawlu: A tree root is pushing it up from underneath.
colloquial.zh: 马克：这块地砖为什么翘起来了？保罗：有一条树根正从下面把它顶起来。

messages.speaker: Mark (房主)
messages.zh: 这块地砖为什么翘起来了？
messages.en: Why has this tile lifted?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (园丁)
messages.mt_spoken: Għerq tas-siġra qed jimbuttaha minn taħt.
messages.mt_standard: Għerq tas-siġra qed jimbuttaha minn taħt.
messages.zh: 有一条树根正从下面把它顶起来。
messages.en: A tree root is pushing it up from underneath.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先画一条地下的树根，再联想到事情的根源；另把“神经”作为独立义项记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Engagement or betrothal, or the period of courtship before marriage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 订婚、婚约，或结婚前的恋爱交往及其阶段。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Rabta ta' wegħda taż-żwieġ, jew iż-żmien ta' namur qabel iż-żwieġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 订婚；双方约定将来结婚的关系或状态。
求爱；以发展婚恋关系为目的的交往。
订立婚约；正式许婚的关系或状态。

collocations.en: the period of courtship or engagement

formal.mt: Fil-memorji tagħha, l-awtriċi tiddeskrivi żmien l-għerusija bħala perjodu ta' tama u tħejjija għaż-żwieġ.
formal.en: In her memoirs, the author describes her engagement as a period of hope and preparation for marriage.
formal.zh: 作者在回忆录中把自己的订婚期描述为充满希望、为婚姻做准备的阶段。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan hu ċ-ċurkett tal-għerusija tiegħek? Lara: Iva! Għażilnieh flimkien ilbieraħ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Is this your engagement ring? Lara: Yes! We chose it together yesterday.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这是你的订婚戒指吗？拉拉：对！我们昨天一起挑的。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 这是你的订婚戒指吗？
messages.en: Is this your engagement ring?

messages.speaker: Lara (准新娘)
messages.zh: 对！我们昨天一起挑的。
messages.en: Yes! We chose it together yesterday.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用“恋爱交往—订婚戒指—约定结婚”的画面串起 għerusija 的三个相关义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To live or be alive, reside somewhere, experience something, or survive; għex is the third-person masculine singular past form.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 活着、生活、居住、经历或存活；għex 是第三人称阳性单数过去式，通常表示“他生活过、居住过、经历过或活了下来”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kien ħaj, kien joqgħod f'post, għadda minn esperjenza jew baqa' ħaj; forma tal-passat għat-tielet persuna maskil singular.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 生活；度过人生或一段生活。
经历某事；亲身体验某种处境或事件。
幸存；经历危险或困难后仍然活着。
活着；具有生命。
居住；在某处长期生活或定居。
亲身经历；实际体验某段生活、某种情境或事件。

collocations.en: he went through a difficult experience
collocations.zh: 他经历了一段艰难的遭遇

formal.mt: L-awtur għex f'Għawdex għal għaxar snin u kiteb dwar il-ħajja ta' kuljum fuq il-gżira.
formal.en: The author lived in Gozo for ten years and wrote about everyday life on the island.
formal.zh: 这位作者曾在戈佐岛居住十年，并描写了岛上的日常生活。

colloquial.mt: Maja: In-nannu tiegħek qatt għex barra minn Malta? Mark: Iva, għex Londra għal ħames snin.
colloquial.en: Maja: Did your grandfather ever live outside Malta? Mark: Yes, he lived in London for five years.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你爷爷曾在马耳他以外的地方住过吗？马克：住过，他在伦敦生活了五年。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: In-nannu tiegħek qatt għex barra minn Malta?
messages.mt_standard: In-nannu tiegħek qatt għex barra minn Malta?
messages.zh: 你爷爷曾在马耳他以外的地方住过吗？
messages.en: Did your grandfather ever live outside Malta?

messages.speaker: Mark (孙子)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għex Londra għal ħames snin.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għex Londra għal ħames snin.
messages.zh: 住过，他在伦敦生活了五年。
messages.en: Yes, he lived in London for five years.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għex 放进“他曾住过、他曾经历、他活了下来”三句话中，连同过去式一起记。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Easter, the Christian feast celebrating the resurrection of Christ; written Għid as a proper name.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 复活节，基督教纪念基督复活的节日；作为节日专名时写作 Għid。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-festa Nisranija li tiċċelebra l-qawmien ta' Kristu mill-mewt; bħala isem proprju tinkiteb Għid.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 复活节；基督教节日的专名。

sense_translations.en_definition: Easter (feast celebrating the resurrection of Christ)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 复活节，即庆祝基督复活的节日。
节日；节庆；庆典。
假日；节日。
庆祝；庆祝活动。

formal.mt: Il-programm kulturali jinkludi wirja dwar it-tradizzjonijiet tal-Għid f'Malta.
formal.en: The cultural programme includes an exhibition about Easter traditions in Malta.
formal.zh: 文化活动安排中包括一场介绍马耳他复活节传统的展览。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tagħmlu għal Ħadd il-Għid? Mark: Se nieklu mal-familja. L-Għid it-Tajjeb!
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to do on Easter Sunday? Mark: We're going to eat with the family. Happy Easter!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：复活节星期日你们打算做什么？马克：我们会和家人一起吃饭。复活节快乐！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 复活节星期日你们打算做什么？
messages.en: What are you going to do on Easter Sunday?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们会和家人一起吃饭。复活节快乐！
messages.en: We're going to eat with the family. Happy Easter!

cognitive_memory_aid: 先记祝福语 L-Għid it-Tajjeb“复活节快乐”，并用大写 Għid 提醒自己这是节日专名。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Envy of another person's advantages, or jealousy over someone's attention or affection.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 因别人拥有优势、成就或物品而产生的嫉妒，也可指因担心失去他人的关注或感情而产生的妒忌。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Sentiment ta' dispjaċir minħabba dak li għandu ħaddieħor, jew biża' li titlef l-attenzjoni jew l-imħabba ta' xi ħadd.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 羡妒；因别人拥有自己想要的东西、优势或成就而心生不快。
嫉妒；尤其指因担心他人夺走关注、感情或关系而产生的妒忌。
妒忌；嫉妒，涵盖对他人所有的羡妒及感情关系中的嫉妒。

formal.mt: Ir-rumanz juri kif l-għira tista' tagħmel ħsara lill-ħbiberija.
formal.en: The novel shows how envy can damage friendship.
formal.zh: 这部小说展现了嫉妒如何损害友谊。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ħassejt ftit għira meta Lara rebħet il-premju. Mark: Nifhem. Tista' tkun kuntenta għaliha u xorta tħoss hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: I felt a little envious when Lara won the prize. Mark: I understand. You can be happy for her and still feel that way.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：拉拉获奖时，我有点嫉妒。马克：我理解。你可以为她高兴，同时也有这种感觉。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.mt_spoken: Ħassejt ftit għira meta Lara rebħet il-premju.
messages.mt_standard: Ħassejt ftit għira meta Lara rebħet il-premju.
messages.zh: 拉拉获奖时，我有点嫉妒。
messages.en: I felt a little envious when Lara won the prize.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nifhem. Tista' tkun kuntenta għaliha u xorta tħoss hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Nifhem. Tista' tkun kuntenta għaliha u xorta tħoss hekk.
messages.zh: 我理解。你可以为她高兴，同时也有这种感觉。
messages.en: I understand. You can be happy for her and still feel that way.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两幅画面记 għira：看到别人获奖而眼红，以及担心亲近的人把关注给别人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tool, utensil, or instrument used to carry out a practical task.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用于完成某项实际工作的工具、用具或器具。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Oġġett jew strument li jintuża biex isir xogħol jew kompitu prattiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 工具；用于制作、修理或完成工作的器物。
用具；供日常操作使用的器具。
工具；器具；为完成特定操作而使用的器物。

formal.mt: Qabel jibda x-xogħol, kull ħaddiem għandu jiċċekkja li l-għodda tkun f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: Before starting work, every worker should check that the tools are in good condition.
formal.zh: 开始工作前，每位工人都应检查工具是否完好。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn qiegħda l-għodda tal-ġnien? Mark: Fil-garaxx, ħdejn il-bieb.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where are the garden tools? Mark: In the garage, next to the door.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：园艺工具在哪里？马克：在车库里，门旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (家人)
messages.zh: 园艺工具在哪里？
messages.en: Where are the garden tools?

messages.speaker: Mark (家人)
messages.zh: 在车库里，门旁边。
messages.en: In the garage, next to the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一个工具箱，里面装着修理、园艺和厨房用具，把 għodda 与“做事所用的器具”相连。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To dive below the surface of water, or become deeply immersed in an activity or subject.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 潜入水面以下；也可比喻投入某项活动或沉浸于某个主题。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Daħal taħt wiċċ l-ilma, jew intefa' b'attenzjoni kbira f'attività jew suġġett.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 潜水；潜入水中或向水下游去。
沉浸于某事；全神贯注地投入某项活动或某个主题。

formal.mt: Ir-riċerkatur għodos fil-baħar biex josserva l-ħajja taħt l-ilma.
formal.en: The researcher dived into the sea to observe underwater life.
formal.zh: 研究人员潜入海中，观察水下生物。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn mar Mark? Lara: Għodos biex jara l-ħut; dalwaqt jerġa' jitla'.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where did Mark go? Lara: He dived down to look at the fish; he'll come back up soon.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：马克去哪儿了？拉拉：他潜下去看鱼了，很快就会上来。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 马克去哪儿了？
messages.en: Where did Mark go?

messages.speaker: Lara (游泳同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Għodos biex jara l-ħut; dalwaqt jerġa' jitla'.
messages.mt_standard: Għodos biex jara l-ħut; dalwaqt jerġa' jitla'.
messages.zh: 他潜下去看鱼了，很快就会上来。
messages.en: He dived down to look at the fish; he'll come back up soon.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象整个人潜到水下，再想象注意力完全投入学习，用“潜入—沉浸”连接两个义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The early part of the day, from dawn until noon.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天中从天亮到中午之前的时段，即早晨或上午。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-jum minn meta jisbaħ sa nofsinhar.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 早晨；上午。

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti qattgħu għodwa sħiħa jiddiskutu l-proposti.
formal.en: The participants spent an entire morning discussing the proposals.
formal.zh: 与会者花了整整一个上午讨论这些提案。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għodwa t-tajba, Pawlu! Kif int? Pawlu: Għodwa t-tajba! Tajjeb, grazzi. Trid kafè?
colloquial.en: Maja: Good morning, Pawlu! How are you? Pawlu: Good morning! Fine, thanks. Would you like a coffee?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：早上好，保罗！你好吗？保罗：早上好！很好，谢谢。要喝杯咖啡吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (同事)
messages.zh: 早上好，保罗！你好吗？
messages.en: Good morning, Pawlu! How are you?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għodwa t-tajba! Tajjeb, grazzi. Trid kafè?
messages.mt_standard: Għodwa t-tajba! Tajjeb, grazzi. Trid kafè?
messages.zh: 早上好！很好，谢谢。要喝杯咖啡吗？
messages.en: Good morning! Fine, thanks. Would you like a coffee?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把清晨见面递咖啡的画面与 Għodwa t-tajba 一起记，għodwa 就是问候中的“早晨”。

gloss_zh: 升高；上涨；地位提高；变贵

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move or become higher, increase in amount or price, or gain power or prestige.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置升高，数量或价格上涨，或权势、声望有所提高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tela' aktar 'il fuq, żdied fl-ammont jew fil-prezz, jew kiseb aktar setgħa jew prestiġju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 上升；向更高处移动。
被抬高；被提高。
变得有权势；势力增强。
声望提高；地位上升。
变贵；价格升高。

sense_translations.en_definition: to ascend; to rise; to soar; to climb up (move to a higher position)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 升起；升高；高飞；攀升到更高的位置。
上升；增加，指水平、数值或数量变高。

sense_translations.en_definition: to rise in price; to become expensive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 涨价；变得更贵。

formal.mt: Il-livell tal-ilma għola wara x-xita qawwija.
formal.en: The water level rose after the heavy rain.
formal.zh: 大雨过后，水位升高了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Għola l-prezz tal-ħobż? Toni: Iva, issa nħallsu aktar għall-istess ħobża.
colloquial.en: Sara: Has the price of bread gone up? Toni: Yes, now we pay more for the same loaf.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：面包涨价了吗？托尼：是啊，现在同样一条面包要多付钱了。

messages.speaker: Sara (家人)
messages.zh: 面包涨价了吗？
messages.en: Has the price of bread gone up?

messages.speaker: Toni (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, issa nħallsu aktar għall-istess ħobża.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, issa nħallsu aktar għall-istess ħobża.
messages.zh: 是啊，现在同样一条面包要多付钱了。
messages.en: Yes, now we pay more for the same loaf.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象水位和价格旁的向上箭头：għola 表示“升高了”，也可把这幅图迁移到声望提高。

gloss_zh: 高的；高大的；响亮的；大声地

teaching_sense.en_definition: High in position or tall in height; also loud when describing a voice or sound.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 位置高或高度大的；描述声音时表示响亮的，在相关表达中可译作“大声地”。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jinsab f'pożizzjoni għolja jew għandu tul kbir; dwar leħen jew ħoss, li jinstema' b'qawwa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 出声地；大声地，常通过描述声音的表达体现。
高的；处于较高位置或水平的。
响亮的；声音大的。
高的；高大的，指人或物的高度。
位置高的；个子高的；高度大的。

formal.mt: L-istudent qara t-test b'leħen għoli sabiex il-klassi kollha setgħet tisimgħu.
formal.en: The student read the text aloud so that the whole class could hear him.
formal.zh: 这名学生大声朗读课文，让全班都能听见。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Fejn joqgħod ħuk? David: F'dak il-bini għoli ħdejn il-baħar.
colloquial.en: Nina: Where does your brother live? David: In that tall building by the sea.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：你哥哥住在哪里？戴维：住在海边那栋高楼里。

messages.speaker: Nina (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥住在哪里？
messages.en: Where does your brother live?

messages.speaker: David (朋友)
messages.zh: 住在海边那栋高楼里。
messages.en: In that tall building by the sea.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 għoli 配上两幅图：高楼表示高度大，大声朗读表示音量大；搭配名词就能分清。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hill, slope, or raised area of ground above the surrounding land.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 高于周围地面的自然隆起，可指小山、山坡或地势升起的部分。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Parti mill-art li titla' 'l fuq mill-art ta' madwarha; tista' tkun għolja żgħira jew art imżerżqa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小山；山丘。
山坡；斜坡。
地面的隆起；地势升高的部分。

collocations.en: at the foot of the hill

formal.mt: Il-kappella tinsab fuq għolja żgħira li tagħti għal fuq il-wied.
formal.en: The chapel stands on a small hill overlooking the valley.
formal.zh: 这座小教堂坐落在一座俯瞰山谷的小山上。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Nitilgħu fuq l-għolja? Luqa: Iva, minn hemm naraw ir-raħal kollu.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we go up the hill? Luqa: Yes, from there we can see the whole village.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我们上山丘去吗？卢卡：好，从那里能看见整个村子。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我们上山丘去吗？
messages.en: Shall we go up the hill?

messages.speaker: Luqa (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, minn hemm naraw ir-raħal kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, minn hemm naraw ir-raħal kollu.
messages.zh: 好，从那里能看见整个村子。
messages.en: Yes, from there we can see the whole village.

cognitive_memory_aid: 在脑中画一座能登上去看村庄的小山，把名词 għolja 与“山丘、坡地”的实物画面绑定。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move something higher or make its amount, price, or prestige higher.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 把某物抬到更高的位置，或使数额、价格、声望等提高。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għamel xi ħaġa aktar għolja fil-pożizzjoni, fl-ammont, fil-prezz jew fil-prestiġju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 举起；抬高；提高。

sense_translations.en_definition: to increase the prestige of sth.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提高某事物的声望或地位。

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise; to lift (move something to a higher position)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 抬起；举起；把某物移到更高的位置。

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise (an amount, rate, tax, etc.)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提高数额、费率、税额等。

sense_translations.en_definition: to raise the price of; to make something more expensive
sense_translations.zh_definition: 提高某物的价格；使某物变贵。

formal.mt: Is-suċċess tal-istudenti għolla l-prestiġju tal-iskola.
formal.en: The students' success raised the school's prestige.
formal.zh: 学生们取得的成功提高了学校的声望。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Min għolla din il-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa? Ben: Jien. Kienet fin-nofs u ridt nagħmel ftit spazju.
colloquial.en: Anna: Who lifted this box onto the shelf? Ben: I did. It was in the way, and I wanted to make some space.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：谁把这个箱子抬到架子上了？本：是我。它挡着路，我想腾点地方。

messages.speaker: Anna (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min għolla din il-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.mt_standard: Min għolla din il-kaxxa fuq l-ixkaffa?
messages.zh: 谁把这个箱子抬到架子上了？
messages.en: Who lifted this box onto the shelf?

messages.speaker: Ben (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Jien. Kienet fin-nofs u ridt nagħmel ftit spazju.
messages.mt_standard: Jien. Kienet fin-nofs u ridt nagħmel ftit spazju.
messages.zh: 是我。它挡着路，我想腾点地方。
messages.en: I did. It was in the way, and I wanted to make some space.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用成对句子记：għola l-prezz 是“价格涨了”，għolla l-prezz 是“他把价格提高了”。

gloss_zh: 荆棘；有刺的悬钩子类灌木

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thorny bramble plant, or bramble growth forming a tangled patch.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 带刺的悬钩子类灌木，也可指这类植物交错生长形成的荆棘丛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xitla bix-xewk u bi friegħi li jitħabblu ma' xulxin, jew grupp ta' dawn ix-xtieli.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 荆棘；带刺的悬钩子类灌木。
荆棘；带刺的悬钩子类灌木。

formal.mt: Il-ħaddiema neħħew l-għollieq li kien qed jagħlaq il-mogħdija.
formal.en: The workers removed the brambles that were blocking the path.
formal.zh: 工人们清除了堵住小路的荆棘。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Oqgħod attent għall-għollieq ħdejn il-ħajt. Samwel: Rajtu. Se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra biex ma nitniggiżx.
colloquial.en: Rita: Watch out for the brambles by the wall. Samwel: I've seen them. I'll go around the other side so I don't get pricked.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：小心墙边的荆棘。萨姆韦尔：看到了。我从另一边绕过去，免得被刺到。

messages.speaker: Rita (徒步同伴)
messages.zh: 小心墙边的荆棘。
messages.en: Watch out for the brambles by the wall.

messages.speaker: Samwel (徒步同伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Rajtu. Se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra biex ma nitniggiżx.
messages.mt_standard: Rajtu. Se ngħaddi min-naħa l-oħra biex ma nitniggiżx.
messages.zh: 看到了。我从另一边绕过去，免得被刺到。
messages.en: I've seen them. I'll go around the other side so I don't get pricked.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象小路被带刺枝条缠住，必须绕行；把 għollieq 和“荆棘挡路、碰到会扎”的画面一起记。

gloss_zh: 忧虑；不安；苦恼；悲痛；闷热

teaching_sense.en_definition: A feeling of worry, unease, trouble, or deep sorrow; also oppressive heat in the weather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 忧虑、不安、苦恼或悲痛的感受；也可指天气的闷热。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tħassib, nuqqas ta' serħan jew niket li jtaqqal il-qalb; ukoll sħana tqila fit-temp.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 忧虑；担心。
不安；心神不宁。
苦恼；烦忧；困扰。
内心的痛苦；悲痛；哀愁。
天气的炎热；闷热。

formal.mt: Il-familja esprimiet l-għomma tagħha wara t-telfa ta' qarib.
formal.en: The family expressed its grief after the loss of a relative.
formal.zh: 这家人在失去一位亲人后表达了内心的悲痛。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xi għomma hawn ġew! Niftħu t-tieqa? Mark: Iva, forsi tidħol ftit arja.
colloquial.en: Lara: It's so hot and stuffy in here! Shall we open the window? Mark: Yes, perhaps we can get some air in.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：这里真闷热！我们开窗好吗？马克：好，也许能进来一点空气。

messages.speaker: Lara (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Xi għomma hawn ġew! Niftħu t-tieqa?
messages.mt_standard: Xi għomma hawn ġew! Niftħu t-tieqa?
messages.zh: 这里真闷热！我们开窗好吗？
messages.en: It's so hot and stuffy in here! Shall we open the window?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，也许能进来一点空气。
messages.en: Yes, perhaps we can get some air in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用中文的“闷”作学习联想：心里闷对应忧愁，屋里闷对应闷热；这是记忆提示，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 年龄；一生；寿命；很长时间；慰唁用语

teaching_sense.en_definition: The time a person has lived, or the whole duration of a person's life.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一个人已经活过的时间，即年龄；也指整个人生或寿命。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Iż-żmien li persuna tkun għexet, jew il-medda kollha tal-ħajja tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 年龄；已经活过的岁数。
一生；一个人从出生到死亡的整段时间。

sense_translations.en_definition: an expression of condolence used with sb. who is in mourning
sense_translations.zh_definition: 向正在服丧或遭遇丧亲之痛的人表示慰问时使用的慰唁用语。

sense_translations.en_definition: lifespan, lifetime (the entire time of a person’s life; with regard to living persons also: that which has passed of it or that which remains)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 寿命；一生的全部时间；用于在世者时，也可指已经度过或尚余的人生时间。

sense_translations.en_definition: age (quality of having lived for a particular time)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 年龄；活到某一岁数的状态。
很长的一段时间；漫长的时日。

collocations.zh: 在他的一生中；终其一生

formal.mt: Nawguraw lill-awtur għomor twil u saħħa tajba.
formal.en: We wish the author a long life and good health.
formal.zh: 我们祝愿这位作者长寿安康。

colloquial.mt: Marija: Illum għeluq snin in-nanna. Pawlu: Awguralha għomor twil u saħħa tajba!
colloquial.en: Marija: Today is Grandma's birthday. Pawlu: Wish her a long life and good health!
colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：今天是奶奶的生日。保罗：祝她长寿安康！

messages.speaker: Marija (孙女)
messages.zh: 今天是奶奶的生日。
messages.en: Today is Grandma's birthday.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Awguralha għomor twil u saħħa tajba!
messages.mt_standard: Awguralha għomor twil u saħħa tajba!
messages.zh: 祝她长寿安康！
messages.en: Wish her a long life and good health!

gloss_zh: 马耳他传统女式兜帽披巾；女式外罩衣

teaching_sense.en_definition: A traditional head covering worn by Maltese women, typically a long shawl with a stiff edge forming a wide hood.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 马耳他女性传统的头部覆盖物，典型形式为带硬边的长披巾，能在头部形成宽大的兜帽。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għata tradizzjonali tar-ras tan-nisa Maltin, tipikament xalla twila b'xifer iebes li jifforma barnuża wiesgħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 法尔代塔式兜帽披巾；乡村式头部服饰。

sense_translations.en_definition: kind of head covering worn by Maltese women (generally until the 19th c. and occasionally still in the earlier 20th c.), most typically in the form of a long shawl with a stiff hem, creating a wide hood over the wearer’s head
sense_translations.zh_definition: 马耳他女性佩戴的一种头部覆盖物，通常沿用至十九世纪，二十世纪早期偶尔仍可见；最典型的形式是带硬边的长披巾，在佩戴者头部形成宽大的兜帽。
泛指女性穿在其他衣物外面的罩衣或外衣。

collocations.en: an għonnella with a stiff edge
collocations.zh: 带硬边的传统兜帽披巾

formal.mt: Il-wirja tinkludi għonnella, għata tar-ras li kienet tintlibes minn nisa Maltin.
formal.en: The exhibition includes an għonnella, a head covering formerly worn by Maltese women.
formal.zh: 展览中有一件 għonnella，即马耳他女性过去穿戴的头部服饰。

colloquial.mt: Lara: X'inhi dik li qed tilbes il-mara fl-istampa? Mark: Dik għonnella, għata tradizzjonali tar-ras.
colloquial.en: Lara: What is that thing the woman in the picture is wearing? Mark: That is an għonnella, a traditional head covering.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：画里的女人戴着的是什么？马克：那是 għonnella，一种传统的头部服饰。

gloss_zh: 颈；脖子；衣领；容器的颈部

teaching_sense.en_definition: The part of the body connecting the head to the torso; also a collar or the narrow neck of a container.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 连接头部与躯干的脖子；也可指衣领或容器上狭窄的颈部。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti tal-ġisem li tgħaqqad ir-ras mal-bqija tal-ġisem; ukoll il-parti ta' libsa madwar l-għonq jew il-parti dejqa ta' reċipjent.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 颈；连接头部和躯干的脖子。
衣领；衣服围绕颈部的部分。
容器的颈部；瓶、壶等器皿上较狭窄的部分。

formal.zh: 瓶颈较窄，因此应缓慢倒出液体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crow or raven; in a separate animal sense, the fish called the brown meagre.

gloss_zh: 楼上的房间；小屋；小住宅

teaching_sense.en_definition: An upper room in a house, especially a village house; also a cottage or small house.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 房屋楼上的房间，尤其指村落住宅中的楼上房间；也可指小屋或小住宅。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kamra ta' fuq f'dar, speċjalment f'dar ta' raħal; ukoll dar żgħira.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 楼上的房间；位于上层的房间。
小屋；小住宅。

formal.mt: L-għorfa ta' fuq se tintuża bħala kamra tal-qari.

formal.zh: 楼上的房间将用作阅览室。

colloquial.zh: 玛丽娅：你把毯子放在哪里了？妮娜：在楼上的房间里，床旁边。

gloss_zh: 揉；搓；擦洗；按摩；擦亮；彻底清洁；殴打

teaching_sense.en_definition: To move a hand or an object repeatedly over a surface, especially to rub or clean it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 用手或物体在某个表面上反复摩擦，尤指揉搓或擦洗。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tgħaddi id jew oġġett ripetutament fuq wiċċ biex togħorku jew tnaddfu.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 揉；搓；在表面上反复摩擦。
用力擦洗；刷洗。
按摩；通过揉按身体部位使其放松。
擦亮；通过摩擦使表面光亮。

gloss_zh: 愉悦；幸福；婚礼；乐事；盛宴

teaching_sense.en_definition: Pleasure, happiness, or great enjoyment; also a wedding.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 愉悦、幸福或很大的乐趣；也可指婚礼。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjaċir, ferħ jew gost kbir; ukoll tieġ.

婚礼；结婚庆典。

sense_translations.en_definition: delight; great fun; a feast (for someone)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦；极大的乐趣；对某人而言十分令人享受的乐事或盛宴。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To disappear from sight or to fly away.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Jisparixxi minn quddiem l-għajnejn jew itir 'il bogħod.

gloss_zh: 变得跛足；（太阳、月亮等）落下

teaching_sense.en_definition: To become physically disabled or crippled; also, for the sun, moon, or another celestial body to set.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 变得跛足或肢体残障；也指太阳、月亮等天体落下。

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 走路时绊了一下或失去脚下的支撑，也可指双腿突然支撑不住。

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Membru tal-Ġakbini; ukoll, b'sens dispreġġjattiv, persuna qarrieqa jew bla skrupli.

formal.zh: 作者将这个人物描述为一名雅各宾派成员。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Tafdah lil dak il-ġakbin? Mark: Le, diġà qarraq bija darba.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you trust that scoundrel? Mark: No, he has already deceived me once.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你信得过那个骗子吗？马克：不，他已经骗过我一次了。

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡分开记：书面人物介绍对应“雅各宾派成员”，带指责语气的对话对应“骗子、无赖”；不要把两种语境混为一谈。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Glowing pieces of coal or other fuel that remain hot and burning, especially after the flames have died down.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 仍然灼热、发红或燃烧的炭块等燃料，尤其指明火消退后留下的余烬。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċiet ta' faħam jew fjuwil ieħor li jibqgħu jaħarqu, speċjalment wara li jonqsu l-fjammi.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 余烬；火焰消退后仍然灼热的燃料残块。
仍在燃烧或发红的炭块。
余烬；尚未熄灭的灼热炭块。

formal.mt: Wara li għebu l-fjammi, il-ġamar baqa' jaħraq għal xi żmien.
formal.en: After the flames disappeared, the embers remained hot for some time.
formal.zh: 火焰消失后，余烬仍灼热了一段时间。

colloquial.en: Liza: Can I touch this charcoal? Pawlu: No, there are still embers, and they are hot.
colloquial.zh: 莉莎：我能碰这些木炭吗？保罗：不能，还有余烬，烫着呢。

messages.speaker: Liza (女儿)
messages.zh: 我能碰这些木炭吗？
messages.en: Can I touch this charcoal?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (父亲)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, għad hemm il-ġamar u jaħraq.
messages.mt_standard: Le, għad hemm il-ġamar u jaħraq.

messages.en: No, there are still embers, and they are hot.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġamar配上一幅“火焰退去，炭块仍红”的画面：重点是余热与未熄灭的炭，不是已经冷却的灰。

gloss_zh: 粗暴对待；未成熟的果实；橡子

teaching_sense.en_definition: To treat a person, animal, or thing violently or harshly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以暴力或粗暴、严酷的方式对待某人、动物或某物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ittratta lil xi ħadd jew lil xi ħaġa b'mod vjolenti jew aħrax.

sense_translations.en_definition: to treat sb. or sth. violently or harshly
sense_translations.zh_definition: 以暴力或粗暴、严酷的方式对待某人或某物。
未成熟的果实；生果。
橡子；橡树的果实。

formal.mt: Ix-xhud qal li r-raġel ġandar lill-priġunier.
formal.en: The witness said that the man had treated the prisoner harshly.
formal.zh: 证人说，那名男子曾粗暴对待囚犯。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ġandar lill-kelb? Mark: Ma nafx; ħadd m'għandu jittratta annimal hekk.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why did he treat the dog violently? Mark: I don't know; nobody should treat an animal like that.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：他为什么那么粗暴地对待那只狗？马克：我不知道，谁都不应该那样对待动物。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 他为什么那么粗暴地对待那只狗？
messages.en: Why did he treat the dog violently?

messages.speaker: Mark (邻居)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma nafx; ħadd m'għandu jittratta annimal hekk.
messages.mt_standard: Ma nafx; ħadd m'għandu jittratta annimal hekk.
messages.zh: 我不知道，谁都不应该那样对待动物。
messages.en: I don't know; nobody should treat an animal like that.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为ġandar分设“动作”和“果实”两格：动作格记粗暴对待，名词格分别记生果与橡子；先判断词性，再选择意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Japan, a country in East Asia.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 日本，位于东亚的国家名称。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-Ġappun huwa pajjiż fl-Asja tal-Lvant.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日本。
日本，东亚的一个国家。

formal.mt: L-istudenta kitbet rapport dwar iż-żjara tagħha fil-Ġappun.

formal.zh: 这名女学生写了一份关于自己赴日访问的报告。

colloquial.en: Sara: Are you going to visit Japan this year? Daniel: Yes, I'm going to spend two weeks there.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今年要去日本吗？丹尼尔：是的，我会在那里待两周。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今年要去日本吗？

messages.speaker: Daniel (朋友)

messages.en: Yes, I'm going to spend two weeks there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Ġappun写在旅行地图的“日本”位置，再连读il-Ġappun与fil-Ġappun，分别记住国家名称和“在日本”的常用表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Of, from, or relating to Japan.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 日本的、来自日本的，或与日本有关的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li ġej mill-Ġappun jew li għandu x'jaqsam mal-Ġappun.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 日本的；日本人的。

sense_translations.en_definition: hailing from or related to Japan
sense_translations.zh_definition: 来自日本的；与日本有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Japanese (of, from or relating to Japan)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 日本的、来自日本的，或与日本有关的。

sense_translations.en_definition: Japanese (native or inhabitant of Japan) (usually male)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 日本人；日本本地人或居民，通常指男性。
日语；日本语。

formal.mt: Il-klabb organizza diskussjoni dwar film Ġappuniż.

formal.zh: 俱乐部组织了一场关于某部日本电影的讨论。

colloquial.en: Liza: Do you want to watch a Japanese film tonight? Pawlu: Yes, and we can try to understand a few words in Japanese.

messages.mt_standard: Iva, u nistgħu nippruvaw nifhmu xi kliem bil-Ġappuniż.

teaching_sense.en_definition: A person who lives next door or nearby.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Persuna li toqgħod ħdejk jew qrib darek.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 邻居；住在隔壁或附近的人。
邻居；住在隔壁或附近的人。

formal.en: The neighbour informed the residents about the meeting.
formal.zh: 这位邻居通知了住户们开会的事。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak ir-raġel? Mark: Dak il-ġar il-ġdid tagħna; joqgħod ħdejna.

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)

teaching_sense.en_definition: To happen, occur, or be the case.

teaching_sense.mt_definition: Seħħ jew kien il-każ; jintuża biex wieħed jistaqsi jew jgħid x'seħħ.

发生；出现。
发生；某件事情实际出现或进行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To experience or undergo something, especially hardship or suffering.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 亲身经历或经受某事，尤其指困难或痛苦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadda minn esperjenza, speċjalment minn tbatija jew diffikultajiet.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 经历；亲身体验。
经受；承受或经历某种过程。
疥疮，一种皮肤病。

formal.mt: L-awtur jiddeskrivi kif il-personaġġ ġarab ħafna tbatija matul ħajtu.
formal.en: The author describes how the character experienced much suffering throughout his life.
formal.zh: 作者描述了这个人物一生中如何经历了许多痛苦。

messages.mt_spoken: Għax hu wkoll ġarab ħafna tbatija.

messages.zh: 因为他自己也经历过许多痛苦。
messages.en: Because he too has experienced much suffering.

teaching_sense.en_definition: To carry or transport someone or something from one place to another.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 搬、提或携带某物。

搬家；迁居。
搬运、携带的行为。
运输；将人或物运送到另一地点。
搬；携带；运送。

gloss_zh: 尝试；试验；经历；试穿；试验者

teaching_sense.zh_definition: 尝试或测试某物，也可指亲身经历某种处境或困难。

尝试；试用；测试。

sense_translations.zh_definition: 尝试；使经受考验、诱惑或磨难。
