teaching_sense.zh_definition: 皮革，即经过处理、可用于制作鞋、包等物品的动物皮。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġilda tal-annimali maħduma biex tintuża għall-manifattura ta' żraben, basktijiet u oġġetti oħra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮革；经过处理、用于制作物品的动物皮。
皮肤；覆盖身体表面的组织。
兽皮；动物的皮。
父母年迈时生下的孩子；年迈父母所生的子女。

formal.mt: Il-ħanut ibigħ żraben tal-ġild magħmula bl-idejn.
formal.en: The shop sells handmade leather shoes.
formal.zh: 这家商店出售手工制作的皮鞋。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dawn iż-żraben tal-ġild? Mark: Iva, u komdi ħafna. Maja: Nista' nipprovahom?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are these shoes made of leather? Mark: Yes, and they're very comfortable. Maja: Can I try them on?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这双鞋是皮的吗？马克：是的，而且很舒服。玛雅：我可以试穿吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这双鞋是皮的吗？
messages.en: Are these shoes made of leather?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.zh: 是的，而且很舒服。
messages.en: Yes, and they're very comfortable.

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 我可以试穿吗？
messages.en: Can I try them on?

cognitive_memory_aid: 摸一摸皮鞋并念 żraben tal-ġild，把 ġild 与皮革触感联系起来；“年迈父母所生的孩子”单独记卡，不从皮革义硬推。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The outer covering of a person's or animal's body; also animal skin used as leather.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 覆盖人或动物身体表面的皮肤；也指用于制作皮革的动物皮或皮革材料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-saff ta' barra li jgħatti l-ġisem tal-bniedem jew tal-annimal; ukoll il-materjal maħdum minn ġilda tal-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮革；由动物皮加工而成的材料。
皮肤；人或动物身体表面的覆盖层。
兽皮；动物的皮。

formal.mt: Dan il-ktejjeb jiddeskrivi l-ġilda bħala saff li jgħin biex jipproteġi l-ġisem.
formal.en: This booklet describes the skin as a layer that helps protect the body.
formal.zh: 这本小册子将皮肤描述为帮助保护身体的一层组织。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi l-ġilda xotta llum. Mark: Għandek xi krema? Maja: Iva, għandi waħda fil-borża.
colloquial.en: Maja: My skin is dry today. Mark: Do you have any cream? Maja: Yes, I have some in my bag.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我今天皮肤很干。马克：你有润肤霜吗？玛雅：有，我包里有。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我今天皮肤很干。
messages.en: My skin is dry today.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 你有润肤霜吗？
messages.en: Do you have any cream?

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 有，我包里有。
messages.en: Yes, I have some in my bag.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġilda 放在两幅图旁：一幅是手上的皮肤，一幅是皮包；分别连读 ġilda xotta 和 borża tal-ġilda，靠搭配区分词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A period of seven days; with a capital initial, also the name Friday.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 七天构成的时间单位，即一周；首字母大写时也表示星期五。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' sebat ijiem; bil-kapitali, Ġimgħa huwa wkoll l-isem tal-jum bejn il-Ħamis u s-Sibt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一周；一个星期。

sense_translations.en_definition: week (unit of time lasting seven days)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 周、星期；由七天构成的时间单位。
星期五；周四之后、周六之前的一天，通常写作 Ġimgħa。

formal.mt: Il-kors idum ġimgħa sħiħa, mit-Tnejn sal-Ħadd, u l-eżami jsir nhar il-Ġimgħa.
formal.en: The course lasts a whole week, from Monday to Sunday, and the exam takes place on Friday.
formal.zh: 课程从周一持续到周日，共整整一周，考试安排在星期五。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tmur Għawdex? Mark: Nhar il-Ġimgħa. Se nibqa' hemm ġimgħa. Maja: Mela għandek sebat ijiem biex tistrieħ!
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you going to Gozo? Mark: On Friday. I'll stay there for a week. Maja: Then you have seven days to relax!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你什么时候去戈佐岛？马克：星期五。我会在那里待一周。玛雅：那你就有七天可以休息了！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你什么时候去戈佐岛？
messages.en: When are you going to Gozo?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Nhar il-Ġimgħa. Se nibqa' hemm ġimgħa.
messages.mt_standard: Nhar il-Ġimgħa. Se nibqa' hemm ġimgħa.
messages.zh: 星期五。我会在那里待一周。
messages.en: On Friday. I'll stay there for a week.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Mela għandek sebat ijiem biex tistrieħ!
messages.mt_standard: Mela għandek sebat ijiem biex tistrieħ!
messages.zh: 那你就有七天可以休息了！
messages.en: Then you have seven days to relax!

cognitive_memory_aid: 画七个日历格，把整排标为 ġimgħa“一周”，再把周五那格标为 Ġimgħa；配合 nhar il-Ġimgħa 记住单独一天的用法。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A tall plant with a large yellow flower head, grown for its seeds and oil.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一种植株较高、花盘大且外围花朵呈黄色的植物，其种子可食用或榨油；向日葵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta għolja b'ras kbira ta' fjura safra, imkabbra għaż-żrieragħ tagħha u għaż-żejt.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 向日葵；具有大型黄色花盘、种子可食用或榨油的植物。

formal.mt: Il-ġirasol jitkabbar għaż-żrieragħ tiegħu, li jistgħu jintużaw biex isir iż-żejt.
formal.en: The sunflower is grown for its seeds, which can be used to produce oil.
formal.zh: 人们种植向日葵以获取种子，这些种子可以用来榨油。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tħawwel fil-ġnien? Mark: Ġirasol ħdejn iċ-ċint. Maja: Meta jikber, irrid nieħu ritratt tal-fjura!
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to plant in the garden? Mark: A sunflower next to the fence. Maja: When it grows, I want to take a picture of the flower!
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算在花园里种什么？马克：在篱笆旁种一棵向日葵。玛雅：等它长大，我想给花拍张照！

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你打算在花园里种什么？
messages.en: What are you going to plant in the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (园艺爱好者)
messages.zh: 在篱笆旁种一棵向日葵。
messages.en: A sunflower next to the fence.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Meta jikber, irrid nieħu ritratt tal-fjura!
messages.mt_standard: Meta jikber, irrid nieħu ritratt tal-fjura!
messages.zh: 等它长大，我想给花拍张照！
messages.en: When it grows, I want to take a picture of the flower!

cognitive_memory_aid: 在学习卡上画一朵黄色向日葵，旁边放葵花籽和一瓶油；用 ġirasol、żrieragħ tal-ġirasol、żejt tal-ġirasol 串起三幅画面。

gloss_zh: 跑步；一次奔跑；一次乘行

teaching_sense.en_definition: An act or period of running; also an outing or ride.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 跑步或一段奔跑的活动；也可指一次出行或乘行。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att li tiġri jew ħin li tqatta' tiġri; ukoll ħarġa jew dawra b'vettura.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 跑步；奔跑这一活动。
一次跑步；一段奔跑。
一次乘行；一次骑行或乘车出游。

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' taħriġ jinkludi ġirja ta' għoxrin minuta kuljum.
formal.en: The training programme includes a twenty-minute run every day.
formal.zh: 训练计划包括每天跑步二十分钟。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid tiġi għal ġirja fil-park? Pawlu: Iva, imma ejja niġru bil-mod illum.
colloquial.en: Maja: Do you want to come for a run in the park? Pawlu: Yes, but let's run slowly today.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你想一起去公园跑步吗？保罗：想，不过今天我们慢慢跑吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你想一起去公园跑步吗？
messages.en: Do you want to come for a run in the park?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ejja niġru bil-mod illum.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ejja niġru bil-mod illum.
messages.zh: 想，不过今天我们慢慢跑吧。
messages.en: Yes, but let's run slowly today.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个词和晨跑画面绑定，再联想骑车兜一圈：既能记住奔跑，也能记住一次乘行。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The physical body of a person or animal.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 人或动物的身体，即其有形的躯体。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-parti fiżika ta' persuna jew annimal, magħmula mir-ras, iz-zokk u l-membri.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 身体；人或动物的躯体。

formal.mt: Matul il-lezzjoni, l-istudenti tgħallmu l-ismijiet tal-partijiet ewlenin tal-ġisem.
formal.en: During the lesson, the students learned the names of the main parts of the body.
formal.zh: 课堂上，学生们学习了身体主要部位的名称。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Wara dik il-mixja, qed inħoss il-ġisem kollu għajjien. Mark: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
colloquial.en: Lara: After that walk, my whole body feels tired. Mark: Let's sit down and rest for a while.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：走完那一段路，我觉得全身都累了。马克：我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Wara dik il-mixja, qed inħoss il-ġisem kollu għajjien.
messages.mt_standard: Wara dik il-mixja, qed inħoss il-ġisem kollu għajjien.
messages.zh: 走完那一段路，我觉得全身都累了。
messages.en: After that walk, my whole body feels tired.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja noqogħdu bilqiegħda u nistrieħu ftit.
messages.zh: 我们坐下来休息一会儿吧。
messages.en: Let's sit down and rest for a while.

cognitive_memory_aid: 一边念词一边从头指到脚，把全身轮廓作为记忆图像，牢牢记住它表示身体。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jasmine plant, or its fragrant flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 茉莉植物，或其带有香气的花朵。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel fjuri jfuħu, jew il-fjuri tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 茉莉；茉莉花。
茉莉植物或其花朵。

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien tal-iskola hemm pjanta tal-ġiżimin ħdejn id-daħla.
formal.en: There is a jasmine plant near the entrance in the school garden.
formal.zh: 学校花园入口附近有一株茉莉。

colloquial.mt: Sara: X'riħa sabiħa! Minn fejn ġejja? Ninu: Mill-ġiżimin ħdejn it-tieqa.
colloquial.en: Sara: What a lovely scent! Where is it coming from? Ninu: From the jasmine by the window.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：好香啊！香味是从哪里来的？尼努：是窗边的茉莉散发出来的。

messages.speaker: Sara (访客)
messages.zh: 好香啊！香味是从哪里来的？
messages.en: What a lovely scent! Where is it coming from?

messages.speaker: Ninu (主人)
messages.zh: 是窗边的茉莉散发出来的。
messages.en: From the jasmine by the window.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象窗边一盆茉莉，读词时同时回想白色花朵和清香，用视觉与嗅觉共同记忆。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A piece of jewellery worn around the neck.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 戴在颈部的一种首饰，即项链。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa ġojjellerija li tintlibes madwar l-għonq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 项链；佩戴在颈部的首饰。

formal.mt: Il-katalgu jiddeskrivi ġiżirana tal-fidda b'pendent żgħir.
formal.en: The catalogue describes a silver necklace with a small pendant.
formal.zh: 目录中介绍了一条带有小吊坠的银项链。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Din il-ġiżirana tmur mal-libsa tiegħi? Rita: Iva, il-kulur tagħha jaqbel ħafna magħha.
colloquial.en: Anna: Does this necklace go with my dress? Rita: Yes, its colour matches it very well.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：这条项链配我的连衣裙吗？丽塔：配，它的颜色和裙子很搭。

messages.speaker: Anna (顾客)
messages.zh: 这条项链配我的连衣裙吗？
messages.en: Does this necklace go with my dress?

messages.speaker: Rita (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, il-kulur tagħha jaqbel ħafna magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, il-kulur tagħha jaqbel ħafna magħha.
messages.zh: 配，它的颜色和裙子很搭。
messages.en: Yes, its colour matches it very well.

cognitive_memory_aid: 读词时用手在颈前画一个圆，再想象圆上挂着小吊坠，把词与项链的位置连起来。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A hyacinth, a flowering plant with clusters of fragrant flowers.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 风信子，一种开成簇芳香花朵的植物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta li tagħmel gruppi ta' fjuri jfuħu fuq zokk.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 风信子。
东方风信子（Hyacinthus orientalis）。

formal.mt: L-istudenti pinġew ġjaċint u kitbu deskrizzjoni tal-fjuri tiegħu.
formal.en: The students drew a hyacinth and wrote a description of its flowers.
formal.zh: 学生们画了一株风信子，并写下了对其花朵的描述。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'jisimha din il-fjura? Toni: Dan hu ġjaċint. Għandu riħa sabiħa ħafna.
colloquial.en: Maja: What is this flower called? Toni: This is a hyacinth. It has a lovely scent.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这种花叫什么名字？托尼：这是风信子，闻起来很香。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这种花叫什么名字？
messages.en: What is this flower called?

messages.speaker: Toni (花店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan hu ġjaċint. Għandu riħa sabiħa ħafna.
messages.mt_standard: Dan hu ġjaċint. Għandu riħa sabiħa ħafna.
messages.zh: 这是风信子，闻起来很香。
messages.en: This is a hyacinth. It has a lovely scent.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一根花茎上密密排列的小花，像一座有香味的小花塔，用整株风信子的形状记词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Moral baseness or vileness; also a lack of courage.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 品行或行为上的卑劣、恶劣；也可指缺乏勇气的怯懦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' min hu baxx jew ħażin fl-imġiba tiegħu; ukoll nuqqas ta' kuraġġ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 道德败坏；品行卑劣。
卑劣；可鄙或恶劣的性质。
怯懦；胆怯而缺乏勇气。

collocations.en: an act of baseness or cowardice

formal.mt: L-awtur jikkundanna l-ġjufija ta' min jabbuża mill-fiduċja tal-oħrajn.
formal.en: The author condemns the baseness of those who abuse the trust of others.
formal.zh: 作者谴责那些辜负他人信任者的卑劣品行。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex ma ddefendiex lil sieħbu? Mark: Minħabba l-ġjufija tiegħu; beża' jitkellem.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why didn't he defend his friend? Mark: Because of his cowardice; he was afraid to speak.
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：他为什么没有替朋友说话？马克：因为他怯懦，害怕开口。

messages.speaker: Lara (同学)
messages.zh: 他为什么没有替朋友说话？
messages.en: Why didn't he defend his friend?

messages.speaker: Mark (同学)
messages.zh: 因为他怯懦，害怕开口。
messages.en: Because of his cowardice; he was afraid to speak.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用两张情境卡记忆：背弃信任对应卑劣，害怕挺身而出对应怯懦；读句子时判断是哪一义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Frost, or a hard surface layer of ice or snow.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 霜，或冰雪在表面形成的一层硬壳。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Saff irqiq ta' silġ fuq wiċċ kiesaħ, jew qoxra iebsa ta' silġ jew borra.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 霜；在寒冷表面形成的冰晶层。
冰或雪在表面形成的硬壳。

formal.mt: Il-ġlata ta' matul il-lejl ħalliet saff abjad fuq il-ħaxix.
formal.en: The overnight frost left a white layer on the grass.
formal.zh: 夜间的霜在草上留下了白白的一层。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Hemm ġlata fuq il-ħġieġ tal-karozza? Anna: Iva, irridu nneħħuha qabel nitilqu.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: Is there frost on the car windows? Anna: Yes, we need to remove it before we leave.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：车窗上有霜吗？安娜：有，我们得清除以后再出发。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (丈夫)
messages.zh: 车窗上有霜吗？
messages.en: Is there frost on the car windows?

messages.speaker: Anna (妻子)
messages.zh: 有，我们得清除以后再出发。
messages.en: Yes, we need to remove it before we leave.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象清晨草叶和车窗都披着白色薄层，再把画面延伸到冰雪硬壳，记住共同的表层感。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A coat or jacket worn over other clothing on the upper body.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 穿在其他衣服外面、覆盖上半身的外套或夹克。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ilbies li jintlibes fuq ħwejjeġ oħra u jgħatti l-parti ta' fuq tal-ġisem.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 外套；穿在其他衣物外面的上衣。
夹克；短外套，也可指西装上衣。

formal.mt: Għall-laqgħa uffiċjali, huwa libes ġlekk skur ma' qmis bajda.
formal.en: For the official meeting, he wore a dark jacket with a white shirt.
formal.zh: 参加正式会议时，他穿了一件深色西装上衣，搭配白衬衫。

colloquial.mt: Ben: Għandi nieħu ġlekk miegħi? Marija: Iva, għax filgħaxija jkun il-bard.
colloquial.en: Ben: Should I take a jacket with me? Marija: Yes, because it gets cold in the evening.
colloquial.zh: 本：我要带件外套吗？玛丽亚：要，因为晚上会冷。

messages.speaker: Ben (儿子)
messages.zh: 我要带件外套吗？
messages.en: Should I take a jacket with me?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 要，因为晚上会冷。
messages.en: Yes, because it gets cold in the evening.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象出门前从衣架拿起一件外套穿在衬衫外面，用拿衣和穿衣的动作记住这个词。

gloss_zh: 大群；喧闹的人群；鱼群；民兵队伍

teaching_sense.en_definition: A large crowd or gathering, especially one that is noisy or causes a commotion.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集在一起的一大群人，尤其指喧闹、引起骚动的人群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd kbir ta' nies miġburin flimkien, speċjalment meta jagħmlu ħafna storbju jew għagħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一大群人；庞大的人群。
喧闹或引起骚动的人群。
大量；一大群，尤其用于以下所列对象。
人群；聚集在一起的一群人。
鱼群；聚集在一起的一群鱼。
民兵；民兵队伍。

formal.mt: Ġliba nies inġabret quddiem il-bieb tas-sala u bdiet tagħmel ħafna storbju.
formal.en: A large crowd gathered outside the hall door and began making a lot of noise.
formal.zh: 一大群人聚集在礼堂门前，开始大声喧闹。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex hemm dik il-ġliba nies quddiem il-ħanut? Mark: Qed iqassmu rigali, u kulħadd irid jidħol.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why is there such a crowd outside the shop? Mark: They're giving out gifts, and everyone wants to get in.
colloquial.zh: Maja：商店门口怎么聚了那么一大群人？Mark：他们正在派礼物，大家都想进去。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għaliex hemm dik il-ġliba nies quddiem il-ħanut?
messages.mt_standard: Għaliex hemm dik il-ġliba nies quddiem il-ħanut?
messages.zh: 商店门口怎么聚了那么一大群人？
messages.en: Why is there such a crowd outside the shop?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Qed iqassmu rigali, u kulħadd irid jidħol.
messages.mt_standard: Qed iqassmu rigali, u kulħadd irid jidħol.
messages.zh: 他们正在派礼物，大家都想进去。
messages.en: They're giving out gifts, and everyone wants to get in.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġliba配上一幅商店门口挤满人、声音嘈杂的画面；再用ġliba ħut联想到水下密集的鱼群，分别记住人群和鱼群义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Relating to leather, or resembling leather in appearance or texture.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 与皮革有关的，或在外观、质地上像皮革的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-ġilda maħduma, jew li jixbah il-ġilda fid-dehra jew fil-mess.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 皮革的；与皮革有关的。
皮革般的；外观或质地像皮革的。

collocations.zh: 皮革类或仿皮革的材料

formal.mt: Il-kampjun għandu wiċċ ġludi li jinħass iebes meta tmissu.
formal.en: The sample has a leathery surface that feels stiff to the touch.
formal.zh: 该样品的表面呈皮革质感，摸起来较硬。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-materjal jidher ġludi. Huwa ġilda vera? Mark: Le, huwa drapp li jixbah il-ġilda.
colloquial.en: Maja: This material looks leathery. Is it real leather? Mark: No, it's fabric that looks like leather.
colloquial.zh: Maja：这材料看着像皮革。是真皮吗？Mark：不是，是一种看起来像皮革的布料。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.mt_spoken: Dan il-materjal jidher ġludi. Huwa ġilda vera?
messages.mt_standard: Dan il-materjal jidher ġludi. Huwa ġilda vera?
messages.zh: 这材料看着像皮革。是真皮吗？
messages.en: This material looks leathery. Is it real leather?

messages.speaker: Mark (店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, huwa drapp li jixbah il-ġilda.
messages.mt_standard: Le, huwa drapp li jixbah il-ġilda.
messages.zh: 不是，是一种看起来像皮革的布料。
messages.en: No, it's fabric that looks like leather.

cognitive_memory_aid: 记ġludi时想象用手摸一块有皮革质感的材料：它可以描述皮革相关属性，也可以只表示像皮革，不一定证明是真皮。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Black soot, or the dark smudges it leaves on a surface.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 燃烧产生的黑色烟炱，或附着在物体表面的黑色污痕。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Trab iswed li jitħalla mid-duħħan, jew tbajja' suwed fuq wiċċ xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 烟炱；烟尘中沉积下来的黑色细末。
黑色污痕；擦抹或沾染形成的黑印。

collocations.en: soot or black smudges on the wall
collocations.zh: 墙上的烟炱或黑色污痕

collocations.en: to remove soot or black smudges

formal.mt: Wara li ntefa n-nar, il-ħaddiema neħħew il-ġmied mill-ħitan tal-kamra.
formal.en: After the fire was extinguished, the workers removed the soot from the room's walls.
formal.zh: 火被扑灭后，工人清除了房间墙壁上的烟炱。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandek il-ġmied fuq ħaddejk. Mark: Veru? Missejt wiċċi wara li naddaft il-fuklar.
colloquial.en: Maja: You've got soot on your cheek. Mark: Really? I touched my face after cleaning the stove.
colloquial.zh: Maja：你脸颊上沾了烟灰。Mark：真的吗？我清理完炉子后摸了摸脸。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 你脸颊上沾了烟灰。
messages.en: You've got soot on your cheek.

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Veru? Missejt wiċċi wara li naddaft il-fuklar.
messages.mt_standard: Veru? Missejt wiċċi wara li naddaft il-fuklar.
messages.zh: 真的吗？我清理完炉子后摸了摸脸。
messages.en: Really? I touched my face after cleaning the stove.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġmied记成清理炉子后留在手上、再蹭到脸上的黑印；用同一个画面连接烟炱本身和黑色污痕两个意思。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A crowd or mass of people gathered together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 聚集在一起的一群人或一大片人群。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Għadd ta' nies miġburin flimkien f'post wieħed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一群人；聚集的人群。
人群；密集聚集的一大群人。

formal.mt: Ġmiegħa kbira nġabret fil-pjazza biex tisma' d-diskors tas-sindku.
formal.en: A large crowd gathered in the square to listen to the mayor's speech.
formal.zh: 一大群人聚集在广场上，聆听市长讲话。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ma nistax narah f'din il-ġmiegħa. Mark: Hemm ħdejn il-funtana, bil-qmis ħamra.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where's Pawlu? I can't see him in this crowd. Mark: Over there by the fountain, in the red shirt.
colloquial.zh: Maja：Pawlu在哪儿？这么多人，我看不到他。Mark：在那边喷泉旁，穿红衬衫的那个。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ma nistax narah f'din il-ġmiegħa.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu Pawlu? Ma nistax narah f'din il-ġmiegħa.
messages.zh: Pawlu在哪儿？这么多人，我看不到他。
messages.en: Where's Pawlu? I can't see him in this crowd.

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.zh: 在那边喷泉旁，穿红衬衫的那个。
messages.en: Over there by the fountain, in the red shirt.

cognitive_memory_aid: 看到ġmiegħa就想象广场上一群人聚在一起听讲话；把注意力放在聚集的人群上，无需额外联想喧闹或骚动。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Beauty, or the pleasure experienced when appreciating something beautiful.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 事物的美、美丽，或欣赏美好事物时获得的审美愉悦。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-kwalità ta' xi ħaġa sabiħa, jew il-pjaċir li wieħed iħoss meta japprezza xi ħaġa sabiħa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 美；美丽；事物令人欣赏的美好特质。
审美愉悦；欣赏美时得到的满足感。

formal.mt: Il-wirja tistieden lill-viżitaturi japprezzaw il-ġmiel tal-pajsaġġ Malti.
formal.en: The exhibition invites visitors to appreciate the beauty of the Maltese landscape.
formal.zh: 该展览邀请参观者欣赏马耳他风景之美。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-ġmiel ta' din il-veduta! Mark: Ejja nieqfu hawn ftit u ngawduha.
colloquial.en: Maja: Look how beautiful this view is! Mark: Let's stop here for a bit and enjoy it.
colloquial.zh: Maja：看看这景色多美！Mark：我们在这儿停一会儿，好好欣赏吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (旅伴)
messages.zh: 看看这景色多美！
messages.en: Look how beautiful this view is!

messages.speaker: Mark (旅伴)
messages.mt_spoken: Ejja nieqfu hawn ftit u ngawduha.
messages.mt_standard: Ejja nieqfu hawn ftit u ngawduha.
messages.zh: 我们在这儿停一会儿，好好欣赏吧。
messages.en: Let's stop here for a bit and enjoy it.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用欣赏风景时停下脚步的画面记ġmiel：眼前景色的美，以及心里因欣赏而产生的愉悦，可以一起联想。

teaching_sense.en_definition: An area of land where flowers, plants, trees, or vegetables are grown.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 种植花卉、其他植物、树木或蔬菜的园地。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa art fejn jitkabbru fjuri, pjanti, siġar jew ħaxix.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 花园；种植花草、树木或蔬菜的园子。

formal.mt: Il-ġnien pubbliku jiftaħ kuljum fit-tmienja ta' filgħodu u jagħlaq fis-sitta ta' filgħaxija.
formal.en: The public garden opens daily at eight in the morning and closes at six in the evening.
formal.zh: 公共花园每天早上八点开放，傍晚六点关闭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid nieħdu kafè fil-ġnien? Mark: Iva, ħa npoġġi s-siġġijiet fid-dell.
colloquial.en: Maja: Shall we have coffee in the garden? Mark: Yes, let me put the chairs in the shade.
colloquial.zh: Maja：我们去花园喝咖啡好吗？Mark：好，我把椅子放到阴凉处。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我们去花园喝咖啡好吗？
messages.en: Shall we have coffee in the garden?

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 好，我把椅子放到阴凉处。
messages.en: Yes, let me put the chairs in the shade.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġnien写在想象中的花园门牌上，再联想浇花、树荫和园中喝咖啡；用这些具体场景牢牢记住花园义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A food made from milk by separating and processing its curds.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 将奶凝结后分离、加工凝乳制成的食品，即奶酪。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel magħmul mill-ħalib billi dan jitbaqqat u l-baqta tinfired u tiġi pproċessata.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 奶酪；芝士，一种由奶加工制成的食品。

formal.mt: Qabel isservi l-għaġin, żid ftit ġobon maħkuk fuq kull platt.
formal.en: Before serving the pasta, add a little grated cheese to each plate.
formal.zh: 意面上桌前，在每盘上撒少许磨碎的奶酪。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ġobon mal-ħobż? Mark: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli biċċa żgħira.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some cheese with the bread? Mark: Yes, please. Cut me a small piece.
colloquial.zh: Maja：要不要来点奶酪配面包？Mark：好的，谢谢。给我切一小块吧。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 要不要来点奶酪配面包？
messages.en: Would you like some cheese with the bread?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli biċċa żgħira.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jekk jogħġbok. Aqtagħli biċċa żgħira.
messages.zh: 好的，谢谢。给我切一小块吧。
messages.en: Yes, please. Cut me a small piece.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġobon和餐桌上一块奶酪绑定记忆：可以切成小块配面包，也可以磨碎撒在意面上，两个动作帮助巩固词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The activity of running at a slow, steady pace for exercise.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 以较慢、稳定的速度跑步进行锻炼的活动。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-attività ta' ġiri b'pass bil-mod u regolari bħala eżerċizzju fiżiku.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 慢跑；以较慢、稳定的速度进行的跑步锻炼。

formal.mt: Il-programm ta' kull ġimgħa jinkludi għoxrin minuta ta' ġogging ħafif nhar it-Tlieta u nhar il-Ħamis.
formal.en: The weekly programme includes twenty minutes of light jogging on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
formal.zh: 每周计划包括周二和周四各二十分钟的轻松慢跑。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Se tagħmel ġogging għada filgħodu? Mark: Iva, għal xi nofs siegħa. Trid tiġi miegħi?
colloquial.en: Maja: Are you going jogging tomorrow morning? Mark: Yes, for about half an hour. Would you like to come with me?
colloquial.zh: Maja：你明天早上去慢跑吗？Mark：去，大约跑半小时。你想和我一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 你明天早上去慢跑吗？
messages.en: Are you going jogging tomorrow morning?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għal xi nofs siegħa. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għal xi nofs siegħa. Trid tiġi miegħi?
messages.zh: 去，大约跑半小时。你想和我一起去吗？
messages.en: Yes, for about half an hour. Would you like to come with me?

cognitive_memory_aid: 将ġogging与英语jogging对照记忆，再想象清晨用稳定的小步慢跑；重点记住它表示慢跑这项活动。

gloss_zh: 珠宝；宝石；珍爱的人；令人喜悦的事物

teaching_sense.en_definition: A jewel or precious stone; also a beloved person or something that brings pleasure.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 珠宝或珍贵的宝石；也可指珍爱的人，或带来喜悦的事物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġawhra jew ħaġra prezzjuża; ukoll persuna għażiża jew xi ħaġa li tagħti pjaċir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 特别珍贵的人；用于称赞或亲昵地称呼某人。

sense_translations.en_definition: joy, something that gives you pleasure, precious stone
sense_translations.zh_definition: 喜悦；令人愉快的事物；宝石。
珠宝；珍贵的宝石。
心爱的人；受到珍爱的人。

formal.mt: Din il-ġojja prezzjuża tinsab f'kaxxa tal-ħġieġ fil-mużew.
formal.en: This precious jewel is in a glass case in the museum.
formal.zh: 这颗珍贵的宝石放在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Ġibtlek is-soppa, nanna. Rita: Grazzi, qalbi. Int ġojja għalija!
colloquial.en: Lara: I brought you soup, Grandma. Rita: Thank you, sweetheart. You're a treasure to me!
colloquial.zh: 劳拉：奶奶，我给你带了汤。丽塔：谢谢你，宝贝。你真是我的宝！

messages.speaker: Lara (孙女)
messages.zh: 奶奶，我给你带了汤。
messages.en: I brought you soup, Grandma.

messages.speaker: Rita (祖母)
messages.zh: 谢谢你，宝贝。你真是我的宝！
messages.en: Thank you, sweetheart. You're a treasure to me!

cognitive_memory_aid: 把宝石和心爱的人放进同一个想象中的宝盒：ġojja 既能指闪亮的珍宝，也能亲昵地称呼珍爱的人。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A giant: a person or story character of exceptionally large size.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 巨人，即体型异常高大的人或故事人物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ġgant, jiġifieri persuna jew karattru fi storja b'ġisem kbir ħafna.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 巨人；体型异常高大的人物。

formal.mt: Fl-istorja, ġolf kien jgħix fuq muntanja u jgħin lin-nies tar-raħal.
formal.en: In the story, a giant lived on a mountain and helped the villagers.
formal.zh: 故事里，一个巨人住在山上，帮助村民。

colloquial.mt: Marta: Min hu dak il-karattru kbir fl-istampa? Pawlu: Dak ġolf, imma f'din l-istorja hu qalbu tajba.
colloquial.en: Marta: Who is that large character in the picture? Pawlu: That's a giant, but in this story he's kind-hearted.
colloquial.zh: 玛尔塔：图里那个高大的人物是谁？保罗：那是个巨人，不过在这个故事里，他心地善良。

messages.speaker: Marta (学生)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-karattru kbir fl-istampa?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-karattru kbir fl-istampa?
messages.zh: 图里那个高大的人物是谁？
messages.en: Who is that large character in the picture?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (老师)
messages.mt_spoken: Dak ġolf, imma f'din l-istorja hu qalbu tajba.
messages.mt_standard: Dak ġolf, imma f'din l-istorja hu qalbu tajba.
messages.zh: 那是个巨人，不过在这个故事里，他心地善良。
messages.en: That's a giant, but in this story he's kind-hearted.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象绘本里的巨人高得超过整栋房子，在人物旁写上 ġolf；用巨大体型的画面记住这个名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A small bell that makes a ringing or jingling sound when moved.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 摇动时会发出清脆铃声的小铃铛。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Qanpiena żgħira li ddoqq meta tiċċaqlaq.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小铃铛。
叮当作响的小铃铛；小铃。

collocations.en: a small bell around the neck
the sound of the small bell

formal.mt: Il-qattus kellu ġolġol mal-għonq li kien jinstema' meta kien jimxi.
formal.en: The cat had a small bell around its neck that could be heard when it walked.
formal.zh: 猫的脖子上挂着一个小铃铛，走动时能听到铃声。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Qed tisma' dak il-ħoss? Toni: Iva, hu l-ġolġol tal-qattus. Qiegħed wara l-bieb.
colloquial.en: Sara: Can you hear that sound? Toni: Yes, it's the cat's bell. The cat is behind the door.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你听见那个声音了吗？托尼：听见了，是猫的小铃铛。猫在门后面。

messages.speaker: Sara (室友)
messages.zh: 你听见那个声音了吗？
messages.en: Can you hear that sound?

messages.speaker: Toni (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, hu l-ġolġol tal-qattus. Qiegħed wara l-bieb.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, hu l-ġolġol tal-qattus. Qiegħed wara l-bieb.
messages.zh: 听见了，是猫的小铃铛。猫在门后面。
messages.en: Yes, it's the cat's bell. The cat is behind the door.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ġolġol 分成两个相似的视觉小块，配上铃铛左右摇摆的画面；这只是记忆方法，不是词源解释。

gloss_zh: 额外的一段；连接处；大麻烟卷

teaching_sense.en_definition: An extra piece added to something, or a joint that connects parts together.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 为补充或延长而加上的一段，也指把不同部分接在一起的连接处。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Biċċa żejda miżjuda ma' xi ħaġa, jew parti li tgħaqqad biċċiet flimkien.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 某物额外增加的一块或一段。

sense_translations.en_definition: the joint that holds things together
sense_translations.zh_definition: 把物件或部件连接在一起的接头；连接处。
一支大麻烟卷。
额外的一块；补加的一段。

formal.mt: It-tekniku eżamina l-ġonta fil-pajp biex jiżgura li ma kienx hemm tnixxija.
formal.en: The technician examined the joint in the pipe to make sure there was no leak.
formal.zh: 技术人员检查了管道的连接处，确认没有泄漏。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Din il-purtiera qasira wisq. Marija: Nistgħu nżidu ġonta drapp fil-qiegħ.
colloquial.en: Nina: This curtain is too short. Marija: We can add an extra piece of fabric at the bottom.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：这幅窗帘太短了。玛丽亚：我们可以在底部接上一块布。

messages.speaker: Nina (顾客)
messages.zh: 这幅窗帘太短了。
messages.en: This curtain is too short.

messages.speaker: Marija (裁缝)
messages.zh: 我们可以在底部接上一块布。
messages.en: We can add an extra piece of fabric at the bottom.

cognitive_memory_aid: 先想象短窗帘接上一块布，再想象管道的接头，分别记住补加的一段和连接处；烟卷义另配画面单独记忆。

gloss_zh: 水上油杆竞赛；骑士马上比武

teaching_sense.en_definition: A summertime competition in which participants try to walk along a greased pole extending over water.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 夏季举行的一种竞赛，参与者尝试沿伸向水面的涂油杆行走。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Kompetizzjoni fis-sajf li fiha l-parteċipanti jippruvaw jimxu fuq arblu midluk bix-xaħam li jisporġi fuq l-ilma.

sense_translations.en_definition: a competition, held in the summertime, requiring participants to walk over a greased pole extended over a bed of water
sense_translations.zh_definition: 夏季举行的水上油杆竞赛，参与者须在伸向水面的涂油杆上行走。
骑士马上比武；骑士间的竞技较量。

collocations.en: to take part in the greased-pole competition
the pole used in the greased-pole competition
collocations.zh: 水上油杆竞赛使用的杆

formal.mt: Matul is-sajf, il-parteċipanti fil-ġostra jippruvaw jimxu fuq arblu midluk bix-xaħam li jisporġi fuq l-ilma.
formal.en: During the summer, participants in the competition try to walk along a greased pole extending over the water.
formal.zh: 夏季，油杆竞赛的参与者尝试沿伸向水面的涂油杆行走。

colloquial.mt: Luca: Se tieħu sehem fil-ġostra? Mark: Le, illum se nara biss. L-arblu jidher jiżloq ħafna!
colloquial.en: Luca: Are you going to take part in the greased-pole competition? Mark: No, today I'll just watch. The pole looks very slippery!
colloquial.zh: 卢卡：你要参加水上油杆竞赛吗？马克：不了，今天我只看比赛。那根杆看起来滑得很！

messages.speaker: Luca (朋友)
messages.zh: 你要参加水上油杆竞赛吗？
messages.en: Are you going to take part in the greased-pole competition?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Le, illum se nara biss. L-arblu jidher jiżloq ħafna!
messages.mt_standard: Le, illum se nara biss. L-arblu jidher jiżloq ħafna!
messages.zh: 不了，今天我只看比赛。那根杆看起来滑得很！
messages.en: No, today I'll just watch. The pole looks very slippery!

cognitive_memory_aid: 给 ġostra 配两张比赛图：一张是水面上滑溜溜的油杆，一张是骑士马上比武；看到语境再选择对应义项。

gloss_zh: 事件；发生的事情；故事；叙事

teaching_sense.en_definition: Something that happens, or a story or narrative about what happened.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 发生的事情或事件，也指讲述事情经过的故事或叙事。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Xi ħaġa li tiġri, jew storja jew rakkont dwar dak li ġara.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一件发生的事情。
一个故事。
一个事件。
一段叙事；对事情经过的讲述。
事件；发生的事；某件发生的事情。

formal.mt: L-awtriċi tirrakkonta ġrajja minn tfulitha u tispjega kif din bidlet ħajjitha.
formal.en: The author recounts an event from her childhood and explains how it changed her life.
formal.zh: 作者讲述了童年的一件事，并解释这件事如何改变了她的人生。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Għidli ġrajja minn meta kont żgħir, nannu. Ġużeppi: Darba tlift it-triq lejn id-dar, u ġar għenni nasal.
colloquial.en: Anna: Tell me a story from when you were young, Grandpa. Ġużeppi: Once I lost my way home, and a neighbour helped me get there.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：爷爷，给我讲件你小时候的事吧。朱塞佩：有一次我找不到回家的路，一位邻居帮我回到了家。

messages.speaker: Anna (孙女)
messages.mt_spoken: Għidli ġrajja minn meta kont żgħir, nannu.
messages.mt_standard: Għidli ġrajja minn meta kont żgħir, nannu.
messages.zh: 爷爷，给我讲件你小时候的事吧。
messages.en: Tell me a story from when you were young, Grandpa.

messages.speaker: Ġużeppi (祖父)
messages.mt_spoken: Darba tlift it-triq lejn id-dar, u ġar għenni nasal.
messages.mt_standard: Darba tlift it-triq lejn id-dar, u ġar għenni nasal.
messages.zh: 有一次我找不到回家的路，一位邻居帮我回到了家。
messages.en: Once I lost my way home, and a neighbour helped me get there.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把一件发生的事画成连环画：事情本身是 ġrajja，把经过讲出来也可称 ġrajja，用同一画面串起事件与故事。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The act or process of swallowing food or drink; also the process of digesting it.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 吞下食物或饮料的动作或过程；也指消化过程。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-att jew il-proċess li tibla' ikel jew xorb; ukoll il-proċess tad-diġestjoni.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 吞咽；把食物或液体咽下去的过程。
吞咽；消化。

formal.mt: It-test jiddeskrivi l-ġrigħ tal-ikel u jispjega kif l-ikel jgħaddi mill-ħalq għall-istonku.
formal.en: The text describes the swallowing of food and explains how food passes from the mouth to the stomach.
formal.zh: 这篇文字描述吞咽食物的过程，并解释食物如何从口腔进入胃部。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Xi jfisser ġrigħ f'din is-sentenza? Daniel: Hawn ifisser li tibla' l-ikel.
colloquial.en: Maja: What does ġrigħ mean in this sentence? Daniel: Here it means swallowing food.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这句话里的 ġrigħ 是什么意思？丹尼尔：这里指吞咽食物。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 这句话里的 ġrigħ 是什么意思？
messages.en: What does ġrigħ mean in this sentence?

messages.speaker: Daniel (老师)
messages.zh: 这里指吞咽食物。
messages.en: Here it means swallowing food.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一口食物被咽下，再进入消化过程，把 ġrigħ 写在这条过程箭头旁；注意它是表示过程的名词。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The womb or uterus, the organ in which a baby develops before birth.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 子宫，即胎儿出生前在其中发育的器官；也可称母腹。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: L-utru, l-organu li fih tiżviluppa t-tarbija qabel titwieled.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 子宫；母腹，指胎儿孕育的地方。
子宫。
母腹；子宫。

collocations.en: the baby's development in the womb

formal.mt: It-tarbija tiżviluppa fil-ġuf matul it-tqala, qabel ma titwieled.
formal.en: The baby develops in the womb during pregnancy, before being born.
formal.zh: 胎儿在出生前，于妊娠期间在子宫内发育。

colloquial.mt: Ella: Fejn tikber it-tarbija qabel titwieled? Marija: Tikber fil-ġuf, ġewwa ġisem l-omm.
colloquial.en: Ella: Where does a baby grow before being born? Marija: It grows in the womb, inside the mother's body.
colloquial.zh: 埃拉：宝宝出生前在哪里长大？玛丽亚：在子宫里，也就是妈妈身体里面。

messages.speaker: Ella (女儿)
messages.zh: 宝宝出生前在哪里长大？
messages.en: Where does a baby grow before being born?

messages.speaker: Marija (母亲)
messages.zh: 在子宫里，也就是妈妈身体里面。
messages.en: It grows in the womb, inside the mother's body.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用胎儿在母体子宫中成长的示意图记 ġuf，再把 fil-ġuf 整块记成在子宫里，帮助理解句中的位置表达。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Vetch, a leguminous plant that can be grown for animal feed.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 野豌豆、巢菜一类豆科植物，可种植作动物饲料。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta tal-familja tal-legumi li tista' titkabbar bħala għalf għall-annimali.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 野豌豆；巢菜类豆科植物

formal.mt: Il-bidwi żera' l-ġulbiena f'għalqa żgħira biex jużaha bħala għalf.
formal.en: The farmer sowed vetch in a small field to use it as animal feed.
formal.zh: 农民在一小块田里播种了野豌豆，准备用作动物饲料。

colloquial.mt: Maja: X'se tiżra' f'din l-għalqa? Pawlu: Se niżra' l-ġulbiena għall-annimali.
colloquial.en: Maja: What are you going to sow in this field? Pawlu: I'm going to sow vetch for the animals.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你打算在这块田里种什么？保罗：我打算种野豌豆来喂动物。

messages.speaker: Maja (邻居)
messages.zh: 你打算在这块田里种什么？
messages.en: What are you going to sow in this field?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (农民)
messages.zh: 我打算种野豌豆来喂动物。
messages.en: I'm going to sow vetch for the animals.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给ġulbiena配一张“田里种豆科饲草”的学习卡，把植物、种子和喂动物三个画面连起来，避免只记成泛指的豆子。

gloss_zh: 糖浆；朱利普甜饮；甜得过头的东西

teaching_sense.en_definition: A thick, sweet liquid, often made from carob; also a julep or something excessively sweet.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 浓稠的甜味液体，常用角豆制成；也可指朱利普甜饮或甜得过头的东西。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Likwidu ħelu u magħqud, spiss magħmul mill-ħarrub; ukoll xarba ħelwa jew xi ħaġa ħelwa żżejjed.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 朱利普饮料；一种甜味饮品

sense_translations.en_definition: syrup, often made out of carob
sense_translations.zh_definition: 糖浆，常用角豆制成
任何甜得过头的东西

formal.mt: Ir-riċetta titlob kuċċarina ġulepp tal-ħarrub biex tagħti togħma ħelwa lid-deżerta.
formal.en: The recipe calls for a teaspoon of carob syrup to give the dessert a sweet flavour.
formal.zh: 这份食谱要求加入一茶匙角豆糖浆，为甜点增添甜味。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Trid ftit ġulepp fuq il-ġelat? Pawlu: Iva, imma ftit biss, għax ma nħobbux ħelu wisq.
colloquial.en: Maja: Would you like some syrup on the ice cream? Pawlu: Yes, but only a little, because I don't like it too sweet.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：冰淇淋上要加点糖浆吗？保罗：要，不过一点点就好，我不喜欢太甜。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 冰淇淋上要加点糖浆吗？
messages.en: Would you like some syrup on the ice cream?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, imma ftit biss, għax ma nħobbux ħelu wisq.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, imma ftit biss, għax ma nħobbux ħelu wisq.
messages.zh: 要，不过一点点就好，我不喜欢太甜。
messages.en: Yes, but only a little, because I don't like it too sweet.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一勺浓糖浆缓缓流到冰淇淋上，用ġulepp记住这个画面；再把“糖浆很甜”延伸为“甜得过头的东西”这一词义。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Sesame, especially the small seeds used in cooking and on bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 芝麻，尤指用于烹饪或撒在面包上的小种子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pjanta bi żrieragħ żgħar li jintużaw fit-tisjir u fuq il-ħobż; ukoll iż-żrieragħ tagħha.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 芝麻；芝麻植物或其种子

formal.mt: Qabel il-ħami, ferrex ftit ġulġlien fuq il-wiċċ tal-ħobż.
formal.en: Before baking, sprinkle a little sesame over the surface of the bread.
formal.zh: 烘烤前，在面包表面撒上少许芝麻。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Dan il-ħobż fih il-ġulġlien? Pawlu: Iva, għandu ż-żerriegħa tal-ġulġlien fuq il-wiċċ.
colloquial.en: Maja: Does this bread contain sesame? Pawlu: Yes, it has sesame seeds on top.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：这个面包含芝麻吗？保罗：含，表面有芝麻籽。

messages.speaker: Maja (顾客)
messages.zh: 这个面包含芝麻吗？
messages.en: Does this bread contain sesame?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (面包店店员)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, għandu ż-żerriegħa tal-ġulġlien fuq il-wiċċ.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, għandu ż-żerriegħa tal-ġulġlien fuq il-wiċċ.
messages.zh: 含，表面有芝麻籽。
messages.en: Yes, it has sesame seeds on top.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġulġlien写在一幅撒满芝麻的面包图旁，注意词中两次出现的ġ；用醒目的重复字母帮助自己记住一粒粒芝麻的画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The European fan palm, also called the Mediterranean dwarf palm; also a broom used for sweeping.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 欧洲矮棕，又称地中海矮棕，叶片呈扇形；另有用于扫地的扫帚之义。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tip ta' palma baxxa bil-weraq qishom imrewħa; ukoll għodda li tintuża għall-knis.

sense_translations.en_definition: European fan palm, or the Mediterranean dwarf palm.
sense_translations.zh_definition: 欧洲矮棕，亦称地中海矮棕
欧洲矮棕（学名：Chamaerops humilis）
扫帚；用于清扫的家用器具

formal.mt: Fil-ġnien botaniku, l-istudenti osservaw il-weraq tal-ġummar, li għandhom forma ta' mrewħa.
formal.en: In the botanical garden, the students observed the fan-shaped leaves of the European fan palm.
formal.zh: 在植物园里，学生们观察了欧洲矮棕呈扇形的叶片。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Fejn hu l-ġummar? Irrid niknes il-bitħa. Pawlu: Qiegħed wara l-bieb, ħdejn il-barmil.
colloquial.en: Maja: Where is the broom? I want to sweep the yard. Pawlu: It's behind the door, next to the bucket.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：扫帚在哪里？我想扫一扫院子。保罗：在门后面，水桶旁边。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.mt_spoken: Fejn hu l-ġummar? Irrid niknes il-bitħa.
messages.mt_standard: Fejn hu l-ġummar? Irrid niknes il-bitħa.
messages.zh: 扫帚在哪里？我想扫一扫院子。
messages.en: Where is the broom? I want to sweep the yard.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (室友)
messages.zh: 在门后面，水桶旁边。
messages.en: It's behind the door, next to the bucket.

cognitive_memory_aid: 为ġummar画两张并列学习卡：一张是扇形棕榈叶，一张是扫帚；看到花园语境想植物，看到清扫语境想工具，不必推测两义的历史关系。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A decorative tassel or soft puff of threads attached to clothing or another object.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 附在衣物或其他物件上的装饰性线穗、流苏或柔软绒球。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tiżjin magħmul minn ħjut miġburin flimkien, imdendlin jew f'forma ta' ballun artab, fuq ilbies jew oġġett ieħor.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 流苏；由一束垂下的线构成的穗饰
流苏；绒球状饰物

collocations.en: a hat with a tassel or pompom

formal.mt: Il-kappell huwa mżejjen b'ġummiena ħamra magħmula mis-suf.
formal.en: The hat is decorated with a red wool pompom.
formal.zh: 这顶帽子装饰着一个红色羊毛绒球。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Ara l-ġummiena tal-kappell tiegħi! Pawlu: Kemm hi sabiħa! Għamiltha int?
colloquial.en: Maja: Look at the pompom on my hat! Pawlu: It's lovely! Did you make it yourself?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：看我帽子上的绒球！保罗：真好看！是你自己做的吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 看我帽子上的绒球！
messages.en: Look at the pompom on my hat!

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 真好看！是你自己做的吗？
messages.en: It's lovely! Did you make it yourself?

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġummiena想成帽顶摇动的小绒球，再换成垂下的线穗；用“同为线做的装饰”串起绒球和流苏两个画面。

teaching_sense.en_definition: June, the sixth month of the year.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 六月，一年中的第六个月。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Is-sitt xahar tas-sena, wara Mejju u qabel Lulju.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 六月
六月

formal.mt: Il-kors jibda fl-ewwel ta' Ġunju u jintemm fl-aħħar tax-xahar.
formal.en: The course begins on the first of June and ends at the end of the month.
formal.zh: 课程于六月一日开始，于当月底结束。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Meta se tmur vaganza? Pawlu: F'Ġunju, wara l-eżamijiet.
colloquial.en: Maja: When are you going on holiday? Pawlu: In June, after the exams.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：你什么时候去度假？保罗：六月，考试结束以后。

messages.speaker: Maja (同学)
messages.zh: 你什么时候去度假？
messages.en: When are you going on holiday?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (同学)
messages.zh: 六月，考试结束以后。
messages.en: In June, after the exams.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把Ġunju贴在日历数字六旁边，并按Mejju、Ġunju、Lulju的顺序朗读；整块记住f'Ġunju就是“在六月”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A solemn promise or formal declaration that one will tell the truth or fulfil a duty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 郑重作出的承诺，或保证说实话、履行职责的正式宣誓。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Wegħda solenni jew dikjarazzjoni formali li persuna se tgħid il-verità jew twettaq dmir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 誓言；郑重保证说实话或履行承诺的宣誓

formal.mt: Ix-xhud ħa l-ġurament qabel ma ta x-xhieda tiegħu.
formal.en: The witness took an oath before giving his testimony.
formal.zh: 证人在作证前进行了宣誓。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għaliex ix-xhud jieħu l-ġurament? Pawlu: Biex iwiegħed b'mod solenni li jgħid il-verità.
colloquial.en: Maja: Why does the witness take an oath? Pawlu: To promise solemnly to tell the truth.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：证人为什么要宣誓？保罗：为了郑重保证说实话。

messages.speaker: Maja (学生)
messages.zh: 证人为什么要宣誓？
messages.en: Why does the witness take an oath?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (教师)
messages.mt_spoken: Biex iwiegħed b'mod solenni li jgħid il-verità.
messages.mt_standard: Biex iwiegħed b'mod solenni li jgħid il-verità.
messages.zh: 为了郑重保证说实话。
messages.en: To promise solemnly to tell the truth.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象证人在发言前郑重宣誓，把ġurament与“保证说真话”相连；再整块记住jieħu l-ġurament表示“宣誓”。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A mouse or rat: a small rodent with a long tail.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 鼠类动物，可指小鼠或大鼠，通常有长尾巴。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Annimal gerriem żgħir b'denb twil, li jista' jkun żgħir jew akbar skont il-kuntest.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 小鼠；体型较小的老鼠
大鼠；体型较大的老鼠

formal.mt: Waqt l-ispezzjoni tal-maħżen, instab ġurdien ħdejn il-boroż tad-dqiq.
formal.en: During the inspection of the storeroom, a mouse was found near the bags of flour.
formal.zh: 检查储藏室时，在面粉袋附近发现了一只老鼠。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Rajt ġurdien fil-kċina! Mark: Fejn mar? Maja: Daħal wara l-friġġ.
colloquial.en: Maja: I saw a mouse in the kitchen! Mark: Where did it go? Maja: It went behind the fridge.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我在厨房看见一只老鼠！马克：它跑哪儿去了？玛雅：钻到冰箱后面去了。

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 我在厨房看见一只老鼠！
messages.en: I saw a mouse in the kitchen!

messages.speaker: Mark (室友)
messages.zh: 它跑哪儿去了？
messages.en: Where did it go?

messages.speaker: Maja (室友)
messages.zh: 钻到冰箱后面去了。
messages.en: It went behind the fridge.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġurdien和厨房角落里长尾巴的老鼠联系起来；小鼠或大鼠的具体区别由语境帮助判断。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A publication containing news, articles or other writing, such as a magazine, journal or newspaper.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 刊载新闻、文章等内容的出版物，可指杂志、期刊或报纸。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Pubblikazzjoni li fiha aħbarijiet, artikli jew kitbiet oħra, bħal rivista jew gazzetta.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 杂志；刊载文章、图片等内容的定期出版物
期刊；常刊载某一领域文章或研究成果的连续出版物
报纸；刊载新闻等内容的出版物

formal.mt: L-istudju ġie ppubblikat f'ġurnal xjentifiku u huwa disponibbli fil-librerija.
formal.en: The study was published in a scientific journal and is available in the library.
formal.zh: 这项研究已在科学期刊上发表，可在图书馆查阅。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Xtrajt il-ġurnal tal-lum? Pawlu: Iva, qiegħed fuq il-mejda. Lara: Tajjeb, irrid naqra l-aħbarijiet.
colloquial.en: Lara: Did you buy today's newspaper? Pawlu: Yes, it's on the table. Lara: Good, I want to read the news.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你买今天的报纸了吗？保罗：买了，在桌上。拉拉：好，我想看看新闻。

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 你买今天的报纸了吗？
messages.en: Did you buy today's newspaper?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 买了，在桌上。
messages.en: Yes, it's on the table.

messages.speaker: Lara (家人)
messages.zh: 好，我想看看新闻。
messages.en: Good, I want to read the news.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象同一书架上摆着杂志、学术期刊和报纸，用ġurnal串起这三类读物，再靠文章内容判断具体义项。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A day, understood as a period of daily experience, twenty-four hours, or the time from dawn to nightfall.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 一天，可指人清醒活动和经历事情的一段时间、二十四小时，或从黎明到天黑的白天。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Perjodu ta' żmien li jista' jfisser il-ħin li wieħed iqatta' mqajjem, erbgħa u għoxrin siegħa, jew il-ħin mis-sebħ sa ma jidlam.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 一天；一日

sense_translations.en_definition: day (period when a person is awake and experiences things)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 一天的生活或活动时间；人清醒并经历各种事情的时段
一昼夜；作为时间单位的二十四小时
白天；从黎明到天黑的时间

formal.mt: Il-parteċipanti se jqattgħu ġurnata sħiħa fil-mużew biex jistudjaw il-kollezzjoni.
formal.en: The participants will spend a whole day at the museum studying the collection.
formal.zh: 参与者将在博物馆花一整天研究馆藏。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kif kienet il-ġurnata tiegħek? Luka: Kienet twila, imma spiċċajt ix-xogħol kollu. Sara: Issa strieħ ftit.
colloquial.en: Sara: How was your day? Luka: It was long, but I finished all the work. Sara: Have a little rest now.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：你今天过得怎么样？卢卡：挺漫长的，不过我把工作都做完了。萨拉：现在休息一下吧。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你今天过得怎么样？
messages.en: How was your day?

messages.speaker: Luka (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Kienet twila, imma spiċċajt ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.mt_standard: Kienet twila, imma spiċċajt ix-xogħol kollu.
messages.zh: 挺漫长的，不过我把工作都做完了。
messages.en: It was long, but I finished all the work.

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 现在休息一下吧。
messages.en: Have a little rest now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用一张日程表记ġurnata：既能看整天的经历，也能数二十四小时，还能只看有日光的白天。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Fairness and just treatment, or the system through which laws are applied and disputes are judged.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 公平正当的原则或待遇，也可指实施法律、审理争议的司法制度。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-prinċipju li n-nies jiġu ttrattati b'mod ġust, jew is-sistema li tapplika l-liġi u tiddeċiedi t-tilwim.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 正义；公正

sense_translations.en_definition: justice (principle or degree of being just)
sense_translations.zh_definition: 公正原则；行为或安排所体现的公平正当程度
司法制度；司法机关体系

formal.mt: Ir-rapport jenfasizza li kull persuna għandu jkollha aċċess għas-sistema tal-ġustizzja.
formal.en: The report emphasizes that every person should have access to the justice system.
formal.zh: 报告强调，每个人都应有机会寻求司法救济。

colloquial.mt: Nina: Ma kienx ġust li taw it-tort kollu lil Marija. Toni: Għandek raġun. Trid issir ġustizzja magħha.
colloquial.en: Nina: It wasn't fair to put all the blame on Marija. Toni: You're right. She needs to be treated justly.
colloquial.zh: 妮娜：把所有责任都推给玛丽娅太不公平了。托尼：你说得对。应该还她一个公道。

messages.speaker: Nina (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Ma kienx ġust li taw it-tort kollu lil Marija.
messages.mt_standard: Ma kienx ġust li taw it-tort kollu lil Marija.
messages.zh: 把所有责任都推给玛丽娅太不公平了。
messages.en: It wasn't fair to put all the blame on Marija.

messages.speaker: Toni (同事)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandek raġun. Trid issir ġustizzja magħha.
messages.mt_standard: Għandek raġun. Trid issir ġustizzja magħha.
messages.zh: 你说得对。应该还她一个公道。
messages.en: You're right. She needs to be treated justly.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġustizzja放在公平的天平旁记忆：天平代表公正原则，旁边的法庭代表司法制度。

teaching_sense.en_definition: A boy, adolescent or young man.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 男孩、男性青少年或年轻男子，常可译为少年或小伙子。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Tifel imfarfar jew raġel żagħżugħ.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 少年；青少年，此处指男性
男孩；小伙子

formal.mt: Ġuvnott ta' sbatax-il sena rebaħ l-ewwel premju fil-kompetizzjoni tal-fotografija.
formal.en: A seventeen-year-old young man won first prize in the photography competition.
formal.zh: 一名十七岁的少年在摄影比赛中获得了一等奖。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Min hu dak il-ġuvnott ħdejn il-bieb? Rita: Dak kuġin tiegħi, David. Maja: Se jiġi magħna wkoll?
colloquial.en: Maja: Who's that young man by the door? Rita: That's my cousin, David. Maja: Is he coming with us too?
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：门边那个小伙子是谁？丽塔：那是我的表弟戴维。玛雅：他也跟我们一起去吗？

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Min hu dak il-ġuvnott ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.mt_standard: Min hu dak il-ġuvnott ħdejn il-bieb?
messages.zh: 门边那个小伙子是谁？
messages.en: Who's that young man by the door?

messages.speaker: Rita (朋友)
messages.zh: 那是我的表弟戴维。
messages.en: That's my cousin, David.

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 他也跟我们一起去吗？
messages.en: Is he coming with us too?

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象门边站着一个十七岁的小伙子，用ġuvnott给他作人物标签，记住核心是年轻男性。

teaching_sense.en_definition: The feeling of needing food; also famine or severe poverty.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 需要进食时的饥饿感；也可指饥荒或严重贫困。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Il-ħtieġa jew ix-xewqa li tiekol; ukoll nuqqas kbir ta' ikel jew faqar kbir.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 饥饿；想吃东西的感觉
饥荒；严重且广泛的食物短缺
贫困；生活物资匮乏的处境

formal.mt: L-organizzazzjoni tqassam l-ikel biex tgħin lill-familji li qed ibatu l-ġuħ.
formal.en: The organisation distributes food to help families suffering from hunger.
formal.zh: 该组织分发食物，帮助正在挨饿的家庭。

colloquial.mt: Maja: Għandi l-ġuħ. Nieklu xi ħaġa? Pawlu: Iva, nagħmel żewġ ħobżiet biż-żejt.
colloquial.en: Maja: I'm hungry. Shall we have something to eat? Pawlu: Yes, I'll make two portions of bread with oil.
colloquial.zh: 玛雅：我饿了。我们吃点东西吧？保罗：好，我来做两份橄榄油面包。

messages.speaker: Maja (朋友)
messages.zh: 我饿了。我们吃点东西吧？
messages.en: I'm hungry. Shall we have something to eat?

messages.speaker: Pawlu (朋友)
messages.zh: 好，我来做两份橄榄油面包。
messages.en: Yes, I'll make two portions of bread with oil.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把ġuħ和肚子咕咕叫的画面联系起来，整句记住għandi l-ġuħ表示“我饿了”；读到灾荒或困苦语境时，再判断是否指饥荒或贫困。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Peaceful or quiet in manner, especially when describing a person.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 性情平和、举止安静的，尤其用于描述人。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li għandu karattru kalm u paċifiku u ma jħobbx l-istorbju jew il-ġlied.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 平和的；不爱争斗的
文静的；安静少言的，用于形容人

formal.mt: L-għalliem iddeskriva lil Daniel bħala tifel ġwejjed li jisma' b'attenzjoni waqt il-lezzjonijiet.
formal.en: The teacher described Daniel as a quiet boy who listens attentively during lessons.
formal.zh: 老师把丹尼尔描述为一个文静的男孩，上课时听讲很认真。

colloquial.mt: Anna: Ħuk dejjem daqshekk ġwejjed? Mark: Iva, jitkellem ftit, imma jħobb joqgħod magħna.
colloquial.en: Anna: Is your brother always this quiet? Mark: Yes, he doesn't talk much, but he likes spending time with us.
colloquial.zh: 安娜：你哥哥一直这么文静吗？马克：是啊，他话不多，不过喜欢和我们待在一起。

messages.speaker: Anna (朋友)
messages.zh: 你哥哥一直这么文静吗？
messages.en: Is your brother always this quiet?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Iva, jitkellem ftit, imma jħobb joqgħod magħna.
messages.mt_standard: Iva, jitkellem ftit, imma jħobb joqgħod magħna.
messages.zh: 是啊，他话不多，不过喜欢和我们待在一起。
messages.en: Yes, he doesn't talk much, but he likes spending time with us.

cognitive_memory_aid: 用安静听课、不爱争吵的孩子记ġwejjed，抓住平和文静的性情，不把安静直接理解成胆怯。

gloss_zh: 胆怯的；有些怯懦的；欠主动的

teaching_sense.en_definition: Timid, somewhat cowardly, or somewhat lacking in initiative.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 胆怯、有些怯懦，或在采取行动时欠缺主动性的。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Li jibża' jew joqgħod lura, jew li ma tantx jieħu l-inizjattiva.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 有些怯懦的；面对困难或危险时不太有勇气的
有些欠主动的；不太主动采取行动的
胆怯的；畏缩的

formal.mt: Fil-bidu tal-kors, Daniel kien ġwejjef u kien isibha diffiċli jitkellem quddiem il-grupp.
formal.en: At the beginning of the course, Daniel was timid and found it difficult to speak in front of the group.
formal.zh: 课程刚开始时，丹尼尔比较胆怯，觉得在小组面前发言很困难。

colloquial.mt: Rita: Għaliex ma tlabtx l-għajnuna? David: Kont ġwejjef wisq biex nistaqsi. Rita: Darba oħra staqsi lili.
colloquial.en: Rita: Why didn't you ask for help? David: I was too timid to ask. Rita: Next time, ask me.
colloquial.zh: 丽塔：你为什么没求助？戴维：我太胆怯了，不敢问。丽塔：下次问我吧。

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 你为什么没求助？
messages.en: Why didn't you ask for help?

messages.speaker: David (同学)
messages.zh: 我太胆怯了，不敢问。
messages.en: I was too timid to ask.

messages.speaker: Rita (同学)
messages.zh: 下次问我吧。
messages.en: Next time, ask me.

cognitive_memory_aid: 想象想提问却迟迟不举手的人，用ġwejjef记胆怯和欠主动；再与ġwejjed的平和文静作情境对照。

teaching_sense.en_definition: Feed for animals, or food customarily eaten with bread.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 供动物食用的饲料，也可指通常配着面包吃的食物。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ikel għall-annimali, jew ikel li normalment jittiekel mal-ħobż.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 动物饲料；供牲畜等动物食用的食物
通常配着面包吃的食物；佐面包的菜食
饲料；草料

formal.mt: Il-bidwi ħażen il-ġwież f'post niexef biex iżomm l-ikel tal-annimali f'kundizzjoni tajba.
formal.en: The farmer stored the fodder in a dry place to keep the animals' feed in good condition.
formal.zh: 农民把饲料存放在干燥的地方，以保持动物饲料的良好状态。

colloquial.mt: Pawlu: Għandna ħobż, imma x'għandna bħala ġwież? Marija: Hemm ġobon u żebbuġ. Pawlu: Tajjeb, ġibhom fuq il-mejda.
colloquial.en: Pawlu: We have bread, but what do we have to eat with it? Marija: There's cheese and olives. Pawlu: Good, bring them to the table.
colloquial.zh: 保罗：我们有面包，不过有什么能配着吃？玛丽娅：有奶酪和橄榄。保罗：好，把它们拿到桌上吧。

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.mt_spoken: Għandna ħobż, imma x'għandna bħala ġwież?
messages.mt_standard: Għandna ħobż, imma x'għandna bħala ġwież?
messages.zh: 我们有面包，不过有什么能配着吃？
messages.en: We have bread, but what do we have to eat with it?

messages.speaker: Marija (家人)
messages.zh: 有奶酪和橄榄。
messages.en: There's cheese and olives.

messages.speaker: Pawlu (家人)
messages.zh: 好，把它们拿到桌上吧。
messages.en: Good, bring them to the table.

cognitive_memory_aid: 给ġwież画两幅记忆图：农场里给动物的饲料，以及餐桌上配面包的奶酪橄榄；按场景区分两个用途。

gloss_zh: 被拉扯；被拖长；讨价还价；省吃俭用

teaching_sense.en_definition: To be pulled or prolonged; also to bargain over a price or to spend very sparingly.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 被拉扯或被延长；也可指为价格讨价还价，或花钱十分节省。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Inġibed jew dam aktar fit-tul; ukoll innegozja fuq il-prezz jew qagħad jonfoq mill-inqas.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 被拉；受到拉扯。
被延长；被拖长。
就价格讨价还价。
省吃俭用；在开支上十分节省。
讨价还价；反复议价。

formal.mt: Id-dibattitu ġġebbed minħabba n-numru kbir ta' mistoqsijiet.
formal.en: The debate was prolonged because of the large number of questions.
formal.zh: 由于问题很多，辩论的时间被延长了。

colloquial.mt: Sara: Kemm ħallast għall-mejda? Toni: Għoxrin ewro; iġġebbadt ftit fuq il-prezz.
colloquial.en: Sara: How much did you pay for the table? Toni: Twenty euros; I haggled a little over the price.
colloquial.zh: 萨拉：这张桌子你花了多少钱？托尼：二十欧元；我稍微还了还价。

messages.speaker: Sara (朋友)
messages.zh: 这张桌子你花了多少钱？
messages.en: How much did you pay for the table?

messages.speaker: Toni (买家)
messages.mt_spoken: Għoxrin ewro; iġġebbadt ftit fuq il-prezz.
messages.mt_standard: Għoxrin ewro; iġġebbadt ftit fuq il-prezz.
messages.zh: 二十欧元；我稍微还了还价。
messages.en: Twenty euros; I haggled a little over the price.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把四个义项分别配成小卡片：绳子被拉、会议拖长、市场还价、节省开支；这是记忆分组，不是词源解释。

teaching_sense.en_definition: To take part in a fight or quarrel, or to struggle against someone or something.
teaching_sense.zh_definition: 参与打斗或争吵，也可指与某人或某事物抗争。
teaching_sense.mt_definition: Ħa sehem fi ġlieda jew tilwima, jew ħadem b'saħħtu kontra xi ħadd jew xi ħaġa.

sense_translations.zh_definition: 打斗；战斗；斗争。
打架；争吵。

sense_translations.en_definition: to fight (something), to fight with or against
sense_translations.zh_definition: 与某人打斗或争吵；对抗某事物；与……斗争。

formal.mt: Il-kumitat iġġieled kontra l-inġustizzja u talab trattament ugwali għal kulħadd.
formal.en: The committee fought against injustice and called for equal treatment for everyone.
formal.zh: 委员会与不公正作斗争，要求人人获得平等对待。

colloquial.mt: Lara: Għaliex iġġilidt ma' ħuk? Mark: Għax ħa l-ktieb tiegħi bla ma staqsieni, imma issa għamilna paċi.
colloquial.en: Lara: Why did you quarrel with your brother? Mark: Because he took my book without asking me, but we have made up now.
colloquial.zh: 拉拉：你为什么和你兄弟吵架？马克：因为他没问我就拿了我的书，不过我们现在已经和好了。

messages.speaker: Lara (朋友)
messages.zh: 你为什么和你兄弟吵架？
messages.en: Why did you quarrel with your brother?

messages.speaker: Mark (朋友)
messages.mt_spoken: Għax ħa l-ktieb tiegħi bla ma staqsieni, imma issa għamilna paċi.
messages.mt_standard: Għax ħa l-ktieb tiegħi bla ma staqsieni, imma issa għamilna paċi.
messages.zh: 因为他没问我就拿了我的书，不过我们现在已经和好了。
messages.en: Because he took my book without asking me, but we have made up now.

cognitive_memory_aid: 把这个动词放进两个场景：兄弟因书本争吵，以及人们反对不公；用具体冲突和抽象抗争一起记住它的范围。
